googleReviews.author: Richard Rapp
googleReviews.text: I was very pleasantly surprised by all three phases of this dining experience. Came in on a tueday night round 8 to have a low key birthday celebration. It was a slow night there which afforded us the opportunity to have our ouck of tables. The ambiance reminded me of a cross between an old mobster lounge and an artistic boutique dive bar, though i dont mean that with a negative connotation. The lighting and the vibe was fairly unique and appreciated. Not upscale and trendy but with style. The menu had a nice variety of fairly inspired and original options. A number of vegan options.  It ranged from glorified pub food and premium casual. Pricing was very reasonable and felt on target. Our selections were pretty well executed and everything was delicous.  A special acknowledgement of the "apple pie egg rolls" desert. They exceeded our expectations and were a delicous inspired treat that was a perfect conclusion of the meal, portioned nicely for 2 people  The service was excellent. The girl who waited on us was quick, and on top of it, attentive in the perfect degree for this type of establishment. From a co owner of a restaurant, (experienced in serving, bar tending and cooking) i'd like to give credit where due. The gypsy parlor was an excellent experience, my compliments to the staff. I will definitely stop in again the next time i am in buffalo and would absolutely recommend the establishment

googleReviews.author: Francois
googleReviews.text:
Got a Ginger Beer, sat down. Alot on my mind. The bartender with the white Adidas hat and rainbow armband gives me a funny look when I order a Ginger Beer.

"It's 6 dollars" he says.

"That's fine." I respond.

I extend my card.

"There's a ten dollar minimum." He says.

"That's fine." I respond.

Several minutes pass and he brings me a shot cup which I did not ask for.

"What's this for?" I said.

"It's a ten dollar minimum."

"That's fine, just charge me 10 for the ginger beer."

He brings me another ginger beer which I did not ask for.

"I don't need another one just charge me $10 for the one." I said

"Minimum is actually $12."

As I prepare give the man grief, the lady next to me engages me in conversation. While we're chatting he comes back and gives her her bills and she signs.

She's still chatting with me and after five minutes or so I'm still waiting for my bill.

Next time he passes by, I ask him for my bill. He looks around befuddled and realizes he gave my bill to the lady next to me and she signed my bill (with a tip) and he gave her my card.

Mistakes happen. I was willing to let it go. Until he said.

"Well, she signed it, you were charged $16. Want a copy of the receipt?"

It was the callous corporate tendency to not take responsibility for one's actions while expecting customers to take full responsibility for even the smallest slight.

I got loud and told him he needed to void it and print a new one for me to sign.

He got loud with me and threatened to ban me from the establishment. I told him no problem as I intended never to return. He paid me $6 in cash which ended up going to the lady's bill (by my own choice) as she was nice and her card declined.

I left lower than I'd entered and $16 poorer.

Next time, I'll just go to Fugazi.

googleReviews.text:
If you’re looking for one of the best bars in Elmwood Village, you have to check out Milkie's Elmwood Lounge in Buffalo. This place has an awesome neighborhood bar vibe with great drinks, friendly bartenders, and some of the best live music and entertainment in Buffalo. They regularly host karaoke, comedy nights, open mic events, DJs, and local bands, so there’s always something happening.

The bar food is surprisingly amazing too. The house-made wings, chicken tenders, chopped cheese subs, and curry onion rings are incredible, and they even have great vegan and vegetarian options, which you don’t see at many bars.

The atmosphere is cozy, fun, and perfect for hanging out with friends, playing games, or discovering new local bands. If you want a Buffalo dive bar with great food, live music, and a welcoming crowd, Milkie’s is definitely a must-visit.

I came here from Chile with no intentions other than to eat 10 wings and have a beer on Nov 22, 2025.

Instead, I was a part of a 3 hour debate as to whether when a heavy metal band like Pantera does a power ballad…is it no longer “metal”?

The clear answer is “correct”, a power ballad is not “metal” even when from a traditional metal band. Never. It’s a ballad.

So we spent the next 3 hours ensuring the Pantera-lover understood that Blondie wasn’t a hip-hop band just because they did one rap song.

The gentleman Pantera fan, age 65, secretly told me that he thinks the Goo Goo Dolls are awful and keeps it to himself because he knows Buffalo folks milk the Goo Goo Dolls for Buffalo goodness.

So if you want to argue is Dolly Parton is metal, or Less Than Jake is metal, or country music songs that talk about kickin’ ass is a “metal” song because it’s a metal-type mindset…its not metal.

BTW…here are the wings. They were great. Order extra crispy.

We also got onion rings…extra crispy. They were as good as the Sabres 8-goal scoring win the night before.

Secret Tip: if you order sugar-free Cherry Bombs AND you look like a young Chris Farley; the bar will offer free shots.

The speakeasy phrase for getting free post-Cherry bomb shots is: “Norwide? Your mom is nonwide!”

I've come to Duba with my girlfriend a couple of times now, and each time I've enjoyed my experience. The music they play, along with the drinks and food they serve, are consistently pretty solid. The atmosphere is definitely my favorite part.

Overall Ratings
Atmosphere: 5/5
Service: 4/5

Atmosphere:
Probably one of my favorite restaurant/bar spots I've been to. The place is clean, inviting, and has a vibe that keeps you wanting to stay awhile. Not only do they offer happy hour drinks, but they also have happy hour food options. There's enough variety on the menu to make you want to come back for another visit.

Service:
The service is good. Staff are friendly and check on their guests frequently without being intrusive.

What We Ordered:

-(Drink) Soju

-Honey Butter Chips (It’s good, but you do need to mix the butter and honey a bit, or at least wait until the honey cools slightly, otherwise it won’t mix well, as we learned)

The atmosphere was perfect, and the karaoke system is always up to date with the latest Korean hits, which made the night even more fun and energetic. Choosing DUBA was honestly the best decision I could have made for my birthday.

The food was outstanding. The chicken wings were easily some of the best fried chicken I’ve ever had in the U.S., and the Korean-style BBQ pork back ribs were absolutely delicious—tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked.

googleReviews.author: George Hayes
googleReviews.text:
There’s a reason McGillin’s Olde Ale House has been around since 1860. Places don’t survive that long unless they’re doing something very right, and this one absolutely is.

It’s a little tricky to find at first since you enter through an alley, but that just adds to the charm. The bar has been there so long the city grew up around it, and once you step inside you can feel the history.

We stopped in for lunch and started with the fried Brussels sprouts, one of their specialties. I would never normally order Brussels sprouts, but I’m so glad I did here—they were crispy, flavorful, and excellent. I had the open-faced roast beef sandwich, which was classic, hearty, and done right. My wife had the shepherd’s pie, which was comforting and filling, exactly what you want in a place like this.

We also had a couple of craft beers, and even with that, the bill was shockingly reasonable—about what you’d pay at a fast-food restaurant. For the quality of the food, the beer selection, and the atmosphere, it’s an incredible value.

McGillin’s Olde Ale House is authentic, welcoming, and timeless. I can’t recommend it highly enough. If you’re in Philadelphia, this is a must-stop.

googleReviews.author: A Girl Loving Food on Chinco
googleReviews.text: Charming bar that everyone loves. The Christmas decorations were so cute and beautiful. The oldest bar with the best service. The fish and chips were so good. I had an egg nog martini that was amazing. You need to visit here, if for nothing else the charm and atmosphere.

It's noteworthy that you can get a stout but it will not be a Guinness. They have rightfully boycotted the brand for opening up Guinness sponsored pubs to complete against them. Good for them!  I tried the O'Hara's stout but it wasn't for me. Avoid any highball cocktails bc the glass is full of ice and thimble sized. Order your whiskey neat. All said,it is my Philly home away from home! Unapologetically Philly through and through.

googleReviews.author: Abby
googleReviews.text: Luke donated his entire night to providing DJ and karaoke services for our fundraiser last night, let me tell you, RAD is AWESOME!! There are not enough words to express my gratitude towards this company. His set up is professional, he gets the crowd going and he’s a great singer too! He has an endless list of songs to choose from. Absolutely recommend RAD for your next event, you won’t regret it!!

googleReviews.author: Ceri Marino
googleReviews.text: Rad Karaoke was a wonderful addition to our high school group holiday party. We booked a private room at PJ Whelihans and my students enjoyed requesting almost any song they could think of and really enjoyed their time together! Cost was great considering when students weren’t singing we had music playing the whole time!

about: Bob and Barbara's Lounge is a bar in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It holds a 4.6-star rating from 622 Google reviews. Worn-in barroom famous for its cheap beer-&-a-shot special, live jazz & lively energy. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Mariah
googleReviews.text:
i love this place! this is my neighborhood spot--truly has some of the best bartenders in the city and a diverse clientele. i've had many, many interesting conversations here with both staff and patrons and have also met many new friends. and they serve their citywide ($5) (which they invented btw) with a PBR ($3 a can), which is the superior choice.

i'm a single woman and usually go to this bar alone. whenever i've had problems with men here (happens from time to time, not the bar's fault), the bartenders have ALWAYS had my back (shout out to my girl, Kelly!!) both of the doormen do an excellent job of keeping things safe and in control inside the bar too.

the food from their restaurant next door is exactly what you need after a night of drinking, and the events B&B holds are the shit. they have the best karaoke night in the city, and the drag night is absolutely worth checking out. the live music and dj's also never disappoint. and during football season, they have the games on (go birds!)

it's a classic dive bar, maybe one of THE dives in the city. a MUST visit for any dedicated PBR-head. 10/10. oh! and also the bathrooms are clean!!!! what more could you want??

ps. it's cash only but there is an atm inside

googleReviews.author: Sean Kelly
googleReviews.text: Cool spot to stop in for a cheap PBR and shot deal! Depending on what night you stop in, there may be a jazz band blowing the doors off the place and cool vibes. For food, hit up the window next door for some good hot dogs!

googleReviews.author: Michael Haff
googleReviews.text: A truly special and magical place that still exists. I hope it lasts forever. One of the beacons that keeps Philly unique. Looks like more tavern from the outside. Has these awesome musical notes bike locks. Live music. Incredible beer and shot specials. Crazy cool interior. Awesome bartenders and patrons. Protect this place at all costs.

googleReviews.author: Elliot Schnur
googleReviews.text: B&Bs is just the most fun place ever!   Such a fun and friendly atmosphere, great music, and a pure Philly vibe.  The citywide special is its hallmark and I enjoy it at every visit ;).  Do not miss Bob and Barbara's.  It defines Philadelphia, its great fun, and is a city landmark.

googleReviews.author: Jefford
googleReviews.text: Cool old school vibe, cheap drinks, great service and amazing music. A jazz band was playing when I went and the were fantastic. A PBR and a shot for $5. A great value that’s hard to beat. If live music and affordable drinks are your thing it’s definitely worth a trip.

googleReviews.author: Ian Cantrell
googleReviews.text: This place was recommended several places online, and people were talking about how great the vibes were, but we got the vibe they did not like tourists. We went in one afternoon and the vibe was awful. The bartender was having a conversation with some friends or something and was clearly annoyed we walked in, even though we were patient, had cash ready, and tipped, and got out of the way. Ordered simple drinks, and he was shooting daggers at us the whole time. Room was dead silent too. No music. Everyone was whispering to maintain the quiet. Also I got zero idea as to why it’s called the “Happy Birthday Bar” cause it had no clear theme to me. One of the weirdest bar experiences ever. Best bar we went to was The Fountain Porter a few blocks away.

googleReviews.author: Frank Rinkevich
googleReviews.text: One of the last bastions of a real neighborhood bar. Dark, dingy, with cheap drinks, friendly bartenders, and a lively crowd. I stopped in after many years away from Philly and it's still the same place I feel in love with so many years ago. $4 shot and beer in 2026 is a welcome anomaly from overpriced and overly complicated cocktails. As close as it gets to perfection for dive bar aficionados!

googleReviews.author: kachia mapp
googleReviews.text: Whole experience was great. Until I seen racism at it worst. Today  the bartender chose to expose it thanks for showing me who you .Won't be visiting them any more. The bar owners daughter Rocks. Love you babe and your mom and dad. Thanks. Keisha

googleReviews.author: Linda Vanderford
googleReviews.text: I am visiting from Dallas, and this bar feels like our neighborhood bars in Bishop Arts. Eclectic decor, super relaxed and inviting atmosphere, different regulars and Ryan (the delightful bartender) greeting each other by name, it was just great. And the area is super great too, lots of options for food, and parking wasn’t the nightmare fuel it was by the Liberty Bell. Will visit again on every trip!

googleReviews.text: I love everything about this Philly bar; must go for your bday cheers!

Went here few weeks ago since I’ve never been and wanted to try the burger.  Place was pretty packed and got open spot at bar. Got the burger with order of fries , burger came out more well than I wanted like semi hockey puck but missed part where it said charbroiled lol. Was still decent but sad tomato ha. googleReviews.author: Die-no-mite
googleReviews.text: Song selection is quite limited which was disappointing, but if you’re going planning on mostly singing pop songs then you’re probably fine. Also I’m pretty upset that the weekend prices on their website are inaccurate. It says they’re the same, but the weekend price is more expensive than the weekday price. It’s a pretty small increase all things considered, only an extra $5 per hour, the fact that it’s different at all is pretty irresponsible on the business’s part for not making sure they’re website has accurate information.

googleReviews.author: sakke
googleReviews.text:
There are cozy private rooms where you can let it all out. Heard some amazing renditions here e.g., by a super talented singer interpreting "wuthering heights".

The karaoke machine user interface was a bit cryptic, but there was a good wide selection of songs, microphones worked no problemo and the sound levels were great.

googleReviews.author: David Downey
googleReviews.text:
The interior was very clean, stylish, and functional. The rooms were not totally soundproofed, but the JBL speakers were great and you were really immersed in the music inside each room. The leather sofas were in great condition and the lighting/atmosphere was fun. The room had several tambourines also, which was a pleasant surprise that made more people able to participate in the songs. The bar had plenty of options (more than I expected). The staff were friendly and accommodating.

The only issue was that the KTV system was a little confusing and had limited English song selection. Most of the songs had very strange 80s stock footage and questionable lyrical synchronization, but we were still able to find enough songs we liked to be entertained for 3 hours. However, don't expect to find all your favorite songs.

Despite the KTV system drawbacks, the experience was still 5 stars for the high quality amenities and atmosphere.

googleReviews.author: Lux Betancourt
googleReviews.text:
It was not at all clear on the website that they charge more on the weekend!

But we still had a fun time! The machines sometimes glitch out and don't play the full song, so be aware of that! I know this sounds like I don't like the place, but I definitely still do! They're the last true Karaoke place in PGH!

googleReviews.author: julia griffin
googleReviews.text: Worst karaoke place ever!! None of the songs were karaoke version. They were in fact either live performances or excerpts from Chinese singing competition shows. Complimentary tambourines appreciated. Random renaissance paintings and medieval portraiture also appreciated. Stayed an hour after closing and the guy could not have cared less. No search function - all artist names in Chinese characters. Had to manually scroll through 1,400 pages of songs. Ended up singing along to a New Years Eve broadcast from 2010. Asked for chasers with our shots and he said “we only have water.” We’ll be back 😼

googleReviews.author: Rodney Garrett
googleReviews.text:
[Update from March 2025 visit - added two stars]

After speaking to a few people and having a free night, I decided to give it another run. KJ remembered me and I half-joked about the song cutting out again and we could just do Shai - If I Ever Fall In Love (Acapella) 😏

Took 2 hours to get up - Based on who went up and when, I must've been bypassed a few times so take that how you will BUT I did get up for Lose Control by Teddy Swims without issue this time. Hung out after and was talking to someone that knew the KJ and he came up &  said he apologized & would try to get me up more next time. Tbh, the vibe was kinda "ohh you can sing ok lemme get you up next time," ya know?

It was less crowded this time around but still real busy. The bartenders inside Wanna are good but expect to spend $35 minimum.

Only other negative was when I heard a guy say "Hey there's like 30 people ahead of us but I could give him like $10 to move up the list for you?" to his friend so if that's still a thing, there are plenty of better priced options out there where you'll get to sing more but if you're trying to find a large crowd (and you're single,) this seems like a better option on that end so it's damned if you do damned if you don't ya know?

We'll see how round 3 goes.

[Original review from 3mos prior]

10pm - 7 people ahead of me. I can see the list. There's 8 of us.

11pm - 7 people ahead of me.

Ok cool let's change the song then since it's taking so long... (We both know I got bumped but whatever maybe he thought I was gonna be trash?)

Lose Control by Teddy Swims?
- "I don't have a karaoke version"
This is what heartbreak feels like by jvke
- "I don't have that either"

11:45ish - Asked if it was still 7 since it's been 2 hours since I signed up. Staff asked my name, I was irritated and said I was gonna head out. Cooled off and was like you know what? I wanna know why. Went in and asked dude why he wanted to know.

"First, no reason to be a dick but I could get you up next."
Ok one, how is that not shitty of this dude and wouldn't you be a dick right now? and two, why do I have to complain to get up there? It's been 2 hours.
"What probably happened was 20 people came up and gave him money."
So I gotta bribe you to sing? I would've had more than two drinks so everyone's losing money, esp the bartenders, and I won't be coming back.
"Look how many people are here bro."
I gotcha, so you don't need my money and don't care if I come back.
"Not really but I'll get you next."

Got that pity play - and the DJ stopped the track mid song 😂

I mentioned it on a Facebook group and apparently this is pretty par for the course there (and only there,) so that's cool.

Other thing of note:  Had to use the restroom and there's an attendant staring at his phone. One stall was dirty, another had piss alllll over, the third was manageable but the seat cover dispenser was kicked in and empty 🙃 and $8.50 for a vodka redbull with cheap vodka so that's cool...

Called and spoke with a manager. She was not about that life and apologized. She was very disappointed in the staff member. She also said that this situation was an issue they tried to resolve by getting a new KJ because old reviews are based on a guy they had problems with, and she's very disappointed to learn this happened. She said she will discuss with staff, manager, and KJ and hopes to see me back.

googleReviews.author: Mike
googleReviews.text:
Cool place in the back of Tequila Cowboy. The microphone is literally duct taped to the stand.(LOL)
But it was a good time.

googleReviews.author: marlon hudson
googleReviews.text: This bar was awesome live music playing when you walk in. So my wait for karaoke was enjoyable. Then got back to karaoke and it was awesome great sound great people had a blast and will be back again -MARZ

googleReviews.text: This is the most confusing location. A  karaoke bar inside 2 other bars/venues. No problems in getting songs or drinks but if you want a packed, popular karaoke experience this is it.

googleReviews.text: My coworker and I decided that a night on the town was much needed but wanted a different scene than the norm. Jekyll and Hyde was exactly what the doctor ordered! I loved the decor and the drinks were fantastic and quite affordable (I had spooky juice and my coworker had their signature, the Jack-O-Lantern). I also enjoyed the live karaoke and will be back soon for some good ole spooky fun!

googleReviews.author: Dana
googleReviews.text:
I LOVE this novelty Halloween-themed bar, a true hidden gem of the Southside. The bartenders are always so welcoming, friendly, and kind. Pro-tip: If you order from the featured drinks menu, you’ll get glow-in-the-dark fangs!

Jekyl & Hyde is the perfect option for a fun and different happy hour option, or getting a (quite literal) taste of Halloween outside of October. 🎃

googleReviews.author: Kasey Aaron
googleReviews.text: This was my first time going to a Halloween themed bar and it was amazing! It was also Karaoke night when I went and surprisingly enough everyone sounded pretty good. The drinks were great and the bartender was so sweet. Can’t wait to visit again!

googleReviews.author: Maura Brown
googleReviews.text: Such a fun place to spend a night out! I won a free party there which came with free appetizers and there were lots of drink specials too. The drinks are so affordable and there's a ton of options. Everything tasted great and the music was excellent! They really made an effort to include songs that we requested which made it so much fun. There's also a photo booth with a lot of different options for pictures! We loved this place and we can't wait to come back soon for their next theme night!

googleReviews.author: Emily Myers
googleReviews.text:
So fun! The band was so alive and interactive. Piano, guitar, drums and big personalities on stage. The performances were so fun. The energy was high and entertaining.

There was a cover charge for the band, but I felt it was worth it cause they were so good.

There was a bathroom attendant that I felt the need to tip so if you get pressured easy, that’s gonna get you.

The bartenders were busy and it was loud, but they were attentive and fast.

googleReviews.author: Paige Boesch
googleReviews.text:
We were at Howl at the Moon in Pittsburgh on a Friday night, and I can’t say enough about how impressed we were with the staff and security team. The atmosphere, live music, and energy were exactly what you expect from a great night out in downtown Pittsburgh, but what really stood out was how they handled a sketchy situation.
There were a few creepy guys clearly preying on girls, and before things escalated, Howl at the Moon staff noticed and stepped in immediately. Security came over to check on us, made sure we were okay, and smartly distracted the guys while another team member escorted us out safely and walked us away from the area. At the same time, they made sure another girl who had been ditched by her friends was not left alone and stayed with her to ensure she was safe.
That level of awareness and care is rare and incredibly appreciated, especially at a busy live music bar. It made us feel protected, respected, and genuinely cared for. Huge credit to the Howl at the Moon Pittsburgh security and staff for taking women’s safety seriously while still keeping the night fun for everyone.
If you’re looking for a fun bar with live music and a team that actually has your back, this is the place. We’ll absolutely be back.

googleReviews.author: Björn Ólafsson
googleReviews.text: I came here for the Live Music show. And what a show. The band was amazing. We requested very different songs and artist and they played everything perfect. They played Prince, Queen, Elvis, Tina Turner, White stripes, Dua Lipa, Amy Winehouse and everything we asked for. What a talented people! I will be back next time I will be in Pittsburgh. Thank you for wonderful night! Great selection of beers however I did not try the food this time.

googleReviews.author: Karl Schaefer
googleReviews.text:
90s night. Put in a request with tip. Not played. Heard Blister in the Sun (1983), Cheap Thrills (2016), etc. Had fun other than being annoyed that the band doesn't respect the theme or requests.

My advice, don't bother tipping the band before they play your song.

googleReviews.text:
1 star, and that's being generous.

Tequila Cowboy used to have a mechanical bull. They got rid of it, which is fitting because the only thing they're bucking now is common sense.

googleReviews.author: Michael Campbell
googleReviews.text: I went there to see a friend. Was not there. So I watched some of the Bucco game. It seemed as if one bartender was training 2 others.  Everything was good. Paid my bill. ($11.25, which was a fair price).  Put a $20.00 up. The main bartender rang me up. Put the change on a try. All good. A few minutes later. A trainee took the tray, with the money. Just asked if I paid already. "Yes". Just took all the money put it with the tips. Not even a " Thank you". I didn't say anything, because she was training and didn't want to embarrass her. It was only $8.75 When back that way. I will stop by again. Just hope this was just a rookie mistake. No I don't want anything. We were all young before. Oh, the remolding looks great.

googleReviews.text: Stopped in for lunch the other day and I love what they have done with the place. It's all brand new inside and recently renovated. I sat at the bar and had a 1/2 pound burger. Ghost pepper cheese, bacon and a side of hot bbq sauce to dip my fries in. Fries were fresh cut and the wings were super crispy. They also have Stoney's available in bottle which was a huge plus!

googleReviews.text: We love this place but was a little disappointed to see a lady at the bar with her dog. The dog licked the bar. The Dog did not display anything that established it as a comfort dog. When asked the server if this was now a dog friendly bar she shook her head no. Yet no one told this lady to take her dog out. We really love this spot but I’m sure if I walked in there with my two 65lb dogs I would be turned away for sure.

googleReviews.author: Lemlem Gayeem
googleReviews.text: I wanted to give a specific review about the DJ (Zero) who is there Tuesdays for karaoke. I have been coming here for a while, specifically for karaoke nights. Every time I am there, he is attentive and kind, and genuinely cares about the people who come in the bar. On occasion, if someone has had a little too much to drink, he notices every time and ensures they get home safe. I recently had an experience where my friend was out alone, and he helped him home. It is extremely valuable to know that if one of my friends or I is out at Belvs there is someone there who genuinely cares. Much respect to Zero!!!

googleReviews.author: James Delahanty
googleReviews.text: I honestly don't get the negative reviews. This was our first visit to Belvedere's and I have to say that I had a great time! It was just a Thursday, so it wasn't crowded, but that's perfect. It's very hard to appreciate a space when it's so crowded and you can't just enjoy yourself. The guy at the door was very kind, scanned our ID's and stamped our hands. The place was empty, but people where enjoying themselves playing  pool on one of the 3 tables. Very relaxed environment this day. The bartender was great and we had a good converstaion. The dance floor is huge, but I can see how it can get crowded on the weekends. The lights and staging is amazing, super disco fun! Honestly, I enjoyed the vibe. Will most stop by for casual drinks, pool and converstaion. We didn't try any of the food, so can't share any info on that. Overal a nice, big  venue.

googleReviews.author: Madi Danielle
googleReviews.text: Absolutely love this bar. They have a ton of different events listed on their website including line dancing on Wednesdays. The bartenders are amazing as well as the rest of the staff. The establishment is cleanly and welcoming of everyone including the lgbtq+ community. They card and the door and take cash or card.

googleReviews.author: Mitchell Henschel
googleReviews.text: Line dancing on Wednesdays is awesome, but the bar kinda sucks. Drinks are cheap, but the bouncer always acts pissed off and the bartender held my card hostage while chatting with every patron on a slow night (I had to ask him 4 times to close it). Also too small for the crowd. 412 step should consider a different venue.

googleReviews.author: Hopie Bee
googleReviews.text: Is no one paying attention to the number of negative reviews regarding the bouncer?! He’s on a serious power trip, tossing people out for reasons not indicated on the rules of conduct. Zero respect for the LGBTQIA+ community. I’m deeply saddened as this was my favorite place to dance, but they’ve lost my business.

googleReviews.author: Kelsey Cintolo
googleReviews.text: We booked a private room for a friend's farewell gathering, and were so impressed! The set up was great (and we didn't even really take advantage of all of the features!) and easy to use, staff was amazingly helpful and came immediately when we hit the call button, and the ambience was super cool (futuristic feel, great lighting) and fun. Kaitlin was incredible! We'll definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Joanna Cao
googleReviews.text:
If I could give the bouncer/bartenders negative stars, I would. The bouncer was too rude to listen to our explanation that the US territory, Guam, was a real part of the US. My friend had a Guam ID that qualified for TSA Real ID but not for this unserious bouncer’s delusional requirements. Never come here if you value your money or time. The bartenders also proceeded to pretend like they did not understand ID and liquor laws despite being bartenders, and spent their time deflecting issues to the bouncer (Which is fair, I am sure they deal with their fair share of belligerent drunks, but my friends and I were fully sober, 23+ and denied drinks and wristbands to obtain drinks by the bouncer because one persons ID was from Guam) Please take your hard earned money somewhere where they hire people who are smart enough to google what qualifies as a valid ID, this place is run by mostly fools.
——-
Appending a bit more to this review after leaving. The manager of Viva noticed this review less than 5 minutes after its posting and proceeded to seek me out at our booked room by name (which he could not have known without seeing this review) and attempted to justify this behavior from his untrained staff. He explained that they could not take the ID, which was fair, but we were told the rest of us were allowed to drink, just not in the room. I went to order a drink and was subsequently denied after being informed I did not have a wristband, which the bouncer should have supplied me with after verifying my ID. I asked the manger why we were not given wristbands or informed about the wristband rule, and why our coat pockets and bags were searched by the bouncer despite the bouncer letting multiple people in after us without checking ID, pockets, or bags. He attempted to justify this behavior by giving an anecdote about a group of underage BU students from the week prior, which does not mirror this situation, because no one in my group was underage, they just couldn’t validate the Guam ID. The manager then attempted to say that he wanted to make it right and would comp our time, and stated that they were actually being very nice by allowing us entry despite being late to our reservation. I want to make it EXTREMELY clear that they did not comp our time, in fact they actually charged us extra for being late and for staying longer (which we assumed we could do because we were informed our time would be comped for this issue). Please do not come here, the management is only concerned with saving face, appearances, and money. I have no doubt these people retain absolutely no morals or respect for any of their customers, and that they purely operate on delusions of grandeur and lies. Save your money, time and energy.

googleReviews.author: Kassandra Deo
googleReviews.text:
We definitely had some nice servers but the server that took our food order was dismissive and honestly just rude about my food allergies. I can have anaphylaxis reaction to certain foods so I was not okay with that experience.  And I asked the same server about the food/ portion sizes,  she was being very indirect and misleading. We felt kinda pressured to buy the bigger sizes.  I asked other servers plus the manager if I’d be able to tip a specific server for their good service and was told no- this is atrocious. All the tips are pooled. It felt really bad not tipping anything but there was no way I could let the food allergy situation be tipped.
If it’s not me that has an allergic reaction from the food it will be the next person with allergies- this cannot be rewarded with a tip or it will happen again. I should be able to hand a cash tip to a server that was friendly and helpful without having part of that tip go to someone that gets annoyed about doing their job and logging in life threatening food allergies. I didn’t eat the food because I just didn’t feel comfortable doing that, but my friends that did eat it said it was not good. The positives I can write is that there were other servers that were friendly, and the manager was very understanding of me taking off the auto gratuity. The ambience is also nice. The system was kind of delayed and didn’t have all the songs we wanted.

googleReviews.author: Laura Nobrega
googleReviews.text: i loved viva!! my friends and I went there a couple days ago as a walk in and the whole staff was really friendly and attentive. we had a room and our server Mj was amazing, she made sure we always had drinks, helped us figure out the systems and even brought us a new microphone when one of them ran out of battery. we had so much fun, and loved that there's also a karaoke option outside of the rooms:) will def come again

googleReviews.author: Rafelin N
googleReviews.text: I had an amazing time at Viva Karaoke! The atmosphere is super fun and welcoming, perfect for a night out with friends. The song selection is huge, so there’s something for everyone, and the sound system is actually really good. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed the whole night. Drinks were great, vibes were on point, and the whole experience was just a blast. Definitely one of the best karaoke spots I’ve been to — I’ll 100% be coming back!

googleReviews.author: Pamela Medina
googleReviews.text:
It’s a Tuesday!! Showed up here with a group of 7 for our first time and decided to brave it out and hit the main stage instead of hiding in a private studio room. The best part was that the place was basically empty, so it felt like we rented out our own personal private concert venue.

We sang multiple songs. Repeatedly. Zero shame. Back up dancers and everything, we were in our main character energy.

IDs are required whether you’re drinking or not, so just bring it. The DJ was solid and played good tunes in between sets. Just know it is LOUD (as it should be), so prepare your vocal cords and your ears. The lighting is also very dim so be prepared for that too.

A few of us got drinks and they were good, no complaints there. Staff was friendly and the vibe was chill.

Bathroom was clean overall, but most of the stalls didn’t have toilet paper… which you unfortunately discover after you’re already committed. That part? Annoying.

Overall though, we had a really fun night and would definitely go back,  especially on a slower night for some of us that aren’t that brave.

googleReviews.author: Natalia Cohen
googleReviews.text:
We recently celebrated my friend’s birthday at Stage Karaoke, and it was such an amazing experience! The atmosphere was lively and fun, the sound system was great, and the VIP room made it perfect for celebrating with friends. Everything was clean, well-organized, and set up just right for our party.

A special shoutout to Luisa, and all the staff, for the outstanding customer service! They were incredibly friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the night. They truly went above and beyond to make my birthday celebration feel special and stress-free.

If you’re looking for a fun place to host a birthday party or just have a great night out, I highly recommend Stage Karaoke. I’ll definitely be coming back! 🎤🎉

googleReviews.author: Deb Ryan
googleReviews.text: Since the first time I stumbled upon this space, I have felt nothing but welcomed and catered to. Every staff member is a genuinely kind person who enjoy making the atmosphere top notch. Patty is one of the welcoming faces that greets guests as they come in and I’ve even had the privilege of singing with her during my time at stage. She’s a bright light there! Sharon the general manager truly is one boss of a woman. She has so many ideas when it comes to events, food/drink, and overall vibes that Stage carries and she does an exquisite job executing. Not to mention she’s another member who makes me feel very included and special when I go in and it’s something that I feel like is hard to find anywhere, especially in a city. I had the honor of singing with her as well and that goes to show, not only that desire to connect with customers but also the hidden talent that all of them share musically and artistically. 10/10 would recommend any day of the week!

googleReviews.author: Jung Hyun Choi
googleReviews.text: They upgraded the Korean karaoke system and it’s the best! Now all the newest songs are released and my group had the most fun. Especially Dan who took care of our room was super attentive of our needs and provided the best service throughout. Will definitely revisit for Dan!

googleReviews.author: Luis Perez
googleReviews.text: This place Stage Karaoke in Allston is super amazing. It is a must go i totally recommend. I went this Saturday with friends and Service was amazing the bartender name Will was super nice with us and greet us in a very profesional way, super cool person with a GREAT costumer service. Food was really good, we had appetizers so delicious. Love the sweet potato French fries the wings  and a soft bite which I don’t remember the name. Drinks were pure heavenly deliciousness!

about: Station Bistro & KTV is a ktv lounge in Boston, Massachusetts. It holds a 3.6-star rating from 385 Google reviews. Open-late karaoke lounge with private rooms providing a varied song list & dining on bento boxes. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Judy Ha
googleReviews.text: This place will nickel and time you and feels money hungry in a way that I didn't like or feel comfortable with. They charge a mandatory 18% service fee despite no service, and also expect tips added on after that. There isn't much care or context or instructions and alot of expectations to give money. You cannot bring any food or water in and one bottle of water is 3.50! The system was so outdated and had no good selection of songs. If you wanted to look for a song or artist they only let you type the first 3 letters and after that they show you that they don't have it. We spent so much wasted time trying to navigate an old system with not many songs and searching for songs in-between songs cost so much time. The people are dismissive and not very warm with high expectations for money. They keep your ID and credit card which is shiesty. Be careful to not go past your time because they will charge you by the minute but not tell you how much the minute cost. If you're going to have such high expectations about money and be so money hungry, at least provide something of value or have a better attitude and take care of your customers. Not the most comfortable place, couldn't recommend.

googleReviews.author: Yay!
googleReviews.text:
Caution going here! Shady and greedy business.

When making a reservation over the phone it was quoted, “$28 per hour”. However, despite our only additional expense being an overpriced bottled water, our bill came out to a whopping $53 for ONE HOUR of a measly KTV experience.

They automatically charge you 18% for a service fee, yet do not provide basic service like letting you know when time is running out, tap water, or how to use their machines. And then they expect more tip on top of this like what service are you even paying for?

They also hold both your photo ID and Credit Card during your stay. They do not explain why they need both. Feels awfully shady and redundant.

I have been to many karaoke spots across the country and abroad, and some have had their own rough edges, but I always felt good enough after to overlook these things thanks to helpful staff or cheaper prices. This place has neither.

0/10 mid karaoke place I’ve ever been to

googleReviews.author: John Kim
googleReviews.text: NEVER EVER come here it is absolutely the worst. first off, they hold one of your credit/debit cards, and make you sign a form stating that they will take an automatic 18% service fee, for like no service except bringing you to your room. it makes no sense. after that, when you go to the room, the song selections are so limited. could not find half of the songs i wanted to sing and these are popular popular songs we are talking about. every other place i have been to always has the songs i want sing. ON TOP of all of this, they charge like hella for each cheap plastic water bottle, which should not cost that much. they will also charge for the time that is not spent in the room based on reservation times, which is absurd too. this place prioritizes making money over anything, and i will never ever support a business that neglects customer service and experience purely for profit.

googleReviews.author: Liana Sanchez
googleReviews.text: Horrible experience. Had a group of 25 with a reservation and called multiple times over the week leading up to it to confirm our timing and reservation. When we arrived (after calling 15 minutes into it) they told us they gave our room away without calling us, telling us the late policy, or having us sign any sort of policy notice. We have come multiple times before and have never heard of this or been penalized for being late. When we asked how long until the next room (our room was still booked for us for another hour and a half) they said they wouldn’t let us have one and that they were booked for the night. Our entire group of 25 was waiting and they did not try to come to any sort of reconciliation, only shunning us away. Ultimately letting someone else have the room who had no reservation and not checking with us at all. We have never had that experience before (we go annually) and will not be going back because of this.

googleReviews.author: Shea Belsky
googleReviews.text: Good audio quality and TV in private rooms. The touch screen is a bit hard to use and kind of confusing. When browsing English songs, there aren't a lot of options for a wide breadth of artists. Our private room also got very hot, and there wasn't a way to adjust the fan. There isn't a great alcohol selection - you need to buy an entire bottle of wine instead of just a single can or small bottle of alcohol.

googleReviews.author: T. Goda
googleReviews.text: Very cool!  Loved the vibe,  service,  food. Order the pork belly bao buns, cauliflower, mac & cheese and pork dumplings! Thanks Julian for the great service.  Our team were exhausted from our first day conference and starving!  We were energized by the wonderful dinner, your attention to detail and the lounge ambiance + live music!

googleReviews.author: Natalie Gordon
googleReviews.text: Had the pleasure of meeting Sean who made my night! We went for a few beers and some late night food and it was exactly what we were looking for. We tried the empanadas, fried pickles, and truffle fries- everything hit the spot. There are so few bars that have decent late night food. I will definitely be frequenting Lucky’s. Great crowd and good vibes down there I’m excited to go back next weekend!

googleReviews.author: Kevin Wallace
googleReviews.text: Food was fantastic! Smash burgers and pork dumplings were so good! Miranda (?) is a fantastic bartender! Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: karina k
googleReviews.text: It was super busy today due to the AFP conference at the Menino Conference center. But the bartender handled it well. Pizza and drinks were ok. It’s a casual and dimly lit venue and can handle big crowds.

googleReviews.author: Liam R
googleReviews.text:
Wish I could rate zero out of 5.
Worst bar crawl I have ever been on, no exaggeration. To start things off the Guinness was barely drinkable and served in a Bud Light glass! Absolute sacrilege! Any Irish person knows that that’s unacceptable.
Signed up for the St.Patrick’s day pub crawl (wasn’t cheap!) and got our free drinks (3) to be fair but it went downhill from there. We were given a sheet with the list of bars on the crawl & the organisers were nowhere to be seen. We had to make our own way around the bars by ourselves which is against the spirit of a pub crawl!!! We could have done that ourselves - what is the point in that?! Zero atmosphere in some of the bars, I’ve had more fun at funeral. Absolute waste of time. ZERO /10

googleReviews.author: Ryan Wilson
googleReviews.text:
Karaoke night at Wild Rover was an absolute blast! I went with a group of friends and we had an unforgettable time. The energy in the room was electric — everyone was singing their hearts out, cheering each other on, and just vibing together like one big party. The crowd was super fun, the staff kept the drinks flowing, and the DJ kept the night moving with an awesome lineup of songs.

As a guy, I’ve gotta say… I definitely caught a few other guys checking out my butt, which honestly just added to the wild and carefree fun of the night. No complaints — the whole atmosphere was playful, inclusive, and full of good vibes.

If you’re looking for a place to let loose, sing badly (or brilliantly), and make some memories, Wild Rover is the spot. We laughed, we sang, we danced, and we’re already planning to come back again. 10/10 night.

googleReviews.author: Brad Souto
googleReviews.text: Went to Wild Rover last night, Gabby the bartender made the night fantastic. She was very welcoming, efficient and kept me laughing the whole night. Her drinks were delicious, made sure my water glass was always full and all while helping to train a new hire behind the bar. 10/10 would recommend and will absolutely be returning

googleReviews.author: Riley L
googleReviews.text: It’s a fun bar on the weekdays, the weekend staff don’t know how to handle a crowd. They only take cash for their covers when all bars in Boston take card and the lady taking the cover shoved me out of the way while I was trying to explain I already paid to get in. We were charged for shelf tequila when we asked for well. Overall, on the weekends? Not it. Try on the weekends though, fried pickles kinda eat.

googleReviews.author: Kayn
googleReviews.text: Extremely disappointed with the bouncer and security here. Terrible place to have a great night out. Context is, we went during Halloween. We bought pub crawl tickets beforehand, the entire thing costing our group after 120$. We were on the line for almost an hour because of the painstakingly purposefully slow manner the bouncer took to scan everything despite the floors on all three levels being so empty no one was dancing or having fun. Yea we saw their faces. One of our members went to the front to ask if we would still be admitted if being in the line would make us miss the check in time past 9. The bouncer confirmed. When we got to the front of the line, we were then told by this gentleman that we missed the check in time and would need to pay 20$ IN CASH if we wanted admission or to go and track down one of the men giving out the orange wristband. We said hell nah to the cash (excuse me why do we have to pay extra after paying hella for the wristbands?) and then tracked down a person who very kindly gave us a wristband . Then he brought us to the front of the line so we can get admitted, and this bouncer said 'these people be lying bro you gotta be careful out here!' Why did he call us liars just to save face because we successfully tracked down a man giving out orange wristbands instead of coughing up 20 CASH EACH? He thinks he's reallllllly something. we made it in because we were not going to back down. what a nightmare and I hope yall use the money you steal from other customers whether it be from wristbands or 20$ CASH EACH to go and give your bouncers and security some GOOD TRAINING to teach them how to ensure that CUSTOMERS RETURN and buy your 15$+ cocktails cause ain't nobody here for the pathetic vibes or the mid music in the basement and third floor.

googleReviews.text: Service was excellent. Very accommodating. Chowder was thick and very good but not the best. Had to add salt and pepper. Fish tacos great and filling. Caesar salad very good. Worth a stop by.

googleReviews.author: Deb Clif
googleReviews.text:
When in such a historical US town one must stop at the older or oldest tavern, right?

Bar area was definitely carved out from a different time in American history.

Food was very good. The clam chowder was absolutely amazing! Everyone else in our party of 3 enjoyed all the food.

Definitely worth a stop if you are in the area, especially if you are visiting the historical sights in town.

googleReviews.author: Melissa Malone
googleReviews.text:
Truly one of the best lobster rolls I had while in Boston. So much lobster!!!🦞

The shrimp tapas aka shrimp scampi was very good my hubs had as his meal even though it’s on the appetizer menu.

Great service and very accommodating. We walked in with 20 ppl and there is seating around the back and we didn’t have to wait.

Maybe lucky but it was perfect for the last day in town.

googleReviews.author: Connor O'Hara
googleReviews.text: Fantastic service from the staff! Food was good, consistent. Their in house beer is as good as it gets. Would recommend if you can go during not busy hours to enjoy the area and ambience.

Was on the look to a late night restaurant and made this one my choice. Server was very sceptics despite a Saturday night very busy pub

We’ve ordered local food, the service was fast and prices affordable, very loud and hard to talk but as per my understanding this is more like a pub serving food and being Saturday night close to midnight…

googleReviews.author: Mimi Coretta Ware
googleReviews.text: The service, the atmosphere,  the crew members...I can't say enough! If you're in Boston,  go there. You'll see. We didn't order food so I couldn't rate it but our drinks, I can't remember what they were because there were so many,  but they were on point! Served!

googleReviews.author: Sophia Cotton
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been wanting to try Apex Rooftop Bar & Lounge in Downtown Boston since it opened, and Mother’s Day was the perfect reason. For $40, we got a great deal: brunch, a drink, a rose, and live R&B violin music—which was honestly amazing.

The buffet, served one level down by the chef himself, included jalapeño scrambled eggs, fried chicken, potatoes, creamy pasta, bacon, turkey sausage, waffles, fresh fruit, and a selection of cakes. While a few items weren’t as hot as I’d like, I’m pretty sure Chef Jermaine would've happily reheated them had I asked—he was super accommodating.

We even got a surprise visit from Tito Jackson (yes, Boston's own)! It was a fun touch that added to the atmosphere. The vibes were great, drinks were solid, and the entire staff—from servers to the lovely hostess—was friendly and welcoming.

I’d definitely come back, especially if they update the menu and expand beyond fruity mimosas. I don't use cannabis, but next time I’ll have to check out their store. All in all, a good experience at a reasonable price.

googleReviews.author: Nicole Melanson
googleReviews.text: What a cute spot for a cocktail. I bet it's better in the summer with all of the open windows, but was still cool. It's a small spot.  but those drinks hit.. my bartender was amazing. I forgot her name..  my drink was delicious. I had some kind of a old fashion and my ice cube was the orange juice. Plus she added in some cherries.. omg it was delicious. I hope one day this becomes a smoke lounge. It will definitely be a hit! But even though you can't smoke yet still a spot worth stopping in and grabbing a couple of cocktails! Cool vibe!

googleReviews.author: Cameron Barnes
googleReviews.text: Best drinks I’ve ever had. Had one of their versions of old fashioned . It was orange flavor with a frozen orange ice cube.

googleReviews.author: manivanh nanthavong
googleReviews.text: Highly recommended for Sunday brunch day out. $40 include brunch, buffet style. The staff welcomed us with a mimosa which is included with the ticket price. I was inpressed by the options offered. A super cozy and intimate setting. They had a 90’s rnb and hip hop theme today with a live violinist, Fred Woodward, playing. The vibes and views were on point. And $18 for garage parking down the street. This is a black family owned business and the owner personally introduced himself. The staff is super welcoming and attentive. A speakeasy hidden gem. Go support and check this place out.

googleReviews.text: Stopped in because the menu outside looked good. Had a very delicious hardy cobb salad and margarita. The server was attentive & the music was good.

googleReviews.author: Garris Kukta
googleReviews.text: I went to Sissy K's and the drinks were phenomal. Courtney's service was fast and very pleasant. She is so funny and kind and overall a good experience even on a Sunday!! ☺️

googleReviews.author: rebecca handlin
googleReviews.text: Came in after an event nearby on a friday night with a small group. Christina was our server downstairs and was so sweet! Prompt service, food was served hot and cooked perfectly! Stayed around for karaoke and had such a blast!

googleReviews.author: Donald Loughray
googleReviews.text:
Sorry, so late in adding a Review for Sissy K's in downtown Boston Harbour ⚓!
After a Harbour Whale 🐳 watching boat trip I needed FOOD!  Found Sissy K's. Great late afternoon atmosphere and I got my Boston Harbour Fish and Chips Dinner! And a couple of Beers!
Lovely staff, especially the senior lady boss!

This is Half the $-£ price of the Tourist Quincy Market, 50 metres away!  Far better Value!  Much nicer fresh cooked food!  Great Pub Beer 🍻 selection!  Proper friendly Staff and other customers!  I wish I had found Sissy K's much earlier on my trip to Boston, MA.!

This proper Pub Bar serves Gastro-Pub Food in a great real Pub Bar feeling! Sissy K's is also a proper LGBT accepting Bar!

Do NOT go to the Quincy Market!
Do not pay Tourist prices for food!
Visit this real Bar, Sissy K's, instead!

I will return when I get back to Boston, MA!

Donald - from Edinburgh, Scotland, UK.
🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 🇬🇧

googleReviews.author: Chelsea Cooke
googleReviews.text: We did not eat here so I can't comment on the food but boy was this place a good time! Came from Canada for a weekend and popped in here for "a" drink on a Friday night....well we met some hilarious folks from California and some great Bostonians and we did not stop singing and laughing from the time we stepped through the door til the time we left! Started off downstairs where we spent most of the night with some excellent karaoke tunes and exceptional service from Sean, our waiter! What was supposed to be "a" drink turned into 8-9 each, a pretty hefty bar tab and the loss of all our voices! The upstairs is a DJ'd dance floor and we had a blast up there too! Great music, great people, great time ...not so great 3 day hangover but honestly it was worth it 👌🏼😂

googleReviews.author: Christopher “DJ Chris Fiore” DiFiore
googleReviews.text:
I love this place. The food, drinks, and service are always excellent, and we are always happy when we come here.

From my own perspective as an entertainer and DJ, I personally have not found the entertainment to be as enjoyable. I believe it is very important to understand the audience and create an atmosphere that fits the guests in the room. Sometimes it can feel like certain DJs focus more on their own musical preferences rather than what the crowd is responding to.

That approach may work in a major nightclub setting, but in a local bar or restaurant, I feel the guests should always come first. This place clearly puts guests first when it comes to the food, drinks, and service. I just wish that same attention was reflected more in the music as well.

That is only my opinion, and I share it with respect.

googleReviews.author: C Ware
googleReviews.text: The food was amazingly delicious, the staff was friendly and sociable, the patio was perfect for dinner. I have a child who is picky eater but the staff came up with a solution for him to enjoy dinner with us and it worked out well for everyone.

googleReviews.author: Sarah Dirienzo
googleReviews.text: Really enjoyed my meal at dbar for Dine Out Boston! We were served by Julian who gave us stellar service. I really enjoyed the pork shoulder tacos, which was interesting because I'm not usually into tacos. The entrees were universally over salted but still quite tasty and well made and presented. We loved the outdoor seating and decor. Looking forward to coming back.

googleReviews.author: Jea Kim
googleReviews.text:
A serene escape from the hectic vibe of the Dorchester neighborhood.

Recently came here to enjoy the last bit of good weather on their patio with our dog. Their quaint patio offered a good respite with plenty of seatings, and being familiar with the finesse of Boston Urban Hospitality's portfolio, I stepped in with high expectations. A noticeable departure from their other two upscale spots, Dbar's ambiance resonated more with a laid-back, casual vibe, while the menu hinted at elevated tavern fare.

We started our evening with the Veracruz Braised chicken flautas, which aptly mirrored crispy spring rolls, albeit with a Mexican twist. However, the star appetizer for me was the lump crab cake. Bursting with rich crab meat, it danced with the creamy textures of avocado and remoulade, and the grapefruit zest lended a refreshing tang to every bite.

For our mains, we had the pork loin and the poke bowl. While the pork loin was a tad dry, the accompanying pumpkin spaetzle made up for it, offering a soft and chewy counterpart. The poke bowl, with fresh tuna and salmon, echoed familiar notes of spicy aioli and sesame soy dressing. It was reminiscent of poke bowls from typical sushi restaurants, but I still enjoyed it.

Given Dbar's location, frequenting might require a bit of an effort. However, it undeniably offers a lovely patio ambiance and a good dining experience. While I might not venture here again anytime soon, for anyone in the neighborhood or looking for a patio experience, Dbar is worth a try.

googleReviews.author: Laura Maxi
googleReviews.text:
Dbar is always a good time. A local neighborhood spot that has flavorful food with delicious and smooth drinks. The best dish of the night was the pork belly mac & cheese. The sound of the pork belly being cut was enough to stop me mid conversation 😀
The burger was ok. The calamari was a special which was a sweet chilli, papaya salad situation that was good. The mussels were meaty and the tomato base sauce was good it was just missing the bread on the side. They didn't have any dessert options when I asked but I honestly didn't need any. I left feeling satisfied and had a great time dancing as well.

googleReviews.author: Noah D.
googleReviews.text:
I brought a couple of buddies from out of town into Boston and took them bar hopping, hoping to end the night here! Instead we were turned away at the door for apparently being too intoxicated despite the light, rational conversation I just had with security.

I'm not sure what kind of power trip this guy was on, but we just went next door to the Wild Rover, which also does karaoke AND has HUGE $1 drafts. The staff at this place were  going around and giving out VIP cards to bypass the cover for groups of 6 for LIFE. Seems like a much stronger business model to me.

I guess that's why some people say things happen for a reason, because had this guy not turned us away, the night just might have been ruined by the longest waits for bar service I have experienced, and their very small, unclean bathrooms.

googleReviews.author: Sean Pflughaupt
googleReviews.text: We were in town for business and found this GEM of a place literally a 2 min walk from our hotel.  We went on a Tuesday night for Karaoke and some noodles.  We had a wonderful time.  The local crowd was amazing and loved singing along during karaoke supporting each singer.  The bar staff was attentive and drinks were wonderful!  Only critique is a minor one…they need to get a second microphone for duets.

googleReviews.author: Katlyn
googleReviews.text:
THIS WAS THE NEW ENGLAND CHINESE FOOD WE HAVE BEEN YEARNING FOR! My in laws used to live in MA and haven’t been able to find the same taste anywhere! I’m from Miami and I’ve never had anything like it - the Crab Rangoon, AMAZING Chicken FINGERS covered in duck sauce (completely different from the tenders I know) and Jen the bartender made these to die for scorpion bowls.

Then once you’re liquored up- they hired a HOST to help with KARAOKE 🎤🎶 we sung Pokemon and lived our best life. 10/10 recommend - more people need to go here!!! I’m just sorry we inhaled the food and didn’t get to take photos!!!

googleReviews.author: Rachelle Ojo
googleReviews.text: Good vibes for karaoke nights with pretty good Chinese food. Had been coming here sporadically from Providence and the last time my friends and I showed up we were denied entry due to an ID situation. All of us had our ID’s…so we were confused. The crowd that goes there are primarily white people, we are black. I never had any issue with entry up until that moment. Not sure what their deal is but they’re making entry tighter than fort knocks and this isn’t even an upscale restaurant. We were all well over the age of 21 so that couldn’t have been it either. If you are black and want to enjoy this place just make sure you have the proper identification and prepare to get told no.

googleReviews.author: C Crawls
googleReviews.text: Not accepting an Irish passport card or driving license as ID is diabolical.  Don’t waste your time and go next door to the wild rover instead when you’ll be greeted with a warm welcome..

googleReviews.text:
A room was rented for a birthday party. No outside drinks were allowed but we brought some pizzas in. It was fun you can download an app to pick your songs and add them to the queue. The room does get hot with the people singing.

If you don't want to rent a room they have a public karaoke area when you first walk in I believe it's a dollar per song and have a liquor license.

googleReviews.author: lover
googleReviews.text: if you were thinking about coming here, do not. The 2 bartenders I met working at this establishment  Sunday night are the most rude, inconsiderate, Unprofessional, and egotistical people I have ever met. My friend was greening out outside the Neptune hotel and throwing up and coming in and out of consciousness, so I went inside the bar to ask for a bottle of water and they would not let me buy one just because I wasn’t 21. Mind you, I wasn’t ID’d when I walked in the door. They told me I needed to be 21 to buy a bottle of water. And I said my friend is throwing up and all I need is a bottle of water and I would pay for it and they basically said that they didn’t care and screamed at me to get out. I can’t imagine anyone being so inconsiderate it really blew my mind. Don’t come here unless they get a whole new staff.

googleReviews.author: Kiara Berrios
googleReviews.text:
I had an amazing experience here with a group of friends on Wednesday night. Great time in the room until we went to the bar. The first round of green tea shots were nice, we paid the tab and came back shortly after for more. Another person in our party paid for this round and did not leave a tip as we were tipping through out the night and we were not finished yet.

The bartender that was on this night at appx 1130pm, looked at us in disgust and loudly tried to embarrass our friend by saying “NO TIP???”. It was actually weird. We have tipped on the other tabs. and what kind of bartender pressures someone or tries to bully someone into giving a tip? ((also he did not tip because he was being skipped over several times)). Was super disgusting and unprofessional.

googleReviews.author: Haneefah Abdullah
googleReviews.text: Boombox is one of my first karaoke experiences and I have kept coming back for almost 10 years now. With the warm and upbeat ambiance, the welcoming staff and regulars, you feel supported and ready to have a blast. I recommend everyone give the Boombox a try, and if you try one night on a weekend try a weekday too. The Boombox has a night for everyone ❤️

googleReviews.author: Elettra Solignani
googleReviews.text: I was here with a big group of friends, the drinks were great and the vibes as well. Unfortunately, the friend who gave the card to pay for the karaoke room got the numbers of her card stolen — a day later, she noticed some purchases she didn’t make on her account and had to block her card and get a new one, the bank confirmed that it was someone who wrote down the numbers to use the card to do some online shopping. That’s a real pity because we really had a wonderful time, but I don’t think we’ll be back

googleReviews.author: Melissa Caraballo
googleReviews.text: I had the best birthday celebration. The person who checked us in went above and beyond. The room got to warm and he came and adjusted the temperature. We couldn't order food because of the qr code  and he went and fixed it. The bartender was friendly and knowledgeable. We were there for three hours and it flew by. I can't wait to go back!!!

googleReviews.author: Liam Sheehan
googleReviews.text: Good vibes and friendly service at SoLA. I’m glad to support a private room karaoke business in CT because we need more of them. The song selection here is very good and the room was clean and comfortable for my party of 7. A few concerns keep this from being a 5: my room took ran about 20 minutes behind to get cleaned up, the lights in the room were not able to be adjusted, and the microphones went out multiple times while we were singing. The volume on the mics was also consistently low. Might have just been an off night for them- I’m sure I’ll be back and find out in the future.

googleReviews.author: Jonathan Behling
googleReviews.text:
Amazing. Idk why it took THIS LONG to get REAL KARAOKE. Best part is each room is soundproof, it's fairly cheap, has a lot of songs, great sound and mic, some functionality about pitch and tone and tempo of the songs. If u go by yourself you have to avoid the party rooms or they charge you. Stay w the 4-7 ppl rooms I believe, smallest room.
Manager JaQuan was very cool and nice and very patient. He waited to close shop at closing even tho I was only one there n he didn't rush me.

Will DEFINITELY BE BACK. I WISH I HAD STARTED THIS BUSINESS lol, been thinking about it for years, based on Japanese karaoke which there's thousands of in Japan lol. Still, their technology n lights are way better but I will say, this is a huge step forward .  Never again have to wait 45 minutes between songs at a bar lol.

Now you can get your Aggretsuko RAGE SONGS out in karaoke by yourself and then you'll fell better after ;) (TV show / anime reference)

I did not try any food since it was late, so I left unrated. But I will try next time, bar seemed nice.

googleReviews.author: Janelle Mitchell
googleReviews.text: This place was so amazing!!! I came here last year for my 18th birthday with some friends and the experience was beyond my expectations! I even met one of the owners of the establishment and he was so sweet, offering to upgrade our karaoke room to a bigger one since there was an open spot!! The staff was also amazing, they provided us with a cake knife (which was unexpected), plates, and other thing we requested. Thank you so much for creating an unforgettable experience! I will 100% be back!!

googleReviews.author: Yve Joseph
googleReviews.text: I had an amazing time at this karaoke venue! The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, making it an ideal spot for a fun night out with friends. The drinks were exceptional—creative, flavorful, and expertly crafted. The food, provided through their partnership with a neighboring business, was equally delicious and complemented the evening perfectly. I would absolutely choose this place to host my bachelorette party. Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Trinity
googleReviews.text: My auntie’s 60’s birthday was spent for brunch. Music was fire  for us and for everyone else.  A nice mix for family and ppl just there for brunch. server was ty and they were  was amazing. I was definitely repeating a lot and they were patient and kind. It means a lot.

googleReviews.author: John Kamishlian
googleReviews.text:
We were a party of six grabbing dinner before a show, and the place was absolutely rocking! When we made the reservation, we were told that Sunday brunch would still be going on until 6 p.m. and that it might be loud. That was definitely the case while walking through the bar area, but once we were seated at our table we could still have a conversation without shouting.
The music was provided by a DJ playing a great variety of upbeat tracks, which created a fun, energetic atmosphere—perfect for getting in the mood before heading to a show.
The food was outstanding as well. Since it’s a pub/tavern, you might expect typical bar bites, appetizers, and handhelds. They certainly had those, but the menu goes far beyond standard pub fare. One person ordered the grilled chicken Alfredo with broccoli, and it was excellent. I had the Cobb salad with mixed greens and spinach—again, much better than your average bar or pub offering.
Others at the table ordered handhelds, which came on high-quality bread, toasted panini-style. One friend ordered the Caprese panini and didn’t initially notice it included chicken—she was pleasantly surprised and loved it. We also started with an order of buffalo cauliflower, which was impressive.
Honestly, I’m probably not doing their menu justice, so it’s worth checking out for yourself. The owner was there during our visit and spent time sharing the history of the restaurant with us, which made the experience even more enjoyable.
This is definitely a place we’ll be visiting again and again—there’s still a lot on the menu we want to try—especially whenever we’re in the Hartford area.

googleReviews.author: Alexa Russell
googleReviews.text: The food here was so good!! My sister and I both got the chicken Caesar cutlet and it was amazing. My sister said it was the best sandwich she has ever had. Also, we went to watch the UNC basketball game (which was playing at the same time as the UConn game) and the workers and patrons there were kind enough to put the UNC game on one of the UConn screens. Overall a great experience!

googleReviews.author: Vonetta Romeo-Rivers
googleReviews.text:
First time here. We sat at the bar and had a fun time with the bartender, Janelly, who ABSOLUTELY knew what she was doing because my Old Fashion and Bourbon Sour were excellent. We only had apps and salads so didn’t explore the full menu, but what we had was very good, particularly the wings - they were on point - crispy and flavorful. The chili, topped with a combination of cheddar cheeses was also quite good. The salad was served in an edible taco bowl and was yummy. Sliders were solid too. 😋

There was a private event taking place in most of the dining area and the DJ was really loud, plus there were some folks at the bar whose natural decibel level seemed to be 6 million (my poor watch was warning me about the loud environment 😝), but if it’s not typically that loud, we would definitely return.

googleReviews.author: T. Hartman
googleReviews.text:
I have been meaning to leave this review for MONTHS now and am FINALLY getting around to it.

My husband and I were in town for the weekend were driving around famished and happened upon this little cafe.
I have to admit that our expectations were not very high, since it seemed to be more of a tavern than a restaurant, and had done out at a pricey cafe in NYC the night before where the food was tasty but the service subpar (at best) but we were PLEASANTLY surprised at what a great experience it turned out to be!

The moment we stepped in the door, both women behind the bar cheerfully greeted us with smiles. One escorted us to our table and took our drink order.
I only wanted water, but my husband ordered a Diet Coke and then offered me a sip of it, asking if it tasted OK.  I hadn't had a fountain DC in years and admitted that it  tasted a bit off.  One of our servers had obviously witnessed the exchange and immediately came over to ask if we were unhappy with the drink.  We said that it tasted "a little off", but no big deal. She said that the canister might need replacing and insisted on dumping out the drink,  attaching a new syrup canister and subsequently providing a far better tasting drink for him.

I ordered the Alpine chicken sandwich on a GF roll and was delighted at the quality of the prep, the taste of the chicken, mushrooms and onions but mostly was shocked at how soft, fresh and moist the roll was for being gluten free. The sandwich was delicious and the accompanying side of fries was just the way I like them: thick, crisp on the outside, light and fluffy on the inside.

As we were preparing to leave, a groom and his groomsmen stopped in for shots on their way to his wedding. When we approached the bar to ask for our bill, the wedding party asked us to partake in some shots (we declined since we were getting back on the road) but wished them all well. One of the gentlemen grabbed the two of us to pull us into their celebratory photos. =)

Overall, the food was delicious, the atmosphere upbeat, and the service top notch; very attentive, friendly and fast!

Good sound, mingling with the band members, close proximity to the show, great lighting and sound. Highly recommend for either food or shows or both.

googleReviews.author: olson34
googleReviews.text: I have been going to the Arch Street Tavern for about a year now. I mostly go when there are goth and industrial events. I always enjoy my time there. The food options are a little subpar, and the kitchen always seems to close way too early. I have enjoyed most of the bartenders there, but there have been times I've waited 15 minutes or more for busy events. Being in New England, people are not always the most open to talking to new or introverted people.

googleReviews.author: Sammi
googleReviews.text:
I stopped in here for happy hour after work and was glad I checked their parking situation. They validate parking for the garage right across the street so that saved time and money!
Overall their happy hour is great. Very inexpensive drinks ($3 beers, $5 cocktails) and the food was inexpensive as well. I didn't order any food while I was there so can't comment on it, but the beverages were good and they had a decent beer list. Our server was friendly as well and checked in a decent amount.
Recommend for a good happy hour!

googleReviews.author: Lamarrathon
googleReviews.text: Frequently come here for trivia nights on Thursdays. Good beer selections and the bar is pretty spacious. Just wish the food selections got an upgrade. It’s not bad, just could use some new items. Super fan of the corned beef, best item on the menu.

googleReviews.author: Abiola
googleReviews.text: Lovely atmosphere, caught their trivia night so the place was packed to the brim so service was excruciatingly slow. But, our waitress was pleasant. The drinks were good, I had the pistachio cocktail which I really loved. The food wasn't so good, the fries were very bland and cardboard-like and my friend said her salad was half dressing. I would say, go for the drinks and ambience but not the food.

googleReviews.author: Emery Xavier
googleReviews.text: Not a fan of this place at all. Ended up here after another venue was unexpectedly shut down due to plumbing issues. It’s not many queer choices in CT - so majority of us ended up there. It’s like we took over their space - we were all dressed in white. However, I don’t really care for the vibe here. I’m 32 and a native from Hartford. I’ve been here a handful of times and each time I wish I saved my money. Anywho, I get to the bar waited over 10 mins to order a drink, it was made wrong, and the bartender got a whole attitude. I later found out it was the owner - how pitiful. So I went to the other side, waited another 10 mins, and was skipped over twice before my drink was remade. Also - they played techno, electronica, and house with overlays from the early 2000’s all night. Where is the diversity? I should have called it a night after the plumbing issues.

googleReviews.text: Small gay club but super fun and nice interior design. Reasonably priced drinks and it is not overly crowded. Had a lot of fun there!
