googleReviews.author: Mecca Moss
googleReviews.text: I love the environment at this establishment but the bar...unfortunate. I asked for a Don Julio Repo shot, which I've been drinking all night & I'm 99.9999999% sure they served me Jose Cuervo or some other bottom shelf liquor. I could taste the difference IMMEDIATELY. Very unfortunate. I can only assume they they thought that I wouldn't notice the difference because it was late in the night but I noticed & i highly hope they do not continue this practice with their customers.

googleReviews.author: Unlesh Me
googleReviews.text: Ok, let's do it. The service was phenomenal. The bartenders are very attentive and friendly. It was Latin night. The music was good it was supposed to be a kick-off to the Puerto Rican parade. While I was there, it was just a few people. I had a mojito, which was good, and we ordered the wings and the veggie rolls. I enjoyed it. Nice  vibe. I  would definitely go again.

googleReviews.author: Ariana Love
googleReviews.text:
This is my second time coming here. The first time I came, I had a great time. But this second time was terrible. My friends and I were standing at the bar, trying to order drinks. I couldn’t help but notice a very oversized man that kept bumping into us. Didn’t say “excuse me” or anything. Come to find out, he was the owner! I overheard him using STRONG profanities to one of his employees about how my friends and I need to move. I didn’t understand why we needed to move, if we were at the bar…….ordering and paying for drinks…… AT THE BAR.
Finally, he opened his mouth and actually asked us to move, with an attitude though, of course. Once we got our drinks, we moved away from the bar and tried to enjoy our time somewhere else in the establishment. But I couldn’t help but notice that once we moved, there were a bunch of people (of lighter complexion) standing at the bar in the SAME spot that we were in, and the rude owner said NOTHING to them. Very Strange…..
Also, the women’s bathroom didn’t have anymore tissue, so I asked the rude owner if he can restock the women’s bathroom with tissue. He immediately complained about how this would be his fourth time that night restocking the women’s bathroom with tissue. When he finally got the tissue, he slammed the rolls on top of the water fountain outside the bathrooms and walked away. Very rude. That man’s customer service needs serious work. I notice he was drinking alcohol as well. So I’m not sure if he doesn’t know how to handle his liquor or what, but he definitely needs to read a few chapters in Restaurant Customer Service 101 book.
Not to throw them under the bus, but even one of the employees agreed with me and said that man is very rude all the time to customers.

googleReviews.author: Kryssy
googleReviews.text: Ok so I live rather close by to this place and this is my second time coming here. The vibes are super cool, the waitresses are super friendly ESP Chelsea! She is a STAR 🌟 in the making! Super friendly, sociable, and fun! I come for Happy Hour (Only the signature drinks are happy hour for $6) which is usually from open to 9pm. Chelsea makes the BEST drinks!! So if you coming for drinks then I suggest you come check Chelsea Th-Sat from open to close! Food is pretty decent too. I’ve tried the chili cheese dog, wings, curly fries, and Philly cheese steak. Pretty good to me! Nice and hot and ready to eat! I even got on the mic a few times! Maybe it was the liquor haha 😂 Either way I had a GREAT time and I will always come back, ESPECIALLY to see Chelsea! 😉

googleReviews.author: Tina M
googleReviews.text: Wasn't what I expected. Explanation of how things work should have been explained. Paid $30 per person and could work karoke app.

googleReviews.author: Dani
googleReviews.text:
One of the worst karaoke experiences of my life, and I've done a lot of karaoke.

This was just a tablet that connected to YouTube. If your song didn't have a YouTube karaoke version, oh well (a lot of songs weren't available).

Also, because of this interface, you can't search for songs while someone else is singing. This completely ruins the momentum. I think I would have actually had a better time at home. Especially because the pricing for this place is higher than average.

I don't understand why this place has any positive ratings at all. I think it used to have a proper karaoke system and they got rid of it. Maybe recent reviewers don't know that karaoke is supposed to be much better than this?

googleReviews.text: Don't be turned-off by the lack of curb appeal because once you find the entrance to go inside, things improve from there. googleReviews.author: Elias Benitez
googleReviews.text:
TLDR?

Make sure you stop by for the local love of our community.
Food is good, drinks are good, and you’ll never have a dull moment here. 10/10

- the friendly neighborhood gen-z hippie ^^

I’ve been in Ironbound my entire life and only started coming here this year and I’m really glad I did. I’ve been able to create a sense of community with the wonderful people here.

You really get the feel of our neighborhood with The Deep Inn (I would throw the trademark symbol for fun but I’m pretty sure Mariane would kick my ass so not doing it)

We may look rough around the edges from the outside in but if you’re willing to experience having a place to come to even if it’s just to say hello to the friendly faces behind the bar - Angelo has an amazing music range, Mauro makes a mean cocktail, Miss Jackie is honestly a great shoulder to cry on so if you play your cards right you might see her every once and a while, Marcelo is always attentive and making sure everyone’s taken care of, Paulie makes amazing conversation and Ish is always such a pleasure to be around.

There’s always something for everyone to do here, theres a dart board - which was actually the first thing I noticed when I came in. a shloo of games in the back, a billiards table, 5(?) tvs (if you’re unfortunate enough to come in when I’m here I’ll likely be in the corner watching Supermarket Sweep I’ve called dibs on that corner from now on guys I mean it). I also think I just heard something about karaoke Tuesdays?

Anyways. TLDR?

Make sure you stop by for the local love of our community.
Food is good, drinks are good, and you’ll never have a dull moment here.

googleReviews.author: Jill Murano
googleReviews.text: My husband, friends and I love to check out dive bars in the area. As soon as we walked into The Deep Inn m, it was a vibe. It was around 3:30pm on a Friday. Not a lot of people there, but we were welcomed by all as soon as we walked in - patrons, bartender Paulie Walnuts and owner Maryann. Drinks were flowing, first served by Maryann. Paulie remembered our orders and took care of us. Chatted with other folks there and had a dance "party" with the Touch Tunes with all giving song requests!  No judgments ✅ clean  ✅ dive bar essence ✅ strong drinks  ✅ positive vibes  We can't wait to go back!

googleReviews.author: Tia
googleReviews.text: The drinks are strong, lots of games to play. The smell in there is ungodly. Reeks of a place that's never been cleaned ever. I dont know if it's in the carpet or what but definitely makes you not want to come back.

googleReviews.text:
this place is a truly 10/10, 5 stars. from the food to the atmosphere, everything was amazing. my fiance and I decided we wanted to go to a karaoke place and enjoy some good food, not realizing this place is right around the corner from us! so we decided to come in, I'll be honest, we did have low expectations (shame on us) but what an experience we had!! the fried catfish nuggets were so fresh and flaky, the flavor was perfect. the mac n cheese was your typical home cooked Mac, it was perfect! the sliders were exceptional, it was a burst of flavors as soon as you bit into it. the salad was also very good. we tried the berry infused iced tea and it tasted amazing. everything tasted fresh and homemade with love!
they even have karaoke every night!! I went in not expecting to sing, but everyone who worked there were so fun and encouraging that I HAD to, and I did it without alcohol😭 that says a lot. this was such a great experience and I can't wait to come back.

googleReviews.author: Felix Poh
googleReviews.text: Wow - what a great experience! We went for Sunday brunch and ended up doing family karaoke as well! Service was warm and inviting and we definitely loved the concept. The strawberry mojito (non-alcoholic) is a must try and we also enjoyed the crab cakes.

googleReviews.author: Y JAMES
googleReviews.text: I've been coming to this establishment since they opened. At first I came because I wanted to support small minority business. But now I come because 1. The food is great and 2. The vibe is awesome. I am a Karaoke fan and it's rare to find a place that does Karaoke every day of the week. No matter what day of the week you come you can sing your heart out. The staff is always friendly, You're greeted with welcome home every time you come. Menu highlights are the pineapple rice and catfish nuggets. On Sunday the brunch menu includes the best shrimp and grits I've had in a very long time. The grits are so creamy I'm sure she must cook them in milk. And I love those chicken and waffles also. Bottom line if you like to eat good and have a good time, come to this place. And supporting a small minority business is a bonus.

House of Playokee in Union is hands down one of the best karaoke spots around! The vibe is fun, energetic, and perfect for a night out with friends. The private karaoke rooms are clean, comfortable, and create the perfect space to sing your heart out and truly enjoy the night.

The service is absolutely amazing — the staff is attentive, friendly, and goes above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need. From start to finish, they made the experience smooth, welcoming, and stress-free.

The sound system is great, the song selection is huge, and the atmosphere keeps the energy high all night long. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, planning a girls’ night, or just looking for a fun night out, House of Playokee is definitely the place to go. We had an incredible time and will definitely be back! 🎤✨

about: MICS Karaoke is a karaoke bar in Atlanta, Georgia. It holds a 4.5-star rating from 1,351 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Adri R
googleReviews.text:
I’ll start by saying that the interior is very nice.
There’s also free parking.

You will have to get checked (ID/personal).

I’m unsure if this place is black owned, but I will assume so.
Typical Atlanta “nightlife”.
Overpriced food and drinks.
$50 hookah- that tasted burned out as soon as we got it. You can make better hookahs at home.

Came for the VIP room event- their pricing/ billing model needs to be revised. There was much confusion with ordering and paying for drinks using the QR or going to the bar.

The waiters/waitresses were nice and patient.

I do feel like for quicker turnaround, they should clear tables every time they come in or send someone in to help clear the table of plates and cups.

The wings were good- they need to take the spring rolls off of the menu.
It appears that everyone else enjoyed the noodles, burgers.

Other than that, it was a great time, nothing too special.

googleReviews.author: Mr. Jones (JR)
googleReviews.text:
Mics Karaoke delivers a high-end private karaoke experience that stands out immediately. The rooms are exceptionally well-designed each space has a distinct theme with premium finishes, comfortable seating, and impressive lighting that creates a true lounge atmosphere rather than a basic karaoke setup.
The private-room format is a major plus. Sound quality is strong, screens are large and clear, and the song selection is extensive across genres and eras. The touchscreen controls are intuitive, making it easy for groups to rotate songs without interruptions.
Service was attentive without being intrusive. Staff checked in regularly, handled requests promptly,food was prepared quickly and was delicious and they kept everything running smoothly. The overall environment feels upscale, clean, and well-maintained, ideal for birthdays, group nights out, or corporate gatherings.
If you’re looking for a polished karaoke venue with atmosphere, privacy, and quality execution, Mics Karaoke is a solid choice and worth the visit!!

googleReviews.author: Drea S
googleReviews.text:
I LOVE THIS PLACE! 🤩 The Ambiance is Absolutely Amazing!! They offer food and drinks. It’s Karaoke 2.0! lol… I went for my birthday. They allow you to bring your own cake. I love it here because it’s an intimate setting with you and your friends or family. I only had myself and 2 other people with me but we still had a Blast! They have themed rooms to choose from and offer Birthday packages. I didn’t choose the package for my birthday because it was a simple hang out on my special day but it was the best! The ambiance alone makes you feel like you’re in an upscale spot. The fact that the room is reserved for you and your guests, and the servers are there when you need them, makes you feel like you’re VIP.
The price is definitely reasonable. They have mics in the room and big screen tvs that play whatever videos you want (karaoke style)
You and your friends can sing along, make videos, take pics, have fun and make great memories!
It’s definitely a new experience. So, if you’re looking for something fun and different to do, check them out!
I would even recommend it for a kids birthday celebration!

googleReviews.author: Nique
googleReviews.text: It was my guest and I first time at Mics! We had so much fun! The service was great and my event waiter was super friendly and helpful. I can't remember her name but her name started with a S. I would definitely go back again and book longer than 2 hours. It was not long enough. The food was delicious and I like that we had a private restroom in our room and everyone could order their own food with a QR code. Loved that we didn't have to split the bill. There was plenty of parking and it was free.

My two complaints are not enough older hits and the minimum of $200 for food and bev was not clear on the website. I will still go again and be sure to request my songs a week in advance so they are in the system!

googleReviews.author: Anora Wilson
googleReviews.text: Fun spot to go for karaoke night. There’s a large spacious open seating area & karaoke rooms you can book for time slots.   Plenty parking but it’s in a Busy plaza (same as mamak, sweet hut & many other popular restaurants ). Good appetizers selection with veg & non veg options at reasonable prices for food & drinks! All the food tasted great. Great for celebrations, GNO etc

googleReviews.author: Shreya Dundigalla
googleReviews.text:
Unfortunately had an awful experience at Sapphire, this is my first time writing a Google review, it was that bad. The other reviews are accurate about the mandatory gratuity and additional charges. When we walked in, we had to wait 10 min to get service and checked into our room, no one showed us how to use the room properly or how everything worked. When we walked in they asked us if we wanted water, which we assumed was complimentary, they did not share we would be charged for it nor what the price was… at the end of the night they charged us $5 for 18 water bottles… $90 for water!! We had 18 people in our room but only two mics & song selection was very limited. Additionally, our waitress was not proactive about getting our drink orders and getting our drinks on time. At the end of the night, I asked about the charges and the unfairness of not letting us know what we were being charged for but I still paid the bill. As we were waiting outside, our waitress came out and demanded I sign a waiver that I was “supposed” to sign before getting the room… it had a lot of rules & regulations about IDs and the room etc, not once was anyone in our room’s ID checked and we didn’t get an explanation of drinks/menu etc. I did not sign any waiver as it was after our visit.

Very disappointed by this experience, it was my birthday and I was hoping to have a fun celebration as I’ve been here before and had a good experience. Will not be visiting here again.

googleReviews.author: Christian Galoppe
googleReviews.text:
I really can’t say enough great things about this place!

Rebecca was an absolute pleasure to book with. She was so accommodating as I had to move my reservation back twice due to friends getting off work late. I even called less than an hour before to see if I could push back the time and she said no problem at all!

Check in was very simple. We did have some issues with the mics for the first 20 minutes of our time there but that was resolved and they even let us stay 30 minutes past our time to make up for it which was truly appreciated.

All of the staff were so friendly and helpful! My friends enjoyed the food and the drinks were STRONG and very reasonably priced.

The karaoke system was extremely user friendly with a wonderful selection of songs and the private bathroom in the room was very clean.

Thank you to the team for everything!!! This will absolutely be my go to karaoke spot for now on and I am excited to recommend it to others. 100/10 experience!

googleReviews.author: Danielle Smalls-Pressley
googleReviews.text: The setup of this place was great. I threw a birthday party here with about 16 ppl. We had room #9. The karoake was easy to use and the mics worked plus we had a private bathroom. My only issue with this place was how slow the service was. For a party this large we ordered 2 bottles and a bunch of their appetizers. Everyone arrived around 930 and we didnt get to order until almost 1045. I had to go find my server on various occasions. Thankfully she did allow us to stay an hour past my reservation. We had a blast but they have to work on faster service when dealing with big groups

googleReviews.author: camila fabbro
googleReviews.text: 10/10!!!!! We celebrated my birthday and I made reservations in advance. The aesthetic and decor from the moment you walk in are great and honestly feels and looks like luxury. Service was amazing, prices for karaoke were very reasonable and staff was so friendly. They even gifted me a fruit tower for my birthday! We will for sure be making this our new to go spot! 🙂🙂🙂🙂

I’ve been coming here for my past birthdays,
And went yesterday to celebrate again.
The prices are awesome, service as well!
My friends and I LOVE it here

googleReviews.author: Christina Hughes
googleReviews.text: Owners are very nice. Prices are great, hours are good and rooms are good size as well. No issues with mics or music, but the only problem is that there karaoke list is hugely limited. It doesn’t appear to be updated as often as it could be, and if you’re looking for selection you will more than likely be disappointed. They have snacks and alcohol too, and prices are very moderate. It’s still a great spot and I will definitely be back in the future.

googleReviews.author: Jae I.
googleReviews.text: Tonight was my first time at Happy Karaoke and we honestly had the BEST time ever. Wu (the new manager) is so kind and friendly, and made sure our entire group was having a good time. I’d 10/10 recommend this place to anyone looking for a good vibe, good pricing, and good offerings. The mango soju is the bomb. Thanks for such a good time!!

googleReviews.author: Ashley B
googleReviews.text: This is a great place to come to for families or friends. They stay open until 3 AM. When you first walk in you decide whether or not, you would like to enjoy food and beverage during your session. You order all of your food up front. They also have alcoholic beverages. I tried some type of Asian vodka that was flavored. It was pretty good but quite a lot so I would definitely suggest sharing one bottle. It seems like just a normal mixed drink however, it is very strong. I ordered the Ramen which was super super spicy but delicious. I also ordered the lemon pepper wings which wear a bit salty, but definitely seasoned. I also ordered hot wings. They were good as well. We really enjoyed singing the songs we were not at all the stars by any of the other parties in other rooms. You pay by the hour to hold the road the music is quite loud and the microphone has built-in reverb, which makes you sound better while you’re singing, which was pretty cool. You can adjust the lighting to make it more intimate or you can make it brighter. Definitely plan on coming back with friends. Follow my Instagram @rosadivina29 and check out my highlights for more places I’ve visited!

googleReviews.author: Brittany Loadholt
googleReviews.text: I am very upset from my experience this evening. Apparently they have a no handbag rule which is fine. It was new but fine. I had a water bottle so I left it at the front. We went back to the room and she said she had to search our bags. The new rule is because people have been bringing in outside food or drink. She searched my friends bag then mine. She was being aggressive while searching I warned her I had a firearm in there so be careful. She left me no weapons were not allowed. There was no signage whatsoever. I showed her my concealed carry license meaning I can have it on my person regardless of a bag and she still said no. I told her that it was for my protection & that for the future have signage or provide security. So I walked out to put it in my car. I come back she followed me to the room. She asked to see my bag I let her. She starts patting me down. I stoped her because at this point I felt violated and disrespected. She said sorry I’m just making sure could be dangerous. She ran out the room and didn’t interact with my group after. I would’ve left immediately but I didn’t want to ruin my friends night but I will never return.

googleReviews.author: Nathanel Johns
googleReviews.text:
Chill place for vibes and drinks. My friend brought me here for drinks one night stating it was “the spot” for a cool Thursday night vibe up here in Norcross. We sat outside since the inside was pretty packed.

Hookah was solid, good recommendation from the server. Frozen Strawberry Mango Deluxe Margaritas were hitting! My friend and I were over ambitious an ordered one each when we probably should shared one. And of Course wings all around.

I will say the outside patio isn’t the cleanest. Noticed a few water bugs running around. They’re normal here in Georgia and there is a water fountain out there, but most people dont want a side of nature with their Margaritas and wings.

googleReviews.author: Carlene
googleReviews.text: This place has been my go to since I moved to GA a few years ago. The wings are consistently good and my fave. When I feel like switching it up I get the roasted chicken. It literally falls off the bone. Drinks are awesome as well. I absolutely adore Cynthia and Julie. I miss Shane 😢 Ari and Jackie are nice as well. The staff is just great. This is the place you go to sit at the bar after a long day. On a Saturday night if you feel like being spicy and being home by 12 or Sunday if you want a stress free evening with something simple to eat. I love it here!!!!

googleReviews.author: Ronald Lawrence
googleReviews.text: Super lay back spot, the food is good.They actually have private rooms.You can rent a reasonable price.They have pooka and a nice size patio security is good there. Also, they have nice size rooms that you can rent out for parties or if you just want some privacy.

googleReviews.author: roderick coleman
googleReviews.text: My team has had our annual xmas party there for the past 3 years and everytime the vibe is awesome and the service is top notch. We plan on making this tradition for as long we are together.

googleReviews.author: Pat Bradford
googleReviews.text: Good spot, outside general bar is a good up tempo  atmosphere, bar tender was busy and fast... And that's excellent. Private rooms are a fun more intimate, maybe more chill atmosphere, good prompt service there too, very reasonable prices, 5$-$8 beers, ~$38 hookah... Metal detector w/ security at the door🤷🏾‍♂️

googleReviews.text:
This noraebang is always so clean and well-kept, and Gigi is the best. She always takes such good care of everyone who goes there and makes them feel welcome. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to go to a private karaoke room. This was my second time going here, and we ordered food this time and the food was delicious as well! I had an egg roll, and fries and both were delicious.

Thank you for always giving the best hospitality and care to your customers! I will surely be returning :)

googleReviews.author: Shafaa Lang
googleReviews.text: This place was a 10/10 ! Very clean, excellent service, immaculate atmosphere and great food especially the wings! Gigi was such an amazing host!!!! I live 45 minutes away and the drive was worth every minute!!! I will be back again!!!! ❤️

googleReviews.author: Sateria Tinsley
googleReviews.text: The facilities were small and not adequate for the large group for which we reserved. Location was inadequately staffed to serve a group of 30+ attendees. We were clearly placed in the small Karaoke room at best which was no better than a walk in closet with malfunctioning equipment. I spent darn near $40 for a 10 piece very small wings which looked more like cornish hen wings and a drink. Owner complained that our group ordered and paid for too much food. It was more likely that they had inadequate supplies to accommodate the customers and yet blamed the customers for ordering food. Run far and run fast from this location.

googleReviews.author: Phung Tran
googleReviews.text: A great place to hang out with your group of friends. The owner is super friendly and helpful in assisting you to use the machine (there's even a button to call the front desk). Their song selection is incredible and up-to-date. If the songs aren't up to your standard, you can also sing to YouTube, but the audio might not be as good. No smoking smell. The room comes with a disco ball when you sing. A nice place to come back to.

googleReviews.author: Misty V.
googleReviews.text:
Very nice staff at this location! $8 per hour per person. They do hold an ID and card up front at check in and reservations are recommended (especially on weekends).

Also when using the app, use YT links via your phone rather than the tracks in the app as it is a little off when doing songs. Simply look up your song with karaoke behind it and you'll be good to go!

googleReviews.author: Hazel Williams
googleReviews.text:
I have some good and bad feedback about Karaoke Melody.

The price is $8 per hour per person whether you sing or not. I’m not mad at that at all — it’s pretty reasonable. The rooms are spacious, the alcohol prices are fair, and the location has extra parking which is a plus.

However, there were a few issues. The owner smokes in the building before people arrive, so there’s a dull smoke smell. There are floor fans everywhere trying to circulate the air. Also, eat before you come… trust me.

The iPad system used to pick songs freezes here and there, which can be frustrating when you're trying to enjoy karaoke. Another thing is the way they handle payment. The owner collects at the end, so when I had a group of 25 people, I literally had to get a pen and paper and have everyone write their name and how long they stayed so the total could be calculated later. 🤦

Overall: nice location and decent pricing, but because of the issues mentioned, this spot would probably be my last choice for karaoke.

My overall score for this facility: C

— Hazel

googleReviews.author: Megan Burns
googleReviews.text: I really don’t leave reviews like this, but I am so disappointed in this place. I had scheduled my 30th birthday party a month in advance. Unfortunately, due to the winter weather, I had to reschedule. After rescheduling, I called twice to confirm they had a reservation for a room for 30 people. We showed up, ready for the party - and they don't have a room for us. We had 30 people on the way and they did absolutely nothing. No apology, no accountability, and no compensation. This place may have a great experience, but I and 30+ other Atlanta locals will never know!

googleReviews.author: S J
googleReviews.text: We are so glad that we found this place!! There are so many songs ( English and Japanese) ! People works there were so nice and room was also clean (bathroom was clean too) We will definitely go back there soon!!!!

googleReviews.author: peterloveydovey
googleReviews.text: some of the tracks were a little funky and the music volume could be louder, but the service was great and our group had a blast!

googleReviews.author: Owen Sims
googleReviews.text: Best wings in the world! I’ve got to do a lot more tasting to verify, but they’re definitely a contender. The atmosphere is great. It’s important to know that you must be 21 to eat inside—it may not apply to the outdoor seating, but I’m not entirely sure. The humor is perfect for this generation. Keep up the good work, dudes!

googleReviews.author: Noah
googleReviews.text:
I made a special trip to The Local from out of town (Memphis) based on The Studio Review ranking these as the best wings in the US, and I was absolutely not disappointed!

Despite normally avoiding bone-in chicken, I decided to give wings a real shot here, and they completely converted me. I ordered the Lemon Pepper wings with ranch and tater tots, and everything was fantastic. The wings were perfectly crispy, incredibly juicy, and beautifully seasoned, easily living up to the hype.

It was a loud, lively dive bar atmosphere, which normally isn’t my scene but it was absolutely worth it! The staff were all extremely nice and welcoming, which made the visit even better.

googleReviews.author: Nyia Morrise
googleReviews.text: The local has by far the best wings in all of Atlanta. Dare I say some of the best wings I’ve EVER HAD. The atmosphere is a dive bar, nothing special. The hype is really in the food and they run out of wings all of the time because they are just THAT GOOD.  I eat here on a regular and am never ever disappointed. It’s so good that I had to come and give them a review. I dont know what that cook is doing in the back, but keep it up. Yall have a loyal costumer over here!

googleReviews.author: Kevin Slick
googleReviews.text:
This place was absolutely amazing! Fantastic vibes, and the best wings I’ve ever had! Super tender and packed with flavor! I saw this place in the Studio Revue Wing video, and was down in the area for work, and I am so glad I decided to go!

10/10 must go place! Come early, and come hungry!

googleReviews.author: Colette Hughey
googleReviews.text: Believe the hype yall! The local wings set my soul on fire and I will be back. My suggestion get there early like when they open because you risk the chance of not having any wings because at a point they will run out and nothing is more heartbreaking than getting your mouth ready for a meal they sold out of! Also the parking lot is not the largest to plan accordingly.

googleReviews.author: Tiffany Wilder
googleReviews.text:
Went solo on a Thursday afternoon and had a blast. I didn't get the chance to get their names, but everyone from the security guard to the chef and the bartender were lovely. The wings were the best I've had in a while, drinks were strong, the music was great. And they have hookah!

It started getting more crowded as I had to head back to the airport, I can't wait to go back to Atlanta and check out Our Bar ATL.

googleReviews.author: Kien Hunter
googleReviews.text:
So if you want a hood bar experience, then this is probably where you probably should be going. LOL. It's on Edgewood so you know you have to worry about figuring out parking on your own and most likely it's going to be paid parking. Now they do have street parking so keep that in mind but that's always the first to go so just keep that in mind as well.

It seems that the food is solid so I didn't even try any food because I'd already eaten. Maybe I get to give another go on a good night and try the food to give it an accurate assessment but as of right now it was just a typical bar situation.

You'll go ahead and head to the door and get searched by security and then you'll sit down somewhere and they'll eventually take care of you. I wasn't wowed by anything and it wasn't earth-shattering as far as service goes but it was a good experience. That's exactly what I expected lol. Nothing wrong with that though don't get me wrong, but it just was what it was.

googleReviews.author: Alexandrea Brigham
googleReviews.text: I randomly stopped in here and I was impressed with the level of service i received from the staff. Chelle was AMAZING! Absolutely loved her and I plan to come back just so she can make me some more drinks 😆. The chef was patient , informative and accommodating. I truly enjoyed my experience here. Check them out!

googleReviews.author: Chicago
googleReviews.text: Service was top tier! Enjoyed the vibe and the performances were DOPE! All types of music genres really collectively vibing diversity! Drinks were definitely drinking! Cheers to a great time and wonderful vibe!

googleReviews.author: A Walker

googleReviews.author: Akira
googleReviews.text:
Stopped by while looking for late happy hour deals downtown and decided to give this spot a try. Located in Underground Atlanta, the atmosphere definitely delivered. We came to catch the Spurs vs. Knicks Game 2, and between the good music, energetic crowd, and overall vibe, it made for a fun evening.

A quick parking tip: valet was $40, which was an easy pass for us. We found street parking nearby for $10 until 10 PM, and it was free after that.

As for the food, that’s where things missed the mark. We tried the 75-cent wing special, but unfortunately the quality didn’t match the great atmosphere. The wings were pretty underwhelming and not something I’d order again.

The drinks, however, were the highlight. The lemon drop was excellent, and the drink specials were worth it—a small daiquiri for $5 and a large for $10 is hard to beat.

Overall, I’d recommend this spot for drinks, music, and good vibes, especially if you’re looking for somewhere to watch a game or hang out with friends. Just skip the food and stick to the cocktails.Here’s a polished review with a balanced tone:

googleReviews.author: Shane Sellers
googleReviews.text:
If bars had personalities, **Petra's** would be that effortlessly cool friend who knows every underground band *before* they’re cool and somehow still remembers your drink order. Tucked into Plaza Midwood like a well-kept secret, it’s equal parts neighborhood hangout, live-music haven, and late-night storytelling lounge. The patio feels like a backyard party hosted by someone with excellent taste in playlists, while inside you’ll find an eclectic crowd that proves Charlotte’s weird side is alive and thriving.

The drinks are solid, the vibes are better, and the music lineup ranges from “I’ve never heard of them” to “I’m about to tell everyone I discovered them here.” It’s the kind of place where you come for one beer and leave three hours later with new friends, a new favorite band, and a vague plan to start your own.

googleReviews.author: STACEY JOHNSON
googleReviews.text:
I was visiting from Florida and was told by locals to check this place out. Unfortunately, it was not what I expected at all. I felt completely overdressed compared to the crowd it attracted. When I arrived, there were six police trucks parked outside, each with officers inside. That immediately raised some concerns. After entering, there was a full-sized metal detector to walk through, followed by additional wand scanning, physical pat-downs, and purse searches. I even witnessed an officer confiscate and throw away someone’s eyeliner because it was considered “too sharp” to bring inside.
The entire atmosphere felt chaotic and uncomfortable. After seeing everything going on, I decided to leave almost immediately. It simply did not feel like a safe or enjoyable environment. If you value your comfort and peace of mind, this may not be the place for you. I would recommend saving your $20 cover charge for somewhere that feels more welcoming and secure. #TrustMe

googleReviews.author: Geri James
googleReviews.text:
Pinhouse was lit. I had a very enjoyable time. The DJ was cool, the atmosphere inside and outside was nice. I enjoyed playing the bowling game and also enjoyed the mocktail I ordered.

The only gripe I have is I wish the process of ordering food wasn’t so complex. You basically have to order from the restaurant next door instead inside of Pinhouse.

I also didn’t like how I made a reservation for a table online but it was basically ignored. Luckily for me the event I was a part of already had tables for us.

Lastly, I’m not really big on the new “section culture” that clubs have become, but I will say that I like how this venue has a designated area where you can dance, converse, and socialize.

That made my visit well worth it.

googleReviews.author: Alison Hollander
googleReviews.text:
I had a really disappointing experience at Boxcar Bar and feel obligated to share it.

We visited around 8:15 PM and initially everything was fine. My first drink (made by a different bartender) was great. However, when my husband later ordered a vodka cranberry for me, the drink tasted like straight cranberry juice and there was no noticeable alcohol in it.

After this happened, I looked through other reviews and noticed similar comments about mixed drinks containing little to no alcohol, which made this feel less like a one-off issue and more concerning overall.

When we politely brought this up to the bartender (who we later learned was the manager on duty), he immediately became defensive and refused to remake the drink. When I approached him myself and asked if he could remake it in front of me, he dumped the drink and told me I was “cut off.”

For context: I had only had one drink and a few sips of the second. My husband had one beer and part of another. There was no reasonable basis for that response.

From there, the situation escalated unnecessarily. Staff ignored us when we tried to close our tab, and I had to raise my voice just to get assistance. When we asked for the manager’s name, he responded with “wouldn’t you like to know,” which was shockingly unprofessional. As we were leaving, we overheard him tell another staff member to “ban her.”

We also observed beers being poured significantly underfilled (mostly foam), which raised additional concerns about overall service quality.

What should have been a simple fix to remake a drink… turned into a confrontational and uncomfortable experience driven entirely by poor management behavior.

This was not about being refused service—it was about how it was handled. If there were any legitimate concerns, they could have been addressed respectfully and professionally. That didn’t happen here.

I hope management takes this seriously, because the experience did not reflect well on the establishment at all.

googleReviews.author: Anna Hamilton
googleReviews.text:
My friends and I stopped by the Tin Roof on our night out just to check the place out, regroup and have a drink before we moved onto the next. I ordered a single vodka and cranberry juice. I had already paid for the drink and upon tasting it, I found there to be little to no vodka in it at all (two of my friends tasted for conformation). For $9 dollars, I wanted there to be alcohol present in my drink. My friend who's a bit more outgoing than I helped flag down the bartender who made my drink (upon which several other bartenders took notice as well) and told them my drink was weak, tasteless and that we simply wanted a refund, and they could take the drink and dump it if they wanted. One of the bartenders was immediately defensive and agitated, insisting there was likely nothing wrong with the drink and that they couldn’t take it back, only add more liquor. My friend asked her to straw taste it, to which she did and insisted she could taste the alcohol (of course). While arguing with the staff, my friend mentioned that he's a bar tender to which the guy who made my drink replied "Well, bartenders are more likely to be alcoholics"...

Calling your patrons alcoholics because they dare to complain about your poor service is appalling.

The woman did end up putting a splash of vodka in the top of my cup, which I thanked her for (if only to get them all to calm down and for us to exit this confrontation).

Will not be returning for overpriced, watered down drinks and terrible, argumentative bartenders. Very unprofessional.

googleReviews.text: Great spot for live music and a fun night out. Local bands play here regularly and the sound is good. The drink specials keep things affordable. The food is solid bar fare — the sliders and nachos hit the spot. The atmosphere is always energetic and friendly. The covered patio is great for warm nights. If you're looking for live music without a cover charge on most nights, Tin Roof is a reliable bet.

googleReviews.text: This venue is a work of pure love and passion to serve the local and regional music scene. I was so glad to discover a goth/metal/industrial club in the Triangle. And it's a coffeeshop and art gallery by daylight! All the staff I interacted with were warm, helpful, and professional. Many non-alcoholic options on the menu, and free water and earplugs, which in my experience is a rare gesture of hospitality at a small club. The stage and dancefloor are in direct sight of the door and bar, which is unusual and cool. Restroom clean and well provisioned. I was lucky enough to see one of my very favorite electronic/industrial artists here, very grateful they booked Aesthetic Perfection, who tours the U.S. so rarely. I had a great time in a crowd of happy people and I look forward to more shows here. Rivetheads of the Triangle unite!

googleReviews.author: Duke9023
googleReviews.text: I went for the coffee shop part and found the atmosphere awesome. I got a flat white and it was the best I’ve ever had. Will be back again if in the area.

googleReviews.author: Vianey Mares
googleReviews.text: Amazing place with delicious coffee! Also kick ass music!!

googleReviews.author: Kat and Dan
googleReviews.text:
We had the absolute joy of celebrating our wedding at the Chapel of Bones on October 17th, 2025. Honestly, it was everything we could have dreamed of and more! From the moment we first saw the venue, we were captivated by its incredible aesthetic and the way it showcases collaboration pieces from local artists. The space has such a unique, memorable vibe that perfectly blends artistry and elegance, making it truly one of a kind.

The Chapel of Bones made planning our day seamless. There was ample seating for the ceremony, including real pews, and plenty of tables to hold all of our food, party favors, and decorations. The staff went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly. Allison Robinson, our wedding coordinator, was an absolute lifesaver! Her guidance, support, and attention to detail ensured we could enjoy the day without a single worry. Our DJ, Nate Stokes, kept the party energy high all night, and every guest had a blast.

We also want to give a huge shout-out to Dante and Liz, who introduced us to this incredible venue. Without them, we might never have known the Chapel of Bones was even an option for our wedding. It truly made the day extra special.

A fun little personal touch! If you spot the bone chandelier hanging in the Chapel, that’s ours! We designed, 3D-printed, painted it and donated it to the venue, and it felt amazing to see our creation become part of such a stunning space.

Our friends and family are still talking about how memorable the wedding was. Many said it was the best wedding they had ever attended, which speaks volumes about how well the Chapel of Bones and its team brought everything together. If you’re looking for a wedding venue or just a spot to have an amazing party that is unique, stunning, and supported by a team of people who genuinely care about making your day/event perfect, we wholeheartedly recommend the Chapel of Bones. It made our wedding day unforgettable!

googleReviews.author: Stephanie Taylor
googleReviews.text: Super cute karaoke spot in Durham we just discovered and we will for sure be back! Celebrated my mom’s 53rd birthday in a large private room, $80/ hr plus taxes and services fee. googleReviews.text: What a epic bar!!!! Karaoke, bull riding, darts, and some much more. THANK You Peyton, Sarah and Jamar for great customer service. I enjoyed the experience.... I absolutely will be back hoping to see you here! :) #beaverclub #thewildbeaver #love it #sing #dance #enjoy

googleReviews.author: Browne Bear
googleReviews.text:
We had an absolute blast here from start to finish. Visiting during the off-season on a Sunday night turned out to be the perfect move, it had plenty of energy without feeling crowded or chaotic. The place felt alive, but you could still move around easily and actually enjoy yourself. And honestly, where else are you going to find $5 bull riding? That alone set the tone for a fun, laid-back night. Even better, the prices across the board were reasonable considering the location.
We ended up spending hours bouncing between activities shooting pool for just $1 a game, taking turns on the punching bag, and throwing darts. It was one of those nights where there was always something to do, so you never felt stuck just standing around with a drink in your hand. It’s a great break from the typical bar scene where your only options are drinking and yelling over loud music.
The unexpected highlight of the night? Walking into the bathroom and witnessing two guys doing a full-on song and dance routine. It was completely unplanned, absolutely hilarious, and one of those moments you’ll be talking about long after the night’s over. Honestly, that alone made the visit memorable.
The place itself is smaller, with a relaxed setup where you order directly at the bar. Instead of a live band, they had karaoke going, which actually fit the vibe perfectly and added to the fun without overpowering the room. Overall, it’s a unique spot with character, affordable drinks, and plenty to keep you entertained. Definitely a great place to hit later in the evening when you’re looking for something fun, different, and memorable.

googleReviews.author: Steven Russell
googleReviews.text: We had a few shots, we listened to some karaoke. Nice, weird joint. A little off the "Broadway" path, but well worth the time. Friendly, engaging staff. Clean venue. We'd definitely go back when we're in the area! Check them out

googleReviews.author: S
googleReviews.text: Visited Santa’s Pub for the first time and loved the experience! Fun for both tourists and Nashville locals to have a great night out! We visited on a Friday night. It was busy, but there was enough seating for everyone. It didn’t feel overly crowded. The vibe was amazing! My karaoke experience here was one to be remembered!  It’s cash only, and there is a cover charge to get in. Pricing on drinks is extremely reasonable, and they have an on-site ATM which is great if you forget to bring cash. I highly recommend Santa’s Pub! A true Nashville gem.

googleReviews.author: Meredith
googleReviews.text: Always a great time at Santa‘s pub. We hadn’t been back since Santa passed away. We visited over the weekend and had a chance to talk with the new owner, which is Santa’s grandson. Very nice guy & we were happy to meet him and see that he’s keeping the place going. Photo Booth is a must do at every visit. This has always been a favorite spot  of ours in Nashville!

googleReviews.author: Ilya D
googleReviews.text:
Finally tried this place out and it’s really cool!
Great friendly staff. Awesome and fun vibe. Very homey. Cash only, no liquor fyi. Decent beer selection though
Karaoke was fun as well!

googleReviews.author: Tran Nguyen
googleReviews.text: Truly, TRULY a karaoke bar. I've been around, so I can definitely say that the vibe here is one for those who WANT to feel like a star. Other bars that offer karaoke, you tend to find everyone is doing their own thing. But HERE, EVERYONE is paying attention to the singer. Whether or not you think that's a good thing is your discretion. I had fun.

googleReviews.author: Christeyne Phan
googleReviews.text: This place is basically a trailer converted into a Pub. I was told the original owner resembles Santa, hence the name. It is completely cash only and there is a cover charge. They offer karaoke and a selection of beer like Coors, Pabst, Bud Light. No mixed drinks. Whether you can sing or not is a non issue. I do recommend checking it out

googleReviews.author: Rob Herman
googleReviews.text: I was with my 18 year old daughter and her friend in Nashville and they wanted to experience a bar setting and dance. We googled this location statinh they accomodate 18 YO and older with karaoke. We walked WAY out of the way from main strip and had to literally walk over passed out people on the street. When we finaly got there there was noone there and it looked very dirty. We did not end up going in because the girls were scarred to even enter. We will not be back

googleReviews.author: Ettie Elmonte
googleReviews.text: hi everyone i’m a local to nashville and lived basically all my teen years hearing about broadway and how it’s gonna be so much fun to walk broadway, being 20 years old this year and summer coming up i get excited for the warm weather and the ability to go out without freezing to death, that being said i’ve been to lonnie’s multiple times and always have an issue getting in, i have a state issued ID and have no issues getting in anywhere else, the owner is very old and tried to keep me from getting in twice, to the point where another worker came outside around him and welcomed me in with my VALID ID, i happily paid and the night went on, we proceeded to use the bathroom and my boyfriend (the only boy with us) utilized the seat outside the bathroom in the back corner to wait for us while we did our business, i came out of the bathroom to him being told he cannot sit there and that these are only for women, (mind you there was two men sitting on the same bench), he then proceeded to follow us through the joint staring at us and making our group uncomfortable to the point where we all agreed it was best to leave and go somewhere more welcoming, it sucks when these things happen because i look youthful even though i presented him my valid id multiple times, he ignored me and did not care told me to “go to the back of the line”, it’s already nerve wracking enough to be in your early twenties and going out for your first times without people clearly unfit and way to old to do their job as they should, i haven’t been back to lonnie’s but it made me want to leave a review after sitting on it so long.

googleReviews.author: Joe Trail
googleReviews.text: Big Hot Dogs, great people, hopping little beer joint! Come sing your heart out. Cash only! Plus the Manager is a Star, cute too!

googleReviews.author: Julie Mullikin
googleReviews.text: We had a great time!! Lonnie's is always a fun place and this time we were able to take our 11 year old daughter. We went on a Thursday night and it wasn't as crowded as usual. Our daughter even got up there to sing too. Great time!!

googleReviews.author: First Last
googleReviews.text:
Not recommended.
Basic alcohol... nothing for us under age folks but soda and water.
Very hot and high humidity inside.  No fans or AC but a lot of sweat.  Then you leave.
There is a 5. Cover.
The sound system is muffled and it is missing a lot of the music.
The DJ likes to experiment so much that the sound is missing too much music and volume and base.  I think there is only one speaker.

And the main screen for singers went off.

address: 101 20th Ave N, Nashville, TN 37203, USA
about: Cross-Eyed Critters Watering Hole is a bar in Nashville, Tennessee. It holds a 4.1-star rating from 85 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Kelly
googleReviews.text: No idea why people complain about the singing bartenders—they’re great. This karaoke bar at the Graduate Hotel has such a fun vibe. The bartenders are super talented and honestly help keep the energy up between regular karaoke performances. Just a heads-up: drink prices are definitely on the higher side, so be ready for that.

googleReviews.author: LeAnnza Ball
googleReviews.text:
Cross Eyed Critters Watering Hole is an absolute Nashville gem! We stayed at The Graduate for three nights and ended up here every single evening because it was that good. It is cozy, welcoming, and full of fun energy without being overwhelming. The people are amazing, the drinks are spot on and the green tea shots became our favorite.

The food surprised us in the best way. The birria quesadilla, chicken flautas, tajin fries, and the apple chimichanga were all delicious. We genuinely looked forward to coming back each night!

If you want great vibes, karaoke that makes everyone feel like a star, tasty drinks, and fantastic food, this is the place! We already know we will be back every time we visit Nashville. Highly recommend and such a fun experience!

googleReviews.author: Kate Mahoney
googleReviews.text: Cute, fun, great bar staff, wonderful host! Brooke worked hard to get the party started and to keep things positive and fun. Nice mix of talented karaoke entertainers and the rest of us. Plan for noise mitigation for those with sensitive ears. The bar is super laid back but songs are understandably loud. Decor details are fantastic.

googleReviews.author: Dylan Ariss
googleReviews.text:
This is a cool little spot inside the Graduate Hotel, by the elevators. Full bar with good house drink options and a solid variety of food to munch on.

The service was great and seating was near full, but open enough to find seats for 2. The karaoke aspect is lively and was very fun to listen to/enjoy!

I was helped by Samantha, who did a spectacular job. Very accommodating to me and my mom, and was quick with service.

Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Emily T
googleReviews.text: Our bachelorette party wandered into Critters after leaving White Limozeen, after they had just opened. We were the first ones in there and were immediately greeted by very friendly staff. Safe to say we are NOT singers, but they tolerated us as we butchered every single song  and made us feel like superstars. Shoutout to Jared (if that’s even your name… we second guessed ourselves later) for dealing with us and our incessant Jared Goff chanting. You’re a legend in our group (as is the bouncer, Marshawn, who has the voice of an angel). We were bummed we couldn’t make it back later in the weekend, but next time I am in Nashville I am sorry to say we will certainly be passing through! Highlight of our weekend!

googleReviews.author: Austin Blanton
googleReviews.text:
Wil is everything.

Had such an incredible time at Canvas, and a huge part of that was thanks to Wil. From the moment we walked in, he made the space feel welcoming, fun, and full of good energy. He’s attentive without hovering, friendly without being fake, and somehow manages to make everyone feel seen — which matters so much in queer spaces.

Drinks were perfect, vibes were immaculate, and Wil’s personality truly elevated the whole night. You can tell he genuinely enjoys what he does, and that energy carries through the entire bar.

googleReviews.author: Aaron Ralph
googleReviews.text: Forst time visitor was in town checking out the nightlife. This is a nice little place  and they will not put up with people staring trouble with others inside thier bar. I had first hand experience, guy wanted to start trouble and get in my face finally got him to walk away. He than he got in his own trouble with thw staff. Staff and other i assume to be regulars check on me to see if I was okay. I shook it off and enjoyed having a great time. Thursday nights are karaoke nights and they got some people with vocals that hit that stage!!!!!!! Friday they have a DJ spinning the jams. Thanks again to bartender John aka Daddy for putting my hoodie in the file cabinet so I could get it back!!!!!! Will definitely go back whenever im in town again. LOVE YA CANVAS thanks for treating a Kansas City MO boy a great time.

Cute, unique, divey bar with 80’s decor and memorabilia. Somehow every inch of the bar is covered in stuff without it feeling claustrophobic. Curated chaos. Gwen & Chelsea on the bar were phenomenal and attentive. Karaoke was fun.

Edit: went for just a bit on my last day in town. Sarah was great! Love this place, wish I could take it back home with me.

googleReviews.text: This place is a hidden gem in West Nashville! Cheap drinks, and fun games to play while there such as pool, darts, and a punching bag. Andy holds this place down, and his bar customer service skills are excellent! I look forward to more weekend outings here at Copa! 10/10 would recommend their Birria Tacos for food selection!!!

googleReviews.text: Great local hole in the wall. Love to stop after work, get a beer and play pool before going home. Spanish version of cheers. Ravens the best.

googleReviews.author: Edgar White
googleReviews.text: Karaoke night is the highlight of this place.. Love it.

googleReviews.author: Sarah Winters
googleReviews.text: The best experience at copa! Bartenders were on point and the food was absolutely delicious! I’ll be returning soon

googleReviews.author: James Ed West
googleReviews.text:
I live across the street from Copacabana and frequent it a couple of times a month. They have great drink prices and surprisingly good food for a bar, especially the wings and quesadillas. There are darts and a couple of pool tables, along with karaoke on the weekends.

The staff is also super friendly, and the clientele primarily consists of local Nashville folks, offering a refreshing alternative to the downtown tourist scene.

googleReviews.text: Really fun place for karaoke in memphis. Area was pretty good too. Workers checked on us often. Very much a great time. Check out this place if you love karaoke. They gave us half off for food because of the situation with our card and heartbroke night. Will be back!

This was so much fun🥰excellent service and most importantly a safe space to have a good time with family and friends 🧡

googleReviews.text: Idk what else I could say but absolutely amazing. If you don't have fun here your the wrong crowd for this bar. Eileane is so sweet and really helps create the vibe. The drinks are good a bit pricey but for the vibe and consistency in drinks I'll definitely be back. So fun getting our group here for karaoke and good times.

googleReviews.author: Cori Sanders
googleReviews.text: We were visiting from Chicago and Chris (we met at cross town brewery) recommended this spot. We showed up Saturday for the end of month burlesque show, F-Ing amazing!!! We came back Sunday for burlesque bingo, also amazing. Made new friends for life. If you are in Memphis for the last Saturday of the month, this is something you need to see. Everyone is accepting and open. It’s a safe place. And the performance is like nothing to have seen before.

googleReviews.author: Xavier Coronado
googleReviews.text: The daddy bartender bear is super sweet and the front counter host was kind. Friendly guests and surprisingly good bar food.

googleReviews.author: Shelley Schoggen
googleReviews.text: The drinks are overpriced.  The event was not what was on the website for that night. People who were "known" took precedence over regular bargoers.

googleReviews.author: Nico Cagle
googleReviews.text:
My review is a bit long overdue as a longtime patron of this bar (the old carpet era & present). It’s one of the few nostalgic dives left in Midtown & the owners have put in a lot of positive changes to create a safe place for everyone & add variety to the bar. Next to Black Lodge—the Lamplighter is one of the few places you can attend a variety of events successfully. In many ways it can feel more like a cafe than a bar depending on the day & time—if you have an appreciation for dives & preserving nostalgia this is your place. It’s a local “Cheers” where it’s quite obvious many patrons know each other’s names. For me personally the Lamplighter has served as a place to wrap up work/creative projects, a place to relax after work, a meeting place for karaoke, drag/burlesque, comedy, live music, & community. Newly, the bar is providing a space for local artists to sell their work on “Market Day” something I hope to check out soon!

I’ve been saved by a lot of burgers, veggie dogs, BLT’s, & baskets of fries more times than I can count! For non drinkers they have an impressive selection of coffee, tea, kombucha, & ginger beer! The staff members are usually working around the clock & care about this place a lot—like any dive there is an element of self serving in terms of seating & obtaining a menu from the bar. The building is older but constantly getting TLC from the staff & as with any bar on a weekend night staff are more than happy to address any issues (i.e. tending to replenishing paper products etc when notified).

I appreciate feeling safe going here alone & having a safe place to express my art creatively. Most of the events held here feature a diverse variety & are fairly charged a cover to support local & touring acts. The Lamplighter may not be everyone’s cup of tea but it’s definitely my neighborhood bar; stop by sometime & sign up for their VIP membership I can vouch for the cool perks offered monthly for just $10 for those interested!

Thank you to the staff of Lamplighter for keeping this diamond in the rough alive & a place for everyone! Without you there would be a lot of lost love in the community. 💖Nico

Laid back vibe, cool atmosphere, but very different. I like that the patrons were diverse. There were all ages, all races, and an atmosphere of peace (regardless of the music, which was still cool).
We came in looking for food expecting to be served some food if not the whole menu 😆 I placed my drink and my server brought it to me, it was great!!! When I said we'd like to order food also, he said the kitchen is closed... I thought, how are you going to handle these drinks on an empty stomach? So, I sat there and sipped on my drinks while ordering a pizza. I was so busy ordering, I didn't see the dog walk up next to me (YES, THIS IS A DOG FRIENDLY RESTAURANT).
Their menu is incredible!!! There are so many options. But, I hate we didn't get to experience any of it.
It was still a great night out with my daughter that was very much needed.
Thank you

googleReviews.author: Brandon D (Brandon Blaq)
googleReviews.text:
As an over the road Truck Driver there are not many restaurants you can eat at outside of chains. And of those that aren't chains, most reside along major interstates and are genuinely packed. Now the Crossing isn't a truck stop, nor is their target audience truckers, however they do have enough parking in back for a few trucks to stop and enjoy a solid meal.

Now by solid meal I don't mean go into a Dennys and order steak and eggs, I mean old fashion sit down, and order something made with a decent level of pride behind whats served. The menu, beit small, was fairly priced. There was a tad concern as an OTR driver about portion size for the price, however much to my suprise, they don't cut corners. I ordered a streak with shrimp, something I don't order often as the steak and shrimp are usually on the the small side yet these were not. In addition to that order, it came with 2 sides, you get to pick, and I had home made onion rings and what also tasted to be home made potato salad. Unless Sysco or Gordon's upped there quality, its definitely home made lol.

Anyway I think the photo will speak for itself, If you're a driver in the area, definitely stop, keep in mind that it does appear to be have bar half small venue, I'd use heed to use extra caution on Weekend evening as im sure that back lot may fill with cars as well. But if you're in the southern Greater Memphis or Olive Branch area definitely stop and check them out. I'll definitely be back.

UPDATE 9/27/23

Still amazing

googleReviews.author: Monica Valdes
googleReviews.text: Hidden gem in Wynwood! Free entry karaoke bar, great song selections, and a fun, social atmosphere in a clean, well-kept space. Drinks are reasonably priced ($10–$20) with happy hour specials and ladies night on Wednesdays. You can even reserve a table, which is a huge plus. Ralph behind the bar is incredible—even when weekends get packed, he takes care of everyone with great energy and top-tier service. Awesome staff, great music, and nonstop vibes. Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Abigail Vassallo
googleReviews.text: This is a free to enter karaoke bar. We had a few cocktails which were in the normal range of prices for the area ($10-20 each depending on what you get). There are specials on Wednesdays (ladies drink free) and happy hour specials as well. The set up is pretty straightforward for the karaoke, if you want to sing sign up and your name will appear on a screen at the front when its your turn. It was a lot of fun and this location is a great alternative to hourly karaoke rooms, with a much more fun and social atmosphere.

googleReviews.author: Lyss Stone
googleReviews.text: Ralph and JC are great! Super fun bar w/ great drinks. Karaoke setting is awesome and done well. Really good service and nice atmosphere. Any night of the week is a good one to go here! Definitely recommend 👌 👍

googleReviews.author: Will King
googleReviews.text: Drinks were a little over priced and food was decent but what stood out amongst experiences at other bars in the area. Is the service i recieved. Find us more bartenders like Rafael or Ralphy that’s what seperates the good from the great. Getting a drink quick prompt correct and with a smile makes ya feel good walking away from the bar after spending that amount unlike other bars in the area where it’s a fight to get the bartenders attention then attitude and a drink that’s wrong and overpriced makes you infuriating. Not with Ralphy where u go sir we shall follow

googleReviews.author: Otto Munoz (LiveAbundant_)
googleReviews.text: Dead Flamingo is easily the best bar in the area – every time I go, I’m reminded why. They have some of the best cocktails in Miami, and BLOO behind the bar is a star: super talented, friendly, and always on point with the pours and recommendations. Paired up with Mugen and Max , they’re a great team that keeps the energy high and the drinks flowing perfectly. The amazing hospitality starts the moment you walk in, and the amazing atmosphere keeps you here all night, especially on their karaoke nights, which are always a blast. Huge shoutout to the amazing management team Sean and Alex to name a few! You can tell they really care about the guest experience and the vibe of the place. If you’re looking for a go-to spot for great drinks, good people, and fun nights, Dead Flamingo is it.

googleReviews.author: Diani Ortiz
googleReviews.text: As a day 1 I have to give it to this team from bare bones and a vision they made it all happen !! Lex, Will, Gio, Danny, Sean, Max, Raul, and the rest of the TDF fam are truly the best mixologists Miami is blessed to have! Everyone absolutely everyone at The Dead Flamingo is truly amazing the future is incredibly bright for everyone involved! Here’s to many more karaoke nights, cocktails, parties and memories. If you haven’t been to TDF, you’re truly missing out.

googleReviews.author: John F. Sklavounos
googleReviews.text:
This is one of my favorite cocktail bars to visit. The staff is loaded with mixologists who are very creative and have great palates.

Each member of the team can make you all the standard cocktails, but ask them to put their own flair on it and you will be amazed at the flavors.

There's always a great crowd, but keep your eyes on their events page because they have a stage and all kinds of cool things go on there.

If you're looking to have fun, this is definitely one place to go.

googleReviews.author: Jocelyn Garcia
googleReviews.text:
If you’re looking for a spot that feels like a second home, this bar on 8th Street is it. My best friend and I come here all the time, and it never disappoints. The atmosphere is warm, welcoming, and full of good energy, you walk in and instantly feel like you belong.

Karaoke nights are hands down one of the highlights. Whether you’re grabbing the mic or just enjoying the crowd, it’s always such a fun, lively vibe. The décor is stunning too—super chic but still cozy, with details that really make the place stand out.

The drinks are always on point, and I have to mention Raul, he makes the BEST margaritas. Definitely my favorite! You can tell there’s real care put into the menu, especially with their specially tailored drinks for holidays and events. There’s always something new and creative to try.

Overall, it’s one of those places you keep coming back to not just for the drinks, but for the feeling. Highly recommend if you want a spot that’s fun, beautiful, and truly feels like home.

googleReviews.author: Christy Costas

I’d recommend this lol gem to anyone wanting a cool lil night with great music n vibes and epic drinks.

We went to Mickey B to watch the NBA playoff games and had a great time.
The place was packed with Knicks fans, which made the atmosphere loud and fun all night.
Service was surprisingly fast even with the crowd, and the staff kept things moving. Drinks and food were definitely on the pricey side, but you're paying for the Miami Beach location and the game day vibes!
We met some really nice people while there and they immediately became Knicks fans just from all the fun, and shouting our table was doing. A fun and lively sports bar to watch games or catch up with friends.

Overall, truly five-star customer service. Thank you!

googleReviews.author: Philippe T
googleReviews.text:
Great atmosphere for sports, but the burgers could use more seasoning!

Mickey Burges is a very cool location if you're looking for a spot to watch sports. The ambiance is exactly what you want from a great sports bar—very lively and well-designed.

The food was okay, but to be honest, I’ve had better burgers before. For a top rating, I felt the burger lacked a bit of seasoning; specifically, it needed some salt and perhaps a better sauce to really bring out the flavor. It just felt a little bland.

Overall, we still had a wonderful evening there and enjoyed the vibe. Great for drinks and games!

googleReviews.text:
My boyfriend took me this small sports bar after the Marlins game and the moment we walked in it was filled with vivid colors, sick iconographies and immaculate vibes. The owner, Alex was super chill and did a fantastic job with tackling the bar and food service solo (and the help from the cook). googleReviews.text: Was going to the Netherlands vs Dominican Republic game & stopped by to grab some quick drinks. Great dive bar type of vibe with great food. They had Ace Ventura playing on a tv in the bathroom 😂 👍🏻

googleReviews.author: Muhammad Mazhar Hussain
googleReviews.text:
Stepping into Thank You Miami Cocina & Beer House was an absolute delight and truly felt like discovering a hidden gem in Little Havana! The moment I walked in, I was captivated by the incredibly chill and welcoming vibe – it felt like walking into a cool friend's place, complete with awesome decor and a fantastic atmosphere. This place truly screams the love of Miami, and I could have easily spent hours there.

The food is absolutely on point! I was particularly impressed by the vegetarian options; the tacos were so good, I ordered them twice! Every dish I tried was bursting with great flavor, and the prices were surprisingly affordable, especially for Miami. It’s clear they put a lot of care into their cuisine.

Beyond the delicious food, the service was exceptional. The staff and owner are incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely hospitable. They anticipate your needs, which is a rare and wonderful quality. The drinks are also really tasty, and I highly recommend trying their sour beer or the "sun" lager – kudos to their bartender!

Adding to the fantastic experience, they sometimes have live music, and the vintage video games are a fun touch. Whether you're looking for a spot before or after a Marlins game, or just a cozy joint to unwind, this place is perfect. I had an absolute blast and will definitely be coming back to Thank You Miami Cocina & Beer House – it's a true gem!

googleReviews.text: This place is special to me. I love to enjoy live performances from my friends, enjoy amazing food, and vibe. I recommend Thank You Miami to anyone looking for a fun night out!

googleReviews.author: DJ AJ Falcon
googleReviews.text:
One of my favorite local dive bars! Lol 😆 such a charming lil hole in the wall! As a wedding and event DJ in Miami and South Florida I really appreciate good live entertainment, and there's great live entertainment on the weekends! I regularly come here when I don't have a gig that night. You can get up close to the stage with the talented bands that have the latest time set in the area (end at 1AM). Here are some clips of one of my favorite, unique local bands @Tremora, but all the bands I've seen here are really enjoyable, AND there's no cover or minimum (same for  the other pub crawl venues nearby). It's small, so it gets pretty crowded on the weekends. As such, it can be hard to get a drink at the bar, and it can be a tight squeeze so be patient. It's worth it! That's part of the charm here. It feels like you're in a friend's living room. The crowd is cool, and I've never seen any altercations despite how crowded it can get. It is loud, so you may wanna wear ear plugs if you're near the stage.
There's also an outside terrace with more breathing room and space. An added plus is there are several local bars and restaurants within a short walking 🚶‍♂️ distance of

Now, when it came to buying drinks, we all took turns buying drinks, and when it came to my turn, I ended up buying four bottles of Soju that came out to $64 absolutely insane but we were already there so not much we could do about it.

googleReviews.author: Arianna Torres
googleReviews.text: Came for private room,+ modern music karaoke and stayed for the AMAZING FOOD. Served hot, delicious and fast. I was concerned and confused by how much I loved the calamari. The man who runs the bar is sweet and efficient

googleReviews.author: Brieaunna's World
googleReviews.text: I know the ourdoor environment looks suspicious but go inside and sing your worries away! My friend invited me here once before and we came back for NYE. I didn't try any of the food, I was ḥere to sing lol its $25/h so keep track of time😅 Very clean business and restroom!

googleReviews.author: Steve Doherty
googleReviews.text: The only private room Korean karaoke bar in ALL of Orlando! Even in 2026! It's great so much fun. Solid food, great drinks, awesome service and the light up rooms are super fun to sing and dance in. Belt it! 🎤😆🕺

googleReviews.author: Zach W
googleReviews.text: Our experience at Q Karaoke was a blast! We visited with a large group of 10 we got a reservation without issue. They gave us a comfortable large room lined with leather couches set up with a large tv display & speakers, Karaoke box, microphones, plus a smaller TV for easy reading of song lyrics. We were impressed by the service, food options, price, and the sound proofing. The sound proofing was impressive it gave us a private feeling experience from other guests. The place was packed too but youd never know from inside your room. The food was reasonably priced especially for group shareables, all of which appeared to be Homemade and were delicious!! Highly recommend for your next booking great for parties too

I will be back the next time I am in Orlando. Well done guys, one of the very best bars i have been to. Thank you!

googleReviews.author: Alissia Isaacs Satchell
googleReviews.text: I truly enjoy The Keg Social and all of its many activities. The staff is attentive and great! They have a plethora of activities. Great place for family, friends, college students,  company team buildings. I just did our team building Axe Throwing 🪓 today here! We all had a blast! Sky is an AMAZING  Axe Throwing instructor. She is super sweet and gave us proper techniques and was very helpful and enthusiastic! I have been here many times. They offer bowling 🎳, axe throwing,  arcade, ping pong 🏓, and billiards 🎱. Excellent atmosphere! Can't wait to return!

googleReviews.author: Andres Ospina
googleReviews.text:
The Ultimate Spot for Sports, Drinks, and Unbeatable Vibes!
I originally came to Keg Social to celebrate my birthday and catch the Knicks playoff game, and I had an absolute blast! One of the absolute best things about this place is the layout—no matter where you are standing or sitting, you have a perfect view of the TVs to watch the games. The atmosphere was so electric that I ended up coming back the very next week to catch the Mets and Yankees Subway Series.
The staff and overall vibe are just awesome. I spent most of my time hanging out in the billiards area, and the bartenders there were incredibly nice and attentive. I honestly wish I could give them a personal shoutout by name, but their drinks were so well-made and strong that my memory of the night is a little fuzzy—cheers to them for that, lol!
Beyond the unbeatable sports viewing, the entertainment options here are next level. They offer a little bit of everything:
Billiards (My personal favorite spot!)
Bowling & Axe Throwing
Ping Pong & Beer Pong
Karaoke
If you're looking for a top-tier place with great personnel, phenomenal food, and genuinely great drinks, this is it. I will absolutely be coming back on the regular, especially for game days. Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Shelly Osborne
googleReviews.text: This is an all in one type of environment for kids and adults. The bowling experience was done differently. The staff setup the bowlers names for the lane. This is a much easier process than trying to figure out how to setup the system. Great food, awesome service, wonderful establishment on the east side of Orlando.

googleReviews.author: janery duyag
googleReviews.text: Angelica was absolutely incredible! she made us feel welcomed and taken care of. She has a positive energy and friendly personality. She’s so genuine and she didn’t just serve drinks she created an experience. Angelica’s exceptional service, professionalism, and warm attitude made our night unforgettable. She is hands down one of the best bartenders we’ve ever had, and we can’t wait to come back because of her. Thank you, Angelica, for making our visit so special!
