googleReviews.text: I went with my friends on a Friday night and it was so much fun! The service was great. Our waitress, Olivia, was the sweetest person and was always checking up on us. We ordered the smoked nachos, 10/10 recommend! The place was clean and organized. The price is by time, not by person. I would say it was  definitely worth the price. I can't wait to go back and try the karaoke room and billards!

googleReviews.author: Tyson Walker
googleReviews.text: They wouldn't let me buy drinks because my ID had tape on it because it was broken a spot but it can work in any other convenience store in florida. And it worked on the Nintendo Land side. Management is really bad rude and uppity

googleReviews.author: Karina B
googleReviews.text:
This was my first time visiting this karaoke bar, and it was unforgettable! I came all the way from NYC to celebrate my birthday and reserved a spot via email in advance. I had read reviews about some guests not getting a turn to sing due to high demand, but the bar is upfront about their random selection process and the fact that a chance to sing isn’t guaranteed.

We decided to give it a try anyway, and to my surprise, I was the first performer called! We arrived at 7 PM, and the band began performing at 8 PM. The process is simple: you fill out a form with four song choices when you arrive.

The live band is absolutely fantastic. A huge thank you to them for making me feel so special during my performance—it was the best karaoke experience ever! Singing with a live band brought back such an incredible feeling of joy and confidence. The background singers were phenomenal, and their harmonies made the moment even more magical.

This is the perfect place for anyone who loves singing and wants to feel like a star for a moment. I only wish we had something like this in NYC! Wishing you continued success, and thank you for everything you do.

googleReviews.author: McKenzie Helton
googleReviews.text: Opie the bartender is an atrocious human being. He was rude, insufferable and insensitive. He truly provided the worst service I have ever received in my entire life and we were still charged the full price plus a tip for our drinks. Horrific service, terrible atmosphere. Do not come here if you are a young woman or a person of color unless you want to be verbally abused. Racist undertones and he absolutely made it clear that we were not welcome at this establishment. I’m sorry to say this. Val the manager tried clearing this situation up as best as they could but unfortunately it’s not enough. We will no longer be returning to this establishment and going to Disney instead. At least we will be treated like human beings there. It’s truly a shame because we have gone to this bar at least five times over the past year and we were treated great. But Opie ruined universal and the entire experience for us. He made me cry and feel like a horrible person, snatching the drinks out of my hand. Universal if you see this, please make sure you train your staff on hospitality. Because at rising star Orlando, its absolutely horrific!

googleReviews.author: Enriquez Emmanuell
googleReviews.text:
On this past Sunday 12/14/25 my friends and I decided to go and have a good time at this place, It was not crazy busy but the problem was there was only 1 Bartender taking all the orders at the Bar, and here’s where the problem came, after waiting a while at the bar for my turn, when i FINALLY was gonna get help with my order (I was next one on line) this White, blonde older lady that works there ask me “what i wanted to Order” we told her we wanted to know the price of some “Lemon Drops shots” for our group, She told us where we were sitting and that she will bring it to us, she never told us the price or nothing and after waiting another 30mins (ridiculous after i was next on the bar line), She brings the shots to the table, at that moment I was on the restroom and when walking back to my table  she stops me on the way and ask for the payment (really odd for someone to do that), I told her sure how much is it, she told me it was $102!!! $102 for some Lemon drops shots that if u don’t know what they are is literally made only with vodka, lemon juice & syrup, I told her why it was so expensive? That literally all the cocktails we were drinking at the place were way cheaper than the price she was charging me for 6 lemon drops, that it wasn’t making sense for me, she answers me back “I don’t know, but if you don’t pay right now, I’m gonna have to call security..” I replied back “What??” And she just said “I’m gonna have to call security to escort you and your friends out of Universal if you refuse to pay”. I NEVER even refused to pay, I was only asking WHY i was being charged so much for something that it’s really really cheap at  ANY PLACE! That wasn’t even Tequila! What got me really upset was the attitude and the way she approached me and the way she treated me, I have never in my life been threatened like that anywhere!! Oh and after she asked me to tip her! (And I DID), I wanna know why we were treated like that? We were tipping the bartender none stop for each drink (GOOD tips), we were quiet in a little corner of the place just listening to people sing, was it cause we were Hispanics? What place treat people like this? This has been the most horrible experience and place I have ever been, Is this the staff this place hires? I need some answers! After this I definitely don’t recommend this place to NO ONE and less if you are hispanic!!!

P.S
Does “Lemons Drops” were HORRIBLE! Literally tasted like water with sugar.

googleReviews.author: S
googleReviews.text: We went to City Walk’s Rising Star while in Orlando on Vacation, and the karaoke experience exceeded our expectations! The karaoke experience with a stage and backup singers truly makes you feel like a professional singer. My experience there was one I will remember forever. The audience was singing to every song that was played which made the vibe so fun and not intimidating! At the front, there were multiple binders full of songs so there were a ton of options to choose from. We were a party of 5, and everyone that wanted to karaoke was able to do so with no issues and not a long wait time. It was such a great experience! City Walk’s Rising Star is a must while in Orlando, and I can’t wait to go back!

googleReviews.text: I’ll gladly give a better review when the self advertised karaoke bar hires a DJ that respects the order of people signing up to sing. I got to watch the same person go up three times in a 2.5 hour span of me being there. I asked him how he got to do that, and he said he paid the DJ over $100. Cool, I get it’s your hustle and you gotta make money where you can. But it won’t be my money. There are better bars to sing at and listen to your friends sing, and better bars to just hang out with friends instead of paying $6 a beer.

googleReviews.author: Luis Diaz
googleReviews.text: This is my Favorite bar/dive/watering hole in town. It's Grandfathered in and we like it that way. The Staff and locale are exactly what I want in a bar. They know my name. They know my poison of choice. My fine Pilsner is served by the time I step up to the bar. Why would I bother with any other place? I feel the love!

googleReviews.author: Natasha Thomas
googleReviews.text:
If y'all want a blunt and honest review, here you go... If you're a minority, or any decent human being, I wouldn't recommend this place as somewhere to go for a good time. Atmosphere isn't welcoming at all. A Caucasian male decided it was okay to go on stage and rap a song and actually say the N word once it came up...not only once, but twice. The DJ (also a Caucasian male) didn't even flinch and the song went on as if it were normal. I don't condone the use of the word no matter if it's in a song or not. There were maybe 2 small groups of African American/Hispanic individuals, me included and we all left either during the song or right after in shock. All it takes is one time to think you can do it...and the rest of the crowd to condome such behavior in support. So again, this review is for all of those who actually care about supporting those who respect others....this isn't one of those places.

Also, the "DJ" and karaoke itself, in general, suck. Long lines and allowing the same people to sing every other song.

googleReviews.author: Matthew Riggins
googleReviews.text: Great dive bar and decently priced drinks. It’s a karaoke bar and that’s where it’s lacking. We were there early and my date and I each put in a song and followed the rules to not put in another one until after you’ve sang. 3 hours later and we never got to sing One guy was up over 5 times along with others, and I also witnessed where people that had been there less than 30 minutes got a chance. We even asked when is our turn to sing. He said in 8 songs, 12 songs later we got up and left. My date even tipped him, so adding money doesn’t seem to help. Seems they pick and choose who sings. Probably won’t be back.

googleReviews.author: Derrick Bradshaw
googleReviews.text: One of the best places I have been.   Great employees, great customers, and great music.

googleReviews.author: Brian Alexander
googleReviews.text:
Tin Roof is one of those spots that effortlessly brings together tourists and locals under one roof. Whether you're visiting for the weekend or you’ve lived in the area for years, it’s the kind of place that feels welcoming the moment you walk in. The atmosphere is lively without being overwhelming, making it a solid choice for just about any night out.
One of the biggest highlights is the live entertainment. There’s always something going on—whether it’s a live band bringing high energy to the stage or a fun, crowd-involved karaoke night. The vibe is interactive and upbeat, which makes it easy to let loose and have a good time. If you’re someone who enjoys music and a social scene, this place delivers.

The food is decent and hits the spot, especially if you’re looking for classic bar-style options to pair with drinks and entertainment. It’s not trying to be fine dining—and it doesn’t need to be. The menu complements the overall experience and keeps you fueled for a full night out.

googleReviews.author: Ronnie Denton

See our YouTube channel Coolest Life

googleReviews.author: Joseph Artura
googleReviews.text: The atmosphere was great. Live music and the music was good.  The food was great, i had a bacon burger my girl had the chicken quesdilla, both good choices.  Our bartender was Sam Waggles she was amazing 👏, a couple screw ups on the order but she made it right and it's definitely a great spot to stop and grab a bite to eat with a cold drink.. get the outside seating and order from the bar!

googleReviews.author: Jen Hall
googleReviews.text:
We had a group of us who would come out for their karaoke on Wednesday nights for a few months. At first we loved the place-- good vibe, drinks and food reasonably priced, bartenders phenomenal. Until one night there was a mix up with the DJ calling the wrong person for a song and the most inappropriate and unprofessional interactions. It boils down to a member of the security team committing a micro aggression against a black woman and throwing her out. When I approached him to try to straighten it out, I started out calm. I kept upping the level of aggression of my behavior and even when I was almost touching him there was no removal of me and he was unfazed. It was at that point, it was clear to me that the way he treated my friend was due to her being black, as I was much more aggressive and "violent" without being removed. So I told him "next time just say you're racist, it would be faster" and it wasn't until I called out his behavior that I was thrown out. I asked if it was just for the night and they said yes. But when our group showed up two weeks later, I was informed I was not allowed in because the security guard "didn't feel comfortable with me being in there." And management at Tin Roof supported him.
So if you like supporting establishments that give cover when their employees are racist, this is a place you'll enjoy. Otherwise there's tons of other places that have karaoke and are touristy.

googleReviews.author: Peter Fritz
googleReviews.text:
I rarely write reviews with this intensity, but our experience at The Copper Rocket was a test of patience and truly a culinary debacle. From the moment we stepped in, the establishment seemed chaotic and lacking in basic customer service. There was no warm greeting, no staff to guide us to a table, leaving us to fend for ourselves.

After twiddling our thumbs for 20 long minutes, we took the initiative to approach a waitress and fetch our own menus. A restaurant's first impression is paramount, and at this point, we should've recognized the red flags and departed. But in the spirit of giving a second chance, we decided to order.

My appetite was modest, so I opted for the deep-fried Oreos. Others in our group sought heartier meals like the Buffalo Chicken Wrap, Club Wrap, and a Club Sandwich. Josie, our server, was the one silver lining amidst this chaos. She was visibly overwhelmed, having to handle the entire floor alone and juggle drink-making due to an uncooperative bartender. Her sincere apologies resonated, but it's the management and kitchen that need a serious re-evaluation.

The inconsistency in delivering our orders was frustrating. First came the Buffalo Chicken Wrap, then a prolonged wait, and an eventual revelation that they'd run out of turkey for the other dishes! To add insult to injury, after what felt like an eternity, they admitted they couldn’t even provide the deep-fried Oreos due to a lack of batter.

To the management of The Copper Rocket: your inefficiency is costing you more than just a negative review. If you aren't able to ensure basic service standards, perhaps it's best to reconsider your place in the restaurant industry. As a reviewer, I evaluate based on met expectations. I've praised establishments that deliver on their promises, regardless of their stature. The Copper Rocket, despite its spotlight on "Bar Rescue", clearly needs more than a mere rescue. Jon Taffer would be livid with such mismanagement.

To potential patrons, I'd advise you to reconsider your choice. Your time, money, and appetite deserve better. I hope The Copper Rocket reflects on this feedback and initiates a radical change for the betterment of its future patrons.

Our riding group dropped in here on Sunday a morning. The staff, though surprised by eleven of us right after opening, handled our requests quickly and pleasantly.
We all liked the staff and the food. A great 1/2 pound burger, fries and cola, was under 15 bucks.
This is a nice place for lunch with easy access, clean, with flat screens everywhere.
They provided good service for our group.
You should give them a try.

There is a lot to say about this place.
I went for the private karaoke rooms, and I really enjoyed their setup. The sound system and mics were good quality, and we appreciated the staff and good service.
But in my personal opinion... the front bar/club/"lounge" area was a bit odd and had a lot going on.
At one point in the night, our room got really cold, and I remembered seeing a few tables and an area of people selling stuff. Long story short... I almost spent $100 on a fake fur coat being sold at the back of a blaring dance floor. That was definitely one of the more interesting and unique experiences I've had out. Drunk shopping... probably not the best idea, ha!
Overall, it was a crazy fun and interesting night. The crowd and staff were cool and friendly. And I have to give this place 5 stars... cause the chilly room/coat issue I mentioned before was solved by one of the staff (DK) offering us his personal jacket to borrow for the night.

googleReviews.author: Dawn White
googleReviews.text: I was looking to book a Karaoke room for my birthday celebration, called the location for a week no one every answered the phone red flag number 1.  We were over in the area a week ago and stopped by to see the karaoke rooms. A pleasant man introduced himself as the owner took us on a tour,  I loved the rooms that he showed us, he stated they would reopen in a few weeks. I also addressed that I had been calling for a week he did say they were closed. We talked about the orange room which would accommodate my party and the price which he stated was $150 per hour which was fine, I asked how do I book a reservations he gave me a email address , he also gave me his number and said if we wanted to book for that specific date we have to paid by the next day. The owner also said they are having a event that night and that my party would have access to the event and would not have to paid an additional fee. After a little research I read reviews with the same thing happening to other they paid and booked a room, then was not allowed in due to a event on the same day. I found some flyers for the event for the same say I was looking to book. I spoke with a gentlemen and he called a young lady that was hosting the event with him. They both were very honest and after speaking with them I elected to take my business to another establishment. I was informed I could have the celebration there no problem even was more than willing to accommodate my party also informed me that all Karaoke rooms would be used as overflow for the guest that will be attending the event, which made sense and that tickets were needed to get in the event and that my guest would get tickets. I am sure I will get a response to this review I stand on what was written and its bad business and not a good look!!

My husband’s burger was cooked perfectly but also under seasoned. The fries were amazing! Very unique atmosphere here! Funky and cool idea with the karaoke rooms, the atmosphere is chill. We had a strawberry lemon drop and Moscow mule, mocktails, and soft drinks. The vibe and ambiance was great! We were in the Reggae room. Ironically it was ONE LOVE... which was our theme! Our servers, Yeri and Alex were great! They were very friendly and prompt with delivering the food fresh and hot. A mess was made by one of the guest and it was cleaned up promptly to avoid any accidents from occurring. I've enjoyed this establishment so much that I suggested my son celebrate his 39th birthday here. However, because this place is so popular the rooms were all booked and we ended up booking at LaLa St  Pete in the Speak Easy room. My hope is that it will be just as good as the Tampa location. Keep up the great work and providing a place where people can eat, drink and sing the day or night away. 🤗

googleReviews.text: Food was amazing, atmosphere was incredible, drinks were BOMB. The attached liquor store is the most beautiful I've ever seen. Only giving 4 stars for service because the bartender was our waitress and she was the only one working. GIVE THAT GIRL A RAISE.

googleReviews.author: Alexander Guzman
googleReviews.text:
First time here this past weekend. I've seen the name come up multiple times in facebook groups, so we gave it a try.
I went insight and ask if I had to wait to be seated and was told I could just sit anywhere and some would come. We went snd sat outside where the band was playing. Very nice atmosphere.  There were some people but not crazy full. We sat there for a good 12-20 mins before someone approached our table to take an order. We were by the door so servers were walking by us all the time. Even serving other tables close by and crossing eyes a couple of times. We got nachos, wings, and beer. The food was terrible. Seriously some of the wrote chicken wings I've ever had.

googleReviews.author: STACEY JOHNSON
googleReviews.text:
Sometimes it truly baffles me how some businesses choose to operate.

I came into this store ready to purchase four bottles of tequila, priced at $43 each (Rounding Up). However, another store nearby had the exact same bottles for $37 each (Rounding Up). I simply asked the cashier if they price matched, and the answer was an immediate no.

So you’d rather lose a $148 sale (before tax) instead of matching a competitor’s price? That’s the difference between a business that’s just getting by and one that’s actually trying to grow and keep customers.

Needless to say, I took my business elsewhere and purchased the items from the other store.

This place is overpriced, and the customer service left a lot to be desired. Just for comparison, Dewey’s Liquor is much more affordable than Gaspar’s, although I didn’t purchase my bottles from Dewey’s that particular day.

Overall, I’d rate this place 2 out of 10. And that's only because the store itself was neat and clean, but when it comes to pricing and customer service, it was a major disappointment.

Needless to say, I won’t be shopping at Gaspar’s again.

googleReviews.author: Ryan Moore
googleReviews.text:
Amazing unique place, hidden little secret only really known by residents of Temple Terrace. Had amazing service from the Bartender Lisa who was patient and helped explain the menu and drink options, the bar was stocked full of amazing liquor choices of all varieties and tastes.

I ate a burger while my wife had the quesadilla, both came out amazing I'd even place it in top 10 burgers I've ever had. I recommend going a level down from what you want in terms of how cooked the burger is. I wanted medium rare and it came out closer to medium well. So I'd recommend ordering rare in this case. I saw someone order an old fashioned which looked amazing, so that's the first thing I plan to order next time. Definitely would recommend gaspars for anyone looking for a new experience.

If you prefer more of a calm quiet and family vibe come earlier in the day, for a more party and nightlife vibe go after 9pm. Thanks for the great experience Lisa.

googleReviews.author: Tim C
googleReviews.text: Some of the best wings in Tampa Bay Area. Combined their bbq and Buffalo sauces for a spicy bbq. Great spot if you’re a jets fan as well to watch the games.

googleReviews.author: Stacey
googleReviews.text: A very fun and upscale relaxed vibe. Our server, Clifford was attentive, observant, and pleasant from the start sonwe knew this would be a great experience. The menu was diverse and made our selection difficult, but we were very happy with our our choices. The ladies at the table next to us ordered wings, and I could tell they were epic so we got some for ourselves. They had the perfect amount of crisp- and heat. We ordered the housemade ranch with them, which was OK but didn't stand out and clearly sour cream based (very thick). I'll try the blue cheese next time. For the main dishes we both ordered steaks- my husband had the steak frites and I had the petite filet which comes with two sides. The Brussels sprouts were so delicious I'm craving them today. And the fries had a detectable truffle rosemary flavor to them and were hot and crispy- pure perfection. I wish they had more options on their dessert menu- everything was dairy based or had dairy, so we passed on dessert. Overall a fantastic meal, and we will go back again!

googleReviews.author: Anastasia Guimaraes
googleReviews.text:
We visited Lala on a rainy weekday during lunch. What a neighborhood gem we found!

It was not busy with just a few tables and people seated at the bar. The vibe of the restaurant is very nice. I was impressed with the bartender/server Neil who whipped up beautiful and delicious cocktails, the freshness and presentation of the food (I had their bowl with grilled chicken), the music choice, the decor, and overall friendliness of the place. Everything is made from scratch and tastes like real food should taste. They even make their own garnishes for drinks! In between serving customers and making drinks, Neil was loading dehydrator with slices of lemon, orange, and lime making a new batch of garnishes.

They have several private rooms that one can book for parties, a roof-top bar
, as well as outdoor area in the back of the restaurant. Karaoke nights is a thing, we were told.

Overall, I cannot recommend this restaurant enough. Wish we had more places like Lala!

googleReviews.author: Sheri S
googleReviews.text: The food was amazing. I had the Frenchy burger and it was the best hamburger I have ever tasted! The French fries were so delicious too. The atmosphere was cozy and the service was top notch. The only thing that was a bit bothersome was the table. It just needs some adjustments to stop wobbling. Definitely not a deal breaker tho! I highly recommend this little gem!

googleReviews.author: Ruth Hall
googleReviews.text:
We love LaLas.  Tonight was our first night with Kyra and she made our experience excellent.  She was attentive and helpful.
The food was delicious, as always, and I would always recommend LaLas for good food.
And if you get Clifford as your server you are also in luck.  He is a LaLas staple, wonderful, cheerful and anyone is lucky to have him.
Perfect neighborhood restaurant with a kitchen that is open late and fun karaoke.  Also 1/2 price bottle wines on Wed!
We ordered a bottle of wine but without drinks $25-$40 per person.

googleReviews.author: Vince Miller (Men's Bible Studies)
googleReviews.text:
What a night! From the moment we sat down, the service and atmosphere were top tier. Will, our bartender, was phenomenal—friendly, quick, and great with drink recommendations. Patrick, our waiter, was just as impressive, checking in with perfect timing and making sure our table never needed a thing.

We ordered a little bit of everything—wings, duck linguini, filet mignon, and the Frenchy Burger. All delicious, but let me say it plainly: the Frenchy Burger is the star of the menu. Juicy, packed with flavor, and cooked to perfection. If you go and don’t order it… you’re missing out.

Great food, exceptional service, and a vibe that makes you want to stay longer than you planned. We’ll definitely be back!

Highly recommend.

googleReviews.text:
This was my first time in. The owner was working and we had a nice concession as I snacked and sipped my latte.
My pretzel and beer dip were very good. The pretzel was like what I ate in Germany.
The latte was amazing!!

googleReviews.author: Cecilia Martin
googleReviews.text:
Unfortunately, we ended up leaving without eating, even though we had already paid for our food. We had a front row seat to the kitchen from the bar, and our entire group watched as our food was being prepared, including pancakes and sandwiches, without gloves. At one point, we could clearly see her palming our food with bare hands. It immediately made us uncomfortable and made me lose my appetite.

The food itself was also disappointing. The BLTs we ordered came out as just LTs. The breakfast sandwich was simply two stale biscuits with nothing on them. For the price, I would have expected a much better overall experience.

The space itself is cute, which makes this even more unfortunate. I never leave bad reviews, but I felt it was important to flag these issues. Cleanliness, accuracy, and basic food quality are reasonable expectations. I hope this feedback is taken seriously so future customers have a better experience.

googleReviews.author: Kailia Gilligan
googleReviews.text: The outdoor area was beautiful!! Don't let the outward appearance scare you off. My group were the only ones in the bar at 7pm, but a few people came in. The food was so good!! Some items were typical bar food, but the soup and salad far exceeded my expectations. The server explained without prompting where the ingredients were sourced, all local. I will be back!

googleReviews.author: Iris Melendez
googleReviews.text:
I recently visited with a friend during a midweek lunch and was really looking forward to trying this place based on the positive reviews. Unfortunately, the experience was underwhelming from start to finish.

When we arrived around lunchtime, the parking lot was empty and the restaurant had no guests inside. We waited about a minute before a server came over to greet us. We ordered a variety of items to get a good feel for the menu — hummus, fish dip, two French onion soups, a salad, and a breakfast biscuit.

If I had to describe the food in one word, it would be underwhelming. The appetizer portions were very small, presentation across the board was lacking, and most importantly, the food just didn’t taste good. The French onion soup was especially disappointing — it had shredded cheese that melted to the bottom with no traditional bread and melted cheesy topping, which I’ve honestly never seen before.

Once our food was delivered, our server never checked back in, which made us wonder if he was already aware of the quality being served. The overall experience just felt flat and disappointing.

This might be a decent spot to grab a drink in the evening, but based on our visit, I wouldn’t recommend it if you’re looking for quality food or a memorable dining experience.

googleReviews.author: S. I.
googleReviews.text:
Corner Club is the story of a local Dive bar reborn as a lively open air welcoming local eatery, coffee bar, and weekly cozy events place catering to locals of Old Seminole Heights neighborhood of Tampa.

Corner Club has a limited menu but each item on their thoughtfully crafted menu is made with heart and pride.  The menu offers coffee, cocktails, mock tails, wine, breakfast items (quiche, biscuits, pancakes, toast), lunch items (bratwurst, pretzel rolls, pizza, sandwiches, wings, burgers)

The space has plenty of indoor seating, a small game room, and a decent sized backyard patio with covered seating and a small stage.  The staff are very welcoming and it's a great space to hang out with friends for conversations over yummy dishes.

I tired their Strawberry Jalapeño Margarita which tasted like a combination of strawberry fizz with jalapeño tequila. This drink isn't for everyone.  It was decent but somehow the combination weren't my favorite.

I also had their Smoked Bratwurst - pork sausage, tepache mustard in a pretzel roll. This was by far one of great tasting bratwurst I've had in a while. The hot bratwurst wrapped in warm pretzel roll had a perfect balance of meaty glutinous taste.  The mustard added a little bite as aftertaste. A great item to order.

My side of Papas Bravas - Spanish style potatoes w/ paprika, aioli, scallion was a perfect combination to my bratwurst. The potatoes were slightly crusty on the outside while being moist inside. The paprika added the visually striking color and the aioli added a creamy finish to each bite.   This is a must have when visiting Corner Club.

This place is a hidden neighborhood gem. If you are not local to the neighborhood, you might find it to be in the middle of nowhere.  I think the location adds appeal to the history and legacy  of corner club.

googleReviews.author: Jules Nickerson
googleReviews.text:
Was visiting from out of town as Jax is my hometown. I finished up for the day and was looking for something local to do before I have to check put and leave tomorrow and a freida recomeded this bar. I saw that they have izakya vibes and was really intrigued and I was not disappointed! It wasn't packed which was perfect for my energy level right now. My bartender was so personable and chatted with me a bit, made AMAZING suggestions bassed on my preferences, and asked subtle inclusive questions that made me feel welcome and included as a visibly queer trans man (Like asking if the name on my card was the name I used). At one point I couldn't decide between two drinks and I asked him to surprise me and when he brought the drink he turned it into a game and had me guess which one it was. This was such a nice, personalized experience! It's a wine bar too so you can try quite a few things more than a regular bar!

For someone traveling by myself just looking for a nice local experience I had a perfect time!

googleReviews.author: Christine Mojica
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been to this anime bar multiple times and usually enjoy it because of the target demographic and the fun atmosphere it provides. This visit was on May 1 after celebrating my college graduation, where I reunited with a high school friend. We decided to book a private karaoke room since we had a great experience doing that before.

I will say that there have been some technical issues with karaoke in the past, but I noticed they upgraded to Bluetooth microphones and speakers. The bartender working that afternoon was very helpful, setting up our room and assisting us whenever needed. I was able to sing one song, and everything seemed fine at first. However, after I stepped out to grab Ramune sodas, the remote and TV stopped syncing when my friend tried to start her song. We let the bartender know, and we understood he was busy handling multiple orders, so we were patient and went back to our room.

This is where the situation became uncomfortable. A random man came into our room and insisted on helping. At first, I thought he worked there, but it quickly became clear he didn’t. He started asking personal questions like our ages and continued the conversation in a way that felt intrusive. Some of his comments didn’t make sense, and at one point he made a remark about my friend not being the one who graduated because of her tattoo, which felt unnecessary and inappropriate. He also suggested joining us to sing, which made the situation even more uncomfortable, especially since we were just two girls trying to enjoy a private celebration, and we felt like we had to keep engaging in conversation just to avoid escalating things. Eventually, the bartender came back, and I was able to privately let him know what happened, and he apologized, which I do appreciate.

I’m giving this place 3 stars because while the staff was kind and doing their best, it felt like there weren’t enough employees to properly monitor the space. Situations like this could potentially be avoided with more staff presence, especially in private room areas.

I still enjoy the concept of this bar and don’t want to discourage people from going, but I do want to raise awareness, especially for other women, to stay mindful of their surroundings.

googleReviews.author: PhatGyrlSnoop
googleReviews.text: I really enjoyed this bar. It seems like a great place for the trending nerds to hang out in a safe space. The bartenders were really nice and the karaoke was fun. The two drinks I had were really good and hit the spot. The atmosphere and vibe was so enjoyable and it was very intimate and I met a lot of cool people. Will be returning again to try more different drinks and sing different songs.

googleReviews.author: DJ Perry
googleReviews.text: I enjoyed going to the Nakama Anime Bar with my friend and meeting Mae and I have to say if she were to have a funny pun I would like for it to be "Mae I take your order?" Haha, we both ordered alcohol and got to enjoy the speedy service. Mae was friendly, servant who served us tonight! Got out drinks just in time as I had the Night Sky and even though their were 2 drinks out of order tonight, I still enjoyed it. Definitely, recommend it. Plus, the karaoke is spectacular!

googleReviews.text: One of the best ways to enjoy a night with friends—and an even better place to make more! Danny makes the bar amazing, keeping everyone in good spirits and the karaoke setup and atmosphere is so confidence inspiring, and that’s saying a lot coming from someone who is nervous to get up there!

googleReviews.text: love this place! been 3 times because i love karaoke and it is super fun!! the rooms are definitely not soundproof though, so if you absolutely need soundproofing... not the place for you, but everyone is just kind of doing their own thing and not listening to other people so it's not a big deal to me 😁 no food, but lots of drink selection

googleReviews.author: Liam Paulson
googleReviews.text:
I visited this karaoke bar and had an extremely unpleasant experience. The staff behaved in a rude and dismissive way from the moment we arrived, and the pricing felt intentionally misleading. The final bill was far higher than what we were told, creating the impression that customers are taken advantage of rather than treated fairly.

During my time there, I noticed several situations that raised serious concerns about how the business is being run. There appeared to be very young individuals present around alcohol, and the atmosphere inside some of the private rooms felt unsafe and poorly supervised. The environment suggested the possibility of inappropriate behavior going unnoticed, which made the entire place feel chaotic and unregulated.

Overall, the combination of unprofessional staff, questionable billing practices, and unsafe surroundings makes this a place I cannot recommend. Anyone considering a visit should be aware of these issues and exercise caution.

googleReviews.author: sara ibrahimi
googleReviews.text: So much fun!!! More people need to know about this spot! My friends brought me out to Austin's for the first time and we had a blast. This place is legit! The owners are Korean & were very friendly, very welcoming. They were very patient and helped us with everything we needed! You have lots of options in the big book provided both foreign and English music. You can also Bluetooth which is convenient when you can find the songs your looking for. Soju bottles prices are reasonable, just $15! And it was like $20 pp when we checked out for like 3 hours so not bad at all!

googleReviews.author: Ewy
googleReviews.text: Always a great time at Austin karaoke, my fiancee has been obsessed with this place ever since our first trip and we've now brought many friends out to Austin as well. We always have a great time and the prices are fair for an experience based venue.

googleReviews.author: Collin Marts
googleReviews.text: Tommy and Kenny are absolutely very accommodating! They need to know exactly how many people are in your party bc they are per person and time based. Korean karaoke machines are designed to be very easy to use. All the Korean buttons you need to use are labeled in english and if you want to know what the other buttons are you simply just take a google translate photo (there’s a bluetooth button that isn’t labeled but you will find it two buttons under the “cancel” button). Literally every one of the funnest activities you could possibly do late at night in Jacksonville even when you don’t enjoy singing or serenading. Please give it a try! googleReviews.author: Walter Garcia
googleReviews.text:
We were excited to try this place since it was close to our Airbnb. Our first experience wasn’t great. We stopped in to place a to-go order so we could relax back at the house, but after standing there for about 15 minutes without being acknowledged or helped, I ended up leaving. My wife called to see what was going on, and they asked me to come back in, but by that point we were frustrated and decided not to. Unfortunately, we didn’t even get dinner that first night because of the confusion and lack of service.

We decided to give them a second chance, hoping it was just an off night. While our server (a tall guy with a tattoo on one leg) was friendly, the service itself was disappointing. Our food came out quickly, but he rarely checked on us and seemed more focused on joking around with coworkers than taking care of his tables.

I will say the black-haired waitress was very friendly and appeared to be working harder than anyone else there, even though she wasn’t our server. She was constantly moving and staying busy. On the other hand, it was concerning to see another employee vaping in the drink area, which didn’t leave a good impression. (Dirty blonde headed girl)

Overall, the restaurant seems to lack management and oversight. With better leadership and attention to customer service, this place could improve. Based on our experience, though, we wouldn’t return.

googleReviews.author: Jula Shkurti
googleReviews.text:
This happened during last call while they were preparing to shut down. I understand that restrooms may close at a certain time and I had no issue respecting that when I was told I couldn’t use it.

What wasn’t okay was the response when I asked where the nearest restroom was. The security attendant told me, “You can use the ocean.” I was not intoxicated, disruptive, or causing any issues - I was simply asking for directions to the closest available restroom.

Enforcing closing policies is understandable. Being dismissive and sarcastic isn’t. A simple, respectful answer would have been appreciated.

googleReviews.author: Drew Hart
googleReviews.text:
I had an extremely disappointing and upsetting experience at this bar on the night of my birthday due to the conduct of the woman who runs their karaoke nights. There’s a review from about 6 months ago mentioning her using racial slurs toward patrons, and unfortunately, it seems nothing has changed.

My friend and I (both Black) came in and signed up to sing a song together like everyone else. Over the next 30-60 minutes, we watched the same group of people get multiple turns — some as many as 3-4 — while no new names were called. We remained patient. Eventually, I politely asked where we were in the queue, and was told we were song #19 while they were on #15. I thanked her and waited.

Four or five songs later, those same people got up again, and we still weren’t called. When I respectfully asked to verify our spot again, I was told — incorrectly — they were still on #15. When I calmly pointed out that this didn’t make sense, she became hostile and incredibly inappropriate, raising her voice at me while her daughter joined in, cursing at me as well.

I calmly walked away, but the host then began loudly shouting over the microphone at the entire bar, causing an unnecessary public scene simply because I asked a reasonable question. No rational person would react this way if it were an honest mistake.

Considering the fact that only white patrons were called up to sing (with a few minorities only going up when accompanied by white friends), paired with her known history of using extremely racist, offensive language, it’s very plausible that the way we were treated was racially motivated. At the very least, it was biased and discriminatory behavior.

We left immediately, along with a few other patrons who were also made extremely uncomfortable by the host’s conduct, and I contacted the bar the next day, regarding the incident. I have since given them ample time to address this, and no one from management ever followed up or made a good faith effort to rectify this situation. That sends a clear message that this business condones hostile, biased, and incredibly inappropriate behavior from their staff.

If you’re looking for a welcoming and enjoyable night out, I strongly recommend going elsewhere.

googleReviews.text: Wonderland Bar. First of all Yuengling. Secondly this is a bar for all ages. Embrace the weird and stay a while. The proprietor is funny and serves a mean mixed drink. Prices were very good and the atmosphere alone will keep you planted.

googleReviews.author: Liz Pena (Dizzi Lizzi)
googleReviews.text: My kind of dive bar. Colorful walls and colorful people.  Friendly service and good rock  music...I would compare to Lola's Depot in Houston.  🖤🩶💯 I'll definitely be back one day!

googleReviews.author: Rated Jaded
googleReviews.text: I was here visiting from Colorado and my son told me about this bar.  Being a huge Rob Zombie fan, as soon as my son mentioned Captain Spaulding, I had to see this place.   I LOVE this bar!!  Met the owner briefly, and he was a super nice guy.  I told him I was here from Colorado, but he had already figured I was from out of town.  Guess walking around the whole place running live videos was a dead giveaway, LOL.  Anyway, if you enjoy local bars with good music and great people, make sure to stop here when in Richmond. Even the regulars were awesome.   Impressed!  RIP Sid Haig

googleReviews.author: Joselin Solis
googleReviews.text: If I could give the food zero stars I would. We got the “6oz” steak that was not that flavorful but really salty. I ordered the lounge burger and the “beef patty” was incrediblyyy salty. I’ve never had a beef patty with the texture it had. It tasted very artificial and chewy. Not to mention, my stomach started to hurt almost immediately after barely finishing half of the burger. The fries were nothing special as well. The loaded potato came cold to the point where the cheese didn’t even melt. The only good thing was the drinks, and the waitress was really sweet and attentive. Unfortunately we will not come here again.

googleReviews.author: Eric Bliss
googleReviews.text: I'm new in town...just moved here from Austin, TX and this place really fits. Taylor said over the phone I could bring my dogs back to the outdoor area via the side and it's really Texas back there--full stage, plenty of seating, shade or sun as you like. People are friendly, service was impecable, atmosphere laid-back, the best happy hour in all of Richmond--all day on a Monday. I got the beef sandwhich for my dogs for $10 which came w fries I could dole out at will, and I had wings. Honestly, for the music alone, I can't wait, but it was the genuine attention I received that stood out w the vibe here--you might expect a college bar, but this was more a locals scene in a good way...though how the students aren't filling in  even at 3-5pm on a Monday is surprising. 5 stars w no 2nd thought, and I'll be back w my wife for music. They do acoustic stuff up front too. Really a hidden gem in Richmond.

googleReviews.author: marymo love
googleReviews.text: came in, they were pretty busy, sat on the patio, our waitress was fantastic and patient. environment was great. food was absolutely amazing. 10$ BLT with a side of the best Mac and cheese ever. 10/10

googleReviews.author: Jaden Presley
googleReviews.text: Would not recommend if you are a student at the college their bar is at just trying to pick up food nearby. Personally felt judged because I was dressed comfortably as a college student… (their bar is directly on the campus). Also felt alienated by security when they asked what I was doing there, since I was just picking up my food. Maybe if the pickup situation was better managed this wouldn’t happen. Again, would not recommend if you’re a VCU student trying to grab food nearby.

googleReviews.text: I could give this place a 5 star review but they fired their talent. Every time I meet a bartender I like (Chris and Kaitlyn) I get told they were fired by management. Sounds like management needs a revamp not the bartenders! I enjoy my nights on the patio next to the organic installation (I followed her on Instagram).

googleReviews.author: Kryptyk
googleReviews.text:
The Park in Richmond, Virginia is located near the baseball stadium and was honestly a really fun experience. There’s plenty of free parking for guests, which is always a huge plus. As you walk in, security pats everyone down to make sure everything is safe, and the process was smooth and professional.

When you first walk up, you’ll notice the huge bowling alley on the left side. They also have mini golf, an arcade, karaoke, pool tables, another bar area, and even a DJ playing music, which really helps create a fun atmosphere. There’s honestly a lot to do here for groups, couples, or just a night out with friends.

The atmosphere was definitely a vibe. The entire place felt very safe, clean, and well maintained. The staff was amazing and very friendly, welcoming, helpful, and sweet throughout the night.

We didn’t get to try every attraction besides bowling. Unfortunately, I’m personally not the biggest fan of string bowling, but it was still a fun experience overall.

For food, we had a smash burger and fries. The burger was really good and tender, and the fries were great too. The drinks were surprisingly very cheap, which was honestly amazing considering how much entertainment they offer.

Overall, we really don’t have any complaints. There’s a lot to do, the environment is fun and friendly, and it’s definitely a dope spot to check out in Richmond.

We give it 4 out of 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

googleReviews.author: Satori Poch
googleReviews.text: It was a rainy day in Richmond and we were looking for fun places to take the kids, ages 6, 11 and 13. We took the kids and decided to play 18 holes of mini golf. It was their first time and they had so much fun. The course was challenging but not too easy or difficult for us. It wasn't overly busy so we got through the course without feeling rushed. They also had duck pin bowling and karaoke. We didn't try those but we'll definitely be back another day. The woman at the customer service counter was knowledgeable,  kind and energetic. We didn't try the food or drinks. They have live music on Wednesdays and it turns into a club after 10 pm. It sounds fun, I would love to come try it one day!

googleReviews.author: Matea L.
googleReviews.text: Jan 2026 - My work booked this venue to celebrate all of our nominees for our award ceremony. We got to enjoy bowling, putt putt, and the karaoke room. We only had one bar tender, but he did great. All of the staff was great. We really enjoyed our time. I would love to come check it our during regular hours.

googleReviews.author: Tasha Newbill
googleReviews.text: Drinks, wings and fries were good. Burger looked good from the outside but as you can see it was SO PINK on the inside. Sent it back, waitress was nice about it and she also had it removed from our check. We didnt do anything else there, the burger set our whole mood off. Likely not will not return.

googleReviews.author: June Keenan
googleReviews.text: What a fun place! Something for everyone. The main bar is a huge so they could have used a few more bartenders as the drink service was slow.

googleReviews.author: Christy Baker
googleReviews.text: My first time here and I absolutely loved EVERYTHING and will def be back! Alissa provided great service and drinks and a great personality! Breakfast burrito was absolutely delicious and my BF enjoyed his CBH breakfast as well. Prices are beyond reasonable, very affordable. I'll be trying Eggs Benedict on my next visit.

googleReviews.author: Erica
googleReviews.text: I love little places like this. the server had a smile you could see from anywhere and she was as sweet as can be. the walls covered in everything from animal mounts, to flyers from many moons ago. the food however, different story. The bacon was the best part out of it all. the French toast tasted as if they still had grill cleaner on the grill before they cooked it and the inside was dry. It’s sourdough so I don’t know if maybe that’s the reason. Eggs were eggs. Nothing special there. Overall, I would say this is one of those places you just get a drink or two from.

googleReviews.author: Amy Sabet
googleReviews.text: I really like Buddy’s! Love being able to sit at a booth with friends and enjoy some drinks without feeling like I need to buy food. The only thing I would change is adding more bathrooms! It seems like there's always a long line for the bathroom.

googleReviews.author: Kim
googleReviews.text: Marie was our server. She was very nice and efficient!! The food was delicious. The prices are reasonable. I will definitely be back!

Sat right down took a while to get service but think they just were short handed seemed to be one guy doing it all he was vey pleasant but you could tell he was taking orders and bussing tables so had his plate full. Food was great wife had chicken salad club I had the BLT kids shared French toast we both had tots. Also had the wings and they were gigantic! Healthy portions for all and the chicken salad had huge delicious chunks of chicken. Will be back cool spot good food.

googleReviews.author: Mercy Guzman
googleReviews.text: I spent Halloween weekend in rva for the first time . Let me tell you, Babes’ WAS THE PLACE TO BE AT! The atmosphere was awesome and music was jumping! I felt VERY comfortable and included. I ordered vodka crans all night and the beautiful southern bartender, Lily made them! I loved Babes’ and it’s going to be a stop EVERY time I come into town.

googleReviews.author: Danty Hammer
googleReviews.text:
Never been super sold on this venue. Last night I was there and got leered at, zeroed in on, stalked by, and approached two appearly cishet men who were hunting together. I told management and they said to talk to security. As someone who has been stalked and sexually assaulted, going to security or fighting isn't something I automatically do, I am running.

There are loads of poc and trans folks who have had issues in the past. Last night I was thinking, where are the progress pride and trans flags (tons of 1978, 6 color flags and a lesbian flag but what of others)? What are you doing to protect the community?

I will give their work and landing place for stonewall sports seems like community work. I guess I just expect more of a place where there are vulnerable populations. I want people in our community to be safe. We should be able to dance without predators creeping that don't even belong in gay/ queer spaces. I almost wonder if they switched to a membership format it might help.

googleReviews.author: juice
googleReviews.text: i love babes. it’s a good silly little gay bar. it doesn’t take itself too seriously, and i love playing volleyball when i can here. however. PLEASE get a new dj for saturday nights. someone who actually djs instead of just barely mixing one song into another. i know this isn’t nyc, but every saturday i come and am disappointed by the top 100s dj . still come and support your local gay bar, but retire dj joey……..

googleReviews.author: Valerie Ashley Bell
googleReviews.text: It's Babes. It's home. It's your local comfort spot and always delivers an uplifting special experience. The love is all up in there no matter when you go. The LGTBQIA community (and straight) love coming here because it's so accepting and full of love and no judgement. Dancing, pool tables, drag shows, evnets and good happy hour specials. Last time I went (on a Saturday), even standing in line outside was an incredible life changing experience of laughs and lifelong connections and memories.

googleReviews.author: Morgan Anderson
googleReviews.text: The drinks were good. Wouldn't reccomend going if you expect it to be a lesbian bar. I dont know if it was the saturday I choose or not, but majority of the patrons were men. A mixed bar isnt an issue, but I feel like that label can set certain expectations. I also don't feel super safe going back after being assaulted by one of the men there.

googleReviews.author: John Person III
googleReviews.text:
Professionally: I found this establishment on a chance. But once I entered it was a complete vibe. Owners are genuinely nice & treats everyone with dignity & respect. Place makes you feel like you're welcomed home. Servers at this point remember my drink order and you can't forget about mama.  I started off saying professionally, but this place really is like a family. Not to mention the food is banging. You gotta try mama Lo's seafood salad. I'm from bmore and its my starter!!

Personally: I don't honestly know or think they know what the owners have done for me or given me. I've always loved music, but have never been confident in myself.  But these ladies have taken a chance on me time & time again. Them believing in me had made me believe myself. The amount of love they show, the amount of care they give, & the amount of believe they have has made me a better singer & person all around. So I truly truly thank them. I'm honored to be apart of your extended family.

googleReviews.author: Bertette Reneè
googleReviews.text: I love coming here, it is such a vibe. Food was delicious. The atmosphere is very friendly and makes you feel like you are in the presence of family. I've visited a few times with friends and even with my mom. The atmosphere is for all ages. Definitely a gem on Brookland park. Karaoke night is my fav.

googleReviews.author: Kelsie Cotman
googleReviews.text: I’ve come here a few times on a friend’s recommendation. I enjoyed myself. I love the small space because I don’t care for crowds. But it can easily get crowded in there. I’d love to see Harlym Blue’Z with a slightly bigger space. The vibes are there. I enjoy the Karaoke Nights and all they have to offer. No major complaints aside from wishing they had a bigger place.

googleReviews.author: Daicia Price she-her
googleReviews.text: I stumbled across this place when I was here for a work trip. I went home and told my husband, I HAVE to come back. Just like others say, it’s intimate, amazing and attentive staff, and the music creates an awesome vibe. My husband brought me back for my birthday/anniversary and one of the owners sang happy birthday to me and another person! My review can’t describe the feeling I had listening to the music, with my delicious drink, and I LOVE LOVE LOVE the seafood salad.

googleReviews.text: Birthday trip with my daughter, first time visiting this establishment. A small establishment filled with a smooth relaxing and charming environment. Overall we enjoyed ourselves , will return

googleReviews.author: Keith Ross Sr
googleReviews.text: Worst Birthday party for my daughter ever, waitress never came back to to check on us. The food was not that great,  for the amount of money we paid for this party is said. I will never recommend anyone to have a birthday party here. Very disappointed, need better management and staff.

googleReviews.author: Juliana Lopes
googleReviews.text: We came with family members who were visiting from out of town. Service was -5 out of 10 even though the place was not crowded. We sat at a booth at the restaurant after 10 minutes of waiting for the hostess to show up. After we ordered our food, it took an hour and half for it to show up. Even though we asked for updates, we were told by multiple people that there was nothing they could do. We finished eating, after having missed our place in line to bowl 3 times, and finally went to our lanes. We would have left after the terrible experience at the restaurant but we had already paid for 2 hours of bowling. The kids got thirsty and we made the mistake of ordering soft drinks. After waiting for another 40 minutes, my husband had to go out looking for the drinks because no one brought it. The place is cool, but service is terrible. I do not recommend and won’t be coming back.

googleReviews.author: Alley Kovalenko
googleReviews.text: Had such a great time at Uptown Alley! Their spring break deal was such a good value—bowling, arcade games, pizza, and drinks made it super easy and affordable for a fun day with the kids. They had an absolute blast, and I loved being able to relax while they played. Everything was clean, organized, and the whole experience felt stress-free. We’ll definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Tiffany Stembridge

Thank you for your amazing service Laquisha!

googleReviews.author: Marilyn Miller
googleReviews.text:
After having planted roots for three years, my fiance and I came in one evening on a whim and could not be happier to have taken the chance.
This is a Midlothian Tnpk monument.

We were greeted by smiling faces and had our orders brought out to us in rapid succession. The drinks were cold and really tasty! They have a ton of drinks specials going on at any given time.
We were not expecting the food to be the quality that it was. I was pleasantly 'pissed' when the grilled cheese came out tasting identical to mine! Now I have to find another secret weapon to bend my fiance at my will ;)

Caddy's is home town, no frills, and totally authentic. They don't pretend to be what they aren't, which makes their appeal that much brighter.
The greatest surprise was when we got our bill - how affordable everything was! We had to study our check for a moment.

I can't wait to come back and take over the karaoke stage!!!

googleReviews.author: Sophia Narlis
googleReviews.text:
⭐️Came for karaoke, stayed because the staff (Daniel, Lou, Bryan, Jennifer, Nesha & Mae) made it the best night ever. ⭐

I’ve been to Grammy Karaoke a few times before, but I’ve never had a night like the one we had yesterday, and it was entirely because of the STAFF Truly, they made our night.

My two friends and I came in pretty late, so there was a bit of a wait, but instead of feeling stuck, we were immediately taken care of at the bar. LOU was amazing; answering all our questions, giving great recommendations, and making us feel welcomed right away. BRYAN was behind the bar making absolutely superb drinks and keeping the energy fun the whole time.

Once we got into our room, DANIEL showed us the ropes and completely set the tone for the night. He was friendly, entertaining, and genuinely thoughtful; he even tried to save us money when we were ordering too many drinks by suggesting the soju yogurt drink (which was delicious and clutch). That kind of care really stood out.

Throughout the night, JENNIFER and MAE would check in so politely, always making sure not to interrupt the vibe. Jennifer especially was so warm and conversational which made everything feel more personal. Mae even helped us calculate things out when paying at the end which helped ease tensions too!

And somehow the amazing service didn’t stop there, because even the bathroom experience was memorable. We met NESHA, who made sure we were okay, not too out of it, and somehow managed to make us laugh and have even more fun from such a short interaction. Who knew?

At the end of the night, while waiting for our ride and with the place closing in five minutes, instead of rushing us out into the cold, the staff let us sit at the bar and just talk. That ended up being my FAVORITE part of the night. We laughed, chatted, and genuinely felt like we had made new friends.

Daniel, Lou, Bryan, Jennifer, Nesha, and Mae—thank you. You didn’t just give great service; you created an UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE. We left having had the time of our lives and feeling like we’d made real connections. I’ll absolutely be coming back to Grammy Karaoke, hoping we’ll meet again.

I recommend everyone come here; and if you’re nervous, new to karaoke, or just want a guaranteed good night, keep an eye out for these staff members. With a team this friendly, accommodating, and FUN, I honestly don’t see how anyone could have a bad time.

googleReviews.author: Brianna Worrell
googleReviews.text:
I was really looking forward to the Galentine’s Brunch at Keagan’s Irish Pub with a group of girlfriends, but unfortunately it was a pretty disappointing experience overall.

The biggest issue was the location of the private, ticketed event. It was hosted in the “Vice Bar,” which apparently allows regular smoking. The room was heavily permeated with cigarette and cigar smoke. It made my nose run, my sinuses burn, and my eyes itch and water almost the entire time. By the end of the event, our clothes and hair smelled overwhelmingly like smoke. My car still carries the odor, and I now have to get my blazer dry cleaned. I spent the rest of Valentine's Day with a migraine, my husband and I having to cancel our plans for the evening. At one point, a restaurant patron even came into the room and lit a cigarette. When we asked him to stop, he told us he didn’t have to because it was the smoking room. We had to call the hostess over to address it. For a prepaid, ticketed brunch event, that environment was extremely disappointing.

The food was also underwhelming. This was advertised as a full brunch, but what was offered felt more like breakfast appetizer portions. There was a single pan divided into thirds with eggs, bacon, and potatoes, no additional options, and no lunch-style items despite the noon start time. The food began running out about 20 minutes into the event and continued to run out regularly. It often took 10+ minutes to be replenished, and the fruit tray was never refilled. Because the plates were very small, you couldn’t fit more than one or two items at a time, which meant frequent trips back, only to find something empty again.

The welcome cocktail was inconsistent as well. The three drinks at our table were completely different in color and taste, one orange and tropical with passion fruit notes, another darker red with citrus and grapefruit, and another bright pink and heavily grapefruit-forward. For a signature welcome drink, that lack of consistency was surprising.

That said, there were bright spots. The mixology portion was enjoyable, Ally, the liquor/marketing rep, was informative and engaging, and Ashley, the bartender, was pleasant and helpful. The event closed with a flower arranging activity. While it was more of a “here are your flowers and vessel” setup rather than a guided lesson with arranging tips as I had expected, it was still a fun hands-on element.

Overall, for a ticketed event, the smoke-filled environment and limited, inconsistently replenished food made for a disappointing start. There were some enjoyable components, but significant improvements would be needed for me to attend one of Keagan’s Irish Pub's events again.

googleReviews.text: I had a grilled chicken Caesar salad found a small piece of bone I alerted our server who was amazing. I wanted them to know so they could let the supplier know. She came out apologized, my meal was free and I was given a gift card. I was not expecting this. The customer service was outstanding! If you live or visit Virginia Beach you need to go to Keagan’s! You all are amazing!!!!

googleReviews.author: Stuie “Gunny” W.
googleReviews.text:
We decided to go out on 4July2025 at about 10:00PM, still three hours before last call and four hours until close.  I am a disabled veteran with a really bad back so I requested a booth. There was a one minute side conversation that ended with "...as long as it's my table." Famous last words. Spending three years during high school and college, prior to the Navy, I waited tables. And for those that don't know, restaurants are divided into zones, so when a guest makes a request for a specific table (i.e. being a "potential problem pain in the ass table"), either a server gets double sat (two groups of guests he/she may have responsibility for at the same time for all tasks) or it gets assigned to a different server. Well, it was obviously Mila M's turn to be sat, so she was assigned as our server.

We sat in a beautiful wood bench by the door, adjacent to the bar, very spacious and comfortable. We enjoyed the tree made out of Jameson bottles across from us. Even though they had live music and we sat adjacent to the bar, the volume of the music was enjoyable and didn't interfere with normal conversation.

Mila walked over to us introduced herself, was very friendly, and seemed knowledgeable about the menu items. We ordered drinks, I had a Hardywood West Creek Cider, on tap, and I enjoyed it. Mila told me people usually order the other brand they have on tap. I decided to take a chance. The Hardywood Cider was good, but not on the sweeter side. So if you find some hard apple cider drinks too sweet, then this is your goto.

We ordered the fried pickles as an appetizer and they are huge and delicious, served with ranch. The breading is like a beer batter and suits the pickles well.  She took our appetizer order with our drinks, then cane back to take our food order with our drinks.

I ordered the Fish and Chips and the fish was light, flaky, not very fishy, and rather delicious. The batter did not overpower the fish except at the very end pieces, but I enjoy those crispy ends anyway. It's served on a bed of French fries that come out crispy and with good flavor. It's served with a lemon wedge and tartar sauce. I asked for malt vinegar.

My table mates ordered potato skins, 1lb of wings, lemon pepper flavored, and an order of onion rings. Kind of a hodge podge for the two of them to share.

Sorry, no photos of the potato skins or wings, but I did get the onion rings, which are in the same beer batter as the fried pickles, so very tasty. I couldn't help but snag one.

So far, everything is great, the app came out at a perfect time, the food came out at a perfect time... yet Mila, in a different Devin clear across the restaurant failed to notice our drinks were all less than half full. For the next 30-35 minutes, while we were dining, Mila did not stop at the table one time. Sitting with empty water glasses, empty drink glass, an empty bar glass (drinks from the bar can significantly increase the cost of a meal, therefore increasing the amount of tip). She finally came over to ask how we were doing and we asked her for four boxes. Not once, looking at the table while standing there with seven empty glasses, did she ask if any of us would like a refill or a drink to go. She brought the boxes, we packed our food, paid the bill, and I left a 20% tip. When i enjoy my meal out, and the wait staff is exceptional, I usually leave between 30%-40%.

Now, being a server, a half full drink should prompt a "are you ready for refills or would you like to wait a bit?" Nothing like that when she had to leave her station of assigned tables all the way across the restaurant to deliver our food. Now, as we were not in her section, even though she "strongly suggested" We were going to be her table, we were neglected. As servers walk their own section they scan for issues with food, disgruntled glances, EMPTY GLASSES, yet even though Mila wanted us as her table, we were obviously an inconvenience. We sat down at about 10:05 PM and got our check at 10:48 PM. We were also only sat with one place setting of silverware.  Now for the pics

Go see the Cult Leader on lunch M & F. Have Sal's ebullient service on Tuesdays. Experience the joy of Lilly on Wednesday and Thursday.  Have the burger and have the fish and chips. Get a Hendricks martini.

Go. Go now.

googleReviews.text:
Went here with my family based on reviews on Yelp showing 4.3/5 stars. We show up, and it was dingy looking, bathrooms were not clean, and the service was absolute trash.

From the time we walked in and sat down, it took 20 minutes to even be acknowledged by staff and for a round of waters to be brought. It wasn’t even busy. There were 5 people sitting at the bar when we walked in, 2 of which were getting ready to leave. Then when we placed our order, we ordered an appetizer and a side salad. It took 30 minutes for them to bring it out to us, and an additional 7 minutes AFTER I had to go up to the bar and ask for them because we didn’t want them coming out with our food. So we finally got the side salad and appetizers, and our food was coming out. My food was overcooked, and my tater tots were hockey pucks. Well, the bartender(s) were so drunk and one was high on drugs that they forgot to ring in a meal for one of my family members. So we asked them about it, and they both said oh let me go check on this. It took another 12 minutes before his meal was brought out. It was for a simple BLT- should have taken make 5-7 minutes total. Then we asked for refills on water and we didn’t get those until we were almost finished with our dinner. VERY DISAPPOINTED. Not only that, but the bar tenders were too busy talking and socializing instead of doing their jobs, and checking on customers. After the meal was finished, we had to go and ask for our checks so we could pay. They didn’t even ask how everything was. This place does not even deserve a single star. It was terrible. I won’t be recommending this to anyone, because of how awful the service, food, and environment was.

googleReviews.author: Tina Li
googleReviews.text:
Lived in Baltimore a couple years but never came here before. The decor is amusing, quirky, and hilarious but honestly the food exceeded my expectations. Came an hour after opening when it was relatively quiet for lunch.

I got a Wild West burger with fries (they were waffle fries) and the individual components were good and they also worked well together. Burger was well seasoned / flavorful. Very cheesy. Super crispy, plentiful bacon. Only wish there was more of the pickle / jalapeños which provided nice complexity to the burger. This was like a 9/10 burger which was a pleasant surprise. Waffle fries were solid/standard.

Service was friendly.

googleReviews.author: Chaz Stanford
googleReviews.text: 1st time checking out this historic bar in Fells Point.  Walked in early afternoon on a Friday.  Seemed like a cool spot with some live music playing and had some Olympic coverage on one of the TVs.   Ordered a beer and asked to put the US Men's Hockey semifinal game on.  Bartender said they only sports they normally show are Ravens or Orioles games on and he wouldn't change it even though he said multiple other people had asked for the hockey game.  Had planned to stay for multiple drinks and watch some hockey, but ended up closing out after one and going over to Max's Taproom which has way better beer and had the game on.  I get you have your policies and what not, but maybe read the room when there are like 10-15 people in the bar on a Fri afternoon and multiple people wanting to watch a US Team in the Olympics playing to advance to a gold medal game.  You definitely lost some business today.

googleReviews.author: Samantha Wolfe
googleReviews.text:
We stopped into The Horse You Came In On Saloon twice during our Baltimore trip and it ended up being one of our favorite spots.

First off, the history alone makes it worth a visit. This place is often credited as the oldest continuously operating bar in Baltimore, and you can feel that history the moment you walk in. That said, don't let the name or exterior fool you this is not a country bar. The first night we were there they were playing early 2000s emo, which was unexpected and amazing.

The crushes are clearly the star here. I had a blackberry crush ($14) and I also tried the orange crushes ($12), which was really good and fresh. The only small downside was the blackberry seeds but that's kind of expected since they muddle real fruit. Just a personal texture thing, not a dealbreaker.

I also grabbed a t-shirt because the merch is genuinely cool. Shirts were $28 for a short-sleeve tee, which seems reasonable for a historic spot and a solid souvenir.

Food-wise: the first night (Tuesday) they didn't have food, but Wednesday they did. We ordered the cowboy fries as a small plate. The menu isn't huge more bar snacks than full meals but it worked perfectly for grazing and hanging out.

The vibe is where this place really shines. Rustic, grungy, slightly outlaw cowboy energy with a twist. There's a motorcycle mounted on the wall, a small stage between the front and back areas, and way more space than you'd expect. The front bar is smaller and cozy; the back bar is massive with tables and booths spread throughout. It's the kind of place you accidentally spend five hours just talking, drinking, and existing.

Overall, great drinks, cool people, killer atmosphere, and serious character. We had such a good time and will absolutely be back next time we're in Baltimore.

googleReviews.author: Robbie Deaton
googleReviews.text: My wife and I went here for the first time while visiting spots in Baltimore associated with Edgar Allen Poe. This place is advertised as one of his last stops before he mysteriously died and we visited here on the same day we visited the house he lived in for 2 years between 1833-35 and after visiting his grave site in Baltimore. While food and  service were excellent, we were also excited to enjoy live music while we ate. This is a bar and is probably the reason for how dimly lit it was in  places in the bar, but that's why I rated the atmosphere as 4 stars. Regardless, we thoroughly enjoyed our wine, food and the time we visited and will definitely come back.

googleReviews.text: The service I received at this establishment last night doesn’t even deserve one star. My coworkers and I were treated unkindly the moment we walked in, the older woman with strawberry blonde hair made sure we will never return to this “dive bar”. My coworkers  who forgot their ID were asked to leave that I understand, however, I was asked for identification twice, my coworker who is legally 21 and awaiting her right to left ID was also asked to leave. The bar was full and by our second drink we were told we were getting closed out because it was last call. This was shortly after 1 am. Bar was fully closed, everybody out by 1:40 despite hours listed as 2 am. I work in the service industry and have never felt so targeted. She did not hold back her disdain for us at all, it was so obvious.

googleReviews.author: Vladimir
googleReviews.text: If you love beer and a great bar atmosphere, this is a must-visit! First of all, I highly recommend the ribs if you're a fan. Also, be sure to grab a beer flight (sampler set) so you can figure out what you like best. The atmosphere here is amazing, the food is delicious, and the beer selection is massive. Don’t just stick to the basics—try something unique and interesting!

googleReviews.author: Tiffany
googleReviews.text: Extensive tap list and special beer fest days. Their June beer fest days offer 6o+ sours. The pit beef is like no other! Try it spicy! They also offers tots, tenders and Mac n cheese and allow children in before 5 PM. Also, really cool environment and excellent service. Expect to order at the counter.

googleReviews.author: Doug Fischer
googleReviews.text: Gotta give this place 5 stars. Visiting Balti for a boys trip, we wanted a sports bar for a good Sunday fun day and very happy we chose this spot. The whole atmosphere was fun and everyone was geared up for football. The beer selection here is insane, SO many top-tier selections. Food was great as well, we ordered a ton but the two unanimous favorites were the wings (5 stars, must try) and the barnyard burger 🔥🔥🔥. Everything else was decent, although the pit beef sandwich was mediocre, only thing we weren't crazy about/ disliked. The service here was great too; the staff walking around bussing the tables was 11/10 working full throttle.. full bar and not a single empty glass sat on our table for more than 2 minutes without being cleared off (please give this guy a raise -- we were there 9/21 afternoon).  I explored the entire Fell St area in my inebriated state in order to scope the scene for a possible bar swap mid day just to switch it up, but after poking around in every single establisbment in the area I didnt feel that anything out-matched Max's. We stayed here all day and didn't regret it.

googleReviews.author: David Camargo
googleReviews.text: A fantastic spot to catch a game while enjoying an incredible selection of beers on tap—over 100 varieties to choose from! The atmosphere is lively, the screens are everywhere, and there’s something on draft for every taste.

These are the most flavorful wings that I have had in a WHILE! Don’t change a thing & I will definitely be back for 2 orders the next time! If you haven’t had their wings, I feel like saying “you’re missing out” is an understatement.
