googleReviews.author: Isaac Askew
googleReviews.text:
Super chill place! The staff was friendly, direct, and communicative. Bartender (Katie) was stupid fast with the drinks, and the drinks were good. We didn’t try the food. Karaoke system worked very well - plenty of signs to pick from and you could easily change the key of each song if you needed or adjust the volume of the speakers in the room. Rooms hold up to 6 people but a larger one was available for up to 14 people if needed.

Great night, great drinks. Was available last minute in a Saturday night too by chance. Will definitely be back.

googleReviews.author: Kristin Becker
googleReviews.text:
I came here with 12 of my besties for my 41st Bday. First of all, cute as hell! Beautifully decorated, comfortable and posh. I was greeted warmly and my friends and I were brought into our private room. We used our phones to control the music and sang for three hours straight. The vibe was on point with a solid go-to cocktail menu, cider, beer and even sake on tap. Rocket Dog brought over some killer apps - try the fried cauliflower with Thai sauce. I also ordered a picture perfect and delicious provision tray so everyone could try different cheeses, cakes and nuts. So classy!

I love to come to Pitch solo as well, but having all my friends there to sing and celebrate with and excellent food, drinks and service made it extra special.

googleReviews.author: Melinda Myrick
googleReviews.text: I have no notes for Pitch! The staff is friendly, helpful, and welcoming. We booked a party to celebrate our daughter's birthday. She and her best friend use a power chairs, so accessibility is often an issue for our families. This was not the case at Pitch. They reserved a room that accommodated a party of 8, and they worked with the neighboring business that shares the accessible entrance to ensure it was free of obstacles. The girls had a great time, and we can't wait to go back.

googleReviews.author: Emily Leach
googleReviews.text: So much fun! We celebrated a birthday here and had an amazing time. The karaoke rooms were a blast, the atmosphere was great, and the food and drinks were honestly just as good as the entertainment. Everything made for such a fun night out. Would definitely recommend for birthdays, group nights, or just a fun evening with friends!

googleReviews.author: Chris Langford
googleReviews.text:
I grew up going to Mister G’s — back when I was twenty-one… and even a little underage at eighteen. Times were different then, and I had friends who worked there, so it always felt like home. The original nostalgia is still there, and walking in today brings back all those memories.

They’ve added a brand-new area that’s really nice and gives you a different way to enjoy the place. I went on a Wednesday thinking it wouldn’t be busy, but it was still packed with people from the Middletown area and Eastern High School. It actually made the night better — getting to catch up with everyone.

The pizza isn’t quite the same as it was when Goodall’s restaurant was in the back, but honestly, you’re really there for the drinks and the people. And for that, Mister G’s still delivers.

googleReviews.author: Jess Ehm
googleReviews.text:
The service was great! Unfortunately, the food wasn't the best I've had.

I ordered the chicken wings. The sauce was okay. I believe on the menu it's claims to be a "secret sauce". The issue was the large amount of breading and fat on the wings. I could barely find any actual chicken. They might want to reconsider their take on "wings".

Good selection of beer and cocktails.

googleReviews.author: Nathaniel Pendleton
googleReviews.text: Two words: SKEE BALL. also live bands. That's actually four words, five if you include "also." This was one of the best burgers i have had in AGES and the bar staff is super cool. The stage is huge and the sound setup is great for any size band. Highly recommend.

googleReviews.author: Sarah Michelle
googleReviews.text: Holy wow, this place was awesome! The staff was the kindest and friendliest I've ever met in a bar, and the food was outstanding and reasonably priced for the amount you get. The interior is gorgeous and I love the use of all the whiskey barrels! Such a beautiful place!

googleReviews.author: T Bins
googleReviews.text: Travis was the bartender and he was the sh....!!! He recommended Jefferson Bourbon and it was excellent. He made me the absolute best smoked old fashion I have ever had! He torched the orange and he muddled that with the cherries and the juice. He added Heavenly Hill Bourbon, smoked it, covered all the smokiness in the glass with a coaster, just to add ICE!!!! LAWD!!!! IT WAS THE BEST OLD FASHIONED! THE SMOKE WAS LOCKED IN THE GLASS!!!!! ALL OF THIS.... on top of an awesome burger. I had the Gouda Burger. It was perfection, once I asked for extra sweet chili aoli sauce. WE WILL BE BACK! THANK YOU TRAVIS!!!!

googleReviews.author: Celess Parson
googleReviews.text:
If you're ready to BUMP AND GRIND- this place has outstanding music selection especially if you want to hop in and sing a tune or two with karaoke Thursday, Friday and Saturday. The cocktails and drinks are to die for, not literally, but delicious. You won't find anything like it!
But the best part was the BBQ! Best BBQ I've ever had IN MY LIFE. Swing in and show them some love!

googleReviews.author: JigglyPix
googleReviews.text: We had a BLAST at this location. We went on a Friday night. Despite opening at 6, it doesn’t really get busy until like 9 or 9:30. Upon entering we were immediately checked for weapons which made me feel extremely safe in this environment. Staff were super friendly and everyone was extremely encouraging. Music catalog was HUGE, just wish they had more/newer Taylor Swift! Drinks were super good too. HIGHLY recommend the “Sweet Dream”!

googleReviews.author: Cierra Best
googleReviews.text: I had a girls night tonight celebrating our birthdays and this was the perfect spot! The staff was so friendly, they take their security seriously, and it was actually so clean! As soon as people would leave, I saw them wiping down their tables and chairs, there were covers over the mics, if something was spilled they cleaned it up immediately. The staff was also so accommodating to me. I have OCD so they allowed me to hold my ID while getting checked in and they didn’t pat me down-they just had me empty my pockets! At one point I had to walk away because I kept smelling weed and one of the bouncers (Jake) asked me if everything was ok. When I told him, he went and sprayed febreze! And he walked us to our cars! Just overall a great experience. We will definitely be coming back!

googleReviews.author: Shelby Frederick
googleReviews.text:
I’m not a person who writes reviews often, and over all this was a super fun experience. HOWEVER, we got there 30 minutes before our reservation time and waited 25 minutes to be brought back to the room. Our reservation was from 11pm to 1am, and we were told our time was up at 12:30. We were told this was because we showed up early, and by early they meant the time we waited to get into our room. The forms you sign
before going say they charge late fees. So, since it was New Years we arrived early since traffic is unpredictable, and we wanted to ensure we arrived in a timely manner. We did not realize in doing so that would be cutting into our time in our private room. I feel like if you book a room, you should be in that room for the duration of your reservation time. Waiting time to get into the room should not be accounted into it. The girl was super nice and polite, but we had no warning that our time was up. We still had songs and things that we wanted to do while we were in there. Also, after we left we realized we had been double charged for said room. They did fix this, but it’s just annoying, especially after we got kicked out of our room early.

googleReviews.author: Gompye
googleReviews.text: Rented a room for 2 hours, it was a ton of fun! They had a great music selection, even some anime songs! And if you didn’t see a song on their app, you could switch the ipad to youtube

googleReviews.author: Jasmine Dickens
googleReviews.text: Want to real karaoke fun!! Check out Night Kitty near downtown Lexington. They ID at the door, you must be 21. You can have the open space or a private room and have the time of your Life!! Our group has a private room and we were able to select any song of our choice. Our server was great and efficient. My friends ordered drinks and said they were really good. I’d definitely visit again!!

googleReviews.author: David Shea
googleReviews.text: When you walk thru the front door of Yesterday's you feel a vibe. Its a laid back place to meet friends and make new ones. With a great set of bartenders that are sweet and always ready to make you that next drink or take your food order. The karaoke  dj is awesome an she has such a warm friendly attitude an is a great singer. Th e sound system is well adjusted an the crowd is really receptive to all styles of music. An alot of them will dance an cheer you on! Plus for some of my friends with optical impairments the words to the sings are easy to see. The pool tables are great an there are always chances to play . I think they have 6 of them .  Sticks an chalk on the wall an lots of places to sit near the bar or at tables or on stools ,chairs or comfy little cube style seats. The kitchen is ok with a few bar foods. .  The karaoke talent is mind blowing. An everyone I met there is so friendly and welcoming. Plenty of parking. and clean bathrooms.

googleReviews.author: Nicole Addison
googleReviews.text: Loved hearing my brother sing. Celebrating his 40th bday. Kyra is the best bartender/ waitress!!! I had the disco fries with no green onions and brown gravy on the side. They were crispy, crunchy, so good!!!! No cover charge, did not check if at door or at bar. I took pictures of the menus so you know what's here! No booths very little seating that's not bar stools. Pool is expensive. 15 for an hour. They have seperate music where the pool tables are. That's all I can think of about my 1st visit here.

googleReviews.author: justin johnson
googleReviews.text: Used to love this bar. Me and my girlfriend have been coming here since we have been together. But we walked in tonight to play some pool and my girlfriend had to use the bathroom. Their ignorant staff accused her of doing blow in the bathroom, which is outrageous because she works for the state police and doesnt do anything close to that. I've seen full groups of people go in there just to snort coke and nothing was ever even said to them. But even when we prove that we didnt do anything, I guess the security was too embarrassed to admit that he was in the wrong, and said it doesnt matter EVEN THOUGH HE GOT THE WRONG PERSON and still felt the need to escort us out. We did nothing wrong. Just walk in and wait for a pool table. I advise for you to never come to this establishment if you dont want to be disrespected. As a bartender, I dont think this should stand and I hope more people with similar stories come forward and put them on blast. We did not deserve that at all.

googleReviews.author: Lauryn Pace
googleReviews.text:
My husband and I absolutely love this place!! Hands down the best karaoke place in town. The pool is nice too, and the atmosphere is always fun and welcoming!
We’ve become regulars and the staff is genuinely friendly, the drinks are always great, and the DJ does a killer keeping everything running smoothly, and singing too! Could not recommend this place enough!!!

googleReviews.author: Bennie Melton
googleReviews.text: My husband and I are from out of town, we got recommended this bar and it did not disappoint! Our bartender Avery was impeccable and did not miss a beat, the security guy Zeke was amazing and taught us to properly play cornhole🤣. The rest of the staff was wonderful and so very welcoming. Safe to say it’s our new favorite bar!!

name: Neon Moon Bar & Lounge
address: 1801 Alexandria Dr Ste # 50, Lexington, KY 40504, USA
about: Neon Moon Bar & Lounge is a karaoke bar in Lexington, Kentucky. It holds a 4.5-star rating from 134 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Katelyn Joy Moore
googleReviews.text:
Unbeatable happy hour and prices! It is a fun energy — they always have events going on, like trivia, karaoke, themed parties, contests, and more! They do a good job keeping social media updated with new events, cancellations, etc!

The drinks are your basic bar drinks. Nothing too interesting for wine, but a good amount of beer options and a few fun cocktails, as well as classics like a Margarita and a Moscow Mule! The pretzels and beer cheese are really good, especially for being only $8!

The bartenders are super friendly and personable! You can tell they all have fun together and enjoy their jobs. My bartender was very sweet and she was very quick to help me!!

The atmosphere is very much that of a hole-in-the-wall local spot, and not necessarily geared towards the college demographic, but more so geared towards the community itself, which is great! Everyone seemed to know each other already, or want to know each other! It is a super fun but laid back space that doesn’t feel like it’s trying to be something it isn’t. The bathrooms are a bit run down but they are clean and taken care of — don’t judge a book by its cover like I did. It is just fun, chill, and a solid dive bar!

INFO ADDED AFTER BEING AT THE PLACE A BIT LONGER: some of the regulars I met were a bit creepy to me as a younger woman, as well as made some racist and sexist comments, as well as slurs. Obviously this is not a review of the business itself, but I wanted to put that information out there in case there are younger women or people of color considering coming alone. I was here on a Wednesday evening so it’s probably not every night, but some of the people said some things that made me feel a bit unsafe.
Just sharing so people who may be considering coming have a bit more info! :)

googleReviews.author: V. B.
googleReviews.text: The ultimate local bar experience with plenty of parking, amazing food, friendly staff and karaoke, trivia and more going on!!  Love the vibe here. So glad I ran up on this place. Very affordable and delicious food. The crowd is diverse and I love that about this place too! Trivia Wednesdays @ 8pm. Come win a prize!! Live music and check out the beautiful patio area with a heated tent out there too!

I love their food! Quesadillas are excellent! I got the bbq pulled pork quesadilla, comes with chips and salsa! Tips and tricks: ask for the honey hot sauce on the side and dip your dilla or chips in it! So yummy! See pics below!

Street corn quesadilla for $5. Add chicken is $2. Chips and salsa! Monday special all quesadillas $5!

googleReviews.author: Keith Elam
googleReviews.text:
Before attending an event at Memorial Coliseum, we decided to stop by Tin Roof for a beer and some food. We were greeted promptly and seated outside, which was perfect for the nice weather. Our server, Cat, took great care of us—she was friendly, attentive, and very knowledgeable about the menu.
We started with the Loaded Tots, which were excellent—crispy, flavorful, and a great appetizer to share. For our entrées, I had the Cheeseburger with fries, and my nephew had the Shrimp Po’ Boy. Both were tasty and well-prepared.
Overall, the service from Cat was the highlight of our visit. She really made the experience enjoyable. We’ll definitely be back next time we’re in the area!

googleReviews.text: Review 8.12.2025 We tried this restaurant for the first time, and the last a couple of weeks ago. I want to start with the very first impression. As we found a table and sat down both our table and my chair were not balanced so they were wobbly. My husband and I could tell this is a “regulars” hangout. The waitress (the only one for all tables) knew many other customers by name. When she was moving, she was hustling but she would stop to chat with the “regulars”. Our drinks ran dry more than once and it took a bit to order. They advertise “All Day Brunch” on the menu but when my husband ordered a Breakfast Burrito we were informed they were out of eggs, which is in all but one brunch item they offer. The menu just says “Chicken”. It does not indicate the kind of chicken, which we found out later were wings. The flavors/sauces were also not listed. After we ordered we had to wait quite a while. A guy who entered 15 mins behind us had his food before we even got our appetizer. The appetizer arrived, and as you can see by the picture, one tater skin had no topping (other than cheese).. The table two over actually ended up sending their meal back but I can’t speak to why. My husband liked the flavor of his wings. My meal was much more underwhelming. I never had a Philly that I didn’t like, until that visit. It was under seasoned and flavorless while the sweet potato fries were over salted.

googleReviews.author: Hefe Prescott
googleReviews.text: It can be loud, but the wings are really good and who can resist mini corn dogs. Such a guilty pleasure. Happy hour has some awesome deals, but you have to get there early. The staff is super friendly. And there is live music three days a week.

googleReviews.author: Mike
googleReviews.text: It's been a few years since we came here last and this was before the expansion.  The new design is so much more and we love it with lots of seating in the two big areas, two bars, outside patio area, and nice live action. I love the atmosphere for our visit on new years eve.  No crowds, nice vibe and a calm environment. We're 30 and don't care for crowded areas anymore. So thank you for a nice low key area for delicious food and drinks.

googleReviews.author: Lori Stokes
googleReviews.text:
It’s not called the Wal-mart of bars for nothing.
My husband and I stopped by the other night after a long hiatus.   We used to go somewhat regularly before the redo.   It had a neighborhood feel to it and never any issues.   We are close to retirement age and like to go out for a fun night of drinks and mind our own business.   The food is pretty good but the some clientele as the night progresses seems to get less desirable.

For instance my sister was there for a Halloween party with her friends and some lady sucker punched her for no reason.

We wanted to give it another try the other night but as always we leave there and say we won’t be back.   This time we mean it.

The drinks may be cheaper, but with cheap drinks come with some rough clientele.

Save Your Time & Money!

I’ve gone a lot of time over the years, but it has definitely lost its quality. The atmosphere, cleanliness, and attitude of workers & customers is overall awful.

Last night I got a shot and I got charged $8! dollars! I told the bartender that’s crazy and asked where the manager or owner is. He directed me to the Owner, Kenny, outside.

I went and told Kenny that he’s insane for doing that. This isn’t some bar downtown, it’s a small, hole-in-the-wall. He got so mad, surrounded by his “women” he started calling me names, threatening to call the cops, I was already walking out.. but still awful, disgusting behavior. I’m never going back.

googleReviews.text: Immediately one can tell this is a home away from home, where everyone is "framily." We had the most wonderful experience!! We have already planned our next Kentucky trip with daily trips to this amazing bar, and hope our new Kentucky "framily" will come to SC so that we may repay some of the southern hospitality shown to us. googleReviews.author: Karol Herron
googleReviews.text:
Was by far the absolute best karaoke bar I’ve ever been to. I’m from Louisville Kentucky, travel a lot, been to many. This is my absolute favorite ALL the way around!! I did not encounter one single person that was rude in any way shape or form. There was one, we TRIED one another lol. You know who you are, but WE redeemed ourselves quickly. We know what happened and why. Every single soul was absolutely gorgeous inside and out.
I feel Lexington should be my home!
Two very special souls touched me deeply. You know who you are. HALEY and your boyfriend as well.
Had such a blast and such pure fun by all was had. Missing this place more than anything atm, due to several reasons, but mainly being so unfairly and so far separated from one of my very own besties.
He still cannot believe he was the last singer and closed down this place. 🙌🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻
Props my friend and I’m praying so deeply this new found journey and happiness, plays out just as God had planned for you ✌️💜🙏⭕️💯👸🤴🙌🏻🐦‍🔥💪🏻

googleReviews.author: John Conway
googleReviews.text: A lot of nice people go here as regulars from the local community. They have TouchTunes here if you ever want to play music, and the prices at the bar are quite reasonable. As for the atmosphere, it's pretty dark in there, it's like a really dark version of Cheers.

googleReviews.author: Derek Picklesimer
googleReviews.text:
Best bar in Lexington- BAR NONE!

Reasonably priced drinks and some terrific bar food. The best beer cheese I've ever had. Highly recommend the Chinoe burger.

But what makes this place so great is the service and the employees. Kyu Su is just the best and a great guy and Donna makes the best LIT in the world and always takes great care of us. The staff here are so friendly and accommodating I can't say enough good things about them.

And of course, Chinoe is known locally for having the best karaoke in town. Such a fun, laid back atmosphere and everyone is there to have a good time. Huge catalogue of songs to choose from and the sound quality is great.

Been coming here for almost 7 years and it's always a good time. You won't find a better bar with better service in town. Plus, more recently, they have a great selection of Buffalo Trace bourbons.

If you like darts, there are several boards in the back and if youre looking for a great place to watch a UK game or sports this is absolutely my favorite place! They crank the sound up for the games and the patrons get very lively and excited for the UK games. Certainly the best place in town to catch a game and enjoy a few (or more) cold ones.

This is a staple of the Lexington community and the staff are like family. I've never had a bad experience here. It's just the best!

googleReviews.author: Scott Teepe Jr
googleReviews.text:
Strongest drink on Lexington! Karaoke, usually with amazing singers. The owner is there most nights, and it is typically busy.
One of our favorites spots to go and relax. Plenty of TVs for football as well.

Great KJ.. Dwayne was amazing!! Thanks for singing regulators with me my friend!
😉💜🙏
Super talented people and everyone is so supportive and friendly! Bartenders are on point and provide great service!!

They have darts and TVs in the back room as well! Awesome place, great crowd,.. please stop in and check it out!! 🤘

googleReviews.author: Ron Nelson
googleReviews.text:
I have to start by saying I was invited by friends to meet here. I'm not usually interested in going to bars, I was told they had food and I was hungry.

First, it's a bar and it serves food fit for bar flies. I read the menu offering of something to the effect of roast ribs with au jus gravy, au gratin potatoes, with grilled asparagus and baby carrots and thought I'd try it. I was hungry so I ate it but it wasn't at all worth the $15 it cost me.

The roasted ribs or whatever it was advertised as reminded me of straight up canned roast beef that likely come from the dollar general down the street. There was actually some roast involved, but it was covered in something canned for sure. Very watery and very greasy.

Once I used the salt and pepper packs I was given with it, the meal actually wasn't bad tasting. It was just too greasy for my taste. I get it though, greasy food and alcohol go hand and hand.

The veggies were honestly my favorite part of the meal. They appeared and tasted grilled. A grilled veggie medley would've been a better meal choice imo.

My friends tried a reuben and a cheeseburger. They also ordered chips with their sandwiches instead of fries or rings. I tried a chip, I didn't mind it, but my friends said they were too salty. And the friend who ordered the burger said it tasted good but was too messy.

My server seemed really busy, if I was guessing she was the only server working. It took quite a while to place my order and another diner I didn't know asked for my menu when I sit it down. I wasn't sure how long a refill of my water might take, so I nursed it in case.

I can say I appreciate that they did check id's at the entrance. And they had karaoke advertised certain nights and a friend mentioned they had a lady's night sort of thing going, so that's nice. The location is fine, it isn't far from other food choices at least. If I went back, I'd fill up somewhere else cause the red carpet lounge is meant more for drinks.

googleReviews.author: Justin Sowards
googleReviews.text: This is a tough review. I went her for the Kegs 4 K9's event and ultimately my experience is based off the food. The bar area and outdoor space is really nice but these were no question the worst chicken wings I've tasted. Thick breading and way overcooked and the "hot" were only hot because of the fryer temperature. Seems like it's by design that it's more of a dry rub instead of a sauce because others nearby had a similar appearance even though they were different flavors. My wife had the turkey wrap which was pretty ok and the onion rings were pretty good but wow, those wings were bad. Maybe you can order them in a different style without the breading? I'm not sure but I couldn't finish them. Cool spot with an expansive menu so if I'm ever back in there then I'll try something else and update the review.

googleReviews.author: Linda Porter
googleReviews.text: Always used to love it but the drinks have become very overpriced and very weak.  It's a good old dive bar but they need to up their drink game.  Same owner as Sam's Uptown Cafe, but Sam's has great drinks and excellent bar food. Carpet needs improvement in a lot of areas.

googleReviews.author: Flower Power
googleReviews.text: We came in the waitress told us we could sit wherever we wanted, our waitress was super sweet. We had apps, wings and beer. The apps were alright, the pickles were tasty but a bit oily for my taste. The dip that went with them wasnt my favorite, tasted a little like ketchup. The pretzels and cheese were delicious. They were covered in butter with chunky salt. The wings were good and pretty big by normal standard. I had spicy honey, and expected them to be a bit hotter but were more like a sweet n sour kinda feel. Beer was cold and delicious. We've been a few times, and well always go back!

googleReviews.author: Josh Keaton
googleReviews.text: What a fantastic experience we had! From the moment we walked in to when we left, it was a grand time! The service could have been better for our table specifically however I believe this employee was still in training. The food was to die for! The cheese fries were phenomenal! The fries were so crispy and well seasoned. I did enjoy the pepperoni roll also, but my favorite dish was the burger! The meat was seasoned generously, and if they had brought out the burger itself without any condiments or toppings I still would have eaten it with a smile. Yes, it was THAT good! We will be back and in greater numbers!

googleReviews.text:
First time here, went with a group of friends for a friends birthday celebration. Security is tight and can take a little while to get through so it's better to be early for your reservation.
Was fun, would go back if in the mood for a karaoke bar.

googleReviews.author: C Curry
googleReviews.text:
WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!

Came here for my friend’s birthday, and I wish we would’ve went somewhere else.

Atmosphere- they have you using YOUTUBE. The internet was slow so the songs were lagging or just not loading while ppl were performing. The microphones were going in and out. We could hear the music from the bar’s karaoke.

Service- waitress had an attitude. Wasn’t personable at all. I think her name was Jasmine. We got in the room late and she rudely came and told us Time was up AFTER we were told we would get our full time.

Food and drinks- food was trash. Got the wings and they were those fatty small freezer wings. Fries were $9 for a small amount. Drinks were okay but def overpriced! They AUTOMATICALLY ADD GRATUITY! And then ask for more after your transaction. It’s literally robbery.

Security- they were cool. Would’ve rather had them be our host/waitress.

All and all I would not recommend and won’t be back.

googleReviews.author: Melissa Thomfohrda
googleReviews.text: This was my (and my group's) first time doing a karaoke room. We thought it would be fun to try for a birthday. I booked online and paid the deposit of $60 for the small room - fair enough. When we arrived we were greeted by a locked door and an armed security guard who seemed to be on his first shift. After standing awkwardly in the "holding room" downstairs we were allowed to go upstairs. I ended up being charged another $94 for the room - on the site it says it is $120 for the small room. The prices are deceiving and you are not provided with any receipts so my calculation is that the room has a ~20% service added so ended up paying $154 for just the room for 2 hours. It is "pay as you go" for drinks and there is a 20% fee added to each transaction but the servers will still ask you for an additional tip so be aware. We learned that you can go to the bar and grab drinks since our server was not super attentive. The room we had (room 202) was an absolute sauna and not in a good way. We asked multiple times to have the heat turned off but the best they could do was prop the door open which sorta defeats the point of a private karaoke room. Everything in the room was "sticky" and the place gives a strip club vibe. Also having to do the songs from YouTube kind of sucks. There are plenty of fun karaoke bars in the city with better vibes, better drinks and better service for WAY less money. My rec is Sidekicks in Irving Park.

googleReviews.author: Bob I
googleReviews.text:
I had a really fun time at this karaoke bar with my friends—the energy was great and they have an awesome selection of songs to choose from. It made for a super fun night out.

One thing I wish had been communicated more clearly was that a 20% tip was already included. The server handed me the portable POS to complete the payment for my bucket of drinks without showing the itemization, so I didn’t realize gratuity had already been added. It would’ve been nice to have that transparency upfront. I tipped the extra 20% because I didn’t know tip was already included. Two stars off for that.

Overall, still a great spot for karaoke and a fun night with friends! 🎤

googleReviews.author: Caitlynn Williams
googleReviews.text: Waitresses was rude, had a very nasty attitude. Took forever for her to even come into our room. Hostess was drunk. Literally fell over when walking us to the room. The only good thing was security! Definitely not worth the money spent

googleReviews.author: Soo Yi
googleReviews.text: Came here for a birthday party and was impressed with the private karaoke room! It was clean, updated song system with selecting your popular songs, and spacious rooms! Had a great night with my group of 7 people. One suggestion is to provide tambourines for the private rooms! I was shocked they weren’t in the room!

googleReviews.author: Raven Hargest
googleReviews.text:
Disappointing experience. They add a service fee without clearly explaining it and still prompt for a tip on top of that, which feels pretty misleading.

For the price, it’s basically just a standard karaoke spot….nothing special to justify the cost & shady practices.

googleReviews.author: Annie Wu
googleReviews.text:
Had such a fun night at KTV Sakura! The vibes are amazing—clean rooms, themed seating, colorful lighting, and a solid sound system that takes karaoke to the next level. They offer a huge selection of songs in English, Chinese, Korean, and Japanese, so there’s something for everyone. 🎤 🎉🎶
My favorite spot is the open stage in the KTV hall. Standing there to sing truly feels like it’s your stage—you can feel the energy all around you! It’s such a cool experience to share that joy with the crowd. The lighting and atmosphere in the hall are electric—it instantly lifts the mood and gets everyone hyped.
The staff was super friendly and helped us get set up quickly. Drinks were reasonably priced, and the snack menu had some great options to keep the party going. This is the perfect spot for birthdays, group hangouts, or even a spontaneous karaoke night. Can’t wait to come back!

googleReviews.author: Kieren Bryant
googleReviews.text: Came here with a friend and had so much fun! Food was great and service was amazing, we reserved a private room. There were only 2 things I think could be improved. First of all, the song selection is somewhat limited. If you enjoy singing very popular songs then you’re in luck. However, there were a good amount of songs that they did not have, even somewhat popular ones. Unfortunately, their YouTube option does not work anymore but if they were able to offer that again, I would definitely come back. The second thing that could be improved is the public singing area. Unfortunately, there was a group of girls that sang back to back songs without leaving breaks so that other people could not sing. If there was a way to join a wait list to sing, I think it would be more organized and give other people the opportunity to join in on the fun.

googleReviews.author: Nora McClorey
googleReviews.text:
If I could give no stars I would. Beyond horrible drinks ridiculously expensive. Ordered 3 lychee martinis it was in a plastic cup with ice and a straw THAT IS NOT A MARTINI. Bartender beyond rude on the instagram it says $50 an hour for rooms and when we got there she rung us up for damn near $300 she called her manager and they confirmed the $50. THEN we finally got into a room the microphone wasn’t working. Staff was great in figuring it out. Unfortunately they then cut us off at the original time disregarding the microphone not working. She offered to “check the security footage to see when the problem was corrected” decided to just leave this place is not worth your money at all. Also don’t expect a bucket deal and don’t look at the fridge for available drinks because we asked for a seltzer they had in the fridge and was told no?
Was here with my friend she left this review wanted to back it up. Don’t spend ur money here.

googleReviews.author: yoona suh
googleReviews.text: i love zero degree karaoke, i love to go there with my friends, the rooms are affordable, most days you can just walk in and get a room, but i recommend reserving ahead of time if you want to get a good room depending on your party size. on some days they run promotional deals so you should definitely ask! they have wifi for customers and they even have youtube so you’re not limited to just the songs already programmed on their systems! sometimes i go just to hang out at the bar with my friends. the owner and his wife are so friendly and fun to talk to. they also host after parties and have people DJ in the main lobby area. I used to go clubbing a lot but now i just come here, it’s just as fun if not more fun!! oh also! they have some really yummy snacks you can order from the kitchen, i tend to get hungry once i start drinking and i always order the beef skewers, french fries, and their fried dumplings.

googleReviews.author: Michael Pang
googleReviews.text: The private rooms have great sound and decor but the service is abysmal, they took 15 mins to get our karaoke working and then rushed us out as soon as our time was up (counting the time it wasn't working). Also this place is in a super sketchy place. But the club seems pretty fun, they play EDM hits and the vibes are good.

The drinks are affordable too, big shoutout to Andy, the bartender, for always keeping it smooth and making sure everyone’s having a good time. Definitely a go-to weekend spot

googleReviews.text: I booked a room here for my birthday and invited a few of my friends and we had an amazing time. The rooms are pretty cool and very clean. The food was delicious! It was a little disappointing to use YouTube to find music but at the same time YouTube has such a huge variety you will definitely find all your deep cuts.

googleReviews.author: Yvette Ramirez
googleReviews.text: We celebrated my sisters boyfriend’s bday here and it was a BLAST. A memorable day for sure. We all sang and the tower shots were great! The fact that we had our own private bathroom was even better. The vibes were definitely giving that night. The bartenders were great. The whole atmosphere itself was fantastic. Definitely would recommend. It’s on the pricey side but worth it!

googleReviews.author: Liz Toussaint
googleReviews.text: We had a great experience for my friend’s birthday. The room was clean and spacious. Our server Lisa was THE BEST. Super kind and accommodating to all of our questions. She knows the venue well and made the experience exceptional.  We will be back!

googleReviews.author: Zack
googleReviews.text:
I organized an event with 12 friends here in a private room for 4 hours and everybody raved afterwards that it was a great time. Lisa was our host/server and she was very sweet and attentive. The only thing that could have been better is that we waited in the room for a while before someone could come in and take our drink orders and show us how everything worked and which button to press to signal the server to come in.

I’m not sure if there was another option for the music but we used their YouTube setup and we had no problems with it and found all the songs we wanted. Even though the room is near the main lounge with loud music, we were able to focus on our own songs and it really felt like a private experience.

about: U-Star karaoke is a karaoke bar in Chicago, Illinois. It holds a 4.8-star rating from 477 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Kyle
googleReviews.text:
This has been my friend's and my go to Karaoke spot near the city for years.
The rooms are nice, clean, and well decorated.
The music selection is great and I love that they give you the option of using either the traditional Korean Karaoke machine or just using YouTube.
While the drinks at the bar are pricey, they do allow outside food which is definitely a plus.
The staff there has always been kind and attentive. Never had any problems.
Even though the parking lot is quite small, I've personally never struggled with parking.
Overall great karaoke spot and will continue to come back.

googleReviews.author: Melissa Cardella
googleReviews.text:
Ustar has such great service! Came multiple times for small groups, and recently for a party of 20. Someone coordinated with me via text to get every question and detail prepared before arriving. Told us we can bring outside food, and made it easy for guests to order drinks.  Staff made the experience wonderful!

If you plan on coming, they recommend bringing a tablet for YouTube which helps a lot for bigger parties.

googleReviews.author: Mackenzie Anderson
googleReviews.text: I can’t say enough great things about U-Star Karaoke! We had the absolute best night ever. They went above and beyond by opening up on a Tuesday just for our group of 25, which made us feel incredibly welcome. The room was super spacious and they had an endless selection of songs. The staff was so kind and attentive all evening, and they really made sure we had a blast. As a cherry on top, the staff gave us a complimentary bottle of soju and some glasses to take home at the end of the night. It was such a thoughtful touch and really made the whole experience unforgettable. Highly recommend, and we will be back!

googleReviews.author: Maggie Jaques
googleReviews.text: An amazing karaoke bar! Perfect place for large and small groups. You will need to reserve a room if you have a large group. The technology is very easy to use as everything is queue through YouTube. Highly recommend for all occasions.

googleReviews.author: Andrea Rosa
googleReviews.text: Great place! Love the bar and tenders. Highlight recommend

about: Theme House restaurant & karaoke is a karaoke bar in Chicago, Illinois. It holds a 4.4-star rating from 195 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Tim Bennett
googleReviews.text: The private rooms here are spotless and super fancy! ✨ We booked the largest room for a friend's birthday party, and it even had its own bathroom inside- how cool is that? 🚻🎉 There's also a bar just outside the rooms for easy access to drinks 🍸. The staff was amazing, really accommodating and kind. I came in on crutches due to a sprained ankle, and one of the workers even held the door open for me - such a thoughtful touch! 🙏 Also, the free street parking right in front is super convenient 🚗. Highly recommend this spot for any special occasion! 🎈

googleReviews.author: Tan Ball
googleReviews.text: Bday party held in their room. Spacey with nice furniture. Workers were awesome. Great service. Food was good. Chicken, Chinese rice, onion rings.  Welcoming place. My family has a good safe time. Good parking. Almost tricky to find. Bar, nice!

googleReviews.author: Jean Kang
googleReviews.text: The private rooms are very clean and fancy looking. There’s a bar outside the rooms. We got the biggest private room for a friend’s birthday party and there was a bathroom inside the room!!! That was so cool. The workers were also super accommodating and nice. I came in with crutches because of my sprained ankle and the worker held the door open for me. I also like that there’s a lot of easy free street parking right in front.

googleReviews.author: Coby Szeto
googleReviews.text: We got an upgrade to a VIP room with a private bathroom inside! The room was so clean and huge with plenty of seating. The karaoke system (DuoChang) had a great selection of English and Mexican songs—we were able to find all the songs we wanted, surprisingly! My coworkers had a blast and absolutely loved it. Speaking of the food, we ordered their signature chicken wings, and they were worth a try! This place exceeded our expectations! We’ll definitely come back next time.

googleReviews.author: Pinqy Ring
googleReviews.text: Really disappointed with the venue. Though they did accommodate a day-of room reservation, the experience when we arrived was lackluster at best. First, the room charges an automatic 20% gratuity, but we had to go to the bar to get our own drinks and there was no check in or servicing from anyone on staff. Second, in going to the bar to get drinks, they quoted us one price on the receipt inclusive of tax but charged our cards $7 more and couldn’t explain why. So I believe they were adding a tip without being transparent in doing so, while also charging us 20% tip on the room with no service or host/waiter. Not to mention the service at the bar was slow and unenthusiastic, we had to ask someone to serve us because she was too busy on her phone and she’s looked as if we were bothering her. Lastly, the shots are not actually full shots. They’re more like teaspoon shots as the shot glasses are misleading and meant to only give you a small pour. Would never come here or book a room again, terrible service shady practices and uninterested employees.

Maybe others reviewing have a lower standard for friendliness but I didn't find the staff here friendly at all really. But really that wasn't a big deal because everything else was great. I would come back.

googleReviews.author: Amy F
googleReviews.text: This was my first time at a Karaoke place with private rooms. The rooms were functional with banquette seating and around the sides and a big table in the middle. It looked like the rooms were pretty cheap to rent .The sound wasn't great and we could hear the party next door when we weren't singing. I'm guessing it's a you get what pay for situation. But it's better than having to sing in front of a bunch of strangers. Easy enough to pull up songs. The food is frozen Sysco. Better than nothing as I didn't eat before going. The mixed drinks weren't great. Stick to whatever comes in a can or bottle

googleReviews.text: Great place if you love Karaoke. You get your own party room to sing your heart out. So much fun. Food and drinks were great too!

googleReviews.author: Victoria Carter
googleReviews.text: The best staff and regulars who I become friends with every time I go. Cole is so lovely and Nicole makes the best cocktails. The food is also amazing! Can’t go wrong with Brando’s

googleReviews.author: Tell Me You Didnt Just Say That
googleReviews.text: Good vibes. GREAT HAPPY HOUR DEAL THAT GOES UNTIL 7PM. AND the service is top notch. NICOLE is a bartender there and she is super friendly and knows how to mix a good cocktail! That's not a metaphor...her drinks are good.

googleReviews.author: Tara Murphy
googleReviews.text:
I stopped by Brando’s after work with some friends, and we were not disappointed!
The service was excellent, and the cocktails were even better.

The General Manager, Cole, does a fantastic job at supporting his bar team, while also creating a welcoming and fun environment for the guests.

I highly recommend Brando’s for any occasion!

googleReviews.author: MAIRIM ROSARIO
googleReviews.text:
Brandos is a place for  everyone. Great cocktails. Ambiance. Karaoke. Great service. Great place to spend times with friends or date or friends. 🔥🔥🔥

I have been coming  to BRANDOS for the last 5 years. Nicole is the best !!! Come and get your drinks and great hospitality! She is amazing!

googleReviews.author: Matt Ana
googleReviews.text:
Honestly really disappointed with Brando’s Speakeasy.

I was helping organize my friend’s birthday dinner there, and we booked everything about a week ahead for a group of around 10 people. Reservation was confirmed, payment was made, everything seemed set. Then literally two days before the birthday, they canceled on us because another group decided to fully book the venue.

What bothered me most wasn’t just the cancellation, it was the attitude around it. Instead of actually understanding how stressful it is to re-plan a birthday dinner last minute, the manager kept talking about how much money the other party was spending. It basically felt like our reservation meant nothing because somebody else had a bigger budget.

They offered to move us from 5 PM to 8 PM the same night, but by then invitations were already sent out and people had planned around the original reservation. That’s not something you casually change two days before an event.

To make it even worse, a gift card was offered afterward as an apology, but then nobody ever followed up. Multiple emails later and still no response.

Things happen, I get it. But canceling a confirmed paid reservation days before someone’s birthday and then handling it this poorly is just unprofessional. I definitely wouldn’t rely on this place for an important event.

googleReviews.text: Billy was an amazing server. We transferred between a couple tables in his section and he followed us to each. Constantly checking on us and making sure we liked our drinks. Fantastic service from Billy!!

googleReviews.text: Billy was an amazing server! Made our night! We kept hopping from table to table and he followed us all night. Our drinks were never empty and he had great vibes. Hope he’s out server again :) Will be back! Kareoke was great and highly recommend the fish bowls.

googleReviews.text: The karaoke is in the front of the bar so it’s pretty loud inside but towards the back outside is quieter and pleasant. There are a lot of beers here. The pizza is decent for the bar. It’s not too far from Wrigley field

googleReviews.text:
The drinks are good and the prices are fair. Overall great atmosphere however, they lost 2 stars because their waitress is simply rude.

She kept pressuring my friends and I to buy a drink and we either declined cause we wanted water first or we had a tab open at the bar.
She kept insisting we buy a drink with her until someone did, when she returned she literally said “Do I get a tip?” My friend felt pressured to buy a drink and on top of that tip her which is honestly unprofessional. Especially since my friend always tips.

How are you going to pressure someone to buy a drink, keep drinking and get drunk at your location. This is honestly pathetic on the waitresses end. She was short, short black hair, a black choker and black lip gloss and a piercing across the bridge of her nose. Please do better as pressuring your customers to buy drinks and get drunk isn’t acceptable.

googleReviews.author: Naza A
googleReviews.text: Overall, we had a great time awesome atmosphere, good music, and friendly service. However, the price felt a bit high: we spent almost $300 for 4-6cocktails and 2 hours of karaoke, with no food or snacks included. The drinks were good, but for that price it seemed a little expensive. Other than that, everything was wonderful and we really enjoyed the night! 🌟

googleReviews.author: Dog Brown
googleReviews.text: One star. We are beyond frustrated with our experience here. We booked a karaoke room for what we thought was one hour, but at no point did any staff member tell us what our actual end time was. When our system suddenly shut off, we were confused and had to track someone down, only to be told we had "gone over" and now owed for a second hour. To make matters worse, at the start of our session, the audio system in our room was broken. It took us 30 minutes just to get a staff member to come and fix it, cutting our paid time almost in half. When we complained about paying for time we lost due to their faulty equipment, they refused to adjust our bill. So we ended up paying for a full second hour we didn't want, while also losing a huge chunk of our first hour to their technical difficulties. Terrible communication and a complete lack of customer service. We will never be back.

googleReviews.author: Rene N
googleReviews.text: We had a lot of fun here! The staff was awesome. The room service was fast. And the two ladies who checked on us were sweet and funny. The drinks are strong and tasty. (I highly recommend the strawberry soju) the kareoke machine can be complicated but just ask for help.) Overall can't wait to go back!

googleReviews.author: Young
googleReviews.text: Wow, finally the real traditional BBQ showed up in Naperville, food are great, fresh and tasty. The staffs there are super kind. Just go there for bbq this time, definitely will back for the food and try the Karaoke room👍👍👍

Naperville is very lucky to have a brand new karaoke bar that is packed with the newest technology and ktv hardware.  Invite a bunch of friends together for a couple hours or karaoke while enjoying a number of different authentic northern Chinese bbq skewer options.  Try the lamb skewers, they are absolutely amazing!

googleReviews.author: Stephanie Nava
googleReviews.text:
This place has aura and is a 10/10. This is the best place to be!! The environment is amazing and the staff is so nice! I have great conversations and great connections with almost all of them! Had the best time making memories in this place and would highly recommend!!

They have Karaoke nights on Tuesdays and it such a fun time seeing how everyone comes together to celebrate each other!

The drinks are amazing and really good price for everything! I would recommend trying the pink lantern!!

If anyone tells you this place is bad it’s cause they probably ruined the experience for themselves or don’t know bar rules!

googleReviews.author: Louis Williams
googleReviews.text:
Almost missed out on this place because of the construction but glad I stopped in for the famous lantern burger. It's on the edge of downtown Naperville so parking is easier than it looks at first.

First off: very chill spot - which is unusual for natty Naperville. Basically an old school tavern, saw a bunch of well off looking guys day drinking; I was the only one ordering food at 2 in the afternoon 😅. They all seem to know each other which is quaint these days.

The lantern burger was amazing! Bun seems store bought but the patty is the real deal - thick, juicy, well seasoned and cooked with a nice sear on. Easy in and out and not much more than Mickey D's. Will return.

googleReviews.author: Vickie Musni
googleReviews.text: So much fun!!! I come here every time I’m in town and always have a blast. Last time I came on trivia night and this trip, karaoke Tuesday. Shaun is amazing but the crowd here also makes it fun. Thanks for a great time!

googleReviews.author: Martin A (Travels With Martin)
googleReviews.text: I was looking for a place to watch the football game and grab a beer, and Danny's Pub & Grill was the perfect spot! The staff was super friendly, the beers were cold, and I got to watch not only the football game but also catch my team playing baseball. It was a great, satisfying stop for a sports fan like me. Definitely a solid place to relax, enjoy the game, and have a cold drink!

googleReviews.author: Jill farmer

googleReviews.author: Ashon Parker
googleReviews.text: No complaints. Had fun , I went by myself, my first time will not be my last. Everybody was accommodating even my fellow guest. Some people even wanted to sing with me which is what Karokee is all about all us having fun together. Stefan the piano player was great and very accommodating I think I sang like 5 songs to the best of my ability LOL . Thank you for such a great time.

googleReviews.author: Charles Bassett
googleReviews.text: One of my favorite hidden gems in Detroit. Great bartenders. The star though, is literally YOU. This is LIVE karaoke with a real pianist accompanying.

googleReviews.author: Greg McKenzie
googleReviews.text: Piano karaoke! Level up your karaoke experience at Sid Gold's. Wednesday thru Saturday. Great drinks and phenomenal piano karaoke hosts.

googleReviews.author: kendra komp
googleReviews.text: Swanky addition to the downtown nightlife scene.  We were only able to sit at the bar in the front room because a large group had just entered and filled the back karaoke room.  We did walk through though and the piano player was impressive and it looked like everyone was having fun.  The decor is lovely.  Vintage but not kitschy.  It's a little pricey but really nice.  I would go back and try to get into the back room.  I can't sing to save my life but it would be fun to watch.

googleReviews.author: Alexis H
googleReviews.text:
I used to love Sid Gold’s, but the experience has really declined over the past year. The staff has completely turned over and the new team is consistently rude (. My group was double charged multiple times. Someone in my party would pay, and they would still add the same items to my tab.

On top of that, my phone was stolen while I was there and the staff refused to close my tab or return my card until I agreed to pay for four additional drinks they claimed someone else had purchased (I later saw a receipt that they paid for these). I used Find My iPhone and realized they had my phone the entire time. When I asked to speak with a manager about the situation, they refused.

It now feels like they are intentionally double charging and creating extra charges to boost sales and tips. It is extremely disappointing considering how great this place used to be.

googleReviews.author: Gabriela Alegria
googleReviews.text: We went to celebrate a friend's birthday. The place itself is nice, but it had some details I didn't love. First, the good points: the room they gave us was completely soundproof, and there was plenty of space for all ten of us. The downsides were that the mixed drinks we ordered were all flavorless; I recommend sticking to beer.  Although there was a private restroom, it didn't have any toilet paper or hand towels. We asked the waitress if she could turn down the heating because it was too hot, but she only lowered it by one degree, so one of my friends ended up standing by the bathroom door to avoid sweating so much. The french fries were delicious, though. If you're going for the karaoke atmosphere, it's great; it gets really fun.

googleReviews.author: cardy b
googleReviews.text: Went here for a group karaoke of about 12 or so. The do offer different sized rooms based on party. Very simple setup nothing complicated… a tv, good quality speakers, two mics, and a keyboard to search up your music on youtube. I like how they have a service button you hit for assistance that way they don’t have to nag or interrupt you. Service was decently fast for a busy night. Usual seafood boil prices and nice selection of meats including crawfish. The spicy boil was amazing! The shrimp could have been cooked more because it was firm. You get 3 hours for the room and it was plenty of time for us. Definitely recommend.

googleReviews.author: Faith Herr
googleReviews.text: I booked for a large room and it was great the price I paid 75 dollars to hold it and the remaining balance of 111.00 dollars upon arrival, my food was 48 dollars it was a decent price.We had 15 people and it was great we all payed individually. My only issue it that the next day I was charged 2 with incorrect amounts. I called and spoke to a manager Angela and she acted as if she had no clue what I was talking about and making me seem like I was lying. I mean thank god I keep my receipts because soon as I mentioned that it was magically corrected. All I can say is keep your receipts and check yall bank accounts

googleReviews.author: Nunya Business
googleReviews.text: Good flavor. Alcohol beverage was weak. God was hot and good. I got boils for my kids and myself. Drinks are canned beverages. Enjoyed the karaoke as well. Went for a preteens bday party.

googleReviews.author: Lakesha Brown-Robinson
googleReviews.text: Our food was hot and came out quickly, and our drinks came out fast as well. I love that you have a restroom in the actual room. It's convenient. I will definitely go back

googleReviews.author: Mike Heath
googleReviews.text: I've been to a few college bars over the years. This one is right at the top. Great atmosphere spacious, friendly bartenders, great live music on the night I was there. The food was elevated bar food: double slider burger with the perfect crust and soft bun, and the loaded waffle fries are hard to describe. Perfect combination of sweet and savory. Great selection of beer and booze. One star reviews either have the wrong place or they have an axe to grind. I'll be back!

googleReviews.author: Luxury Chaos
googleReviews.text: Customer service was amazing. Drink selection is decent. The ONLY problem I have is the food selection. Their attached restaurant is vegan based. I got the brunch potatoes and they just weren’t my vibe, especially for $7. I wouldn’t come back only because I can’t get drunk and eat vegan food. Everything else was good though

googleReviews.author: Heather Brock
googleReviews.text: My first time here really enjoyed myself. The staff behind the bar is amazing The frozen drinks are so good. However, an me and my bestfriends had walked out for a second to get some air and the person at the door, checking IDs made a very rude and explicit comment that made us feel very uncomfortable we left right after that an went to another bar around the area

googleReviews.author: Albert Emery
googleReviews.text:
This place was okay. I came in here a few weeks ago and the place seemed a little neglected. It was a Saturday evening, yet there was only a few people inside.

Their service is friendly but very unattentive. They were all texting and just standing around.

The floor was all tore up and it kind of had sort of an old warehouse rustic feel, which I honestly didn't care for. I get Detroit is an old gritty city and having a bar like this is hipster and trendy, but this was a little overboard. The floor was beat up and it borderline looked like they were remodeling.

The outdoor space was nice. It seems like a good spot to chill when there is entertainment and the place is filled. But again, it was very unkempt. The palm trees were all brown and dying.

Supposedly they had very good pies back in the day but now they quit serving them and that part of the bar is just abandoned.

The slushy that I ordered was watery and sour. It didn't have the best flavor. It was nice and strong though.

The only thing that saves this place is its location and atmosphere. Being right in midtown helps this place out a lot. Any big event going on in the area, which does occur often, will draw people to this bar. There are some dart boards and a skee-ball game as well, which is pretty cool. The place is also very spacious.

Overall, this place feels neglected. The things that keep this place afloat are its location, friendly wait staff and the large indoor and outdoor space.

googleReviews.author: Mariah Bard
googleReviews.text: Nice patio, service was weird. A bartender behind the bar and no servers walking around helping people.

googleReviews.author: George Strimpel
googleReviews.text: I work downtown and love to experience different places for lunch. I enjoyed a delicious Checker Burger and fries, great price, especially for downtown.(Add- Sep.24') I stopped in again for a quick lunch - I was greeted by one of the nicest waitresses (Kim),  be sure to stop in and say hi to her... be certain to tip her well. She even posed for my updated photos.

googleReviews.author: John Addy V
googleReviews.text: It was cool to visit Checker Bar again after so long, but it just doesn't feel the same. The Checker Burger being $14 just feels wrong when this place used to have dive bar prices, but I understand why the price had to go up. That being said, neither the fries nor the burger tasted anything like the Checker Burger from years ago. Will probably come back again soon when the Clubhouse is open and try the Napalm Breath again as that was always my favorite.

googleReviews.author: Vincent Lamb
googleReviews.text:
I'm visiting from out of town and Ken the bartender was the BEST and made me feel right at home.  Friday May 29 was the worst experience I've had in a while.  There were only 4 patrons at the bar when I arrived and I guarantee you that he walked past 4 times without acknowledging my presence.

I walked out for a minute and walked back in, to see if the door opening and closing would draw his attention...I didn't.  He walked back and forth 3 more times, still not acknowledging my presence.  Finally, a female server/bartender from the floor came up and took my drink order. She said she needed  to "hold" my card for the tab.  I was never asked that on my previous visits and while sitting there for over 20 minutes, I saw the male bartender only taking credit cards AFTER the other patrons were preparing to leave. I didn't

I enjoyed myself the first 2 times only because of Ken.  I definitely will return, but will only stay if Ken is working...

googleReviews.author: Samantha Sanchez
googleReviews.text: A friend and I came in for the Rotten Route Event. Upon arrival, it was unique in its decor.  Upstairs has an arcade. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to try these burgers, I've heard so much about them. We only came in for a drink before leaving on the bus. Service was fast, prices were fair, and drinks were just right! I will be back to try a burger for sure!

googleReviews.author: Krystal Lancaster
googleReviews.text: This place is so awesome! There are two floors that you can go back and forth. Bars are on both floors. The top floor has TONS of vintage arcade games and tables to eat at as well. There are even little tables set up throughout the floor, so you have a place to set your food and drink while you play! This place probably has every game you can think of! The staff were friendly, attentive, and kind. The food was 10/10. Ordered pizza, chicken parm sandwich, and the garlic knots. Will most definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Phillip Hurlburt
googleReviews.text: Was hoping for better. I think that they are too busy for there own good. Casadeas and Philly both dry and good luck getting something wet. it was a game night but I would believe that they knew that before I had arrived. Wish I had taken food pics. Live and learn. FYI: Get seated for dine in because at the bar they wanted our stools to go standing room only. No plans to seat us elsewhere. I would pay a couple bucks more for better food. Best location in town.

googleReviews.author: Nikki
googleReviews.text: If you’re going to a tigers game, where else would you go? Rooftop bar with amazing vibes, games, live music, wide variety of drinks, and a solid menu. Food is pretty average bar food, but you know that with a few drinks in you it won’t even matter. Mikey took great care of us and even let me charge my phone behind the bar.

googleReviews.author: Jacob B
googleReviews.text:
I have one word to describe what I experience at Tin Roof: ignorant. Chris, a security guard, profiled me because I was wearing a Chinese jacket and assumed I was causing trouble. I walked in to purchase a beer and a shot, turned around, and this man tells me the bar is asking me to leave — no reason given, no explanation. I kept my composure and asked him who specifically requested that I leave. He had no answer.
I went straight to a bartender, who immediately vouched for me as a respectful patron. Chris never apologized.
I’ve been coming to Tin Roof since 2020 and have never experienced anything like this — racism and ignorance from someone who’s supposed to make the space feel safe. The staff and bartenders here are great. Your security needs to reflect that same standard.
Tin Roof, you’re better than this. I have a photo of the outfit that apparently warranted this treatment.”

googleReviews.author: Matthew Tate
googleReviews.text: Service was very friendly, had the shrimp po boy.  Not very good.  Bar staff was very understanding and nice.  Liz and Cody were great and offered a new sandwich a chicken BLT and it was fantastic! Thank you and service was great again!  Will be back it's in the perfect spot to get to everything.

googleReviews.author: Andrew Kiefer
googleReviews.text: As a Nashville local I had to try out the Tin Roof in Detroit. Exceptional. Friendly staff. Great environment. Jordan, Mark and Megan made me feel at home. Support this staff. They believe in customer service.

googleReviews.author: Leiah Shirley
googleReviews.text: Great time and good service (thanks Rayah) My sister in law threw an impromptu party here last Saturday and we had so much fun. We were placed in the medium room which can hold 15 people. They allow you to bring in your own food and drinks, but also have complementary drinks/snacks in fridge. Songs are selected on smartTv and so you can pick just about anything. Only potential issue is that rooms didn’t appear to be soundproof and be can get a little toasty (nice that there was a fan to cool off). We are planning a return trip soon.

googleReviews.author: Denise Smith
googleReviews.text: Booked this location as part of our bachelorette party and it was so much fun. We had our own private room with a door and it was soundproof so we couldn't hear the other people in their rooms. We got there earlier than our reservation and they still accommodated us, which was amazing 😍. I plan to bring my nieces and nephews back here because they were very upset when they found out. Oh and u can bring ur own food, but we didn't because we ate before we went, but they did have snacks and chips in the fridge. This place was amazing because I ALWAYS wanted to do karaoke but not in front of strangers. Awesome place and amazing location.

googleReviews.author: Rob erto (Roberto)
googleReviews.text: Highly recommended. Rooms were clean and well put together/thought out for Karaoke events. If you have over 5 people, you probably wanna consider 2 rooms or a larger room to rent out, IF everyone is going to be standing. There is an Apple Tablet which makes it easier to choose your selection of songs. There is also like a 50/55 inch TV in sync with the tablet. The mic setup was pretty simple - all you have to do is turn the mic on, as the speakers and power source is only accessible to authorized personnel. Music was clear and volume adjustmented. People brought their own food, drinks and snacks although there is a small fridge with snacks already provided. Will

googleReviews.author: Jasmine G
googleReviews.text: I just celebrated my birthday here and this place is awesome! The girls servicing the place were soo helpful and helped to make my night! The selfie backgrounds were dope! I had such a blast!  I recommend everyone to come here for a great time out!

googleReviews.author: Ana Pinkinski
googleReviews.text: Awful! Poorly managed & dirty. Bookings are back to back which leaves no time before to set up and no time after to clean up. Rooms not cleaned between parties. googleReviews.author: William Grutter
googleReviews.text: Cheers is great for its niche. It's convenient, comfortable, and modestly priced. Active with customers but quiet enough to talk. Food is very good. Famous for their wet burrito (plan to ta l e some home). The French Dip is also very good, perhaps a little small. Service is friendly and helpful without hovering or seeing invasive.

googleReviews.author: Aaron Lehrman
googleReviews.text:
Great burger, amazing fries.

- All American Burger - $15: HUGE!  It is a half pound burger and on the larger size of half pound.  I ordered it medium and it was medium on the inside, but a bit darker on the outside.  It had a charcoal flavor, but I confirmed it was actually cooked on a flat surface griddle.  It was juicy and delicious.

Overall, it was a wider burger which helps it stay together.  I ordered ketchup and mayo and it did slide around, but mainly stayed together.  The lettuce, onion, and tomato were all fresh and crisp.  The bun was a bit above average.  Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed this burger!

- Pub Fries (comes with the burger): A little light on the salt.  If they had the right amount of salt, I’d call these my favorite.  They are battered perfectly.  They are medium cut.  The texture was amazing and cooked just right.

- Basket of Pub Fries- $9: Probably a little on the small side for what you pay, but great fries!

They do have weekly specials and events.  They did not have prices for the desserts and we had to ask.  I believe the cheesecake was around $6 (we did not get it).

- Service: Helpful for sure.  Answered all our questions and was prompt.  Got our order right.  Refilled my water without me noticing!  The burger was served within 15 minutes (as expected).

- Atmosphere: Lots of wood trim.  Warm feel.  It was clean and organized.  We had a bit of an issue finding the host (as you come in the door from Plainfield) to be seated since we came in the side door.  The bathroom has a TV so you don’t miss the game (if you are concerned).

Tables and chairs as well as booths.  Outside there are tables and chairs.  They also have a swinging apparatus that has a bench and table connected and you push with your feet.  Pretty cool!!

- Conclusion: I’d highly recommend them for their burgers and fries.  The service and atmosphere were great, too.

Visited on a Saturday at 6pm.

googleReviews.author: Larry Wagenaar

googleReviews.author: Nick White
googleReviews.text:
One star, not because of a single bad night, but because this place is flat out misrepresented. Their website and Google listings still hype live music, karaoke nights, country nights, and a lively atmosphere that supposedly makes it perfect for bachelorette parties and group outings. None of that exists anymore. There is no live music, no events, and no energy.

What you actually get is a dead dive bar with an empty parking lot and none of what is promised online. Failing to update basic information is either careless or intentionally misleading. Either way, it wastes people’s time and sets expectations that are nowhere close to reality. If this bar has moved on from being an event driven, fun destination, then stop advertising it as one. Right now, the marketing is pure fiction.

googleReviews.text:
Some of the best Korean bbq in gr! Absolutely 0 wait on a Sunday night, flavors were SPECTACULAR, and for a spice lover the levels were perfect! An adorable asian woman came through and interacted with each table making them feel valued for coming in, its the small touches that make a place memorable! I just wish a couple more menu items would have been available but its understandable since they dont get ANYWHERE NEAR ENOUGH PATRONAGE!!!! Take this as your sign to go and try them ASAP!! WE NEED TO KEEP THEM HERE IN DOWNTOWN GR!

Great food, great people, now go in & have a great time!

googleReviews.author: Ms. Yolanda
googleReviews.text: Where do I start. Its was our first time here. Its just sad n bad. We had 4-5 different waitresses. We had to keep stopping ppl just to get a refill on our drinks n food. Food was cold on the buffet. Nobody cant get along. Manager yelling at everyone on front of customers. Just all the way bad. The only good thing i like was they had a pretty crystal next to the fish tank. Sadly, we told the manager about the bad experience we had he just took 25% off our bill. Sad case. We will not come back.

googleReviews.author: P S
googleReviews.text: Left before getting food (raw meat you cook yourself). Arrived and was seated normally. Plates were greasy and covered in sauce and all over the place was grimy (someone’s ear gauge was sitting on the window sill). We were then handed off between servers. Waited 15 minutes for drinks, sure that’s fine, but what we left for was waiting another 15-20 for the raw meat to cook ourselves. Maybe 7 tables in the whole place, not busy on a Saturday night. We usually love this place and use it as a treat for our family and occasional date nights. Buffet was scarce and not stocked and the pickings that were left were cold, hard, stale and inedible. Waiter quickly dropped a lemonade and ran away before we could order from the drink menu and disappeared for a while. Finally, we were able to order meat, we were sure it was going to be easy going from there as the meats did not need to be cooked, we had prepared as a table what meats we were picking next. We left after offering to pay for the waters, kids lemonade, stale buffet pickings and the little rice we received. The bar tender asked if it was the wait and honestly I said yes as I’m not one to lie. Waiter screamed out of the side door he had our food as we were walking down the stairs but at that point we had zero interest in returning to only be what I assume would be further disappointment. After a little over 30 minutes of sad stale buffet pickings, a little bit of rice, missing waiters and no other food we left and went across the street for dinner. Also if you have to smell a food preparation bucket, it’s probably not clean.

googleReviews.author: Nick Humphreys
googleReviews.text:

googleReviews.text:
First time here. Overall it wasnt bad however it seemed like staff didnt know what to do with us. Party of 7 and they moved us tables 2 seperate times and offered no explanation of how to go about things. It wasnt until our waitress came around we had to ask ourselves.
