googleReviews.author: Ezell Underdown
googleReviews.text: I have known Steve for over 20 years, and have attended many of his karaoke shows. When I have been in attendance, Steve has been kind and encouraging to all participants, has conducted his shows professionally, and has not given preference to any particular singer--whether friend or foe. Also, as a musician, I recognize and appreciate the professional quality of the equipment he brings to his shows. And, as a bonus, he usually remembers your top 3 or 4 requested songs, and often, upon request, will accompany a singer on 'stage' as backup. All said, Steve is a great karaoke host and comes with my highest recommendation!

googleReviews.author: Shawn Reed
googleReviews.text: I would like to give an assessment of Steve's DJ and Karaoke service. This is partially in response to a negative review that I feel is unfair and biased because of misunderstanding the nature of what this company does. I have known Mr. Steve Menda for the better part of two years, perhaps a little longer. During this time, I have never observed any behavior that was unprofessional or lacking in thoroughness and attention to detail. You would be hard-pressed to find a DJ/KJ that is as attentive and prepared as Steve and his employees. Mr. Menda sets a high bar for his presentations and truly cares about the quality of his shows, whether it be as a DJ, Karaoke provider, or Music Bingo and Trivia shows. In fact, it's one of the qualities I admire about him because it's rare to find someone of his caliber and standards when it comes to these types of shows. I personally can attest to the fact that he is professional through and through and rightfully expects the same of his employees. One of the critisms in the negative review was that Mr. Menda refuses to rely on online streaming services, such as YouTube, for his background tracks. The reasons for this are sound. Many of the karaoke tracks on streaming services such as these are illegally posted and not in compliance with copyright laws. For those in the know, it is ILLEGAL to play these tracks without paying proper fees to the music publishing companies such as ASCAP, SESAC, and BMI and compensating the original artists with a royalty. This is why Steve uses a proprietary database of tracks stored on his computers that he has LEGALLY paid for and has the right to use. He does everything on the up and up and makes sure he's in compliance  when it comes to public performance laws concerning music as he believes the creators deserve compensation for their works. Using many of the online streaming services bypasses this requirement and is therefore illegal, and risks being sued by the original artists, publishers, and the Recording Industry of America. Another very good reason to not rely on streaming services is to eliminate the possibility of streaming issues, buffering and freezing because of unstable or unreliable Internet connections. This is not only a smart way to avoid such issues but makes sure that a singer is not in an awkward situation with a track possibly stuttering or freezing up during playback, thus avoiding a potentially embarrassing and time-wasting situation. This results in a higher quality experience for all involved. Lastly, concerning the criticism concerning the lack of a dedicated separate subwoofer. This is COMPLETELY unnecessary as all of the speakers involved in the shows have more than sufficient woofers that are capable of reaching the majority of low frequencies in audio as many subs. The audio quality to the great majority of participants is more than adequate and has received good feedback as to the balance and equalization being pleasing to the ear. He spends a great deal of time getting the sound "just right", and of all the time I have known him I have never heard any complaints concerning the quality of his audio or equipment, if anything, the setups he uses go above and beyond what the average DJ uses for karaoke and DJ purposes and is top notch in its quality and capabilities. In summary, and I cannot stress this enough, I feel the negative review is unfair and not a true reflection of the quality of presentations that Steve and his employees strive to achieve. Anyone seeking a quality presentation for a special occasion or event, looking for a great karaoke experience and enjoyable time need not look any further than Steve's DJ and Karaoke service. His attention to quality and professionalism is second to NONE, and you will not find someone more dedicated to presenting a fun and thoroughly top notch show than Mr. Menda and his employees. He is very selective about the people he hires and holds them to the same excellent standards of professionalism, friendliness, and care he puts into the shows he produces.

googleReviews.author: Robert Owens
googleReviews.text: DJ Steve Mendez and His Team provide some of the best DJ and Karaoke shows in the country. As a professional musician and entertainer, I completely endorse Steve's DJ and Karaoke Shows. He is always professional and provides quality music and sound.

googleReviews.author: Kristian Vandemark
googleReviews.text:
I have been having karaoke parties for my birthday for 10 years and working with Steve was by far the least customer service I have ever gotten. Leading up to the event I asked to speak with the DJ about music, setup and planning. Steve refused this and said 'i didn't need to speak with him'. I finally heard from DJ day of the event.

Then he did not have his DJ bring a sub woofer to the event and the sound was a challenge all night.

I also was not made aware that they would only use a database of songs instead of using an internet catalog. Many songs guests requested were unavailable AND especially no non English options. Steve said this was common practice and legally required. However I have never had a company with this limitation. It would have been good to know his stance.

When Steve asked for feedback I provided it and his replies were pointed, and not at all what I would expect from someone who I just paid hundreds of dollars for an important annual event with many friends coming from out of town. I expected more courtesy and service from his response to my feedback.

He said I should use other services in the future, so I will be sure to do so.

I had an amazing experience here with my group of 12! We did a private karaoke room for 2 hours and everything went perfectly. The staff did not bother us at all, which made the experience even better because we could really relax and have fun.
I was honestly a little skeptical at first because I saw some not-so-great reviews, but I’m really glad I trusted my first mind and still booked. If you go with a larger group, it’s definitely worth it because the price gets split between everyone. I ended up paying about $12 for 2 hours, which is a great deal for how much fun we had.
I would definitely recommend this place, especially for birthdays, group outings, or just a fun night with friends!

googleReviews.author: Vincent Lam
googleReviews.text: I have been to this great Karaoke many times since it was opened. Their devices and vibe were amazing at the first months of opening. It is still hard to make an appointment because it is popular with singers in Columbus. However, everything has been turning used and worse. The floor can be a little dirty and the restroom sometimes has some problems. Hope they can keep the room clean and maintain the devices better.

googleReviews.author: Seung Yoo
googleReviews.text: Karaoke machine did not have up to date songs, the machine was hard to use, no remote control to TV nor the karaoke machine. Worst of it all, they charge 10%tax and 15% service fee. Not only charging higher tax rate illegal, nowhere in their premise state that they will charge 15% service fee. I'm not sure if that's in lieu of tip, but they are enforcing shady business practice. Not to mention the restrooms both for male and female, were very dirty and disgusting. Do NOT go here.

googleReviews.author: Reagen Fifield (DARK AROURA)
googleReviews.text: Had a great time with my friends while we were there, but there are some issues. The system that you use to queue the songs is mostly in Chinese, and then you have to flip though several pages on their version of youtube to find a karaoke song. The room we had reserved had no A/C, and the womens restroom was dirty. The toilet had mold spots near the water, there was hair, glitter, sequins and some pee spots on the ground, not to mention the whole roll of toilet paper was also just on the ground, and there were no paper towels stocked.

googleReviews.author: Name
googleReviews.text: I parked in the parking lot for 30 minutes at midnight on a Tuesday while my friend and I were inside. Received a “notice of noncompliance” for $102 from parking revenue recovery services, which threatened to report it to a collections agency if I didn’t pay it within the month. Parking there is free starting at midnight. According to the notice, I parked there at 11:58pm. I don’t remember seeing a sign or being told to pay. This seems wildly greedy to me. Threatening to send this to collections and damage my credit unless I pay a HUGE markup from a fee I didn’t know about for TWO MINUTES is crazy. Companies nowadays really do threaten us until they take every dollar we have. Everything is already so expensive, and this is ridiculous. I won’t bother coming to this bar anymore because I don’t like being extorted. Also the male customers here are creepy. A lot of staring and touching and forcing conversation with me. It happens more here than at any other bar.

googleReviews.text:
Sweet little lowkey find here!
Drinks are EXCELLENT - as in Big City Craft, but at Midwest prices.

Corner bar meets metro hangout with Midwest prices.

googleReviews.author: JeanLuc Paul
googleReviews.text:
I am a comedian and I absolutely love this bar. The owner is wonderful and literally one of the best mixologist I’ve ever seen. Her drinks have a genuine ingenuity and flair and you can tell she genuinely cares about what she does. She’s also a true believer in local comedy and as an up and coming comic her gratitude and willingness to support the art of comedy has been vital to my career.

There’s a sprit and atmosphere that this place has, and it’s due mostly to ownership and how much they care about offering a unique bar experience.

Crescent Lounge will always be a part of my life I cherish and remember

googleReviews.text: I’ve been coming here for karaoke a while now and I absolutely love this place. It’s the only bar that I’ve felt truly safe at and the atmosphere is so cozy and friendly. Crafty always takes great care of me and whoever joins me and is always incredibly kind.

googleReviews.author: Kristen R
googleReviews.text: This is my favorite bar to hang out in... the karaoke crowd is always so kind and supportive no matter whether the singer is amazing or not. It's a real testament to the community that Ana has built in this bar! We love Ana aka Crafty!

googleReviews.text: Do you want to pay a lot of money and not sing a single song you wanted to sing? The place is super cool inside and the bartenders were nice but the karaoke system is absolutely horrible. No one explains how to use it and there’s next to no English songs. We asked the bartender how to operate it and he said “if you want do Michael Jackson you search MJ” well that’s absolutely not how they work🤣 you just gotta type in something and HOPE you see a recognizable English song name. We won’t be back till they update that system. If it was a useable system this would be the spot. Booking the room with management was also a huge hassle. We played phone tag all day. Why can’t you just book a room online

googleReviews.author: Brianna Stephens
googleReviews.text:
Music selection is poor and outdated. They charge an automatic gratuity and never came into the room to serve drinks or make sure we were good. The only time we saw any employees were when they were telling us “times up”.

The concept is cute though and we had a good time but just know it’s overpriced for the experience they provide.

googleReviews.author: Zhao L
googleReviews.text: Cool place, glad it’s in Cleveland. But the karaoke system is buggy. Search doesn’t work, we ended up using YouTube. Which was a hassle. If the systems are more user friendly(and there are actually people who can show you how to use it), it would get a 5 star rating. They were out of half of the snacks. But Good lighting and private rooms.

googleReviews.author: Pavel Lopez
googleReviews.text: I was very disheartened by this location. The atmosphere of the location was very cool but off in a weird way, the song options were extremely limited for all languages, the system was clunky and cumbersome. I had to bring in a speaker from my car to sing the songs we wanted to hear with my party. They don't even have ABBA!? You HAVE to book a reservation, they CHARGE AUTOMATIC GRATUITY, you HAVE to pay for a total of two hours minimum, it COSTS $40 per hour minimum, the first half is DUE as a deposit, and the rest at the door before you enter, the food WAS BAD, the staff was AWKWARD and a little rude, they ENTERED our room WITHOUT KNOCKING TWICE, and the bathroom was DIRTY. I had fun because I overlooked those things in the moment, but I will not be returning.

googleReviews.author: Peachy Keen
googleReviews.text:
It was loads of fun, but ridiculously expensive. Our host rented a private room. They only gave it to us for one hour, and it cost him $100 for 10 of us. Now, granted people bought a few beers and a water, but honest to God, for karaoke and for that price, there should have been free unlimited water. I mean even bars give you free water. They would only offer bottled water, and they wanted to charge $3 per bottle. It wasn't even exotic water or a cool water bottle. It was just very common water. It's irresponsible not to supply your patrons with water.  It got really hot in that little room with people trying to get drunk, being embarrassed, laughing, singing and making fools of themselves.

I am going to share the prices of the place so you can see how absolutely ridiculous they are. I mean, the place doesn't really need to do food. They need to do salty finger food and lots of alcohol. And free water.

We had a good time, but we can have a good time at home with free karaoke on YouTube and unlimited drinks.

The decor is fun, galactic, and modern/futuristic. Made for some great pix.

Choosing songs was hard since half of the menu is in Korean or something. Some of the songs were not the American or British versions we know even though they claimed to be thru artist and title. Some of the lyrics syncing was off, the notes were off, the background videos were laughable and terrible. They also didn't have ANY country songs which at least 2 people in our group wanted to sing.

The guy that came in and checked on us let us stay a little over our 1 hr, but I think we should have been allowed to hang out in the bar area afterwards or something. At least they didn't throw us out and weren't rude to us.

Still, we won't be back.

googleReviews.text: Great neighborhood dive! I have been coming here for years and have never had a bad experience. They have pool and darts in a quieter spot and tvs in the bar area. The drinks are cheap and good. Be sure to give this place a try if you’re looking for a drink in the heights!

googleReviews.author: Claire Andregg
googleReviews.text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience here on January 23rd.

According to the bar’s Facebook page and Google listing, closing time is 2:30 a.m. However, at around 2:20–2:23 a.m., my friend and I were rudely forced out while we were simply waiting for our Uber to arrive. The staff was unprofessional and unnecessarily hostile, including being sworn at by a blonde female bartender and another staff member behind the bar.

Despite having a small tab (under $25), I tipped 50% out of courtesy. I also work in the restaurant/bar industry and fully understand wanting to close on time, but that does not excuse treating paying customers disrespectfully or asking them to leave before the stated closing time—especially in such a rude manner.

This experience showed a serious lack of customer service and professionalism. Unfortunately, because of this, I will not be returning and would not recommend this establishment.

googleReviews.author: Alexandra Richardson
googleReviews.text: Blonde bartender kicked us out at 2:10am in 1 degree weather despite bar closing at 2:30 for no stated reason. I asked if we could wait for our uber for three minutes. She responded saying she can close the bar whenever she wants and we need to get out. Swearing, yelling at us for no reason kicking us out when we weren’t drunk, disorderly or disrespectful. Clearly very eager to go home.

googleReviews.author: Ember Design
googleReviews.text: This place is awesome! Carly took amazing care of us! She was such a sweetheart and made the experience a 10/10! She was so cute and sweet and gave us the best service that will make us return! They have wonderful drinks, pool, darts, and accessible bathrooms! 10/10 recommend the Social Room for a fun night out with friends! They also have touchtunes!

googleReviews.author: Taj The Great One
googleReviews.text:
I WILL NOT BE BACK! Watch out for covert RACISM.
I started coming here for karaoke about a month ago.  Sometimes I stop in to shoot darts and play basketball. I guess since there were only 3 Black people in the bar this particular evening, the truth came out. A White patron yells out, "What's worse calling someone a racial slur or making fun of somebody with a disability?" The barmaid who is blonde with a high ponytail and long fake eyelashes could have changed the subject. Instead, she repeated it while everyone laughs. UNBELIEVABLE! Then I respond, "Why is that a question anyone would even ask?
The guy who said it couldn't even justify it. Then one guy yells out, "We love Jews!" That's when I left. I REFUSE to patronize an establishment where people of different races etc are even mildly disrespected. I will gladly take my business elsewhere.

googleReviews.author: Sarath
googleReviews.text:
I recently visited The Treehouse Brewery and overall had a pretty good experience. The ambience is really nice—comfortable, lively, and a great place to hang out. The drinks were actually quite good, and the variety they offer is impressive. Prices are also reasonable, which makes it a solid spot for a casual outing.

However, the service could definitely be improved. It felt a bit unorganized and not as attentive as expected. If they work on that part, this place can easily be a top-notch brewery experience.

Overall, I’d rate it 4/5. A good place to visit, with room for better service.

They actually have stools made out of tree stumps and booths and tonight was wing night for a decent price and the wings were a nice size.  I ordered the mushroom Swiss burger and it did not disappoint and it was a nice size so much that I had to bring half of it home. The lemon pepper wings were delicious. Seasoned to the tee. The DJ Melissa is very nice too. I will definitely come back again.

googleReviews.author: Elizabeth Brinson
googleReviews.text: We had a fun time celebrating my sister-in-law’s birthday. The bar itself is a vibe but the drinks we ordered never came from the ceiling as expected in the room we booked. The music was really not great at times too. For some songs the lyrics were missing/incomplete, for others the lyrics were highly modified from the original version. The bar is 21+ only so the lyrics being bleeped or edited was absurd and made it very difficult to follow the song at times. You had to really know the songs well without having the words on the screen to guide you which misses the entire point of karaoke. We enjoyed our time in spite of these things but expect improvements before we would visit again.

googleReviews.author: Andrew Lavely
googleReviews.text:
Reserved a room for six for two hours. Drinks are reasonably priced, well-crafted, and pretty tasty. Employees were also pretty nice and helpful.

But the actual experience felt bare and poorly-executed. Cheap. The rooms are very minimalist in design, are not soundproofed (can hear other rooms singing, not to mention the main club room), and the karaoke tech is TERRIBLE: The music defaults to weird keys, is randomly out-of-sync with on-screen lyrics, and the song library is so minimal (do not go to the Japan-themed karaoke bar and expect to karaoke any Japanese songs or anime titles).

Add to that the removal of past elements like drinks being lowered through the ceiling and robot deliveries, plus a mandatory gratuity added to your room reservation fee (not just your drinks, which itself is sensible), and I can’t help but feel Tokyo Kitty has gone out of their way to cheapen an experience (not the cost) that will eventually run out of one-time customers.

----- Initial Review -----
Very fun bar and even better when they have DJs. Check their Instagram for current events.

They have a cozy patio out back. Great service and friendly, so I always tip above average.

googleReviews.author: Guy Frank
googleReviews.text:
Tillie’s Lounge is one of our favorite establishments in the city! This bar manages to strike a balance that most can’t... it’s polished and well-decorated enough to avoid the “dive bar” label, yet still feels relaxed, homey, and completely unpretentious.

Drink prices are very reasonable, and the atmosphere invites you to settle in and stay awhile. The bartenders are incredibly warm and kind. Special shoutout to Randy, Vince and Luna for consistently providing excellent service! The establishment is always clean, and the restroom upkeep is especially commendable, considering how tough it can be to maintain single-stall facilities in a busy bar environment.

Tillie’s hosts a variety of fun, themed events that showcase diverse and talented performers. We especially love their brunches and open stage nights—they’re always lively, inclusive, and full of great energy.

There’s a true sense of community amongst the regulars, yet newcomers are always made to feel welcome. The crowd is friendly but never overbearing, which adds to the overall charm.

Tillie’s is truly a hidden gem. As much as we’d love to keep it to ourselves, it only seems fair to share it with the rest of the city. If you haven’t visited yet, you’re certainly missing out. Stop by and support this lovely little establishment!

googleReviews.author: Alexander J. Hoffman
googleReviews.text: I called a week in advance to book a room, and to ask for special accommodations for a birthday we were celebrating. All accommodations were happily granted. When we arrived the night of, they did not have my reservation on the books and could not accommodate our requests. Thankfully, they had a room available for us. Besides the administrative errors, the customer service was not good, and we had some weird moments with one staff member in particular, asserting themselves into our conversations when we wanted privacy with our friends, which is kindof the whole point of a private karaoke room. The rooms have seen better days, the sound system was lacking, and our room got really hot. They only turned the air on after we complained. Despite all of this, we managed to have a good time. For 3 hours, I was charged over $200, so I expected better. 1/10 I couldn't recommend.

googleReviews.author: Jess Johnston
googleReviews.text: Had an absolute blast singing my heart out! The team was so fun and friendly, a great place for a birthday party.

googleReviews.author: Dorshele Stewart
googleReviews.text:
A TIME WAS HAD!!! 🎉🙌🏽❤️😄😂  This was our first karaoke experience. About 10 of us and we booked the large space - Rm. #4.

We went to celebrate a friend's birthday and the experience and venue was amazing!
- easy to book (the owner & family were kind)
- great location (easy to find, well lit, plenty of parking)
- decent pricing (pay for each hour)
- the staff was friendly and showed us how to work the equipment. When we had more questions, they were available with a kind attitude!

DEFINITELY will be back!

Just one request: have a camera in the room to record the experience! This way, guests can have a separate watch party to play back the experience over and over again! 😂
We were on our phones to record videos and take pictures, but the experience got so good to us, that we put our phones down! 😆❤️

googleReviews.author: Kathy Tran
googleReviews.text:
Buckle in for a crazy ride, folks:

I booked a room at Maru for 8 people at $55/hr. Albeit, I admit 11 ended up coming and I would’ve been totally fine with the $10 fee for additional people. After paying, we discovered they had charged a WHOPPING $120/hr (more than DOUBLE). When confronted, the front desk guy lied about showing me two rooms and that I requested the room for 15-18 people. That NEVER HAPPENED and I have 3 witnesses AND the security camera caught that. He even tried to threaten showing me the security footage 😭like, please, prove me right actually.

Also, my friend told me that the guy was insulting me the whole time when I wasn’t talking to him on the phone, clearly because I was not there in person (he also just hung up on me during the discussion). Even during the refund process, when we were only trying to pay the real $55/hr rate, they STILL tried to haggle saying “fee this, fee that”. There are so many things I could’ve gotten upset about, but literally all I cared about was the promised upon rate. Was I mad about the limited discography? No. Was I mad about the undisclosed gratuity? No. I merely wanted what we were rightfully owed. Simple as that. Then, to still try to negotiate out of paying us back PLUS being heavily insulted PLUS trying to threaten me?!? What is happening?!?

Overall this was an exhausting experience during a time that was supposed to be one of celebration. This place operates DISHONESTLY and WITHOUT ANY RESPECT for customers.

googleReviews.author: andy
googleReviews.text: I went with a large group and we had such a fun time! We stayed for three hours and the entire time we were there everyone was so friendly and accommodating. Lots of good songs to choose from and so fun to have our own little room to sing our hearts out in!! We can’t wait to come back 💗

We ended up here accidentally, but we're super happy about it. We actually had a reservation somewhere else down the road that fell through, so we walked in here on a busy downtown Saturday and they got us in immediately.

The place is way bigger than it looks from the outside and I'm told it's super rare that you can't get set up in there within just a few minutes.

The food is nothing to die for, but considering you're bowling or playing games while they're bringing you food, it's not something I would complain about. You get to just wander around and do all sorts of games, some of which are free and others you pay for in reserved spots. We played quite a bit with a group of friends, probably spent two hours in here (maybe a little longer), and had an absolute blast.

I've got co-workers that have said they also have gone here on large group outings and that they do an excellent job accommodating for that.

googleReviews.author: Sarah Fresen
googleReviews.text: This place is always super crowded- just keep that in mind. Be prepared to wait in line and then be shoulder to shoulder everywhere inside. Prices for drinks aren’t too bad and they taste pretty average. They always have good live music and we’ve met pretty good people. It’s a good mix between a grungy, edge-y place and a more upscale place. Kind of like a cooler Brothers. The women’s bathroom wait lines are ridiculously long so definitely plan for that.

googleReviews.author: AvgJoe
googleReviews.text:
Rolled into Tin Roof around 2pm, which is basically the golden hour for people who enjoy good food and personal space. Downtown was calm before the Pacers storm, and for a glorious moment, I had the whole place to myself like I’d accidentally rented it out for a private lunch.

The bar staff? Absolute rockstars. The kind of friendly where you start wondering if you should tip extra or just invite them to Thanksgiving.

Started things off with a Salty Watermelon, and let me tell you — that drink is dangerous in the best possible way. Sweet, refreshing, and the kind of cocktail that whispers, “Hey… you don’t really need responsibilities today.”

Then came the world‑famous chicken strips, and for once, the hype was real. Perfectly seasoned, hand‑breaded, and cooked so well I considered writing a thank‑you note to the fryer. Crunchy on the outside, juicy on the inside — basically the Beyoncé of chicken strips. The OG Tin Roof sauce? Elite. The fries? Crispy enough to make you feel like the universe is finally on your side.

Cold drinks kept arriving at the exact moment I started thinking, “Hmm… I could use another.” That’s service excellence right there.

Eventually the pre‑game crowd rolled in, jerseys and all, and that was my cue to exit before things shifted from “chill lunch vibes” to “sports bar thunder dome.”

Bottom line:
If you want great food, cold drinks, and a laid‑back atmosphere, hit Tin Roof during the day.
If you want the party, the noise, and the full game‑day chaos, they’ve got that too.
Either way, you’re winning.

#TinRoofIndy #FoodieFinds #PacersPreGame #DaytimeChill #NighttimeParty

If you're into unpretentious hangouts with great energy, this shotgun shack-style bar and music venue is a must. We stopped in after a Fever game and found a lively crowd, a DJ spinning upbeat tracks, and a laid-back atmosphere that made it easy to settle in and enjoy the night.

There’s plenty of seating both inside and out on the patio, making it a great spot whether you want to catch the action or kick back with friends. The drink scene is strong here—daily specials and a solid Happy Hour (Monday through Friday) mean there’s always something good and affordable on tap.

Hungry? The expansive menu has you covered. From wings and tenders to burgers, tacos, and much more, there’s something for every craving.

Want to catch a live set or DJ night? Be sure to check out their website for the latest music lineup—it’s a great spot to keep on your radar for a fun night out without the frills.

googleReviews.author: Stephanie Brown
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been to The Free Spirit a few times now, and it’s quickly becoming my favorite Northside spot. Most people expect bar food to be a grease-fest, but the food here is shockingly fresh, tasty, and not soaked in oil.
The biggest selling point for this location is the late-night kitchen. It is incredibly difficult to find quality food at odd hours near Castleton Square Mall, but these guys deliver every time. Their made-to-order thin crust pizza is made fresh, per order, and helpful hint: 16-inch is absolutely massive (but the price was very reasonable). Just a heads up: it’s so big it likely won’t even fit in your fridge if you have leftovers!

The atmosphere has a total "Cheers" feeling- there is a loyal group of local regulars and a very diverse crowd, but the staff makes you feel welcome regardless. Every encounter I’ve had with the team has been great; they are helpful, attentive, and don’t mind if you’re just there to grab a quick bite.

Highlights:

Late-Night Food: One of the few reliable kitchens open late in the area.

The Pizza: Incredible made-to-order thin crust (the 16" is huge!).

Entertainment: Two well-maintained pool tables, tons of flat screen TVs with all the sports you could want, and more.

Service: Welcoming staff and a relaxed, neighborhood vibe.

Whether you're a local or just passing through the Northside, this place is worth a visit!

googleReviews.author: Mason Washer
googleReviews.text: A good little local spot perfect for tasty bar food, well-priced drinks and good vibes. The outdoor patio space is a perk in warmer weather, lots of table space indoors to eat and all the service was polite and quick to attend our needs. The pool tables are a plus. A new favorite local spot for me!

googleReviews.text: We had our corporate event at AMPED Milwaukee. Everything was fantastic! We made reservations with Hailey, quick turnaround. Everything was communicated clearly. They even provided us with water pitcher when we requested for it on the spot. Staff were friendly and helpful. Thank you Tyler, Mitchell, Miranda and David! You made our experience even better!

googleReviews.author: John Thompson
googleReviews.text: We didn’t eat here so I cannot comment on the food. However, the games and the employees were fabulous. We arrived a few minutes early and the employees allowed us to come in and wait inside rather than sit out in the cold. From start to finish all of the employees went out of their way to accommodate our party and especially our special needs daughter. The drinks were great as well. The MC (Corwind) and the producer (Tevin) made you feel at ease and at the same time made it feel like a genuine TV game show. Our small crew of 10 had a blast. I would highly recommend the activity for anyone. Parking was surprisingly easy considering you are across the street from the Pabst Mansion, and they were hosting a wedding too. We used the parking garage on 9th and it was easy and very close. All in all, just a great time!

One of the best dive bars in the city, without a doubt. Definitely not everyone's flavor but if you're down with a healthy dose of degeneracy and a good crusty atmosphere you'll absolutely love it here. It certainly doesn't look like it on the surface, but this is the only bar in the city that I've never once felt unsafe in - everyone looks out for everyone else and anyone who decides to cause trouble is promptly handled.

Update: several years later and this place is still my favorite spot in the city. Very low threshold for bullshit and troublemakers are handled promptly. They're hosting more shows nowadays too and the daily specials are pretty great.

googleReviews.author: Gregory Melanson
googleReviews.text:
The Garage is one of the best outdoor patio bars in Milwaukee, and this bar has a reputation of being a heavy favorite for weekend warriors, brunch-goers, and day drinking parties.  This bar is fun, and it offers lots of outdoor seating, plenty of sunshine, and an abundance of good vibes! You will feel so relaxed and almost lost, in another climate, when you get your opportunity to enjoy the outdoor patio, with an array of comfortable seating, the patio sits under and thin sliver of canopy cover with a heavily exposed patio to the sunlight, and an outdoor bar that radiates a tropical atmosphere.  Lots of conversations and comradery at The Garage, and this bar is becoming very popular for event gatherings and typical weekend fun!
The Garage is an exciting place to be, in a very exciting neighborhood! This bar is definitely identifiable with the locals and the culture of late night Brady Street. googleReviews.author: Benedict LeFort
googleReviews.text:
Family friendly restaurant with an amazing dive bar and even better menu/tap list. Oh wait, did I mention there’s an airplane hanging over the bar both inside and out??? Pilots and ground/cabin crew welcome!

If you would like to show your kids or your friends, what a real MKE  airport bar is like, you’ll come to Amelia‘s and enjoy every minute. Pull tabs bound, the staff is amazing, and the owners are great., come down to the airport and check it out. Or at least stop by for a drink on your way home from baggage claim! 50+ years of tradition is going strong!

googleReviews.author: M D
googleReviews.text: Nice Milwaukee Airport area bar and grill. Food was good.  Service was great.

googleReviews.author: Under Ma's Roof
googleReviews.text: We went there yesterday. There were two sets of doors. The first door we went through reeked of cigarettes. When we entered I noticed they still have the same carpet that was there when I was a kid. Having carpet in a bar is dumb because that old spilled alcohol lingers in the air and it's hard to eat while smelling funk. It was a Saturday night and dead. The bartenders were playing a variety of music and but had the volume up WAY too loud. Can't really rate the food. It had no flavor and was undercooked. Our appetizer came out first. We ordered the blooming onion. It was raw, hard, crunchy onion with the middle missing. We sent it back. It came back cold after we were served our main course. My son's sandwich had no flavor what so ever. I've worked in the food industry for a long time. First sight is so important. If it looks terrible it'll probably be terrible. Many years ago their food was amazing. So this was a big disappointment. And a lot of business's would do anything for a great location. You are right across the street from the airport. PLEASE fix this place up or sell it to someone that can. Our waitress was AWESOME 😎 She definitely gets 5 stars! Sorry to be so harsh but this place definitely needs some improvement.

googleReviews.author: George Wortz
googleReviews.text:
Went for friday fish fry.
Food was ok but not that great.
Our server was not too friendly and inattentive.
I would go back and give it another chance tho and try something else .
The booth was great and the airplane decor was cool!

googleReviews.author: Trucking With kingfish (Trucking with kingfish)
googleReviews.text: We stopped on for Friday night fish fry. Now, if you want to survive in Wisconsin as a place to get food, you have to have a Friday night fish fry, or you will close abruptly, I ordered the cod  the cod, and it came out piping hot, crisp, and crunchy; the fish was perfect, the service was spot on and fast if you are near the airport I suggest you stop on by

googleReviews.author: Tom Conway
googleReviews.text:
Laid-back and local—that’s the vibe at Mary’s. It’s the kind of bar where the regulars all know each other, the bartenders are friendly and fun, and you’re just as likely to find yourself in a game of dice as you are kicking back on the front porch. Live music on Sundays keeps the energy going, and it’s always a good time.

Saw the recent one-star review, and let’s be honest—it’s completely unfair. Showing up with a 10-year-old on a Friday night and expecting a full sit-down dinner? That’s on you, not the bar. They’ve got a grill behind the bar and will cook you up a burger, but Mary’s isn’t trying to be something it’s not. Docking a place one star because you misunderstood what kind of bar it is doesn’t make sense.

Mary’s Caddy Shack is exactly what it should be—and if you get it, you’ll love it.

googleReviews.text: I love this place!  Great atmosphere, the perfect Wisconsin pub and great food.  Staff is very friendly with quick service. I highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Paolo Cataggatan
googleReviews.text: Booked a karaoke room to celebrate a birthday, and it was an absolute blast!!! We had 14 people in our group, and we were able to fit just fine in the room. No issues with the mic, karaoke machine, or anything; everythjng worked great and it even included a lot of newer, recent songs which was nice. Zach was a great host and kept the drinks coming! Thanks for having us, and we are for sure to come back for another night of singing. The food looked great too, will have to try a different time. Appreciate the hospitality! $50/hour is a great rate!

googleReviews.author: Riley Spieler
googleReviews.text: Food is pretty good depending on what you get. I got the Sticky Noodles with Beef and they were very very good, but a bit skimpy on the beef. Also tried the Pad Thai which was average and chicken fried rice wasn’t too crazy, so I definitely do recommend the noodles or the pho which looked great too. Haven’t been for Karaoke yet but seems like a great time!

googleReviews.author: wylan brown
googleReviews.text:
I work fairly close to Nam’s so my coworker and I decided to order it for lunch through their website. We placed our orders at the exact same time but for some reason, only mine was ready. They (a woman and a man) claimed they had no proof of my coworker’s order even though my coworker had the order up on their phone and their card was charged and my coworker showed them both. The manager was called and it was pretty evident that the man and woman thought my coworker was lying. When the manager asked my coworker if their card had been charged, my coworker said yes, and the woman went “No. No it wasn’t.” My coworker just placed a new order and was told to contact Grubhub for a refund for the previous one.

As for the food, it was very mid. I ordered the pineapple chicken and shrimp fried rice. There were exactly three pieces of shrimp. Definitely not worth it.

googleReviews.author: Riz Goodwick
googleReviews.text:
I normally wouldn't rate Nam's Noodles so low, typically I would rate them closer to 4 to 5 stars for everything, however I recently had a terrible experience and need folks to know about it.  I recently went to Nam's on a Sunday night, and normally when I go it's the older couple that I believe owns the restaurant.  This night it was I think their son, but also could just be a younger employee, working the bar and karaoke rooms.  He started out wonderfully, very fast and attentive to our needs and orders.  However after about two hours of our 5 hour reservation a large crowd had formed out in the bar area of about 10 white men and maybe a couple white women, and they all seemed to be friends with the main employee/son of the owners. The reason I bring up race and gender is because my group was AFAB and had many different minorities. This other group proceeded to harass us the whole night and the employees did nothing about it no matter how upset or uncomfortable we seemed.  This group would peer into our room while we were singing, they'd dance and crowd around our room so we couldn't get out, and they would specifically refer to me as if I was an employee and they would also misgender me at the same time.  They repeatedly asked me to clean up their food and plates and things even though I very clearly was not an employee, and the actual employees were sitting on the opposite side of the bar with this group.  We ended up feeling so uncomfortable we demanded to end our reservation early due to these people's behavior.
I am so disappointed at how we were treated.  I have never been treated like this before at Nam's or any restaurant for that matter.  Completely unacceptable.  Even though I've been a semi-regular the last 5 years, I'm unsure if I feel comfortable and safe coming back after everything.

googleReviews.author: Abby V.
googleReviews.text:
If you’re here for karaoke, you’re better off using Spotify and singing into a hairbrush.

$50 per hour for a karaoke room and one of two mics didn’t work half of the time. They had only about a third of the songs available for Karaoke that we wanted, or some songs plain didn’t work (wrong lyrics or weird videos). The karaoke equipment was outdated and overpriced. There were only 2 finicky mics for what is advertised as a 12 person karaoke room. The room was snug and hot on a -2* night with 8 people. We asked for water and they begrudgingly gave us 5 cups for 8 people even after we spent almost $100 on food and drinks plus booking the room. It took 26 mins to get a boba drink and an appetizer, so much so that it went over our hour and then they charged us for two hours when they took that long. Language and communication was a serious barrier with the workers.

The food was fantastic. If you’re just there for food, 5/5 stars (well, unless you want a drink to go with that food, then 2/5 stars). But if you’re there for Karaoke? You’re better off using Spotify and singing into a hairbrush.

googleReviews.author: Hudson Kraut
googleReviews.text: haley gave us the most amazing service. An amazing shot and was very generous on my birthday. Will return for the pool tables and fun beers! Many thanks, best.

googleReviews.author: Andrew Pechenuk
googleReviews.text:
I find it extremely unprofessional that a bar back came up to us in line wearing a Whiskey Jack’s sweatshirt and claimed there is a dress code of no sweatpants. He was very adamant that we would not be let in wearing sweatpants and told us to go home and change. He claimed he was a bouncer and would not let us in if we wearing sweatpants. When I got to the door we found no issue getting in with sweatpants on, and when we asked about it, we were like told there is no dress code. This was reinforced when we went inside and saw numerous individuals with sweatpants on including some employees. The interesting part however was this individual who claimed they were a “bouncer” was not at the door, but was in fact behind the bar and grabbing trash around the premises, so we assume they actually a bar back. Our group does not understand why this individual thought it was okay that as a bar back to enforce their own policy that is clearly not a policy of the establishment, but we found it extremely unprofessional and will let everyone we know of this encounter to warn them for the future. No one should be dress coded at a college bar, especially by an individual who has no merit to tell customers what to do and relay a fake policy, and blame the owner so the bar back can keep who they don’t want in the bar out.

EDIT AFTER RESPONSE FROM OWNER: Well if you do have a dress code, it feels like you are picking and choosing who has to and who doesn't have to follow it. Why were multiple employees wearing grey sweatpants and why were multiple individuals inside the bar wearing grey sweatpants? If you "absolutely have a dress code", then make sure it's followed by everyone involved including your own staff. Make it a known thing as well. You are on a college campus with many students who go out in what they please with no issues from other establishments. You making it a policy that you randomly call out to who you see fit makes it seem targeted which is the consensus from the other reviews I read as well. Post a sign or something. Otherwise you are going to keep getting negative reviews about your establishment, and people are going to keep making "assumptions" about what the establishment believes in.

googleReviews.text: I love FIVE. Fun to be had literally every day of the week, the Sunday drag show is a real hit if you want to see some incredible artistry. My only complaint is the parking lot is cursed: I have had multiple friends get their vehicles damaged. The club did help with footage and the community is always kind and helpful, I just wish more people would heed Miss Kayos Lynn Mirage’s advice to take a safe way home so we can “hear from you, not about you”

googleReviews.text: Every time I come here it’s the best time ever! The bartenders are so wonderful and friendly and the shows are always amazing!

googleReviews.author: Brian
googleReviews.text:
The bartenders here have refused to serve me drinks lately. I thought that I was finding community here, but two different bartenders that at least know me by face have blatantly served other people when I was clearly at the bar first. This place cares a lot more about taking care of the regulars that they’re friends with than about serving everybody else.

I don’t know for sure, but I think that they really resent pan/bi people. There’s certainly SOMETHING that I don’t experience in other queer spaces. Despite volleyball being their big warm weather draw, they never posted info on how to play or sign up… so if you aren’t in the know, YOU ARE NOT WELCOME.

I’m moving to the DC area, and EVERYONE raves about how much friendlier and more welcoming people are there. The sad thing is that I like the clientele at Five and the staff is the entire problem. Madison deserves a place where EVERYONE in the community feels welcome.

Five is less inclusive than most “straight” bars.💯

UPDATE: ok… I came here one last time before moving, and I received great service in an atmosphere with a great vibe. I guess that I have a love/hate relationship with Five, so we’ll land on 3 stars.🤷🏼‍♂️

googleReviews.author: Shaneise Harris
googleReviews.text: Stopped here after it was recommended during a company trip, and I’m glad I did. I ordered the chicken strip basket and was genuinely impressed by both the taste and quality. This spot has officially become a must-stop anytime I’m in Madison.

googleReviews.author: Jacob Bentley
googleReviews.text:
*Kitchen does not take allergens seriously. Incredibly dangerous.*

I have a gluten allergy. I had placed an order for a burger, after confirming with their staff they had gluten free buns available. There was a place to specifically note allergens, so we marked "gluten allergy." Waitstaff was polite, and seemed to understand the concerns with customers and allergies.

The food looked great when it arrived, however, the bun stood out as not gluten free. I wanted to be safe, so I called and asked if what we had was a gluten free bun, or not. When the person who answered the phone (a very kind person) asked the kitchen to describe the gluten free bun, you could hear the kitchen staff say "Round." While the person on the phone understood the severity, it was obvious the kitchen staff has no interest in actually providing food for people, and just wants to be snarky with their waitresses and customers. For anyone who is familiar with any level of cooking, it is clear the kitchen staff do not respect their coworkers, nor their customers, which in turn shows the business does not respect their patrons to hire (or keep) staff like this.

0/10, will never order food from this location, and will be sure to recommend others to steer clear. There are plenty of other places in the area who take it more seriously.

googleReviews.author: Linda Nellen
googleReviews.text: Brad's Saturday BBQ was great. The ribs have a great dry rub, the 6-pack of sauces are wonderful. Mac & Cheese "creamy", Cowboys beans flavorful, but the brisket was thick cut and frickin awesome! Thnx Oaf!

googleReviews.author: Matt Schmalfeldt
googleReviews.text: Used to work here back in 2013-2014 and moved away from Madison in 2018. Went back yesterday to walk down memory lane and man, this place had a glow up! Place was packed from Music Bingo but our bartender, Jim, had us taken care of with in minutes. Food came out hot, fast, and delicious! Glad to see the L'oaf still thriving!

googleReviews.author: David Carlson
googleReviews.text: We were between flights at Dane County Regional Airport and were hungry.  The Lazy Oaf was a short drive away, so we decided to try it.  The staff was very friendly, welcoming and accommodating to our situation.  The pizza and jalapeño cheese curds were good.  The Brandy Old Fashioned Sweet was also good!  The atmosphere was warm and welcoming.

googleReviews.author: Amelia Bowers
googleReviews.text: Bartender wasn’t very nice! Left my zip up there last night, came in today to get it back (it had my prescription glasses in the pocket that I need to drive read and see), I ask bartender if she can grab my zip up, she seems very annoyed with me steps into the back for a second and says “we don’t have it” I tell her I’m sorry but I was only here last night and that I know I left it here. She tells me to call them tomorrow?? (Unsure why as if you don’t have it how would calling help? Also I’m from another state). I don’t want to argue and leave, my boyfriend says he’ll ask the bouncer. He goes inside and asks the bouncer instead (bless him I love him sm!) the bouncer is gone for five seconds and immediatly coms back with my hoodie! She told me there was nothing in the lost and found!! Like did she purposely not give me my sweater? Idk. Love the bouncer tho and the karaoke is very fun!

googleReviews.author: Brenna Pazour
googleReviews.text:
Get ready to wait four hours to sing unless you want to bribe the dj.....

My sister and I came in for a fun filled night of karaoke and drinking. We arrived at 10:00 p.m. and promptly signed ourselves up to sing. After an hour and a half of waiting, we attempted to sign ourselves up again for another song in attempts to sing twice before the night was up, but were told people were not allowed to have their name in the list twice to perform. It was very busy at the time, so we expected to wait 2+ hours to sing our selected tune. However, come 1:00 a.m. we saw many repeats on the stage, specifically repeats of individuals who we knew showed up after us. We asked the dj what was going on and he told us we would not have time to perform before the night was up. When pressed about the repeats I saw on stage, he said they paid him money to be able to perform and insinuated we do the same. I was disgusted, as we had been patrons at this establishment all night, awaiting our time to perform, just to have this individual attempt to take additional money from us to tip himself directly. In the end, we waited for four hours and were told we had to leave 10 minutes earlier than actual bar close as their clock was wrong, with no possibility of ever singing our karaoke song.

I recommend that anyone go anywhere else if they actually want a chance to do karaoke unless you feel comfortable tipping the dj who had multiple technical issues and despite saying the night was incredibly busy, decided to sing his own six minute tune instead of allowing the patrons of the establishment to perform.

googleReviews.author: Rachel Vouk
googleReviews.text: I would give this place 5/5 stars if they didn’t have such a horrible dj. I have had issues with him every single time I have been here. He is incredibly rude and will let other people that he knows sing 3 times before anyone in our group can sing. Bartenders, drinks, food and service are great. I wish there was a different dj. Based on the other reviews, I’m not the only person who has had this experience.

googleReviews.text: Love this place! Food from the Korean restaurant was amazing. Everything was very affordable, cheaper than I expected. Gentleman that brought us to the room was very kind and helpful with showing us how to navigate the karaoke machine because it’s a Korean system. Had a good range of songs, Korean and English. They even had K-pop Demon Hunters which is what we need to stay happy in life XD thanks for the great time guys!

googleReviews.author: Nick Jones
googleReviews.text:
Great Karaoke place in Minneapolis. Attentive  staff and many options for music. Large remote with many options to queue songs in advance. Up to four remote microphones for our party of 13. Korea restaurant in first floor serves DELICIOUS food to your private room. All ages accepted.

Edit: Huge shoutout to our KJ Lee for impeccable service and attention to client relations. He is an excellent host.

googleReviews.author: Nicole Feest
googleReviews.text: I happened to be invited to a birthday party here and WISH I would have known about Shin's earlier. Lee was manning the rooms and was an incredible host. We were so satisfied with our experience and I cannot wait to book a room for my own birthday. We actually were having too much fun that we booked an extra hour.

googleReviews.author: Jacob Blackwell
googleReviews.text:
It's definitely Korean Karaoke.  The controller takes some learning and the music selection is super odd, lots of 2000's songs, then weird "kid bopz" sounding covers of other songs. Had HotToGo and Wicked Movie stuff but not like, Queen Latifah, Donna Champlin, or They Might Be Giants.

Overall had a great time though, great pricing and nice staff!

googleReviews.author: Kristin Gill
googleReviews.text: This place rocks, super affordable, staff are very kind, and they give you space to have fun. I’m already planning a return visit with another group of friends. They have a ton of music selections (huge books of songs) but just be prepared to navigate the karaoke machine in Korean (use Google translate or ask for help) bc the buttons are in Korean! To find the karaoke place, enter the restaurant and speak to an employee who can show you to the upstairs. You can call ahead to make a reservation.

Trendy veteran-focused venue with bars, a full menu & entertainment such as live music & karaoke. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: S F
googleReviews.text:
My friend and I had a really disappointing experience at the Uptown VFW tonight. We ordered drinks expecting the normal drink size, but instead were served what was essentially a shot-sized portion. When we questioned it, we were still told we would need to pay $30 for the drink, despite it clearly not being the size of a standard cocktail.
Rather than resolving the issue or having a conversation with us about the misunderstanding, the bartender was the manager for the evening and decided to kick us out, even though we had barely had anything to drink and were simply asking about the drink we ordered. Pictures below to compare the usual size to what he tried to give us.
The situation felt unnecessary and poorly handled. We were respectful and just trying to clarify what we were being charged for. Unfortunately, the response from staff was dismissive and escalated quickly instead of being handled like normal customer service.
Really disappointing experience overall.

googleReviews.author: Ashley Jackson
googleReviews.text:
My friend and I planned a girls’ night out and were very disappointed with how we were treated. We had purchased tickets in advance for the event ($15 per person) and were looking forward to the evening. At one point, my friend ordered drinks, but the bartender/night manager made shots instead. When she politely questioned the order, he immediately became irritated and insisted we pay $30 for them. Since that was not what we ordered, we declined and returned to the event area.
Shortly afterward, three bouncers approached us and told us we were being kicked out because we were intoxicated. This was simply not true. We had just arrived and had barely had anything to drink. It felt like we were being removed for questioning the incorrect order rather than for any legitimate reason. We also asked to speak with the bartender/night manager and requested a refund for the event we had already paid for, but he refused to speak with us or refund the $15 each that we paid to attend. As the wife of a retired combat veteran, I was especially disheartened by how dismissively we were treated. We came out expecting a fun night and instead left feeling embarrassed and unfairly accused. I hope management reviews how this situation was handled and ensures staff treat guests with professionalism and respect. No one should be removed from an event they paid for without a clear and fair reason.

Experience occurred 07 March 2026

googleReviews.author: David Marcelo Seminario Calle
googleReviews.text: It’s a nice place to go out with friends, it could look kinda ghetto tbh. When u go inside go to the “upper” level, that room is more chill and there are people doing karaoke.

googleReviews.author: Marc H
googleReviews.text:
Every Wednesday at 9pm this VFW hosts “Transmission,” an 80s/90s dance night focused on new wave, alternative and early-days MTV video staples (i.e., Depeche Mode, Duran Duran, Madonna).
Local DJ Jake Rudh does a great job of playing the favorites for the majority, but also mixes in a few rarer tracks for the music heads (Ministry’s “Halloween”, Tears for Fears “Change”). As a former club DJ, I can appreciate technical mixing skill, but that’s not the focus here, as Jake segues the (mostly music videos) together, with the occasional microphone announcement.
The crowd is a chill, generational mix: 40 and 50 somethings singing along with the lyrics, as well as a decent number of younger partiers especially as the evening progresses. All in all, a fun night out with your friends or solo.

googleReviews.author: JC Cross
googleReviews.text:
Impressed after my first visit and second and third. You might not expect such well-prepared and well-presented food from a VFW, which means you’ll be in for a surprise.

The entrees here deliver a lot of flavor and bang for your buck. Unless you have a hard time leaving anything on your plate (like me), you’ll probably have enough for two meals.

The chimichanga first sold me. It’s the size of your forearm and sits on a mountain of crispy potatoes.

They have a good-sized menu with some nice salad options if you’re looking for something on the lighter side.

googleReviews.text: This place is a classic neighborhood dive bar. It has a really friendly and cozy vibe. The food was surprisingly good! googleReviews.author: AMAZING A
googleReviews.text: I have lived in Minneapolis most of my life and this bar is in the top 3 of unique bars. The regulars are from all walks of life and have created a family. They have tons of live music and amazing DJ's and have New Orleans boil night and Jamaican jerk chicken night ( amazing). Outdoor patio with two fire pits is also awesome for smoking. Their kitchen is always on point and Wendy (cook) is awesome, I highly suggest their deep fried green beans and buffalo cauliflower.

googleReviews.author: Brianna Fabian
googleReviews.text: The place is ok if you have nowhere else to go. I love the karaoke but good luck getting to sing. Theres a dj downstairs which is pretty cool. The bouncers are nice. The bartenders, not so much. It was super busy so I was patient but people who got there after me got helped first and a bartender left in the middle of my order to say hi to someone which I thought was a bit rude. Seems like this place is really only for people who know the bartenders.

googleReviews.author: Halsten Larson
googleReviews.text: Moose Bar & Grill in Northeast Minneapolis has quickly become one of my favorite bars in Minneapolis, thanks to our waiter, Alaina (I’m not sure if that’s how her name is spelled). From the moment we sat down, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely excited to make sure we had a great experience. She knew the menu inside and out, offered spot-on recommendations, and checked in at just the right times without ever hovering. Drinks arrived quickly, food was hot, and every request was handled with a smile. Alaina somehow balanced efficiency with real personality, making us feel like regulars on our very first visit. When the place got busy, she stayed calm, organized, and upbeat, which made the whole night run smoothly. It’s clear she takes pride in her work and cares about customers in a way you don’t see often. Management should know that Alaina is a standout employee who elevates the entire restaurant. Give her a raise, because she’s exactly the kind of server that keeps people coming back again and again on every visit without exception.

googleReviews.author: Jason Pawelsky
googleReviews.text:
Great Northeast dive bar atmosphere with excellent service.

Met us with some friends for wing night and the food did not disappoint. They've got plenty of TVs to watch your favorite sports games.

We devoured 8 lbs of wings along with some onion rings and spinach dip.

I'll definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Lois Green
googleReviews.text: I love the moose. There is so many different things to do karaoke playing darts, having fun with friends. And their chicken wings are absolutely delicious. I had the dry rub and buffalo wings. Great neighborhood bar and restaurant

googleReviews.author: Amber Crowley
googleReviews.text: Nye's bar was an absolute blast! The atmosphere was lively and energetic, with a fantastic crowd that really added to the fun vibe. The piano player was exceptionally talented, providing great music that enhanced the overall experience. I had a fantastic time at Nye's bar and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a lively night out. The combination of the vibrant scene, energetic crowd, and skilled piano player made for a memorable evening that I won't soon forget. If you're in the mood for a good time with great music and a fun crowd, Nye's bar is the place to be!

googleReviews.author: Jessica Poindexter
googleReviews.text: The bar itself is a lot smaller than I was expecting. It's kind of long and narrow. We went for the piano karaoke and that was a joy to watch. The specialty drinks were tasty. Specifically, the pear martini and very affordable.

googleReviews.author: Reilly Miller
googleReviews.text: This place is definitely made for white folks who want to have a Billy Joel moment. Daina (the piano player) has work to do to make patrons, especially Black and Brown folks, feel welcome here.

googleReviews.author: Brandy Churchill
googleReviews.text: My blueberry mojito was good and the piano music was loud and well done (don't plan to have much of a conversation if your group is bigger than 3). All our requests got played. Someone at my table ordered a whiskey sour and it came in a smaller glass than my cocktail (pretty noticeable because the glasses were the same shape and style), but the bartender did come by to clarify some preferences for the sour to make sure the person would like it. My single, regular sized cocktail was $16. The server came around 3-4 times over 2 hours for our group of 8 - it was Saturday night and there weren't any open seats, but it wasn't wall to wall people. I really wish they had some kind of snacks available, or a food truck outside. Some of the folks at my table would have had another drink if there were food available (even if just peanuts, chips, other non-refrigerated goods that don't require cooking). The restrooms were clean and gender neutral (there are two separate single restrooms).

googleReviews.author: Lexie Haglund

Bartenders & servers are very nice and talented , live music that takes requests and even lets you sing if you’d like.

I ordered one espresso martini and it was $15 but well worth it

googleReviews.author: Gabriella Thorsen
googleReviews.text: The staff was super friendly and made for a great experience. The sausage platter was delicious and definitely a highlight. The schnitzel was just okay the cream sauce tasted more like a ranch-style dressing, so I’d recommend getting it on the side. I’m still on the hunt for the best schnitzel in town!

googleReviews.author: Ben Lauer
googleReviews.text: We stoped into Gluek’s after a game at Target Field. Walking from the stadium was very easy and a short time/distance. There is plenty of seating available even though the establishment was busy. I ordered The Sausage Party which includes a choice of 2 grilled sausages, kartoffelsalat, sauerkraut, and a stone ground mustard. I chose the Polish Sausage and the Chorizo Sausage. Everything was very good with the exception of the chorizo. The chorizo sausage was exceptionally delicious, actually the best I’ve eaten. The spice level was perfection. My wife ordered the Schnitzel Sandwich which was also delicious. The service and the atmosphere was superb as well. Highly recommended before or after a game!

googleReviews.author: Tim Noonen
googleReviews.text:
Looking for a Bavarian Beer Hall? Gleuk's is the place. We were looking for an interesting place before attending the pre-Broadway release of Purple Rain and Gleuk's was withing walking distance of the State Theater.
Let's start with beer! They have a great selection including their namesake. I chose the rotating Paulaner and this month it is a doppelbock. Tasty!!!
For an appetizer, we chose the pretzel sticks ... ummmm, more like pretzel logs! They were very good, but it was a big portion. If that is possible to have too big a portion.
For dinner, I chose the walleye sandwich. It was deep fried in a beer batter to a perfect crispiness. The tartar sauce was yummy and I really enjoyed the sandwich. Again, the portion was big!
My partner chose the Berliner ... an open face roast beef with mushrooms and Swiss. She said it was delicious.
I look forward to going back to Gleuk's with friends. I really want to experience the beer tower and there are some things on the menu that I want to try.

googleReviews.author: Michael Landen
googleReviews.text: The macaroni and cheese with spaetzle instead of traditional noodles (I had a bratwurst added on top) was quite good and I would highly recommend. I make my own spaetzle at give, but nowi want to try mac and cheese at home this way too! The service was good. The food, in general, takes after a southern German cooking style vs a sweeter northern German - I prefer the southern style more, so this suited me.  Service was attentive without being overbearing.  All in all, I'd go here again. I also went to another German (barbarian themed) restaurant about 20 miles away and this one was better. A solid choice, especially if you're downtown.

googleReviews.author: Wendi
googleReviews.text: Drove here for lunch. I got the Schnitzel späetzle and my daughter got the mac and cheese with a bratwurst. Of course  we needed to try the warm potato salad. The food was fantastic and the server was so nice.

googleReviews.author: Miss Trista's Soundcheck
googleReviews.text: One of my favorite local live music venues!  Nice sized stage with great lighting and sound. Staff is awesome, always friendly. Parking lot parking, can get crowded during busy live music nights but I've always found a parking spot. They'll check ID etc. right as you walk through the door if you're there for live music events.  Pool tables, darts, etc. make for a great place "to hang." Food and drinks are good too!

googleReviews.author: Ian T
googleReviews.text: I've been to the Dog House several times typically to watch a live band.  Always had an exceptional experience.  The crowd was small for a Saturday night.  But the band RIVAL5 was on FIRE!!!!   The Dog House offers an extremely varied array of different entertainment throughout the month.  I think I'm going to check out their Texas hold'em games on a Sunday evening next.

googleReviews.author: Chris Montan
googleReviews.text: First time customer here and seems like a very nice setup with plenty of TVs, dart boards, pool tables and even a trivia event. Seemed fairly busy for a Tuesday night which guessing by staff reactions was because of the concert at the Myth nearby (which us exactly why were there). There was one bartender and only one waiter which seemed really understaffed. We waited about an hour after seating ourselves to even place our food orders because you had just one guy responsible for serving everyone not at the bar. That was incredibly annoying, especially since we were on a time limit with the concert to go to. The waiter was sweating bullets and offered great service, so a lot respect is due to him. Food was enticingly delicious; I went with the Minnesota classic pickle roll ups for an appetizer and a Cubano sandwich fory entree. Prices are very reasonable for the portions served and the quality of the food. I'd come back again, although if I had a similar experience with slow service again it'd likely be my last visit. Even with the slow service, I chose to give 4 stars since every other aspect either met or exceeded my expectations.

googleReviews.author: Becky Donahue
googleReviews.text:
I visited Dog House in Maplewood last night and had a concerning experience.

I ordered a drink and paid for it immediately after placing the order. Later, when I ordered a second drink, the bartender told me that I had never paid for the first one and that I owed him for both drinks. I explained that I had already paid and was certain of it. He said he would check, walked away for a while, and then returned asking for payment again without providing any clear confirmation that he had actually verified the transaction.

After I questioned it a second time, he briefly went back to the register and returned saying there was no record of payment. Although I was confident that I had already paid, I chose to pay again rather than create a scene or argue.

What concerns me most is that later that evening, while at another establishment, I mentioned what had happened. The bartender there told me he had heard similar complaints from others and claimed that he had experienced something similar himself at this bar.

I cannot say whether this was an honest mistake or something else, but the experience left me disappointed and concerned. I would encourage management to review their payment procedures to ensure customers are not charged twice.

googleReviews.author: Amy Thorne
googleReviews.text: We love 10, 000 Days and Mad Alice was amazing! I hope you keep the wallaye  cheeks on the menu. They are SO good! Also a shout out to Joe for going the extra mile for us! He is awesome!! He really helped our group out and we so appreciate it. Also our server Nicole was great! Very attentive and so friendly! Qw really appreciated all the great service on such a busy night!

googleReviews.author: Chloe Spencer
googleReviews.text:
Been intrigued about the Black Hart for a while, and hey, I'm all for hitting up businesses that are accessible on the lightrail. To my understanding, they're LGBTQ-owned, and give back to local organizations. I visited for the Dining Out for Life event, and they specifically donated 33% of their proceeds to the Aliveness Project, a local organization dedicated to education, prevention, and treatment for HIV/AIDs.

So the Black Hart feels like a dive bar in a lot of ways, it's very old school but immaculate and clean. I was honestly astounded by how not-sticky the bar is. They have a wonderful selection of drafts, bottles/cans, and cocktails (including a soft-serve margarita for $8? Hello?) They recently unveiled a new food menu which features a variety of brats, hot dogs, and vegan brats (but please note, per their Instagram, the oil they use is not vegan. They have a very small kitchen, y'all.) I ordered a Japanese brat, which comes with sriacha, kewpie mayo, and fried onions. I was accidentally served a Korean brat (which has kimichi and gochujang) and they let me eat that for free. Don't sleep on the Korean brat: the kimchi they serve is so fresh and has a sweet taste. Sometimes kimchi can be a little too sour/bitter--Idk who their vendor is, but it was good. The brat is also high quality, excellent texture and seasonings. Their cheese curds were also decent! But don't skip the brats!

Service was great. One bartender holding down the fort, and he did a great job at attending to the customers there and checking in with them. ALSO! PLEASE BE SURE TO ORDER AT THE SIGN! It is VERY obvious and I'm seeing some folks leaving negative reviews on not seeing the sign for ordering??? Babe, look up???

All in all, great business, lovely bar. Don't miss out on the cherry rhubarb cider they currently have on the menu. If there's any feedback I could give? It'd be rad if they put their menu on their website. But aside from that, rad place. They also have pool and bocce bar ($5 for 1 hr for the bocce ball.)

googleReviews.author: Sterling Scherschel
googleReviews.text:
*Real bar with actual humans working there.

Yes, I got roasted for taking too long to order on a busy Tuesday night. Yes, the pool tables are confusing if you’re new. Yes, there is almost always some absurd event happening and often an unexpected cash-only cover.

I find myself unable to stay away.

I love drag, pool, beer, & queers. I like a bar without much fluff but a ton of character.

This is that bar. Its consistent. It’s dive-y, yet whimsical. I have yet to try to food; what should I order?

We visited with a large group (14 people) last night and rented their larger room for 2 hours at $50/hr.  Lots of karaoke song options with good service for food and drinks.  Note they don't have hard liquor, only beer and wine (and soda and non alcoholic drinks). We had the wings and shrimp tempura and both were good.  There are a lot of other menu options like fried rice dishes, noodles, etc.

googleReviews.author: Colby Era
googleReviews.text: I would return. Finding songs could be challenging. I think the remote is Korean by default but there is English very visibly. Didn't figure out how to queue songs or how the scoring worked. However, we did not ask, either. It did what was advertised and was fun. Unexpectedly fun! The rooms contain most singers but there can be loud individuals. I was one of those loud ones. No one complained except my own friends! Wish I was there before kitchen closed,  next time! Highly recommend.

googleReviews.author: Tasha M
googleReviews.text: We made reservations for a karaoke room at 8pm. The room wasn't ready until after 8:20pm. It was almost 8:30pm when we actually made it to the room. They made us leave at 10pm, even though they are open until 11pm per the sign on their door. Then they made us pay for the full 2 hours that we had originally reserved the room for. They say no outside food or drink, then they make you pay for water. Service was slow. Both of the karaoke microphone batteries died and we had to wait for several minutes while they switched out the microphones. The food we ordered from the Korean restraunt attached to the karaoke place was really good. I would visit the Korean restraunt, but I'm not sure I would return for karaoke

googleReviews.author: Brian Brenhoch
googleReviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Howl at the Moon – Kansas City

If you ever find yourself in Kansas City and want a night packed with music, energy, and pure fun—Howl at the Moon is the place! 🎹🎸🥁

I stopped in on a Wednesday night (yes, Wednesday), and the place was absolutely buzzing! Turns out, a few conferences were in town—including ours—and this spot was clearly the crowd favorite. The performers? Unreal. Five insanely talented musicians trading off between keyboards, guitars, bass, drums, and vocals like a well-oiled rock-and-roll machine. Every song was a crowd-pleaser, and the audience was all in from start to finish.

Even with the place packed, the bar staff didn’t miss a beat—fast, friendly, and flawless under pressure. I brought about 25 people from our BRMConnect conference, and everyone was blown away. Between the music, the dancing, and the non-stop good vibes, it was hands-down one of the highlights of our trip.

Huge shout-out to the Howl at the Moon crew—musicians and staff alike—for making a Wednesday night feel like a Saturday party. Can’t wait to come back next time I’m in town! 🎶🔥

googleReviews.text:
I have been told that people who possess many condiments are talented in specific, personal skills. If that were the case, and could be applied to businesses, this bar would be so lacking that it would be forced into celibacy.

The problem all started when I asked for a hot dog with just chili. “We don’t do that”, replied the apathetic bartender. When I then kindly asked for a hot dog with only  ketchup, the bartender informed me they don’t have ketchup. Don’t have ketchup?! In this economy?! In this political state?!? When will the tragedies cease?? I’m all about respecting art- but when it comes to the creation of a hot dog, I believe there should be some more basic options outside of the two specific dogs listed on the sign. Sorry I don’t like mustard. Just a plain dog on bun for me, I guess.

I got nothing but hate and dirty looks from the bartender then entire time. Was there for 20 minutes and then left.
