googleReviews.author: Emily Halaszynski
googleReviews.text:
We are lucky to have so many gay bars in KC, but honestly, the best place to start or end any night out is always Missie B’s.

It’s also our fave place to watch RuPaul’s Drag Race every Friday. We started coming for the show itself, but keep coming back for the hostess with the mostess, Minti Varieties. My only wish is that she’d host more things! There’s truly nothing like some Minti V at Missie B’s!

googleReviews.author: Daine Dvorak
googleReviews.text:
I am in the dead center of discovering myself at 34, and I started coming here. The first time was such a great experience, even by myself; I finally pushed myself to do it again. Well, I guess I walked in with someone sketchy. Right when I started feeling myself and comfortable, I was asked to come off the dance floor and talk with this short guy. He asked me if I knew the guy who walked in right after me, and please keep in mind I did not know who the hell he was talking about. Overcoming a lot of things and being courageous to go out by myself, as I have no one else, getting singled out with the question of "why did he run off" from one stranger to another makes no sense. I left immediately after tonight not feeling the least bit comfortable because how did he know exactly where I was? More importantly, no damage was done, so why single me out? And make a situation over nothing, and honestly, I didn't know this guy until I was walking behind him. He opened the door for me like a gentleman, and I went in, and he took off running (it is only 38°F in KC right now and raining really cold for the 60°F weather today).

People here are awesome, and I may update this review later when I can move beyond that situation tonight. Honestly, I am just shocked they even did this when you could tell on video if someone is together or not... and this was just fishing and that's the weirdest part in my opinion.

googleReviews.author: Holly McCrery
googleReviews.text: The Saturday night drag show is AMAZING. Highly recommended. I only drank water, but bottled water was a dollar-VERY reasonable. Heated smoking area and several areas to get drinks.

googleReviews.text: I had been meaning to come here earlier but made my first visit after the pandemic for my mother's birthday. There's a 10 dollar cover charge and IDs are checked at the door- cool cool no underage kiddos here. Everyone who works there is super nice and friendly, bartenders, bouncer, you name it. The drag show was right on time and super fun! The drag queens and kings have great shows and song choices too, they're definitely fun and full of energy! The drinks were good but definitely strong. The bomb pop honest to God tastes exactly like one. Keep in mind it's cash only so be prepared with cash or use the ATM in the building. The place itself is pretty big with multiple levels but if you want to sit close to the stage for any shows get there earlier as it's harder to see at the tables in the far back area closer to the bar.

The food was stellar. The service was lackadaisical, I think is the best word. It was a leisurely afternoon for us, so not a huge deal, but we waited a very long time to have our order taken for drinks.
The server attempted to walk away immediately after we ordered our drinks. They didn't ask us if we wanted to order an appetizer, even though we had already chosen both an appetizer and our entrees. I had to stop the server as they turned away and say "Hey, can we order our appetizer too?"
It took a fair amount of time to get our drinks, but it looked like the bartender was also functioning as a server on the floor, so that was understandable.
It also took a very long time for our food order to get taken, in fact, a table that came in after us had their food order taken about 15 minutes before we had ours taken.
When it was time to check out, my wife was irritated enough with the amount of times that we've been left waiting that she went outside to have a cigarette because we figured it'd be another 15-20 minutes before anybody came with the bill.
Server was friendly, the atmosphere was great, it just was very underwhelming.
We were also a little puzzled about why we needed to make a reservation online but there was plenty of open seating.
Also, there was supposed to be edible glitter in one of my drinks, the mermaid one, but there was no edible glitter. That was very sad; I wanted to be glittery on the inside as well!🤩

googleReviews.text:
I booked my birthday party on the 12/20/25 for 1/8/26 and once I got there I was informed that the price went up at the beginning of the year and I had to pay the new price regardless if I booked before price went up. I didn’t understand because I thought once I paid my deposit and received confirmation with remaining balance that was it. It doesn’t state in the policy that price could go up. They tried to say the taxes wasn’t included but it states that it was and gratuity. I didn’t understand why I was getting charged 18% gratuity when no server came into the room at all to take drink orders.

Outside of being over charged, I enjoyed my night. We were able to play any song we wanted off YouTube from our phones. We didn’t have many technical difficulties besides the mic and they fixed it quickly….

I do recommend this place but the drinks are pricey….

I would have given 4 stars not 5 because of the drinks but I’m giving 3 because I believe I was overcharged and given no logical reason.

googleReviews.author: Tony Contorno
googleReviews.text:
Weirdly, we just had a somewhat similar experience as someone who posted two months ago (also for my 40th).

While the staff were friendly, there was a price increase on the room (reserved in December for a night in January) after the start of the new year and I was not notified about until the moment of paying, which feels poorly managed sadly :\

The sound equipment was great and the room aesthetic was too, but the native system was lacking and there were some loose components in the wall.  Personally, I think it'll greatly help the experience for the customer if we feel like the options the business provides are not reliant on our phones to complete it.  Supplement, sure, but the fact that the native system offerings were practically non-existent... it's not a deal breaker but it's a place to improve.

The drinks were a mixed bag.  They were out of some pretty common alcohols (which again, I would chalk up to poor planning) but the wait/service staff were completely on top of our orders and very friendly.  Very happy with that side of our experience, and honestly what kept my review at 3 stars.

All in all, I'm not disappointed, but I can't say it was worth the cost of admission either.  I would say improving the native system for karaoke song selection and tightening up the stock for the bar will justify the cost, along with producing drink menus for the rooms.

googleReviews.author: Catherine Healy
googleReviews.text:
Came here for my birthday and although we had fun, they seem disorganized and didn’t add much to the experience. I sent a list of songs three days in advance, as they recommend, and received a reply confirming that they’d been received. When we got there, we were pointed toward a room. The room didn’t have instructions for how to use the interface, and it was not straightforward. Half of the words on the multiple different screens were in Chinese, and there was a QR code leading to an app that was also largely in Chinese. We eventually had to go get someone to explain it to us (which I feel like should have been done when we arrived), and were told that we shouldn’t use the karaoke catalog at all and should instead hook one of our phones up and screencast karaoke videos from YouTube. They didn’t know what happened to the song list I sent, which was nowhere to be found. Also, as other reviews have noted, you can’t use videos from either SingKing or Karafun on YouTube, which pop up for every search. We didn’t have too much trouble finding videos from other channels, but it did take more time to sift through. They took our drink order and when the guy came back with the drinks he just stood there. We asked what he needed and he asked if we were ready to “take care of the room charge.” Their website says you pay at the end, which is the usual way, so it was frustrating to be interrupted midway through our time to do so. I asked him to just charge the card on file from when I made the deposit, but he didn’t have it (how?), so I had to go dig through my bag to find the card. After that, we were left alone and enjoyed the rest of our time.

Overall, the room was nice, cocktails were pretty good, and the microphones worked well. Service was polite and responsive, but not proactive, and no one seemed to have explanations for anything. Screencasting YouTube worked fine (although I could have done the same on my TV at home). But between trying to figure out how to work the system, having to get someone to explain it, having to queue up our own songs, and cutting into our singing time to pay, I felt like we didn’t get our full two hours’ worth, and it cost more than when I’ve done karaoke in NYC. Ultimately, I was disappointed with the experience and don’t think I’d return, as I don’t feel they provided much beyond a room and microphones. We could have had essentially the same experience at home.

I hope they take these criticisms and work to improve the experience, as the place has potential. It just needs to deliver more than it is right now to justify the price.

googleReviews.text: Out of the list of bars I went to for my 21st birthday, this was my favorite! They had a sweet cafe area, and a karaoke bar! The decor was amazing and my bartender was great. And the crowd was amazing and friendly despite it being a Tuesday night, I will be comming back!

googleReviews.author: Jimmy Roustio

googleReviews.author: JK
googleReviews.text:
Never had food here, but June and her husband try to make it a welcoming atmosphere. It's a dive bar vibe. Not state of the art technology. If looking for that I would go elsewhere. We have always had fun there. Brought family from out of town and now they like it also.

googleReviews.author: Kaitlyn Brady
googleReviews.text: if i could do zero stars i definitely would. seriously the worst place I’ve ever been to in my entire life. They are so worried about regular customers that they have a problem with our group who was simply trying to have a good time celebrating a death anniversary and had ZERO consideration and they even let their regular customers that they hold in such high regards tell people to kill themselves and make horrible comments and kick us out rather than the actual problem causer. The place was boring, unwelcoming, the sound of the karaoke was awful, Location is terrible and everything as a whole in this place is complete trash. they also like to charge depending on the person you are to charge more or less for the same exact drinks which is insanity and should not be allowed but doesn’t surprise me with how shitty this place is. i pray this place and their regular customers get the karma they deserve because you all are terrible people and I would never recommend going.

googleReviews.text: If you don’t buy a drink you’re charged a cover it doesn’t say that on the website. I got three yuenglings and paid the cover charge for 2 of my girls. googleReviews.author: Bridget B. Brands
googleReviews.text: I was looking for somewhere to watch the 1st NBA final game and came across Westport Social by way of a Google search, and I'm so glad I did.  Westport Social is perfect for sports viewing.  They have seating and TVs outside with a cute, modern fireplace situation.  It was perfect for watching the game and the weather to match.  Indoors has huge TVs with the game on, 2 bar areas, basketball cages, darts, and table games.  Very grown and sexy atmosphere.  I had the chicken tacos and a mojito mocktail.  Both were good.  Our server is the reason for the 4 stars.  The initial encounter was lackluster and nonchalant but she warmed up during our time there.  I will be back to Westport Social!

googleReviews.author: Antonio Marcelino
googleReviews.text:
This place is pretty cool. Saint Louis is building up around that area a lot. There Westport Social spot itself is really cool and interactive. Great place to watch games or have a meet up with friends. I ordered a Margherita pizza with jalapeños and the hummus which comes with naan bread. Both were very good. I have been getting the hummus for years from here and it is always a hit. Perfectly cooked dough, the hummus isn't traditional, but it's still amazing. As far as the pizza, I always enjoy the pizza here. It's like a small New York style pie. The pizza is good, but the hardness of the crust was a little off putting. Maybe it was the temperature of the oven or kind of oven it was cooked in. Other than that, I enjoyed it.

Pizza: 7/10
Hummus: 9/10
Atmosphere: 9/10
Overall: 9/10

googleReviews.author: Mary Roach
googleReviews.text: The tator tots are awesome . Mo digity was there. She was amazing. Needs to get away from Kevin Federline but that just my opinion. Came back to see That 80s band. The wigs are horrible but they sound great

googleReviews.author: Lyndsey Sanderson-Rogers
googleReviews.text: Food was unremarkable. Staff did a great job handling such a large group and there were multiple. Incredibly accommodating with dietary restrictions.  Great space for all ages.

googleReviews.author: Alicia Saint Ives
googleReviews.text:
Westport Social is a decent option for a fun night out with solid food, drinks, and entertainment—all in one place.

The vibe is upbeat and energetic, with a mix of lounge seating, game areas, and live music that keeps things lively. Whether you’re out with friends or hosting a casual group hang, it’s the kind of place that works for most people.

The elevated bar food is better than you’d expect for a venue with games and live music. I love their chicken wings—crispy, flavorful, and satisfying. The nachos are another standout: huge, loaded, and perfect for sharing (or not, no judgment!).

Drinks are solid, with a cocktail list that’s creative without trying too hard and a good mix of local beers and classics.

Whether you’re playing shuffleboard, shooting hoops, or just vibing to the live band, Westport Social delivers a full-package experience that keeps me coming back.

Follow me for more STL nightlife recs, food finds, and fun local gems!

googleReviews.author: Naira Brown
googleReviews.text: I came to tin roof Friday and Sunday and both times I had Mckinlee. She was on point! Great server. Her energy was amazing. She was very informative about food and drinks. I definitely cannot wait to go again.

googleReviews.author: Bob
googleReviews.text:
Update: Went back. Had the tenders. Excellent, as predicted. Service and atmosphere remain great. Try the Tin Roof Sauce.

Stopped by Tin Roof for lunch. I had the Nashville Hot Chicken sandwich, as the bartender said it was very popular (but she had not yet tried it herself.)
Let me just say that the service and atmosphere were absolutely fine. No notes. Perfect. The kitchen speed was about average. No complaints there, either. I was easily in and out within the course of my lunch hour.
The sandwich, though - holy cow, there was way too much dry rub on it, and it got on everything. It was also far spicier than I anticipated. I can handle spicy food, but this was next level. I broke a sweat, and was unable to finish more than a few bites of the sandwich. If you're into that, you should definitely try that sandwich. I'm not into *that* much spice, though, and found the spice level made the sandwich mostly inedible. The bun and fries were both solid, and were good... but they also had a lot of dry rub on them.
I'll be back, but will likely stick to chicken tenders next time.

googleReviews.author: David Peluso
googleReviews.text:
​I visited this spot recently and had a bit of a mixed experience. To start with the positives, the vibe is absolutely on point. The decor is stylish, and the lighting creates a perfect mood for a night out. The music was definitely the highlight for me—a great playlist that kept the energy up without being so loud that you couldn't have a conversation.
​The drinks were excellent—well-balanced and clearly made with quality ingredients. The service was also decent; our server was friendly, attentive, and checked in on us regularly, which made the wait a bit easier to swallow.
​The only real downside was the kitchen speed. The food took a surprisingly long time to come out, even though the restaurant didn't seem overly slammed. When it did arrive, it was good, but the delay definitely put a bit of a damper on the flow of the evening.
​Verdict: This is a fantastic spot if you’re looking to grab drinks and soak in a cool atmosphere. Just maybe don't come if you're in a rush or already "hangry!" I’d come back for the music and the cocktails alone, but I’ll be planning for a longer stay next time.

googleReviews.author: Jerm
googleReviews.text: Was down in STL visiting and decided to stop here for brunch, and it was worth it , the food was good which matched the vibes. The best part was my server Mckinlee honestly. Above and beyond , she def made she I had a time!

googleReviews.author: Sandwich Club STL
googleReviews.text: The Platypus is a great bar & live music venue. The cocktails are cleverly put together and distinctly unique. They have a great selection of local and domestic beers. There is food available with some vegetarian options. The bar is broken into 3 parts. A bar side with DJ’s a lounge side with pinball and a venue in the back. The venue is professionally run with a good PA and sound engineer. Shows run on time. Space is limited but has a really good vibe when full of people. We love the Platypus and  would consider recommending this venue to any small touring band passing through StLouis. Parking is limited but manageable. Platypus is a safe place for all. 🫶🏽

googleReviews.author: Sunny
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been here a handful of times with friends and it never disappoints. The crowd is really diverse and the vibe is super welcoming. Great spot for anyone in their 20s and 30s looking for a chill but fun night out.
The main bar area has karaoke nights and people get INTO it! They’re so talented. If you keep walking through there’s another room with games and a small kitchen for food.
The menu is simple but the food is unexpectedly amazing and leans mostly vegetarian. The tofu is an absolute 10/10, the fries are good, and the buffalo cauliflower and chicken poppers are both must orders.
Oh and the drinks are fun and the bathroom is a whole little experience on its own. Overall, it’s just a good time. Definitely coming back.

googleReviews.author: BESTOFYOU17
googleReviews.text: Another great destination in the Grove! The mural outside of their building is beautiful.  The space is eclectic with 3 separate places to eat, including a patio. We chose to hang out inside and enjoy some Chooch's chicken nuggets and fries. I  really could've shared the fries since they were so large. I prefer skinny fries myself, but the chicken was fantastic! I opted for the small chicken and it was plenty. The sauces were fresh too; I loved the ranch.  The staff came out and talked with us and were genuinely curious about our opinions on the food. We even talked about our favorites in St. Louis. I recommend this fun spot with your friends!

googleReviews.author: Saif
googleReviews.text: It's cheaper to drink beer than the non-alcoholic options or at least the $4 day drinking lager they have on tap. I had three of those along with some fried tofu, fries and chicken bites. Midwest Dani is one of the incredible bar tenders working here but she alone makes this place worth visiting again and again. They do live music their bathrooms are colorful. One employee was wearing a Tyrese Halliburton shirt and Baltimore Orioles hat. I attempted to talk hoops with him but he wasn't too friendly. Better to talk with Danielle instead.

googleReviews.author: Justin
googleReviews.text: Atmosphere is fine, food is great, bartenders are amazing, The people who run Karaoke here on Mondays are absolutely terrible at it. Worst in the City. There are better options on a Monday, or anywhere in the city for Karaoke.

googleReviews.author: Laura
googleReviews.text: After reading recent reviews, I wasn't very optimistic about this place when I went last night. First thing, there wasn't a parking lot and the place was packed with people. So I ended up parking about 3 blocks down. However, I was told that this isn't always the case. The doorman was a jerk, but only in the way sarcastic people are. He was actually super sweet even when he was trying to be rude. Or maybe I just saw through him... There were a lot of groups and not a lot of mingling between them. I felt like an outsider with the patrons and no one was really interested in talking to me until the end of the night when I was leaving around one. The bartenders were probably the worst part about it. I waited until the building had cleared out a bit and stood at the bar for a good 10 minutes, had my card out, and made eye contact with both women and neither came up to ask what I wanted. I finally gave up when someone came up after me and they served her before even acknowledging my presence. The karaoke was your average setup, but I didn't notice any technical difficulties. It seemed to run smoothly to me. Might be a good place to go with your own group, but I definitely wouldn't recommend going here by yourself unless you like being alone in a loud, crowded bar and probably not getting anything to drink.

googleReviews.author: Eric Woelbling
googleReviews.text: I walked upward to this location with great enthusiasm excited to sing karaoke in the hopes I could get in early to sing. Right as I walked up to the door the person who was guarding the door to checking people in decided to comment on my appearance and began to use profanity and degrading language towards my sweater and to me when all I asked was “are they doing karaoke tonight?!” I was so taken back by the way this guy was treating me and I assume others as they enter this place and decided “if this is how I’m going to be treated on the outside of this place, then there is no way I feel safe going inside” I would not recommend this experience to anyone. The phrase “I’m just kidding” does not make it alright. I won’t be going back and it’s a shame bc I was really hoping for a place to enjoy.

googleReviews.author: Tactical Taylor69
googleReviews.text: Great place to drink, pool, and enjoy some karaoke. Got a back room for smokers with a pool table. Stan’s a great guy too.

googleReviews.author: Patrick Duffy
googleReviews.text:
This place SCREAMED negative energy. The (worthless) "doorman", who started insulting several different guests (causing some of them to TURN AROUND AND LEAVE!), to the... ah yes, WORTHLESS doorman, who continued to ridicule the guests as they were leaving! Such an inviting AURA.
So sorry your strict WARDROBE wasn't met. Thank your WORTHLESS DOORMAN for literally chasing away some business.

googleReviews.author: Sean Hall
googleReviews.text: This is our weekly spot for a guy's night karaoke!! I can go here everyday and feel like I'm at home yo!!!!!

googleReviews.text: The staff was very friendly and nice. The drinks were great every time and decent prices! Just the atmosphere can tend to lean a certain way with customers at times 👋🏻

googleReviews.text: We love stoli’s! It is a great bar with great staff and we always have an amazing time here! The owners are so friendly and will always have a conversation with you! 10/10 recommend!

googleReviews.author: John Etherton
googleReviews.text:
Stoli’s Lounge is a hidden gem in Omaha that perfectly blends a relaxed atmosphere with top-tier service. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with friendly, attentive staff who make you feel like a regular, even on your first visit.

The drink menu is outstanding, and their Old Fashioned is one of the best in town—balanced, smooth, and crafted with real attention to detail. Whether you’re stopping by for a quiet evening cocktail or meeting friends for a night out, Stoli’s delivers every time.

If you appreciate great service, well-made drinks, and a welcoming vibe, Stoli’s Lounge should definitely be on your list. Highly recommended!

googleReviews.author: Frankie MacGregor
googleReviews.text:
Do not recommend. The good: The staff person who attended us throughout the evening was lovely. Prompt, accommodating, light-hearted; a joy. The drinks were good and reasonably priced. The karaoke system worked well and sounded good.
The bad: Every karaoke room at this establishment, no matter how many people it's for, is limited to TWO microphones. You can hear (loud and clear!) all the other people singing in the other rooms.  The ugly: The seating in the karaoke rooms looks like bus benches. Or maybe like cheap diner booths? Awful. Our room was for six people but it only had seating for four. Our attendant kindly brought us more chairs. The carpet is so stained from drink spills (or who knows what else???) that it looks like someone was murdered. The room was freezing, but if you make it warmer, you have to put up with the smell of the murder carpet. We checked out all the other rooms and found them equally as gross.

googleReviews.author: Victoria Garcia
googleReviews.text: We just had our granddaughter's birthday party here. Santiago's covered the food, which was fantastic and Reno's for some karaoke 🎤.  The rooms (karaoke and party) were spacious and the staff was very attentive and very friendly. Did I mention the food? The food was so good! Thank you for an excellent alternative to the old hummdrumm birthday parties, we'll be back for sure.

googleReviews.author: Mollie
googleReviews.text: These 5 stars are for JENNIFER who was working at the karaoke rooms last night. My group had the best time ever and she was why!! So fun and kind and gave us the best service I have ever had here at Reno’s at Blue Sky in Omaha!!

googleReviews.author: Stacey Wood
googleReviews.text:
I love the individual karaoke rooms so it's just you and your party jamming out.
Great song selection, service, and drink selection.
We didn't get food today, but they had a great selection of items, including a gluten free pizza crust option.

googleReviews.author: Cody Holtapp
googleReviews.text: My bad experience comes from this location’s refund practices. They say you’ll receive a full refund if given 24 hours notice, but this is false. I canceled with two days notice and am still waiting on my refund over two weeks later, despite three phone conversations with the staff and management. I never had this issue with Blackstone. We were planning on returning at a later date, but the shadiness of a simple refund has turned me off entirely of Reno’s.

googleReviews.text: Visiting from Texas and landed on this very cool little place with super friendly service and attention from Dave and Sab! googleReviews.author: AuTianna Walker
googleReviews.text: Went last night to continue our night out and have a good time thought we'd go in there and play some darts because they had some dartboards and it looked like a pretty cool environment and vibe. Which was true at first. I went and got my girlfriend and I a couple shots no problems bartender came right up to me, Had exactly what we wanted I was happy I even left my tab open ready to chill. After a couple games of darts my girlfriend went up to the bar to get us some more drinks and the bartender just ignored her she got somebody else a drink with no problem stood right by my girlfriend and picked up her phone instead of proceeding to ask my girlfriend what she wanted her how could she help her, she even looked at my girlfriend a couple times and continue to do what she wanted to do she stood there for at least 3 minutes. The nice guy sitting next to my girlfriend said this is what her name was and he could get her attention if she wanted him to but he shouldn't have had to do that when she was standing right there not doing anything . Made us feel completely uncomfortable and unwelcome which was weird because I had no problems with her in the beginning. You never know what someone was going through you don't treat people that way especially when they come to spend money for your business and if that wasn't her business I feel sorry for the owners. This is a great location right by our house we could've become regulars but unfortunately we will never go back.

googleReviews.author: CHRISTINA SMITH
googleReviews.text:
The few times I’ve been there it’s been pretty chill small group of regulars that all enjoy teasing each other and shooting darts and they usually have one person running the music bc I don’t think the regulars care either if it plays or not. Staff is cool I liked the girl who gave me the chalk! She’s awesome and light hearted! Plus she can throw right back the guys at the bar with a quickness! My kinda girl!!!
However I ordered a basic very common drink the last time I was there and they didn’t have anything other than the liquor it’s self to finish the drink. SMH! So the bartender and I had to get creative in making something similar yet nothing at all what I was hoping for.

googleReviews.author: J C
googleReviews.text: We moved to the area and shopped around for a little elbow room. Been there a few times. Small place. Good prices. Good people. Our 3rd visit was fresh after our wedding reception. Everyone in the bar bought us drinks, celebrated with like they've known us for years, and offered surprisingly sound marital advice. Lol. All i can say is every time we've been there, everybody talks to everybody. Never seen someone sit alone and go unnoticed. Very friendly neighborhood crew.

googleReviews.text: I love this small, family feeling place.. googleReviews.author: Elijah Glass
googleReviews.text: I’ve only eaten here 2 times but have been very impressed both times, I’m pretty anti social but live in the same lot as these guys, so I’ve only gotten take out, seems like a nice small place to chill and hang out on the weekdays, but I walked in today on a Friday night and let me tell you, it was busy, staff are all really nice people (at least the ones who’ve helped me) I’m excited to keep going back and trying new things. Definitely recommend visiting with some friends!!

googleReviews.author: Elizabeth
googleReviews.text:
This is gonna be long so skip to tldr if you don’t care about details lol.

Atmosphere/Service - 5 ⭐️- when you walk in you first see the bar, but past it there are a ton of tables. Seat yourself, they’re speedy quick and will be right with you. There was plenty of seating imo. The little blonde bartender that helped us was great! She was super friendly, had lots of good suggestions, and her holiday onesie was awesome!

Food-5 ⭐️- I only had some honey BBQ wings but they were phenomenal! Well cooked but juicy, crispy.. everything you could want in a wing. I will definitely be back to try other things because it all smelled incredible.

Drinks - 5 ⭐️- they’re strong enough that you actually feel like you’re getting your money’s worth. The two mixed drinks were great, not overly sugary but again, plenty of alcohol.

TLDR; first time in, won’t be the last - try the wings!!

googleReviews.author: Cowboy Cory
googleReviews.text: I'm starting to become a regular here. I love the environment and I'm always surprised by the service. I always have another drink waiting for me before I finish my last. Margo kicks ass even when it's busy I don't have to wait. And the karaoke is always fun too. I'm divorcing my old karaoke spot for this place.

googleReviews.author: F Williams
googleReviews.text: In the neighborhood and stopped for a quick lunch. Took advantage of their Taco Tuesday deal: soft or fried shell tacos, chicken or beef for $2 each. Taco were ok but the service was FANTASTIC! Our waitress was friendly, attentive and so very polite. Don't see that kind of service anymore even when you're paying much, much more for the meal. Thank you for doing such a great job!

googleReviews.author: April S
googleReviews.text: I'm very picky when it comes to chicken wings. I've tried wings here a few times and these wings and Track's Lounge are the best I've tried in town yet. I've been to 8 local places over the last 1.5 yrs for reference. Bartender was very friendly and got me a delicious glass of ice water while I waited for my take out wings. A couple of the drums were a tad dry but overall, all of the wings were juicy and had lots of sauce!! Oh and delicious ranch. I will definitely be back!!

googleReviews.author: Mary Jo Hanigan
googleReviews.text: My first negative review; just don’t find them meaningful. However, this was a TERRIBLE experience. Met my 24 year old daughters there for wings. I am the only one who ordered a cocktail. Yet, after the first part of our food order arrived to the table, the male manager asked for my twin daughters’ IDs. One did not have hers and so we were asked to leave. He said we could not prove her age. To add further insult, they boxed our food as takeout. When we got home, it was the wrong order. Food clearly disappointing! Poor customer service and unreasonable hospitality. Don’t waste your time nor money.

googleReviews.author: Helmuth Wilden
googleReviews.text: Came in here on a Friday night and had a pretty nice time. The place had a good vibe, not too loud but still lively enough to feel fun. Bartender was cool and gave a couple drink suggestions that were actually solid. Prices were decent compared to other spots around town. I also liked that we didn’t have to wait forever to get served. Seating filled up quick, but we still found a table after a few mins. Overall it felt relaxed and easygoing. I’d come back again for drinks with friends.

googleReviews.author: The Hubbells
googleReviews.text: We are visiting and overheard someone else talk about the tat-cochs (spelling?). And let me tell you.. they were absolutely AMAZING! It was a cute little dark restaurant. Drinks were cute. They do offer THC drinks

googleReviews.author: Kelly Rodriguez
googleReviews.text: Bar is cool, concept awesome! Bartenders cool, drinks good! Only complaint is the karaoke… you’ll see the same people sing 6 times before someone new gets called up. They should be put in to rotation as a new singer, all should get to enjoy. Not sit for 2 hours watching the same people over & over again waiting to get in for one song.

googleReviews.author: Anita Ocheskey
googleReviews.text: My friends and I had never been to a karaoke place and we went for my friends birthday and we all had a blast! It was the most fun I've had in a long time. I will definitely be back. Oh, and the drinks were delicious!

googleReviews.author: JM Hunziker
googleReviews.text: This was my first visit, didn't know it even existed. I was with a group of 8, we were lucky enough to find a table up by the stage. Arrived shortly before a wedding party. Karaoke list was impressive. I rather enjoyed the idea of purchasing an express ticket to perform sooner. As well as the idea the staff gets a cut of that. Staff was efficient despite being overwhelmed by the newly arrived large party. Bartender were quick. Very cool experience and will definitely return.

googleReviews.author: Noah Notch
googleReviews.text: I walked in and put my name in for karaoke. “You need to buy something “ no shit give me a chance to go to bar and buy a drink” no shit. You need nicer KJs

great place for any size crowd or occasion. the atmosphere is very dynamic and the crowd is supportive. drinks are fairly priced and the staff is friendly

googleReviews.author: Audrey Klunenberg
googleReviews.text: Stopped in for a quick drink on Saturday after seeing the sign for it on every trip to Wingstop. Walking in, the interior was sparse but clean. At the bar we were greeted by a friendly man with a fedora. Ordered the Genie’s lager and looked at the sights (peep the bottle openers lol). Glad to see a pool table and a clean women’s restroom. There is a fifteen dollar card minimum but also an atm in the establishment. If you bring the receipt of the transaction they can give you a free drink token to make up the cost of the atm fee. The bartender was super attentive and you could tell that the others in the bar were regulars partially because of his warmth. We have some drink tokens now so we’ll have to come back!

googleReviews.author: Diane Wagner
googleReviews.text: Stopped into Jeannies Bottle and had a fantastic halloween drink! The bartender was super friendly and as usual  the bar was spotless and welcoming!!

googleReviews.author: Mike P
googleReviews.text: Jeannnie's Bottle has a long history. Somewhat spacious, gives off a nostalgic feeling, karaoke, darts, 2 pool tables. Offer bar pizza & may be offering wings & more food soon. Could use another TV for game days. Great 2 for 1 drinks.

googleReviews.author: Melissa Cox
googleReviews.text: Cute little hole in the wall bar. We went on karaoke night with a group of friends and it was fun. The bartenders were friendly, great at drink recommendations, fast and efficient. The drinks are reasonably priced and not watered down. Highly recommend for a great night out, good vibe here.

googleReviews.author: Katie Zimmerman
googleReviews.text: Overall, a great establishment with a lot of potential. However, the karaoke microphones are of very poor quality, which detracts from the experience. Improving the karaoke setup could significantly enhance customer satisfaction and potentially increase business.

googleReviews.author: Kate Leo
googleReviews.text: Finn's Pub is in my neighborhood- I visit the Walgreens next door like three times a week- but I had never been to Finn's. We had only been there a few minutes when the manager came over to introduce herself and get a birthday shot for my friend who was celebrating. It was an apple pie shot and it was delicious! Several regulars introduced themselves to us as well.  We wanted to sing karaoke and man, this place did not disappoint. So much talent. We had a blast singing along and everyone was so friendly. We will definitely be back! Highly recommend. And the gender signs on the bathroom doors? Hilarious!!

googleReviews.author: Alexandra Atherton
googleReviews.text: Finn’s is a great bar!! Everyone is so kind and welcoming, the staff are all awesome, and the drinks are great! It’s such a vibe there and as a lesbian in and interracial marriage, my wife and I have never felt uncomfortable at all. All the patrons are great!

googleReviews.text: Listen this is one of the hottest spots for karaoke in the city. The KJ’s are amazing. Ellie was so fun Saturday night!! The bartenders are friendly and efficient!!!

googleReviews.text:
Awesome prices and fantastic music — what more could you possibly want?! 💸🎶 This place really nails the perfect combo of affordability and great vibes. You can enjoy yourself without stressing about spending too much, which is always a huge plus 🙌✨.
The music selection is on point, setting the mood just right and making it easy to relax, have fun, and stay a little longer than planned 🎵🔥. Good energy, good tunes, and prices that don’t break the bank — that’s a win in my book! 😎👏

googleReviews.author: Karla Elling
googleReviews.text: Nice restaurant. Great food and excellent service. They gave us lots of chips and our personal salsa. Checked back often for refills. Thanks!

googleReviews.author: Samantha Brown
googleReviews.text: I love this bar. I have been to this one more than any other. I’m not even from the east side!!! 😆 I love the atmosphere it’s just “dive-y” enough but not to where you don’t feel comfortable there. Even someone such as myself (being a small female) feels safe enough. I haven’t been served by a bartender who’s worked there over all these years that wasn’t great at what they do. They have decent/good food. They have karaoke nights, slot style games, arcade games, darts, and a pool table. Also, have a “jukebox” however not many of the songs are free (but the machine can be accessed by touchscreen or an app that allows you to add credits with your debit card which is nifty). Enough seating for how much is packed in there!

googleReviews.author: Mozey
googleReviews.text: I felt like i was on an episode of cheers. I walked in and immedieately i was greeted by people at the bar, staff, and people walking by. Atmosphere was extremely comfortable. Bartender was a doll. Will be back..

googleReviews.author: Tc Buell
googleReviews.text: This place is fine for drinks but in my experiences with food, I couldn't be more disappointed. I've gone twice on Tuesday for there tacos special (one time around 7 and the other time around 8ish) first time the bartender at the time said she could only do fried food and that she had turned all the ovens off (she was waiting for another bartender to release her who was late) we stayed drank our drinks and then the second bartender come in and makes food for another patron. So we ask if we could do the tacos 🌮  she was so sweet and kind and said ya whatever you want on the menu. Second time it was around 8ish and asked for tacos and the bartender this time said the kitchen was closed (didn't even bother to say she could do fried food). I then asked what time the kitchen closes 🤔 she said 8pm but it just depends on the bartender 😬🙄🤯 um okay, I guess bartenders there don't like tips on food orders or just too lazy to do the kitchen. Will NOT be going back for food. Possibly drinks as well as it's a bit out of the way and both times were because I could get something to eat as well. Any who, I guess just take your chance and you get a bartender that will make you food. But for me it was a fail

googleReviews.author: Cynthia Carlsen
googleReviews.text:
We were in Des Moines and I wanted bar food so my husband took me here for lunch. (We live in rural Iowa)
The service was excellent, Lisa was the bartender's name. And that was some of the best bar food we've ever eaten! He has a bacon cheeseburger and I had a grinder.
The food came out rather quickly and the prices were reasonable. Will definitely go back next time we're in town.

googleReviews.author: Kate Leo
googleReviews.text: I had not been to Ducktail in ages. It's a great bar. Clean with nice decor and a full bar. We went there to listen to a local band called The Adaptors and the atmosphere was great. Everyone was having a great time, enjoying the awesome music and relaxing.

googleReviews.author: Sara Jesse
googleReviews.text: Courtney was our bartender tonight and she is AMAZING! Huge selection of drinks and each one is better than the next. Service is friendly and the patio is warm and welcoming. They don’t sell cigars anymore but they are walking distance to a smoke shop and you can smoke on the patio. The butterscotch martini is SO GOOD. if you have an opportunity to stop by for a drink from Courtney you absolutely need to.

googleReviews.author: Jordan Campbell
googleReviews.text:
Great bar with great staff (Callah is an amazing bartender!) and great selection of different whiskeys and other drinks.  Patio is comfortable and warm if you need to make trips outside when you’re drinking!

We hadn’t been out to Ducktail in a while and ran into the new owner who gave us a couple drink tokens - but we ended up staying for a few more!  He was a super nice guy and seems to be running the place really well.

Music is good, but not loud to make things uncomfortable and make conversation impossible like many places these days.

If you’re looking for a place to grab a drink in the entire metro area, Ducktail Lounge is an amazing choice and should be at the top of your list.

-Bathrooms are clean
-Bar smells good
-Bar, tables, floor are all kept clean

googleReviews.author: Mark Joseph Gallagher Jr.
googleReviews.text:
Outstanding karaoke experience in the Fargo Moorhead Metroplex last night, Wednesday, January 14, 2026.

This is the only karaoke place I know of in the area, and there are many, where karaoke starts at the reasonable hour of 8 PM.

Children are allowed with their parents or legal guardians in Harold's until 9 PM, so please bring the family.

There were some singers whom I'm sure had many other gifts, and some singers with exceptional voices.

The karaoke jockey, KJ, was friendly and did a good job encouraging applause and a good vibe. There were several notable duets by female female and male female, as well as many soloists.

This writer may have been the second oldest person in the bar, so he felt a wee bit out of place, but the waitress made him feel welcome as did a very friendly young man named Roman and his friend – – she had a beautiful single-syllable name but my memory is failing.

There were pizza and jalapeño pickled eggs available, but this writer did not treat himself to either, so he can't rate the food.

UPDATED :   AD 2026 February 25 Wednesday

I am back. Good to be back for karaoke, listening and singing.  The only other place in the Fargo ND Moorhead MN metroplex hosting karaoke tonight is Rooters on Broadway in Fargo.

Harold's has mostly youngsters -- 20s and 30s -- yet there is at least one 57 year old, and three 60 somethings.

Good place. Hope I can find a woman to duet with me.

Update on Wednesday 11 March AD 2026
had another great time last night at karaoke at Harold's on Main. The waitress was very nice. The singing was enjoyable. Patrons cheered one another on.

Update March 25

Another fun karaoke night.

This is an excellent place to hang out and meet new people or bring friends for a drink after work or on the weekends.

googleReviews.author: Denis Desmarais
googleReviews.text:
Wiley’s Bar is an absolute gem in Sioux Falls, and my recent visit there was nothing short of fantastic! I decided to try their famous Big Kahuna Pizza, and let me tell you, it was a flavor-packed masterpiece. The combination of fresh toppings, melty cheese, and sweet and savory flavors was perfection, but what truly set it apart was the crust. It had just the right amount of crispiness with a soft, chewy center—pure pizza bliss!

On top of the amazing food, the service was exceptional. Our server Megan was an absolute delight! She was charming, attentive, and brought the experience to the next level with her warm, personalized touch. She kept calling me by my name, which made me feel truly valued as a guest—it’s those little moments that make dining feel special. Megan stayed on top of everything, making sure we had refills, checked in just the right amount, and always had a smile that brightened the room.

Between the delicious food, the comfortable atmosphere, and Megan’s outstanding service, Wiley’s Bar is a place I’ll definitely be returning to soon. Whether you’re a pizza lover or just looking for a great spot to enjoy a night out, Wiley’s delivers in every way. Highly recommend the Big Kahuna Pizza (and Megan if you’re lucky enough to have her as your server)!

googleReviews.author: JenJenSweetness
googleReviews.text: Been here a couple times since moving to the state. They had a cool afrobests event downstairs and then it was one of the few good spots I was able to get into to celebrate new years. Lively vibes, descent music, STRONG drinks or at least the bartender that night made the drink strong

googleReviews.author: glen shepard
googleReviews.text:
We were completely ignored. My wife and I,along with three other groups, waited without any acknowledgment. The only couple who was served once was spoken to sharply by a bartender who said has only been there only two weeks.
If you’re having a rough night—short-staffed or overwhelmed—that’s understandable. All it takes is simple communication: “Hey folks, sorry, we’re short-staffed tonight and it may be a while,” or “We’re not able to take more customers right now.”  No problem try another night. That honesty would have gone a long way.
For comparison, we went immediately afterward to MacKenzie River Pizza, which also had a full house. The bartender was clearly busy but still took the time to acknowledge us, explain that service would be slow, and keep our drinks full. No apology was even necessary—it was packed. We stayed for two hours, waited for the rush to slow down, ordered food, and happily ran up a $130 tab plus tip. It ended up being a great night.
Unfortunately, that was not the experience here. Instead of communication, we were ignored, and others were snapped at. As a result, my wife and I—and three other groups—walked out.
We would like to give this place another try, but not if the same bartender who has only been there two weeks is working.

googleReviews.author: Rachael Dezell
googleReviews.text:
Stopped at David’s for a quick Friday night bite and had one of the best burgers I’ve had in a long time. The Greek Battle Burger was absolutely mouthwatering — perfectly seasoned, bold spices, and incredible flavor in every bite.

The real standout, though, was the tzatziki sauce with the feta. That combo is the perfect topper and takes the burger to a whole different level.
Everything came together so well — rich, savory, creamy, and fresh.

10/10 — don’t miss this spot.

If you’re a burger lover, this one needs to be on your list. 🍔🔥

googleReviews.author: Alyssa Anderson
googleReviews.text: LOVE! LOVE! LOVE! I was at Club David for the Seafood Boil and WOW was it good! The shrimp, crab, corn, and sausages were amazing, and the seasoning had a nice little kick without being too much. The atmosphere was super chill and the staff were amazing, especially with how busy it was! Overall, a fun experience and I’d definitely come back for another boil night.

googleReviews.author: losewirez
googleReviews.text: Great lil bar. Had an amazing line up on the night we went, Aliens DO exist and Not Green Day were AMAZING!!! TOTALLY EPIC!!! They definitely rocked the club so great! Acoustics sounded good and the drink service was great. I also loved their game area on 2nd floor as well as their outside patio! Highly recommend!!!

googleReviews.author: P NW
googleReviews.text:
Caught a show at Club David on the last Sunday of the month and was totally blown away. They do a live jazz night with dinner and themed cocktails—seriously one of the best surprises I’ve found in Sioux Falls. The Jesse Christen Band absolutely killed it, playing jazz and blues classics, and even invited folks from the crowd to join them on stage. Super fun, welcoming vibe.

The food? Not what you’d expect from a local dive. For $17 I had a 1/2 rack of ribs that slid off the bone, some insanely good homemade cornbread (tasted like gourmet cake), and fresh coleslaw. I started with a bourbon cocktail called the Smokestack Lightning—honestly as good as anything you’d get downtown. Ended the night with a bartender-recommended non-alcoholic drink called THX (see pic)—super refreshing and the perfect wind-down for the final set.

Great drinks, amazing music, and a shockingly good dinner special. Can’t wait to go back next month.

googleReviews.author: Godswill Atori
googleReviews.text:
I recently visited Happy Zone KTV and I have to say, it was such a fun and memorable experience from start to finish. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was vibrant, welcoming, and full of energy. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-designed, with great lighting and sound systems that made the whole karaoke experience feel like a mini concert.
Izzy and Brittani were with me, and we all had an amazing time singing, laughing, and enjoying the night. What truly made the experience stand out, though, was the level of customer service we received. Izzy and Brittani were incredibly attentive from the beginning they greeted us warmly, made the check-in process smooth, and took the time to explain how everything worked without making us feel rushed.
Throughout the night, they consistently checked in on us to make sure everything was going well. Whether it was helping us navigate the song system, adjusting the sound when needed, or making sure our room was comfortable, they handled everything quickly and with such a positive attitude. It didn’t feel forced or scripted they genuinely seemed to care about us having a great time.
It also wasn’t just them there was a young man who assisted us as well, and the teamwork was noticeable. Everyone communicated well and made sure nothing was overlooked. Our drinks and snacks came out promptly, and anytime we needed something, it was handled almost immediately. That level of attentiveness really made us feel valued as customers.
The song selection was impressive, with a wide variety of options across different genres and languages, so everyone in our group found something they loved. The drinks and snacks were also enjoyable and added to the overall vibe of the night.
Overall, Happy Zone KTV is the perfect place to unwind, celebrate, or just have a great time with friends. Between the fun atmosphere, great music setup, and outstanding, thoughtful customer service from Izzy, Brittani, and the entire team, it’s definitely a spot I would highly recommend. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

googleReviews.text: Had a great experience. Plan to watch Dynamo and World Cup here! Service was awesome! Steve was amazing

googleReviews.author: Cristy Benson
googleReviews.text: We had a company event here, rented the upstairs area. We had a great time playing pool, darts, ping pong. Food was great. Service was amazing.  Atmosphere was incredible.  Highly recommend.

googleReviews.author: Bianca Baughn [LSE]
googleReviews.text: Drinks were amazing, awesome cocktails, whole staff hospitality 10/10! Atmosphere super inviting and comfortable. So many different options, big screen and comfy seats outside, activities upstairs and great music down stairs! Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Perla L
googleReviews.text:
Social Beer Garden HTX was a wonderful space to host a happy hour for our healthcare non-profit organization, where we gathered 15-20 individuals. The managers Rob & Myles were extremely accommodating, communicative and helpful! Each time I had a question, they were a quick phone call or email away, plus their attentiveness was unmatched. The space and venue itself is large, clean and organized. Upstairs on the second floor there is a pool table along with other entertainment, including an outdoor rooftop. We had our happy hour on a Thursday, which was their steak night and trivia night. There were a few food options, I went with tamales and they were very delicious!! We had such a good time!

Overall, this is a great place to host a gathering, whether it’s a corporate or smaller gathering. It’s also a great place for individuals to play trivia and find entertainment. Lastly having food options was a plus and their lengthy drink menu was impressive.

10/10 would recommend! Thank you Rob and Myles for your hospitality. We will definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Tene Mont
googleReviews.text: Ordered Southern Mule and Cranberry Bourbon Smash for cocktails. Dined at House of Hoopz BBQ and Crawfish and purchased one brisket and one seafood quesadilla. Brisket delicious, seafood fishy. Live music was enjoyable. I love the truck inspired decor. Cute backdrops for photo ops. Would like to return during the daytime.

googleReviews.author: Sasha Swan
googleReviews.text:
I went during the day and it was smooth sailing. No lines, no chaos, just straight to the good stuff.

I ordered the nachos with cauliflower rice and they did not disappoint. Flavorful, filling, and way better than I expected. I also grabbed a half-gallon frozen drink to go for $22 plus tax, which felt like a steal.

Only downside? Paid parking. Come hungry and bring a few extra dollars for the meter. Totally worth it.

googleReviews.author: Johnny Grensel
googleReviews.text:
After hearing so much hype about Truck Yard Houston, I left pretty disappointed. It just felt like they cared more about the “vibe” than actually making the place comfortable or enjoyable.

For starters, it’s basically not heated (or if it is, you can’t tell). If it’s even a little cold out, you’re just standing there freezing, wondering why you paid money to be uncomfortable. The setup is cool and it could be a great hangout spot, but that part kind of ruins it.

The other thing that really got on my nerves was how every time you pay, you get hit with extra prompts. I’m totally fine tipping when it makes sense, but the tip screens felt pushy… and then on top of that they’re asking you to donate to music-related stuff too. It starts to feel less like a fun night out and more like you’re being asked for extra money at every turn.

Maybe it’s better on a warm day, or if you don’t mind the constant add-ons. But if it’s chilly or you want something more relaxed, I’d honestly skip it and go somewhere that actually prioritizes guest comfort.

googleReviews.author: Ronit Rajani
googleReviews.text: Like the vibe of this place. It’s super cute. The prices of drinks aren’t bad. Got the cherry limeade cocktail. The dried fruit on top was awful and it was not that strong. However, I wanna come back to try other items.

googleReviews.text: What a cool spot! Active beer garden with plenty to keep you entertained. Grabbed drinks and light bites from here after a professional event and we all were impressed.

googleReviews.text:
Nightingale hosted my b-day party, and from first contact through the event, Lisa and the entire team here were super responsive, accommodating and professional. I booked their private room 2 with a 5pm start (before normal business hours) and it accommodated my 20+ guests quite nicely. From the moment I arrived through setup, the staff regularly checked in to see if any help was needed, and one of the kind staff members even helped me unload supplies from my car.

The Karafun and sound system in the private room were great. Another cool unexpected feature was that I could control the thermostat in the room, which was helpful as more guests arrived. All in all, my guests and I had an absolute blast, and I can’t wait to host next year’s birthday here!

googleReviews.text: I had the best time ever at Duet K Town Karaoke Bar! From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly friendly and made us feel right at home. googleReviews.author: FRAGSQUAD 938
googleReviews.text: This karaoke spot was a HIT! We came here 2 times in a week and both times the service was fantastic! We ordered soju and ramen! Food and drinks were delicious and up to par with the aura of the establishment!  We will definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Princess Dymond
googleReviews.text:
We visited on a Friday night and overall we had a good time, but there were a few things that were disappointing. They advertise that YouTube is available for song selection, but that wasn’t actually offered, which limited the music choices more than expected. The song selection in general could definitely be expanded.
We ordered a platter and were told substitutions weren’t allowed, which was a bit frustrating since flexibility would’ve made the experience better. Food options overall were somewhat limited.
On a positive note, the private sectional rooms are cozy and great for introverts like myself who prefer a more comfortable, low-pressure setting. The prices were reasonable for a night out. Staff was moderately friendly, though getting simple things like water required going up to the bar.
Despite the hiccups, we still managed to have a great time. With a few adjustments to song access and menu flexibility, this place could really elevate the experience.

googleReviews.author: Cristina Lagunilla
googleReviews.text: Honestly really clean and nice place it's the cheapest Karaoke I've seen when comparing prices and the staff are very nice and friendly. Would definitely go again although I wish they had a wider range of music as my friends also wanted to sing Spanish songs but couldn't find any. Overall was a fun experience.

googleReviews.author: Wise Creations
googleReviews.text: Definitely suggest going!! Such a great time, and an awesome freaking staff!! Great for large and smaller parties. Private rooms make it a great place to feel you have your own space but not have to worry about the clean up after. Pricing is definitely affordable! Food alcohol etc!! They only thing I'd say could improve is the couches were a little worn but honestly you don't even notice! Enjoy your time cause it'll be great fun laughs etc.!! Also top secret ask about the computer room, that's where you can listen to anything or find anything through YouTube, not just be confined by the selection in the karaoke system!!!

googleReviews.author: Abimbola Oyefeso
googleReviews.text:
I came here to celebrate my birthday with a large group of friends who traveled from different states and even from outside the country. Being Nigerian and Yoruba, I was genuinely excited to enjoy music from my culture with the people I came with. Unfortunately, that experience was extremely disappointing.

The music selection was far from inclusive. There were only a 3 of Nigerian songs available, and even those were not by the original artists. While I understand that every establishment cannot have every song, the bigger issue was how the situation was handled by management.

I politely explained to the manager that the music selection lacked cultural diversity and that our group did not feel represented. Instead of listening and trying to accommodate us, she immediately became defensive and argumentative. She repeatedly stated that “no one has ever complained before,” which completely dismissed the concern we were bringing to her as paying customers. Just because something has never been addressed before does not mean it is not a valid issue.

We even tried to come up with solutions ourselves by asking if there was YouTube access, Bluetooth connection options, or any way we could play music from our phones so everyone could enjoy the experience. We were told no to every option without any effort to help or compromise.

As a public establishment that serves people from many different backgrounds, there should be more effort toward inclusivity and customer experience, especially when concerns are brought respectfully. Instead, we were made to feel like our culture and feedback did not matter.

Overall, the atmosphere caters heavily to mainstream radio music only. So if that is what you enjoy, this may be the place for you. However, if you are looking for a place that embraces cultural diversity in music and values customer concerns, I would not recommend coming here.

googleReviews.author: Kaitlin B
googleReviews.text: My friends and I enjoy renting karaoke rooms and what intrigued me about this place was the set up where you could essentially pull up any song you want to sing along to.  That is definitely a plus to this place.  However, you can't put songs into a queue while others are singing. Therefore, people had to wait their turn to pick songs and click on them. That does cut into the singing time.  That being said, the rate of the rooms are good and the staff where helping and checked on us a fair amount.  I guess it just depends on what your preferences are when going out to karaoke.  Overall, this place has some very good points and we enjoyed our visit.

googleReviews.author: Zita Celeste
googleReviews.text: Where do I even start?! This is me and my boyfriend's GO-TO!! They don't charge by group how other places charge. They charge by small or large room use, so you can squeeze plenty without being charged for seats you won't be using. They are usually very speedy and friendly. Any questions, they answer amazingly! This place uses youtube for the karaoke search making it have ANY song basically! I am very picky with my karaoke intrumentals so being able to pick them is so so great! The staff is never in a bad mood, and the young woman with dark hair has an amazing voice! Drinks are perfect and food is great. We love bringing all of our friends and bragging about this hidden gem.

googleReviews.author: Angel Garcia
googleReviews.text:
The food was is exactly at you should expect, it’s nothing fancy or anything. But it was still good and we enjoyed snacking on them throughout the night.

Our hostess/server was Sarah. Super sweet and friendly. The moment we walked in she greeted us and although we were late we were still able to get our room. We had over 15 people and the room fit all of us with plenty of space to dance around and not feel crowded. Brandon assisted her all throughout the night as well. Both Sarah and Brandon kept our night running smoothly. They always checked on us and explained to us in full details on how their system worked. We were there for about 3 hours and no matter what we needed they were able to provide us with what we needed and always stay positive and friendly. At the bar was Millie we didn’t have much interaction with her but she was super kind and would help us anytime one of us came up to the bar.

The place in not super fancy or over the top, but we enjoyed every moment and the staff was great. The location makes it seem unappealing but that has nothing to do with the business itself. Please give this place a chance!

googleReviews.text: Karaoke was great, but they won’t prepare or serve your food unless you pay first. It’s a pay-as-you-order system, which was very inconvenient. The location isn’t that great either. I hope they add more lighting to the parking lot. Per hour for Karaoke is a bit expensive $30

Come fir the live show, stay for the vibe, if u rock n roll

googleReviews.author: Erin Auchterlonie
googleReviews.text: Lovely bartender here - she was super helpful for a lost little traveller 😋 but seriously, nice and helpful in choosing a beer from an unfamiliar selection offering testers to help me choose. I went with the Texas Lager and highly recommend it for the tourists who want a lighter beer. Great atmosphere and happy people for an early Friday hour

googleReviews.author: J. Hernandes
googleReviews.text: It was my friend's birthday, and we decided to celebrate with 🌮 Taco Tuesday at a local restaurant that exceeded our expectations. We indulged in ten tacos, which were only $1 each on Tuesdays, and complemented our meal with a spicy ceviche that perfectly matched my taste. The establishment also offers an affordable happy hour special, making it an attractive option for future visits. They also now have hookah! To add to the celebration, they surprised my friend with a birthday shot, enhancing the festive atmosphere.

googleReviews.author: Ry
googleReviews.text: The aesthetic and amount of picture spots for this place was pretty nice as an avid photo taker. The drinks were strong, which I loved. We also got a hookah which they were fast about bringing out which was nice as well since some places are usually delayed with that. The only thing I would say is our waitress was a little slow coming back to check on us, so we didn't get to take advantage of the food but otherwise it was still a nice overall experience. Great music, and I would stop in again to fully try them out.

googleReviews.author: Nicholas Del Villar
googleReviews.text:
Came here for Friday happy hour w $2 drafts. 3rd or 4th time having come here and decided to try the burger. Was one of the best burgers I've had at a restaurant/bar!

I've had the ceviche and tacos before and they're both very good too 👍🏼

googleReviews.author: Jene'Vue
googleReviews.text: Visiting from NC and we enjoyed this place tremendously! Such a vibe and the decor was very pretty and made the ambiance even better. It was not as packed as we expected it to be and we were able to find a table closer to the back of the place. They did have a dance floor towards the entrance but it was a bit small though. So there was a bunch of bumping into different people. Everyone was super friendly and efficient. Our waitress did take a while with our drinks but ehhh, it can happen so we didn't complain. We went on a friday around 11pm and I believe it was tropical night? They played a bunch of salsa, Merengue and Bachata with a few Reggaeton songs here and there. Drinks were great. Ordered the Watermelon Paloma and it was super strong and tasted delicious! We also ordered a few glasses of Brut (Prosecco) and def hit the spot also. Before we left we got complementary watermelon shots, OMG they were sooooooo good! Definitely dangerous though so be careful if you order those. They can definitely sneak up on you. They do serve food but we did not order any so cant comment on that. Towards the end we saw that they offer hookah and were bummed because we would've enjoyed that if we would've known when we first arrived. The bathrooms were gross though. Floor was wet , tissue paper all on the floor and trash was overflowing. Other than that we enjoyed our time here and will be back if we are ever in the area.

googleReviews.author: Gloria Hernandez
googleReviews.text: We went to celebrate a friend's birthday. They have a patio area which we loved because the weather was amazing that Friday night. We ordered drinks the Cuban (10/10) and Mexicana (6/10). The food was good. We also ordered the hooka and it was a great experienced. The only thing we didn't liked was the time the server took to come to our table. They're all women and really nice ladies but we felt like they focused more on men. That's speaking on our experienced. The security man an African American he is an awesome guy. Loved his energy and kindness. Other than that we liked the place. They have a DJ and you get to dance in a little space they have as a dance floor. We might come back on a Saturday for karaoke night.

googleReviews.author: Haru Amano
googleReviews.text:
i love this place so much, one of the best place open late at night, the food is amazing, price is decent for the portions

so far every food i tried match my expectations, perfect place for solo dinner, with friends, or big group hangout

the vibe is always so cozy and warm

googleReviews.author: Angel Garcia
googleReviews.text: 30 dollars an hour for the room seems cheap until you realize you're having so much fun singing and eating the food that 4 hours have passed!😂 Friends took me out to this place for my birthday. The food wasnt anything fancy like a restaurant dedicated to that particular experience but it wasnt cheap bar food either. Very good snacky/ munchy food. They have plates that are shareable which is nice. The karaoke machine had a perfect loudness, you get 2 mics, good bass for the beat, and easy to sing along on the screen. Staff were knowledgeable with the remote (thankfully!) because we were so confused for a hot minute. They were also very quick each time we clicked the button to call for service. Very nice as well and no rudeness or any attitude even when it got very busy. My experience was solely the karaoke room though, so I cant speak for the dine-in experience. Thanks for the fun experience I definitely want to come back.

googleReviews.author: Duy T
googleReviews.text:
Food is delicious. We ordered a table full of dishes, and each one was tasty and fulfilling.

My favorite was the Bulgogi pizza. Super cheesy, loads of toppings with a crispy crust. Could have finished it all by myself and go for seconds.

Service was good. Nice place with private booths and karaoke rooms.

googleReviews.author: Jac D
googleReviews.text:
Thank you Soju for great service and Karaoke fun😆 with me and  my family. We had a blast. 😄🥳.
I have to recommend this place for a day and evening of great food (✔️♥️♥️), great service (✔️♥️♥️), and Karaoke fun(✔️ and ✔️). This is definitely a great place for laughs and connecting. Try it, what's stopping you. I do not know our server's name, but he got every single order right. Thank you so much!💐 So I had to post his picture, along with all the good food we had.😎 Thanks again for a great service. 👏👏💐

googleReviews.author: Ashley Stimpson
googleReviews.text: I liked this place. For the price of the room, we had a good time. They had a book with the songs they have preselected on their system device, but it was a wife variety. It won't have some of the newest songs though being so selective. The room was hot when we first got there because they hadn't turned the ac on in the room until we got someone to do so. It took them a while at times to get to our room for service, but that could be an understaffed thing. The food we had was yummy, but we didn't get a lot of dishes. The drinks were reasonably priced and yummy. I loved the set up of the bar area, with cute cozy seating areas for two. Overall I enjoyed my time and would come back.

googleReviews.author: Felicia Martin
googleReviews.text: On August 22 I had my 50th birthday party here and I booked the VIP suite , and it was great, clean neat , organized, and the service was amazing shoutout to the serves that night, Thank you 😊 , we didn’t have to wait for nothing, every order and food came immediately. I will definitely book again, they were ready and on point , love it thank you for making my birthday amazing

googleReviews.author: Kristi B
googleReviews.text:
Absolutely loved this place! We went for a friends birthday surprise party - they also loved it. The group did karaoke over in Japan on vacation and missed it. This was a great, fun option.

Did not order food since there are so many good resturants around the location. Will try some next time.

googleReviews.author: CHRISTOPHER ROBERSON
googleReviews.text: Everything thing from the music choices pool table in the karaoke room plenty of space all great. Drinks were cool also but the food was the low light of the night. Also the food came out wayyyy to fast I ordered and it was ready literally like 4 minutes later. Threw me all the way off. Didn't finish any of it.

The food was actually so good and the vibes were definitely there for going out. Couldn’t have asked for a better time.

googleReviews.text: this place is AMAZING! Phenomenal atmosphere, friendly people, great staff, excellent food! definitely a re-visit kind of place! I had the nachos, they're wonderful! had my mouth watering!

googleReviews.author: Draco Lee
googleReviews.text: Partner and I have tried the menu on more than one occasion. They rarely get it right or don't have items available. It's definitely a hit or miss on food. We want to love it, but realistically, they've got a lot of work to get the kitchen right. Bar service for drinks could be a bit quicker by staff being a bit more attentive, especially when conversing with the regular patrons. We love the bar atmosphere and we want to love Liquid Zoo!

googleReviews.author: Jon E. Hendrickson
googleReviews.text: We were there for karaoke. The bartender was super nice. The seating was kind of cramped, but reasonable for the space. The DJ was very charismatic and ran the show well. We didn't try the food, but we will in the future, because my wife and son like to sing there.

googleReviews.author: Benjamin Kelley
googleReviews.text: Love to come here for drinks and food but my visit tonight was less than appreciative. Came in and ordered a drink and tried to order food, was told kitchen was closed due to "staff on break". I asked when they would resume service and I was told "I don't know, it's shift change". So I settled with just my drink. The entire time I was sat having my drink, the kitchen was consistently bringing food out to other patrons in the back room. I took my drink back to the bar and told the bartender while he told me the kitchen was "on break", it was constantly serving food to other patrons. The only thing the bartender had to say in a snarky attitude was  "Well that's what they told me". Ended up walking out and taking my business elsewhere. No amount of good service makes up for bad service and attitude even if it's one time.

googleReviews.author: Hunter
googleReviews.text: First time going the bartender was fantastic he got me my beer and I handed him a dollar as a tip the thing I liked was he counted out my change which was $5 at least I knew how much a beer cost departure was super sincere and transparent it's pretty slow on a Tuesday but I watched and listened to karaoke  it looks like an extremely old bar on the inside they have a heater that looks like it came from I Love Lucy Ricky Ricardo studio bahahahaha 😂🤣 but people where friendly I'd definitely Go back

googleReviews.text: The new door guy is a ticking time bomb. You guys need to let him go before something happens lol I’m 100% sure he’s gonna end up on a list somewhere if he’s not already.

googleReviews.text: I've been to a lot of different bars in Dallas but this place is off the beaten path. You have to drive to get to it. And it's not in a good area of town at all, but apart from those things this is a really fun bar! The karaoke on Fridays lit, the drinks are really good, and the vibe is just wonderful. The people are so diverse and so much fun. This is one of those bars that makes you remember why you like Dallas so much.
