googleReviews.author: William Key
googleReviews.text: Really nice bar! Kent is the owner, and he's pretty cool. He doesn't tolerate rudeness. All of the bartenders I've l met, Andrea, Chase, Nicole, are all very nice too! Good place for karaoke and good drinks that aren't super expensive. So long as you're polite to everyone, you'll love it here!

googleReviews.author: Meaghan Norwood
googleReviews.text:
I had a deeply upsetting experience at this bar and feel compelled to warn others. The bartender was shockingly rude and aggressive toward our group from the moment we arrived. She spoke to us disrespectfully, made inappropriate comments about our weight, and even made remarks about how much we were spending. What should have been a casual night out quickly turned into an uncomfortable and hostile situation.

What made it even worse was that her behavior escalated to the point where she threatened to fight us, which is completely unacceptable in any business, let alone a place that is supposed to serve customers in a safe and welcoming environment. Her conduct came across as hostile, discriminatory, and deeply unprofessional.

I tried to address the issue with the owner, hoping he would take the situation seriously, but he simply shrugged it off and seemed completely unconcerned. That response made it clear that this behavior is either tolerated or ignored, which is just as disturbing as the incident itself.

Overall, this bar felt angry, hostile, and discriminatory, with an atmosphere that came across as racist and sexist rather than welcoming. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a respectful or safe environment.

googleReviews.author: Esther D'Entremont
googleReviews.text: What could have been a great vintage-y, dive bar experience is ruined on each visit by the ever-present Owner who stands on guard with his aggressive Hall Monitor vibes. He is rude and condescending toward customers, probably not realizing that he is actively pushing them out (and that there’s plenty of other places to go). The other employees are gracious and hard-working but the Owner standing in the corner will come out to enforce unknown rules when he doesn’t like you and he dismisses any feedback.  I’ve heard multiple people say that they’re not going back and I, too, have had my limit.

googleReviews.author: Meera Patel
googleReviews.text:
Absolutely terrible experience. The service was rude, dismissive, and unprofessional from beginning to end. The owner was there during the entire situation, which honestly made it worse because there was clearly no interest in fixing the problem or treating customers with basic respect.
The atmosphere felt hostile and uncomfortable, and we left wondering how a business like this stays open with such poor customer service. There are way too many great places in Dallas to waste your time and money somewhere that makes customers feel unwelcome and unappreciated.
Save yourself the frustration and go literally anywhere else. The Old Crow is highly encouraged rather than this place.

googleReviews.author: Jack R
googleReviews.text: Worst experience in a bar in my life. I've been casually visiting bars for 40 years. I've played pool in leagues and have had some success. Went into this pit of a bar after being invited to a birthday party by a friend of a friend. I saw the pool table in the back with a cover on it. I asked "May I play pool?" The answer, quite economical: "NO!"  Well, ok. Then the female bartender asked me what she could get me to drink. I answered I'm not drinking yet. Response: "$20 cover if you're not drinking." Ok, that's a new one on me. I mean, it wasn't as if there was a band or anything. So, with their surly attitude and abject lack of personality, I let her know I was leaving, after driving 20 minutes to get there and being there for 5 minutes. I've never spent so little time in a bar in my life. But, that was 5 minutes too long. "How much did you spend per person?" $0.  "What size group is this place best suited for?"  A group of 0.

googleReviews.author: TA
googleReviews.text: Had a great time here at this hidden gem. Very low key vibes. They had a great DJ who was playing all the jams. Great drinks. Lots of fun.

googleReviews.author: Natassia Marchbanks
googleReviews.text: I’ve loved going to Dad’s Karaoke for years, but this most recent visit on a Friday was just a different vibe. The KJ put himself in a rotation of over 30 people, took entire songs to transition in between singers, shooed me away when I was waiting for confirmation that my selection had been put in, he bumped me no less than three times, and was pretty rude to a couple of other singers who were just there to have a good time. I’ve had really great KJs there before, so it was surprising that this was their pick for a super busy Friday night. The bartenders and staff otherwise were amazing, as always. Attentive, friendly, smiling… I’ll be back for them and the crowd!

googleReviews.author: crystal avila
googleReviews.text: Went for the first time and yes not much parking and can be really over crowded but the vibe was good with people. Bartenders however, were nice but also robing people so just pay attention to what your getting and use cash plus drinks were pricey that could be because of the bartenders too taking advantage

googleReviews.author: Jimmy Holloway
googleReviews.text: This is your typical karaoke bar, with a lively crowd of folks who enjoy to sing on the weekends. They have pool tables, dart machines & an atm. They serve pizza and other typical bar food. This place seems a bit rundown and older, but the upside is that it is quite safe and not very rowdy. I wouldn’t say it was bad or great, but rather just a decent little bar to go to if you would like to sing karaoke or just hang out with friends for a few drinks and to play pool. It seems more like a neighborhood bar and there’s nothing wrong with that, however, to me, it was very average. Nonetheless, that is not to say that it’s a bad place. In the end, If you’re in the area and looking for drinks & a place to hang out, give Hidden Tavern a chance. 👍🏽

googleReviews.author: Marie Schneider
googleReviews.text: Super chill vibe, stumbled upon Karaoke on our first night in San Antonio. Always good when Wisconsinites find a great spot! The red solo cups say everything. 🤍

googleReviews.author: Brittany Danielle
googleReviews.text: I saw this birthday shot video on TikTok and wanted to experience it for myself it was my birthday weekend and I had my cousin with me to check out the this bar. I asked the DJ if the guy who does the birthday shot is working his response was " I'm not stopping my show for some stupid shot" not gonna lie it did put a damper my the night but it  was made up by the great customer service by the bartenders behind the bar Tiffany,Ellie, and Joey. Their friendly service, smiling faces, and great customer service definitely made the night and my drive well worth the visit.  Hope to return soon to see  them three working together again but perhaps with a different DJ, either way  great establishment, great prices,  clean restrooms definitely recommend them three!!!!!!

googleReviews.author: Pokeon catcher
googleReviews.text:
Good place for karaoke as long as you show up when they have their regular (Mexican) DJ since the other DJ (black guy) sells the “next singer” slot to the highest bidder.

I sat here for an hour, checking the list multiple times before he realized that he was recycling singers before he then had the audacity to me to let me know the “price to sing”… No Thanks….

Great spot for regulars… if you can become one.

They treat you like an outsider for sure, gotta earn your keep.

googleReviews.author: Sierra
googleReviews.text: Love this karaoke bar! Its such a fun low key spot to come to by yourself or with a friend/friends! They have a few pool tables and lots of seating. I went on a Monday night where they had a $2.50 special on Michelob Ultra! They have trivia nights on Tuesday’s, and I’m sure they have other fun activities the other days of the week. I’ll be coming back when I want to have a drink and listen to people sing or maybe participate myself!

googleReviews.author: David Fisch
googleReviews.text: We saw a live band called Titanium.  They were good.  90s early 2000 rock.  Drinks were good and cheap.  Only one bartender. Had to be patient getting drinks but she was working her tail off and was friendly.  The place has a dingy vibe that is perfect.  Just enough to let your guard down and relax but not too much so it feels creepy.  The patrons were all types of random friendliness.  Maybe not a place if you’re stuck up but if you just want a low key local San Antonio dive bar with local rock band vibes this fits the bill.

googleReviews.author: Benico Hurst
googleReviews.text: I totally recommend this place super awesome vibe, and great bartenders . Plus you can’t ever go wrong with some karaoke! If you’ve questioned it at all. No further anymore this is your sign .

googleReviews.author: A G
googleReviews.text: Second time Ive been here and a blast both times! Great drinks, food, and staff! Nice tv screen w tablet to search for the songs you want to sing! Comfy, updated private karaoke rooms with booth seating & dimmable lights that they’ll bring your food into!

googleReviews.author: Quincy Wilson
googleReviews.text: Had a very fun time at this place. Went with a group of people to sing karaoke and celebrate a coworker that was moving. Great atmosphere, food was excellent and music was pumping. Enjoyed the drinks especially the soju. Things are expensive depending on what you order. So be ready to spend but it is a very good time if everyone is involved.

googleReviews.author: tinyteef
googleReviews.text: the actual karaoke was fun and the room was small but comfortable. My only complaint is the guy who was running the karaoke rooms was pretty rude and passive aggressive towards me and my friends. He was rude when we came in and when we  asked for a room and had an attitude, then when we went to pay he literally stood and judgmentally looked one of my friends up and down before going to the register to check us out. The worst part is we were overcharged by them starting our timer 20-30 minutes before we even got in room. they started our time at 9:30pm when we didn’t get into the room until 9:56pm. When we got in the room he said he’d TRY to get us 2 hours. long story short we lost track of time and we left the room at 12:15 which is a grand total of 2 hours and 20 minutes. He said we had 15 minutes left. so that would mean we should’ve paid for 2hrs and 35 minutes. We said we would pay for the left over time assuming we’d be charged forl the 2 hours and 35 minutes we spent in the room. We ended up having to pay for 3 hours when we weren’t even in there for 3 full hours regardless if we had left early the room early or not we should not have been charged for THEM starting our timer early. Not to mention there was a sign in the front that said the first 30 minutes of karaoke were free on Friday and saturday's and it was friday so idk where that was. I was recommended this place by a friend who after the fact mentioned they shared a similar experience with the same guy being rude to them.

googleReviews.author: Collin Roark
googleReviews.text:
We had a horrible experience with this place and cannot possibly recommend it. We booked a large room for my girlfriend’s birthday. Upon arrival we went and got some water cups. One of the employees informed us we could not take them into the room due to “possible spills on the wood floors”. When asking for clarification why we couldn’t bring cups or even tumblers when we’re already going to be buying alcohol etc. they totally shifted gears and just told us they wanted us to pay for water. Another higher employee came in very rudely lecturing us about people “taking advantage” of their “generous hospitality”. The whole interaction was so needlessly intense and awkward we would have left on the spot if we hadn’t already put our card down.

The room itself - karaoke setup is really just YouTube with a sound system. There was a horrible lag so we spent about 2 minutes between songs just trying to get things working.

And to top it all off, they added a 20% gratuity to everyone’s individual tab on top of a 20% gratuity for the room. They don’t even provide any service to the room! we each individually had to go to the bar and take time out of the room to order food and drinks.

None of this these policies about the water or gratuity was mentioned up front, despite questions we asked in advance.

Do not waste your money or time at this nickle and dime establishment. You have YouTube at home. Just buy a nice mic and speaker.

googleReviews.author: Kay Bradburn
googleReviews.text:
We called twice about reservations and were told parties under 5 couldn’t book in advance. First, we were told the earliest time was 11:30 PM, then 12 AM. We arrived at 9:30 PM to see if anything was available or to get on a list, but the male host said no—then he went to interrupt another group if they were leaving soon to see if we could have that room. He said they are staying and the earliest room would be 11:30 PM, and we agreed to wait, but no one told us to sign in.

We returned at 11:25 PM, were rushed into a room with no instructions, and saw other guests being told the same rule—except now it had changed to parties under 6 couldn’t book over the phone. About 10 minutes into karaoke, the host came in saying someone else had booked the room and we had to leave. After some discussion, he offered 30 minutes free for the “misunderstanding,” then later said the other group had left so we could stay.

They use YouTube for karaoke, which would be fine if not for the terrible lag and playback issues from sharing one account across rooms. I had to log out of the designated account, causing ads to play between songs. It was a better sacrifice than having an error message pop up while you waited for another party to finish their video. Someone also kept opening and closing our door for no reason which made me uncomfortable.

When paying, we were charged $77 despite being offered 30 minutes for free and no food or drinks ordered. Staff said we couldn’t pay by the minute and would be charged $30 per hour if we went over. I don’t know what the extra $17 was
From. The karaoke itself was fun, but the disorganization, inconsistent rules, and confusing pricing make this place not worth revisiting

googleReviews.text: Found this place on Google nearby search chose it based off the photos on yelp. Glad I came in good chill nostalgic vibe. Enjoyed the atmosphere and drinks were good. Service was good, definitely recommend  If ur looking for a laid back chill vibe and good drinks. ❤️it!

googleReviews.text: Went for dinner and Wednesday trivia and loved it! The atmosphere is so fun with old couches and quirky decorations, as well as the choice of music. The trivia was appropriately paced, and the trivia players were very energetic. Our server/bartender was very sociable and provided some excellent suggestions for pizza customization and drink options. I wish there were more NA drink options, but overall had a great experience and would highly recommend!

googleReviews.text: One of our favorite bars in town.  We had our first date here and have since gotten married and continue to come back. Always have great music and if you check for them on Spotify you can find their awesome playlists!

googleReviews.author: Angela De La Rosa
googleReviews.text: I LOVE the aesthetic of the bar from the furniture to the lighting and music. It's absolutely perfect. Our bartender, Bernie, was attentive and friendly. He made a drink that should be added to the menu! It was a tropical drink and absolutely delicious.

googleReviews.author: Michael Bourne
googleReviews.text:
We didn’t order any food because they are strictly a Bar with Talented Musicians who play multiple different types of instruments & you scan a QR Code on your phone then you Request ANY Song & they will perform the song & you Pay $1 for each Vote for each song that you request to be performed by the musicians. The more Votes that you & the Audience acquire by paying $1 per vote are added up & displayed on their Screen. So you can see where the song you Requested is Ranked/Numbered/Positioned to play next on their screen in the queue.
Very Entertaining & Fun Place!
Great Service with Beer & a Full Bar with Very Attentive Waitresses who take your drink orders & bring your alcoholic beverages promptly to your table.
Get Here Early to ensure you & your party get a First Come First Serve Table.
It’s a $10 Cover Charge per person & it’s worth it!
Also, There is an open air outdoor seating area with speakers to listen to the band singing & performing songs that were requested to keep up with when your song that you requested is being performed where you can smoke seated with a great view of the city.
It’s Fun for All Age Groups!
For Ages 21 & Older.

googleReviews.author: Sami L
googleReviews.text:
Howl at the Moon was such a fun spot and an absolute must if you’re out on the River Walk. The energy in there is unreal. The live dueling pianos make the whole place come alive, and the musicians are insanely talented — they take requests, get the whole crowd involved, and keep the vibe going all night.

The atmosphere is super lively and the crowd is really fun, which makes it easy to get caught up singing along and dancing with everyone. It’s one of those places where you walk in planning to stay for one drink and end up staying way longer because the energy is just that good.

If you’re in San Antonio and want a fun night out with great live music and a packed, high-energy atmosphere, Howl at the Moon is definitely the place to go. 🎹🍻🎶

googleReviews.author: Brian McSteen
googleReviews.text: If you want to go out in San Antonio, dance, let loose, listen to amazing music  and be around an extremely diverse crowd that doesn’t care for what anyone thinks and dances and sings their butt off THIS IS YOUR PLACE. Honestly nothing is as fun in San Antonio as this place. I’ve been here dozens of times and it never gets old!

googleReviews.author: Tommy Boy77
googleReviews.text: The musical talent at this place is next level. The fact that they go from the piano to the bass drum to the guitars and back with the same person is quite amazing. There's anywhere from three to five of them working together to cover your favorite songs. Definitely worth checking out if you're at the Riverwalk.

googleReviews.author: Alissia Segroves
googleReviews.text: Great and savory meals!! Good portions and delicious protein and appetizers! beautiful staff and lovely bartenders

googleReviews.author: elizabeth reyna
googleReviews.text: Went in to order the yukgaeyang and tofu seafood stews and they were bland and there was no brisket found! They also claimed the yukgaeyang had brisket but there was nothing. Also ordered corn cheese and it was just mayo and cheese.. no flavor. Bad food is one thing but the service was bad. Waitresses got upset that we did not like the food. Also there was a basket with cabbage soaking on the floor in an open space right next to their restroom. Major health violations going on.. terrible!

googleReviews.author: Meagan Wrinkle
googleReviews.text: The food was perfectly fine. There are plenty of local Korean restaurants that are certainly much better. The most disappointing thing about the experience was the staff. Service was initially quite pushy and provided 2 menus for a table of 7 and hounded us to order before our party was ready. When we moved to the karaoke room, we were not allowed to take water unless we purchased bottled water. Also fine. We had ordered food to the room, but it never came. The system was extremely laggy and many times we spent more time waiting for the song to load than actually singing. At one point it froze for over 20 minutes. When we requested assistance, we were told that the internet was not their prerogative to control, and advised to use our personal cell phones (and cellular data) to hook into their system. Only one person had a phone that was compatible with the cable they provided, and it would not play sound. In about 4 hours, my party spent probably around $800 easily, and the dismissive reaction to our issues were enough to ruin the entire experience. We will not be returning.

googleReviews.author: Bryanna Gonzalez
googleReviews.text: DO NOT EAT HERE!!!! choose any other korean bbq place if anything just go for the karaoke rooms. But honestly you are better off doing karaoke at your house. We started off by making a reservation for a party of 10 the day before. When we arrived no one greeted us they just said for how many and pointed us to a table. That wasnt the issue really what bothered me the most is that we all paid 40.00 for the all you can eat kbbq. Which was NOT all you can eat. This business made 400.00 off of my family and yet we were told when we asked for more banchan. (We only got one set of banchan for the whole table). That what they had provided was enough. WHICH by the way was small peices of kimchi and some cucumbers. This place was not what i expected at all. The service was horrible everytime we asked for something we never got a response just a look and they would leave. This place is kinda sketchy and i would rather eat at kpot or somewhere else. Not a good experience and a couple of my family got sick after eating. If i could give zero stars i would.

googleReviews.author: Shih Meng-Hsiu (Tony)
googleReviews.text:
Great karaoke spot in Austin! I’m actually a regular here and have been back so many times. I really enjoy this place.

The song selection is amazing. They have a wide variety across different languages, including the original Korean TJ karaoke system, plus a YouTube option, so you can pretty much always find the songs you want.

The staff are super friendly and helpful, which makes the whole experience even better. It’s also BYOB, which is a big plus, but they do sell water and some basic drinks if you need.

Overall, such a fun and chill place to hang out with friends. Highly recommend.
I’ll definitely keep coming back!

googleReviews.author: T
googleReviews.text: Went here with my siblings , and we had a BLAST … we were so happy we were in our own private room 💕 we definitely will come back

googleReviews.author: Nunia Busines
googleReviews.text:
Edit: I went again after the store after being contacted by the owner, and we had a very good experience this time so I'm changing my rating! We went on a Monday night, and weekdays are cheaper which is nice, and we had most of the place to ourselves too. This time, the room we went in was very clean, from the tables to chairs to tablet. The tablet in our room was very good this time, and didn't lag at all which was fantastic. Was about $12 per person in a 6 person party this time, for two hours.

Was about $15 per person for 3 hours starting at their discount time, and it's also discounted if you have a student ID. Very good price! However, the facilities were kind of sticky and run down. We booked in advance like the store suggests, but since one of our microphones wasn't working we had to relocate to another room and the table there was unpleasantly and strangely sticky. One of the seat cushions was also loose, and a phone slipped underneath it. Underneath the seat cushion was straight up concrete and metal bar supports of the foundation of the furniture. The best part about this place is that you can play YouTube karaoke videos, so my friends and I were able to sing whatever we wanted to our hearts content. Depending on the room you get though, the tablet for using YouTube can be more slow and the internet more spotty. In our new room we had a good connection. The rooms are also NOT SOUND PROOF, it's very apparent what other people are doing and singing. We had a lot of fun in the end.

googleReviews.author: Jacob Wright
googleReviews.text: Austin Karaoke is an absolute blast and easily one of the most fun nights out I have had in Austin. The private rooms are well equipped with great sound systems and an enormous song selection that covers every genre and era you could possibly want. The atmosphere is lively and incredibly welcoming, making it the perfect setting for a birthday celebration, a night out with friends, or just a spontaneous good time. The staff is attentive and keeps everything running smoothly so you can focus on having the time of your life. If you are looking for an unforgettable and entertaining night out in Austin, Austin Karaoke is the place to be and I cannot recommend it enough.

googleReviews.author: Louise
googleReviews.text:
Love going here to put my singing practice into action (can't be loud at my apartment).
Staff never treated me bad. The best part is that I can adjust the console to turn echo off, music low, and mic low so I can hear my natural voice more clearly. The other karaoke place has the same console but they restrict you from doing any adjustments which is kind of ridiculous.
Kind of upset Austin Karaoke raised the price for solo people, but oh well.

googleReviews.author: Mrs. 'Ski
googleReviews.text: Cant really judge the food bc I didnt have any, but it smelled good! Our waitress in Room #1 did an excellent job. Didnt catch her name, but the curvy brunette with the facial peircings...GREAT JOB! The atmosphere is relaxed and cool. Gonna have to bring my hubs back. Thanks! Signed - the long last name😉

googleReviews.author: Andrew Dzib
googleReviews.text:
Had such a great experience at Common Interest for my boyfriend Jake’s birthday! We had a pretty large group (around 15–20 people), and honestly everyone had an amazing time. The drinks were great, the food was surprisingly SO good, and the whole vibe was just fun from start to finish.

The table reservation process was seamless and super easy. I originally wanted to book one of the private rooms, but they were already taken because I didn’t plan far enough ahead. That ended up being totally okay though because the main area was honestly just as fun, if not more fun, than being tucked away privately.

The MC was incredibly kind and gave multiple birthday shoutouts to Jake throughout the night, which made the experience feel really special and personal. We stayed until around midnight or 12:30 because nobody wanted to leave.

The only downside was that because so many people signed up to sing karaoke, a lot of people in our group didn’t get a chance to go before the night ended. They do allow people to tip the DJ to move up in the lineup, so the order didn’t always feel the most fair. But overall, it was still such a fun night and I’d absolutely come back again for another group event or celebration!

googleReviews.author: Christopher Wilson
googleReviews.text: The Common Interest is hands down one of the best karaoke bars I have ever been to. The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, making it easy to let loose and have an amazing time whether you are a seasoned performer or a first timer. The song selection is massive and covers every genre imaginable, so there is truly something for everyone. The drinks are well priced and the staff keeps the energy going all night long. I brought a group of friends here for a birthday celebration and we all agreed it was one of the most fun nights we have had in Austin in a long time.

googleReviews.author: Barrett Read
googleReviews.text: Decent prices on drinks and the bartenders were friendly, which I appreciated. Tried to sign up for karaoke, but the DJ seemed a little annoyed when I went up to put in a song request. He also looked pretty distracted talking to the woman hanging around the booth. On top of that, it took over two hours to get called up for one song, and it didn’t seem that busy for a Thursday.That said, the overall vibe was still fun. Solid neighborhood bar to hang out at.

googleReviews.author: Lily Lindsey
googleReviews.text:
I really hate giving bad reviews being a former industry employee and I used to like going here but I had rented a room last month. The reason I had waited to write this review is because I was waiting for my credit card dispute to go through. I was happy to pay the room fee that was discussed along with the added gratuity that was discussed and  not only on my bill for renting the room but everyone else’s individual bills (which makes complete sense and doesn’t bother me at all.) I had to dispute an extra $270 on my card. I know mistakes happen I tried to resolve without getting my bank involved… but I called 3 or 4 times and was promised the GM will be reaching out as soon as I got off the phone.. over a month later and still no call back.

Other than that the service for the private room was meh, again I totally understand that we had a huge party, none of us would have minded going to the bar and getting our own drinks but we would get reprimanded for doing that and have to wait maybe 20 minutes before we saw our server. It wasn’t like we were having a sit down dinner,  we were at a bar and we came to have drinks, everyone finishes drinks at their own pace. I don’t want to blame our server she was probably over whelmed because I’m pretty sure she was taking care of another larger party but there should be a better system involved.

Last minor thing, I’m paying to have a private karaoke room, the mics should not be falling apart.

It stinks because this place is fun with out the private room but this left a really bad taste in my mouth.

googleReviews.author: Lauren Woehrle
googleReviews.text:
Visited Austin for the first time, and this was the highlight of my trip! It was such a fun atmosphere & divey in the best way possible. Service was great, staff were lovely and the crowd was amazing and so high energy.

There was definitely a wait at the door, so plan accordingly,  but I'm happy to report that when I saw some folks try to skip the line, the man at the door kept things fair. Another thing to be aware of is that it definitely gets crowded, but it was a crowd of super fun and diverse people who were all having an amazing time.

I bought a tshirt (literally the first time I've bought a shirt from a bar) because it's definitely a night i want to remember. I look forward to taking another trip to  Austin in the futurw and will definitely make sure that I get more than one night at Ego's when I do!

googleReviews.author: kier
googleReviews.text:
It’s a karaoke bar, and all karaoke bars come with their qualms, depending on what you’re looking for of course!

The bartenders are friendly, and the drinks are reasonably priced. As a service industry person myself, I commend the staff on dealing with karaoke crowds every day lmfao. Not for the faint hearted.

Expect to wait a long time in the queue if you’re coming after 10PM. I’ve come on Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday. I’ve waited over an hour each time. Not sure if they’re ever slow at night or maybe I’ve just come on particularly busy nights. Just something to keep in mind! Seems to be a popular spots for large groups— particularly coworker groups. May be why the queue is always so long.

I’ve never experienced any skipping nor have I seen any successful briberies to skip the line. The KJ Nick is supportive and does a great job highlighting and uplifting everyone that goes up to the mic.

The clientele seems to really love rock music, namely dad rock and emo. There isn’t a whole lot of musical diversity across the board from what I’ve seen in my few visits. Personally I love disrupting the vibe with my song choices… but if you’re coming, expect to hear mostly the same type of music with the obvious karaoke go-tos and some outliers. Don’t be afraid to sing what you want even if the crowd isn’t eating it up!

Overall I’ve enjoyed my visits at Ego’s and I give a hats off to the crew that makes it all possible. Service industry ain’t easy but especially when you add inebriated karaokers waiting in queue into the mix.

googleReviews.author: Ebonie Queen
googleReviews.text: I went to egos tonight (Tuesday, 5/27) was having a good time and went to the bar to order drinks for my friend and I. I was standing in front of the well, where everyone orders drinks, there was no one there waiting to order drinks but me. The bartender looked at me, then another lady walked up to the bar and the bartender took her order instead of mine. I gave the bartender the benefit of the doubt and waited for her to finish with the order because surely she would come to me next because I’m right here in line at the bar and she saw me. No, she finished the order and went to the end of the bar to take another order. I decided that I no longer wanted drinks or to be at the bar so I left. I used to bartend at a speed bar and I understand that bartenders pay attention to the order that people come up to the bar, but like I said, I went up to the bar when there was no one else waiting to order and the bartender took the order of 2 guests that walked up to the bar after I did, even though she saw me walk up. It’s a Tuesday night and the bartop was not busy or overly crowded. I don’t even know if management will see this or care but I’m writing this for other patrons, specifically POCs. I am a POC and the guests that walked up after me were white, so take that as you may. I don’t want to say that it was because of that but it’s hard to feel that it wasn’t. Anyway, I used to love going to Egos but I won’t be returning. I’m not going to force anyone to take my money.

googleReviews.author: Nick Tinson
googleReviews.text: As someone who loves karaoke, Ego’s just has this magic to it! Here you can be yourself and have fun. The best part is karaoke is 7 days a week. Hopefully I can see you there

googleReviews.author: Kris
googleReviews.text: Bartenders were great. Prices are also great. The regulars there? Mixed bag. If you're a regular it's looks like a great hang. If you're new to the area, like me, you might be better off finding a different karaoke spot. I know I'll be looking.

Whether you wanna sing your heart out to the latest hits, some throwback hits, they have it all! Intocable, Madonna, 1D, Temptations, KPop Demon Hunters, and even some Blue October were some of the artist songs we chose from tonight just to name a few. Highly recommended!!!

googleReviews.text: Came here for my best friends birthday last night. It was fun, but unfortunately we had issues from the start in the large room. For super fans of Pantalones they have the blanco. I’ll have to try it again to see if they have gf df food. Of course I enjoyed the Alamo Drafthouse popcorn for the show!

googleReviews.author: Annette Castillo
googleReviews.text: It was my first time checking out the bar. I'm glad a 90s group was performing there that night cause it was good music to listen too while chilling with a friend. I liked the seating area as well. Even though I didn't dance the dance floor was a decent size.

googleReviews.author: Melinda Nguyen
googleReviews.text: I walk by here all the time to go to the movies. Didn't realize that this was a different venue, until my boyfriend booked us tickets to Drag Show Game Night. LOL. it was a great venue to have a great time! There are small tables in the center, with booths on the side and then the bar to the left. I thought the drinks were kind of pricey or maybe it's just me. ($40 for 2 casamigos on the rocks) and I don't know if they charge consistently for each drink or how they even come up with the price. You can also order food, but we didn't eat. Anyways, the show was GREAT. We enjoyed participating and watching others in the audience participate. Celia Light and Mars were sweet, fun and super funny! They totally engaged with the audience and I loved it.

googleReviews.author: Alana Dias
googleReviews.text:
Amazing karaoke experience in the private rooms and it’s truly the impeccable service that sets this place above the rest. Our server Ben was attentive, funny, helpful, and made our night perfect. The Big Top circus themed room is SO fun and we will definitely be back.

googleReviews.author: Candid Cami Travels
googleReviews.text: A time was had!  Michaux showed so much hospitality and graciously allowed us to rent his private karaoke space. We had about 20+ attendees. There was plenty of space, seating, tables for food and parking. The facility came with 2 party rooms: 1 for sitting and the other for karaoke gigging. There were 2 large karaoke screens, 4 microphones for group singing, colorful laser lights, bubble/fog machines and a plumbed restroom. Great karaoke ambiance is also provided. Costumes!! They have hats, wigs, glasses, etc to match your level of fun! Our event was MC’d the entire night. Each singer was introduced with gusto and high energy. They also played background music of your choice during intermissions. Their digital karaoke catalogue had over 60,000 songs! I can’t recommend this private karaoke room enough. The price is extremely reasonable for all that’s offered. Thank you for showing us a great time while we visited Austin, TX. 10/10 Recommend.

googleReviews.author: Juan Ponton

googleReviews.author: Raj
googleReviews.text:
The Spazmatics were awesome. Speakeasy… not so much.

We reserved a table, which apparently meant “serve yourself and good luck.” No table service, bartenders who looked like they’d rather be anywhere else, and drinks that were a complete gamble—one spicy margarita was basically water, the other could double as a weapon.

But the real highlight? We hit the dance floor (because the band was great), came back, and all our drinks were gone—some still 2/3 full—despite having the table reserved for another hour and our stuff still sitting there.

When we asked about it, we got eye rolls and attitude, like we were trying to pull off some elaborate margarita scam. They replaced 1 out of 5 drinks. Generous.

Great band. Rough venue. Plenty of better places in Austin to spend your money.

googleReviews.author: Amber Lee
googleReviews.text:
A local bar in every sense, Canary Roost sits right on Metric Boulevard and offers a quick, cheap, yet fun experience for those who enter. Parking is very convenient as it’s in a shopping area with ample spots. Once you enter you get a pretty strong dive bar vibe, but the karaoke hitting your ears soothes that. There’s a lot of seating available and the place is frequented by locals who come in groups just to sing their favorite tunes. Karaoke here is very popular so you have to queue up to get a chance, but once you do you can often hear people clapping along and singing with you.

The servers are very friendly and the drinks are pretty good. We usually order the Dammit Janet and it’s always been a nice sweet drink for us to enjoy. Besides karaoke there’s also plenty of TVs to show any games as well as pool tables in the back. Pool does cost about a $1.50 per game and they have a cash to quarters machine to help that process. It’s very easy to go in there for a quick drink or two then look at the clock and realize you’ve been there for 5 hours. We would definitely recommend this place to any locals in the area looking for a fun, very laid back place to hang with friends.

googleReviews.author: Chris Saunders
googleReviews.text: This legendary location is where many young UT freshman get their first alcoholic beverage some may prefer to refer to them as spirits when they come from this place. Back in my day, they didn’t seem to care much about IDs. I don’t know how they get the drinks today. But the first drink I ever had at this bar was something called a mind-eraser, which was recommended by the bartender. The enlightening beverage consists of a shot of Kahlúa and a shot of vodka combined. Since then, I’ve seen many great live music show and many a fantastic scene at this bar and live venue. The place is known for its very dirty men’s restroom. I think it has been mentioned plenty of times around these reviews and in movies or documentaries. It’s a lot of fun to see an upcoming musician play on the front stage with the street scenes and people walking by the large window. Also fun to see the medium bands in the backstage with a little more sound. While you’re there take a look at all the interesting street art on the walls at the hole.

googleReviews.author: Alex Silerio
googleReviews.text: Great traditional dive bar with pool tables and cheap beer, haven't had any of the food

googleReviews.author: DeeDee
googleReviews.text:
I love King's X, I've known about this place primarily because of "Lucy's" since the early 90s, when I used to work right down the street with Dr. Llamas. (RIP) where we would visit during our lunch break. The place hasn't really changed much, other than the outdoor patio, which is just okay, nothing to write home about. This patio is pretty large with tables and chairs, but feels somewhat lonely and detached from the bar.

The interior of the bar, hasn't changed much either, it feels familiar. I did notice a few new things in the bar, such as a drum set, (near the front) which makes me think they might have live entertainment on the weekends. At the rear of the bar I noticed "Las maquinitas", or casino machines, a couple of pool tables, darts, and even a shuffleboard. (My favorite) We were there early evening Sunday, so there was plenty of room, and all games where readily available.

We hunkered down at the bar area, where they gladly took our order from Lucy's, which happens to be connected directly to King's x. I am one of those persons who usually sticks to favorites, so naturally I ordered a plate of "Taco's Antonia" (my favorite) while my husband ordered burger and fries. I'll try to be brief, these tacos are the best tacos in El Paso. If you are a local and have not had the opportunity to try these tacos, I highly recommend you make an effort to visit Lucy's, these tacos are so delicious. The "desebrada" meat, is soft juicy and delicious. The taco shell is seasoned with some spices that are visible (in color) and most definitely noticed by your taste buds, on the inside, there is a nice crunch that comes from the cabbage & tomato (yes, cabbage) that when come together, is heaven in your mouth. The burger & fries were fine too. To wash is all down, a bloody Mary or beer, which are both on The Happy Hour menu. Overall, good time, delicious food, plus not to mention "Steelers Nation" (My favorite) GO STEELERS!

However, my experience during evening hours has been consistently disappointing due to unprofessional service from one particular bartender named Taylor, who tends to be rude to most customers. Despite the competitive drink prices, quality service matters more to me and my clients. I’ve decided to take my business elsewhere. Great bartenders are essential in this industry, and unfortunately, the evening service doesn’t meet the same standard as the daytime staff.”

googleReviews.author: Anna Limon
googleReviews.text: Funkmeyers is the perfect spot if you’re in the mood to dance and enjoy retro vibes—especially for fans of the ’80s. The atmosphere is lively and inviting, with great music, good drinks, and a full-on retro ambiance that takes you back in time. Be sure to bring your dancing shoes, because the dance floor is always calling. If you visit early in the day, you might even get the chance to play some classic ’80s video games, adding an extra layer of fun. An all-around great time—highly recommended!

(Oh and they let our up hang out with us!!)

googleReviews.author: DeeDee
googleReviews.text:
This would be the second time I visit a Funkmeyers Rec Room, and I got to say both were equally entertaining. On this evening, we went earlyish on a Friday night and talk about perfect timing. Not too crowded, with just the right amount of energy,

The video machines were up for grabs, (Pac- Man, Donkey Kong, Mortal Kombat, Centipede and others, the only this missing was an ol pinball machine) while others were watching the college football game on the giant projector screen. I also noticed a stage, not sure what this is for but could be for karaoke. Soon after they lower the lights just a little bit and pump up the music to your favorite 80s & 90s era, you can't help but to dance where you are.

They do have a happy hour, (?) which we had just missed, of course, but still average price on drinks. Our waiter was funny and fast, and makes a great Margarita. There are attentive to their customers as long as you sitting at the bar, other than that you are pretty much on your own. There is second mini bar right smack in the middle of the game area so it's no big deal getting a refill.

Overall I had a great time so much fun, I kissed a girl and I liked it and I will definitely be going back again. If you are of the video arcade generation, you must visit this place for yourself. It's a blast from the past but now you get to do it as an adult and with the beer, how fun is that?

googleReviews.author: Denzell Starks
googleReviews.text:
LAST RESPONSE TO OWNERS COMMENT:

I think It’s interesting that every response avoids the actual concern and instead attacks the customer personally. Calling people “lazy,” posting clown emojis, asking “want a hug?” and telling customers to “seek help” does not make the criticism disappear… it just reinforces it.

Nobody expected special treatment. We expected a fair rotation system and basic respect.

Youre quite defensive 🤷🏽‍♂️ I shared my experience honestly. Future customers can read both sides and decide for themselves.

————————————————————————————

1ST RESPONSE TO THE OWNERS COMMENT-

Interesting that the owner focused on correcting “family friendly” instead of addressing the actual issue: people being repeatedly skipped unless they tipped the DJ.

Nobody expected a free business. We bought drinks and supported the bar like everyone else. The issue was fairness. Watching the same people sing multiple times while we sat there nearly three hours after signing up is exactly why the experience felt discriminatory and pay-to-play.

And calling a customer’s experience “lazy sauce” instead of handling criticism professionally says more than my review ever could.
————————————————————————————
ORIGINAL REVIEW: We came here for karaoke expecting a fun, fair experience. Instead, we waited nearly three hours after signing up on the kiosk and were repeatedly skipped.

It quickly became clear why. The same group of people—mostly white patrons—were called up over and over again, while we weren’t called even once. Meanwhile, we were told by others in the bar that you have to tip the DJ (around $25) just to get a turn. So despite buying drinks and following the same process as everyone else, we were effectively ignored.

This wasn’t just disorganized—it felt deliberate. Watching others perform multiple times (badly, at that) while we sat there for hours without a single turn was frustrating enough. But having to beg the DJ just to be acknowledged, on two separate visits, crossed the line.

If this is supposed to be a “family-friendly, free” karaoke spot, it shouldn’t operate like a pay-to-play system—or worse, make certain groups feel like they have to jump through hoops just to participate.

We finally got one song in after almost three hours, but by then the experience was already ruined. Twice now, same outcome. That’s not a coincidence.

googleReviews.text:
We stumbled upon here by accident when looking for a spot to have dinner. How lucky we were to have found this spot! When entering, we immediately got the vibe that this was going to be a solid experience. Korean street signs on the wall, K-pop videos in the background, traditional burlap bags converted to wall partitions, and so much more made for an immersive environment.

The menu is accessed via QR code and has many delicious options. After about seven or so minutes, we were ready to order. An order of tteok-bokki, japchae, and some Seoul wings was the lineup. While we waited, we happened to also realize that they have karaoke too! There was a slight mixup when they delivered the food which resulted in us receiving some extra items. The team was great and didn’t charge us for their mistake.

In a nutshell, we definitely recommend checking out Seoul Pocha. Delicious wings and good service along with a chill vibe environment make for this a very enjoyable Korean spot for your next craving.

googleReviews.author: Guin Geyer
googleReviews.text:
Rolling through OKC and looking for a throttle-friendly stop with cold drinks and zero pretense? Margarita Island is a solid pull-in for riders. Plenty of bike presence, loud energy, and a come-as-you-are crowd. The patio stays busy, the music stays up, and the margaritas come out strong enough to make you forget the miles behind you.

This isn’t a white-tablecloth joint — it’s a boots-on-the-floor, kickstand-down kind of place. Good stop for group rides, bike nights, and meeting fellow road warriors. Service moves with the crowd, drinks hit right, and the vibe is all about freedom and fun. If you like your bars like your rides — a little wild and a lot memorable — it’s worth the detour.

googleReviews.author: Luda Lay
googleReviews.text:
I visited this bar within the past 2 weeks and I am.just now able to write about my experience and how degrated i felt. I rarely leave negative reviews, but this place deserves one. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was uncomfortable. The regulars and even the staff treated my friends and me with zero respect. The so‑called “manager” was especially disturbing — creepy, unprofessional, and constantly making unwanted sexual comments. After I tried to complain about the situation, he crossed the line further by making advances toward me and refusing to back off. He even turned his attention to my friends, hitting on them in ways that were completely inappropriate. Honestly, if he were the last man on earth, we’d still want nothing to do with him.

To make matters worse, the restrooms were absolutely disgusting. Toilets were leaking onto the floor, the smell was unbearable, and the whole setup looked neglected — exactly the kind of environment you’d expect from a place run this poorly.

If you value being treated with respect and basic cleanliness, beware. Margarita Island Bar is not the place to go unless you want to be harassed by creepy staff and sit in filth. One of the worst bar experiences I’ve ever had.

address: 901 NW 64th St, Oklahoma City, OK 73116, USA
about: Kat's Tavern is a bar in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. It holds a 4.7-star rating from 549 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Guin Geyer
googleReviews.text:
Kats Tavern delivers a refined yet welcoming lounge experience in one of the city’s most prestigious areas near Nichols Hills. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels elevated and comfortable, with cozy couches that make it easy to settle in and enjoy conversation or unwind after a long day.

One of the standout features is their exceptional happy hour — $2 specials available until 7 PM — offering impressive value without sacrificing quality or ambiance. It’s rare to find pricing like that in such an elite part of town, making it an excellent choice for both casual meetups and polished after-work gatherings.

The venue strikes a perfect balance between upscale and approachable. Guests can enjoy a relaxed social setting with amenities like dart throwing, adding a touch of fun to an otherwise sophisticated environment. Service is attentive, the crowd is respectful, and the overall tone is comfortably upper-class without feeling pretentious.

Kats Tavern is a smart choice for those looking for a stylish, comfortable, and well-located spot to relax, connect, and enjoy a quality happy hour experience.

googleReviews.author: NAIL’ A
googleReviews.text:
Kat’s Tavern is one of the best neighborhood bars around—perfect mix of fun, comfort, and great energy. The atmosphere is lively but still relaxed, making it a great place to hang out whether you’re with friends or just stopping by for a drink.

The staff is super friendly and attentive, and the drinks are always made right and served fast. You can tell they really care about customer service and making everyone feel welcome.

What really stands out is the vibe—karaoke nights are a blast, the crowd is always fun, and there’s plenty of space inside plus a great patio area. It’s clean, well-run, and just an all-around good time.  ￼

If you’re looking for a laid-back spot with great drinks, music, and a friendly crowd, Kat’s Tavern is definitely the place to go. Highly recommend!

The prices are reasonable for the quality of the drinks and food. Whether you’re stopping by for a casual drink or a night out, Kat's Tavern is definitely worth a visit!

The female bartender working made the night unforgettable—she was incredibly friendly, attentive, and so accommodating with anything we needed. googleReviews.author: Colton Waylon
googleReviews.text:
If you’re looking for a place with real character, great live music, and a laid-back crowd, White Water Tavern is absolutely worth checking out. I stopped in on a Friday night while visiting the area, and the atmosphere immediately stood out. It has that classic neighborhood bar feel that’s becoming harder to find these days — casual, welcoming, and full of personality without trying too hard.

The live music was the highlight of the night. The band sounded fantastic, and the acoustics inside the venue gave everything a raw, authentic vibe that made the performance feel personal. You could tell the crowd genuinely appreciated live music, not just background noise. People were singing along, enjoying drinks, and just having a good time without any drama or pretentiousness.

The bartenders were friendly and quick even when the place got busy. Drinks were reasonably priced, especially compared to larger music venues, and the staff made everyone feel comfortable whether you were a regular or visiting for the first time. I also liked how intimate the venue felt — no bad views of the stage and plenty of energy throughout the room.

What really makes White Water Tavern memorable is its authenticity. It doesn’t feel overly polished or commercialized. Instead, it feels like a true local music spot where artists and customers connect naturally. By the end of the night, it felt less like I had visited a bar and more like I had discovered a hidden local tradition. I’d gladly return anytime I’m back in Little Rock.

googleReviews.author: Cara
googleReviews.text: The White Water Tavern is a live music venue with  a laid back atmosphere.  The musical acts are diverse, from country, alt-country, hip-hop, metal, blues and more. There is music for everyone. Under the new ownership there has been an expansion of the outdoor patio area which is fully enclosed with a wooden fence. They serve great food, have great drinks. I've always enjoyed myself here and will continue to frequent. Keep up with the WWT on Facebook for dates, times of shows and the variety of music.

googleReviews.author: tunahan
googleReviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at White Water Tavern and overall it was a very enjoyable and memorable experience. From the moment I arrived, I noticed the welcoming and relaxed atmosphere that makes this place suitable for both casual dining and social gatherings. The interior has a comfortable, laid-back vibe that immediately puts you at ease, making it a great spot to unwind after a long day.

The food at White Water Tavern was impressive, with a variety of well-prepared dishes that offer both comfort and flavor. Everything I tried was served fresh, properly cooked, and nicely presented. The menu has a good balance of classic favorites and signature items, giving plenty of options for different tastes. Portions were satisfying, and the quality of ingredients was clearly noticeable in every bite.

The service was another strong point of the visit. The staff members were friendly, attentive, and efficient without being intrusive. They made sure orders were taken correctly and served in a timely manner, which added to the overall smooth dining experience. Even during busy hours, the team handled everything professionally and maintained a positive attitude.

Cleanliness and organization throughout the restaurant were also well maintained. Tables were tidy, the dining area was comfortable, and the overall environment felt well cared for.

Overall, White Water Tavern is a great place to enjoy good food, friendly service, and a relaxed atmosphere. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and enjoyable dining spot, and I look forward to visiting again in the future with friends and family.

googleReviews.author: Jessi Pacetti
googleReviews.text:
The White Water Tavern is exactly what you want in a classic local dive bar — laid-back, friendly, and full of character. If you love your neighborhood spot with a relaxed vibe, this is definitely the place to check out. The drinks are pretty consistent, and while they were out of my beer a couple of times, I didn’t mind too much — it just added to the feeling that it’s a real, no-pretense kind of spot where things happen spontaneously. The outdoor patio is a great bonus, especially on nice evenings when you want to soak up some fresh air while enjoying your drinks.

The music line-up is always interesting — whether it’s live bands or karaoke nights, there’s usually something going on that gets everyone involved and having fun. The crowd is pretty diverse, with everything from young 20-somethings to seasoned AARP members, which makes for a cool, eclectic atmosphere. It’s the kind of place where everyone feels comfortable, and there’s just good vibes all around.

And let me just say, their Catfish Basket was probably the best around — crispy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Plus, their French fries are absolutely unbeatable — can’t pass up those crispy, golden fries whenever I’m there. Like most good dive bars, the walls are covered with stickers, graffiti, and handwritten scriptures, giving it that authentic, gritty charm you just can’t find elsewhere. Overall, the White Water Tavern is a favorite local spot that I’ll be visiting again soon. It’s perfect for a casual night out or just hanging with friends in a relaxed setting. I highly recommend it!

googleReviews.author: Jadelin Calmes
googleReviews.text:
After sitting down at this bar the owner asked us to leave because my friends have ID’s that are not approved forms of identification for: flying domestically.
Not all driver licenses are acceptable forms of identification when flying domestically. Due to a new act coming in 2025, people that fly domestically will need to be “REAL ID” compliant. People that don’t fly domestically do not need to pay for the upgraded drivers license. I fly domestically frequently enough that I bought the upgrade for my drivers license, but my friends did not do that.
For the owners sake, it would be smart to read up on the difference between an ID card that is acceptable to use as a passport for domestic flights versus an ID card that is only for driving.
Note: a drivers license that can be used as identification for flying domestically is a “REAL ID” compliant ID. If a license says that it is not for “REAL ID” purposes, that does not mean that the license is fake. It only means that that person cannot use it as a passport.

The bar had a “homey” atmosphere. I had never been there, but I could tell that the people who frequent there were probably like family with the owner and staff. I was sorely disappointed that I couldn’t enjoy the live music and food due to a lack of awareness of drivers license updates

If you’re heading to Rock Lounge Bar, do yourself a favor and grab a seat at Dana’s bar—you’ll be in great hands.

googleReviews.author: Mr noname
googleReviews.text: Been here before and the ladies that work here are awesome. There was a long haired guy working when we came in at 9:30 for a shot and a drink and he said they weren't serving anymore. Bar closes at 10:00...Dude was just too lazy. If you don't want to bartend then don't do it. Won't be back here again, I rather go through the hassle of going off post.

googleReviews.author: Kristy Taylor

googleReviews.author: mark hurley
googleReviews.text: Punky's place advertises karaoke every night. We went on a Tuesday night have a few drinks and sing a song. We sat and had a few drinks and I asked the bartender if they had karaoke. Begrudgingly he said yes but only if people would sign up for it, And that he needed five people to sign up before he would start it. I told him not a problem I went up and put my name on the llist. He then got on the microphone and stated that if 5 people would sign up for karaoke that they would start it otherwise they would just continue to listen to the music. When he announced that a number of people got up and signed up. My name was first on the list. The bartender got up and announced that he would do the karaoke. He stated that he prefer to listen to the house music then to us. I don't know why they would advertise karaoke if the staff is going to behave like that. The patrons in the bar wanted to sing, many got up and signed up to sing. I know the bartender was unhappy for me asking him to start the karaoke. As I said my name was the first on the list. We sat there and when he did start the karaoke 4 people got up and sang but I wasn't called up to sing, we just left. Not a problem. We just won't return there are plenty of places to sing karaoke. I was just frustrated cuz it was my birthday and I hadn't been treated that poorly at ANY establishment before. It's unfortunate because Silva Lanes is close to my home and we were looking for somewhere to hang out on a regular. That is not the place

googleReviews.author: VBIED 2004
googleReviews.text: Some people say it needs a better sound system, but the system is ok. The KJ doesn't know how to work his keyboard to adjust for singers. He just puts on a song and let's it fly. Being an ex KJ you should always try to do your best to make the singers sound the best they can. Also the KJ was si ginger when there was a number of singers signed up. Over all it was a good environment and had a good time.

googleReviews.author: Chris G
googleReviews.text: Stopped in for a night cap and was surprised by the attention and craftsmanship to the cocktails. A huge selection of spirits to choose from and  bartenders did a good job of mixology and pairing of flavors . If your palette is open to variety of notes and flavor try looking at the list for  creative blends. If you want a simple beer or other still good selections to choose from . A good place for a first date or even date night with the spouse for good cocktails. Being emphasis on drinks was reluctant to try food choices but the birrhia  tacos were on point . Price point for drinks is what you expect for a craft cocktail and not a random watering hole . Enjoy what you drink and find one that fits for you . Will stop.in for a few more on my next visit .cheers

googleReviews.author: Salvanna
googleReviews.text:
If you're looking for a nice romantic quiet atmosphere this is the place. Great for a first date or just to sip & chill. The service is excellent and friendly, expertise is cocktails.
I have not tried their food but will soon.
Right next door is a more lively vibe with great music. This place is my first choice before anywhere else.

googleReviews.author: jacob pacheco
googleReviews.text:
Love the atmosphere,  it feels like we just up and left Albuquerque.  The food here is amazing, I have yet to try something I don't like. I recommend ANY of the Tacos (my faves). I am not a cocktail type person but look into each drink and you will definitely find something that suites you (Italian Stallion for me). And if you cant find a cocktail, traditional spirits and beers are also available.  The service is the best. Friendly, efficient, and if you ask the right questions,  you'll get a lot of great information about the products they use, the origin of the drinks and food.
They even hosted our company party and we couldn't have been happier.
A+++ all the way.

googleReviews.author: M
googleReviews.text: Wow. This place rocks! I was in town for a couple months for a project and ALWAYS ended up at The Copper Lounge. The drinks are DELICIOUS!! Every single time. Great food as well. What really makes this place special is the staff!!!! They are kind and efficient. I went in one night after a rough work day and immediately was greeted by one of my favs who noticed I seemed off and she was so kind to bring over my favorite drink (indian army) (be sure to try it) without me even asking and she just really brightened my day. If you’re in a party mood be sure to go next door to Conejos. Same owner. Totally different vibe. So. Much. Fun! I am sure I’ll be back at The Copper Lounge next time I’m in Albuquerque.

googleReviews.author: Shea Washburn
googleReviews.text: Rarely do I enjoy every single thing I order at a restaurant/bar, but Copper Lounge proved me SO wrong for that. Every cocktail I had was complex and delicious. And the food… maybe it was just my thirst for good Mexican food being quenched since I was visiting from NYC, but those were some of the best tacos I’ve had in a LONG time. One of the best parts though was the staff, everyone there was so welcoming, and the girl who helped us at the bar (Milly, I think?) was both courteous and HILARIOUS. Truly made me and my friends’ night. Come here if you want a fun vibe, delicious drinks and fire tacos.

googleReviews.author: BIxI dj
googleReviews.text: Food was not the best for sure wayyy too salty wings 😖 unless u already had quite a few drinks. Nice spot for a night out though dance dj music and people… Word is they do great from Thursday to Saturday along with some other downtown spots around

googleReviews.author: Hans Grim
googleReviews.text:
When they frisked me at the door, I probably should have taken that as a sign that the evening might be… an adventure. (Not kidding)

The staff was friendly enough and kept our drinks filled, which I appreciated. However, the food was a major disappointment. The description says “grill,” so we expected to be able to sit down and have a decent meal. Our party of six ordered a variety of things, though we had to adjust a bit because they were already out of fish and chips and pulled pork.

Unfortunately, most of what did arrive was barely edible. The wings were extremely salty—so much so that no one at the table could finish them. The quesadilla was also heavily over-salted, and the cheese tasted very much like Velveeta rather than anything freshly prepared. Oddly enough, the burger and fries actually looked pretty good, so that might be the safest bet if you’re determined to eat here.

What surprised me most was that several plates came back barely touched, yet no one from the staff seemed to notice or ask about it.

The churros with ice cream were actually quite good and ended the meal on a better note.

As a bar, the place seemed fine and the atmosphere was decent. But if you’re looking for a place to have dinner, I’d strongly suggest eating somewhere else first and coming here afterward for drinks.

googleReviews.author: Patrick Thomas
googleReviews.text: I tried two great wing places but Wing It Up was the best. This is a ghost kitchen inside of Boots and Burbon. These wings were fries to perfection. That's not easy to do with breaded wings. The flavors were absolutely amazing. I had Green Hatch Chili, Extra Hot Buffalo,  Carolina BBQ, and my favorite Lemon Pepper.  These were some of the best wings I've ever had. The fries had the salt and vinegar seasoning on them. This was amazing. You have to try this place. I'm serious! You will love it.

googleReviews.author: Kaylen Shane
googleReviews.text: If you're looking for the best bar atmosphere downtown you need to come to Bourbon and Boots and see all that it has to offer and from its great costumer service or their top quality specialty drinks it’s just great vibes all around.

googleReviews.author: Pouyan Moabed
googleReviews.text: I love this place! One of the last few places that still knows how to do something very simple, just let you have a good time!  My kind of place.

googleReviews.author: Darrel Mauzy
googleReviews.text:
Come watch great stages acts on Friday and Saturday nights from Vakenn and Bad Things to Black Pearl Band of New Mexico and Austin Van!!
Eat an absolutely delicious meal in The Crown Room (with reservations) then slip on over to the Lounge for a show. The menu is prefix @ $49.99/person and worth it. Crafted drink menu too. My wife and I went with the expectations of a small portion meal. We brought home leftovers!!

Ok, now side from that, the Cafe will full your belly with delicious chef cooked meals as well. Crazy great prices!!!! The Downs Double burger is my fave!!! WOW! Another great thing, you can order in the lounge and be served in the lounge as well without having to go to the café. Look out for the server, she doesn't talk and moves kinda like a robot... oh wait, because she is!! Fun to see.

Now it may seem like I'm biased because we host our watch parties (Denver Broncos Fans of New Mexico) at the First Turn Lounge inside the casino building. The truth is a spoken. Come see for yourself!! Secure facility inside and out.
They have happy hour with great drinks and food!

I am the founder and president of the official Denver Broncos fan group here in New Mexico. On Facebook, DENVER BRONCOS FANS OF NEW MEXICO. If you come to any watch party you can receive a punch card (for Super Bowl giveaways *see pics). The more watch parties, the more punches. Each full card give you an opportunity to win a great prize.
Even if football isn't your thing, come on for lunch, come with a coworker and enjoy a really good meal, like the wings or The Downs Double Green Chile Cheeseburger!

Always clean, always friendly staff.  Rev has gone out of his way to make this a go to venue!

A great place for local talent to perform. You can tear up the dance floor too.

A great outdoor patio overlooking the track.

googleReviews.author: Joan LL When

We love to dance, but This Lounge with a beautiful dance floor is NOT used for dancing after hearing many complaints from my other dancers it is frustrating to try and talk to them, about not filling most of the floor with table and chairs. They only need to remove two or three tables. They don’t care,  so, it’s better we go elsewhere. It’s such a shame; they could have a larger dance area. Dancers are always looking for a large dance floor.
We went dancing there last weekend, and they had one table nearly in the center of the dance floor. I banged into the edge of the table and ended up with a black bruise. Please give us plenty of space to dance, there are plenty of room between each sets of tables and chairs, so just push them back and be done with. Thank you!

I was surprised at how low the prices were on the menu, we'll its because the food is definitely "drunk food". It is not "high end", as I expected because its The Downs Casino.  I wouldn't eat lunch there again. The salad had so much onion in it, I couldn't tast anything else. The meat on the Fench Dip sandwich was so dry and flavorless. Chile cheese fries didn't even pass, The chile taste like it from a can. Carne asada tacos was so dry, not even worth the $2.50 it costs. You get what you pay for. Cheap prices, cheap service, cheap food. Definitely do not recommend this place.

googleReviews.text: Grace is a very nice bartender, my husband and I really appreciate her service and friendliness. She is one best bartenders that I've known. We will go back just to see her 🙂

googleReviews.author: Cherry Merian
googleReviews.text: This was my 2nd time at the Sunset Grille and I was more disappointed than the first time I went. A couple weeks ago I stopped in with my partner on a Friday night and the place was PACKED. It was so busy we barely found street parking. The bartender was an older woman who moved really slow and though she saw us, she ignored us. It took about twenty minutes to finally be served. I figured it was a busy night so no big deal. It was $18 for two beers (one on tap and one in the bottle, both domestic). A little pricey but ok, it's a local place. I can spend a couple extra for that. Tonight, another Friday, I drove by and the parking lot wasn't full at all, so thought I'd give it another shot. I live around the corner so maybe this could be a regular spot for me. As soon as I walked in, the bartenders started pointing at me and shouting something but I couldn't hear them over the sound of the band playing. Turns out they have a guy at the front. I showed him my ID and apologized for not seeing him when I walked in, and then he asked for an $8 cover charge! I told him there was no charge a couple weeks ago and he said oh well. $8 is a weird number. I see per previous reviews it was $5 a year ago. I was only there to grab one drink since I was driving so it wasn't worth it to me to pay $16 for one drink so I bailed. I'll stick to Uptown Sports or Quarter Celtic for now. I think y'all would have more of a crowd if you didn't charge the fee. Not everyone likes country music and I certainly wasn't there to hear that band play. Might give it one more try in the future but not anytime soon.

googleReviews.text:
The review is for the bowling alley only.

The positive: it was low-key and somewhat chill for my son's first time bowling. The staff was friendly and helpful. And ice cream cones are 99 cents!
The negative: It smells really bad in here, like feet or something. Every single seat is ripped and busted. I can't even sit on them because I'm wearing shorts and the torn plastic/vinyl is scratchy and hurts my legs. And it was really expensive compared to other bowling alleys.

googleReviews.text: The recent change from figurines and plushes in the prize machines is very disappointing. Spending the same price for items you can get for a few dollars at a grocery store is horrible. Even losing on the machines before didn't feel bad because the prizes were worth it. googleReviews.author: Rachel Machado
googleReviews.text: I liked the place it had security on the front of the building, easy to find access to the arcade area. Plenty of games and prizes to choose from.  They had the bowling and pool tables in separated areas very roomy.  They had a bar with a variety of drinks to choose your drink which I thought was pretty cool. The restrooms were clean. Overall a fun place to spend time with your family and they are opened late for the adults with no children to spend a chill time.

googleReviews.author: Hazel
googleReviews.text:
On Thursday afternoon I attempted to visit Round1 with my service animal and was ultimately denied entry.

When I first arrived, the security guard at the entrance told me “no pets,” and I clarified that my animal is a trained service animal, not a pet. He spoke to someone on his walkie, and allowed us entrance.

A few moments later, after another older security staff member inside visibly took issue with my animal, the first guard was sent back out to speak with me again. He informed me that the General Manager, Dinh, was refusing us entry because of the service animal, and also told me the manager had already left for the day and was unavailable to discuss it.

I want to make clear that I do not personally blame the guard who spoke with me. He seemed uncomfortable with the situation and appeared to simply be carrying out instructions he had been given.

My service animal was calm, under control, and not causing any disruption. While documentation is not legally required for a service animal, I do carry informational cards along with documentation from my doctor and veterinarian because I understand there has been a major increase in people falsely presenting pets as service animals in public spaces.

I’ve taken a few days to sit with the experience before posting this, and I have already filed an ADA complaint regarding the incident. I hope this situation is reviewed seriously so that others with legitimate service animals do not experience the same treatment.

googleReviews.text:
Went today while we are New Mexico and the lady bartender was very rude! My boyfriend and I are early 20s, the vibe was definitely older than that, but we sat down to eat and get a cocktail. The lady came over and we had our Oklahoma IDs out. My boyfriend still has the vertical one, but is of age to drink. She said we don’t accept that. When asked why because we didn’t understand she said, “we just don’t.” My boyfriend asked if it was still a valid ID and she said yes but she wouldn’t accept it. He also has a CAC, but she did not say we could use that instead. We still said we’d eat and I asked if I could have a drink menu. She said there is no drink menu. She left us after that over 15 minutes without getting an appetizer or drink when we wanted both. Finally got up and left after the other lady and the bartender wouldn’t come back to the table just stood and stared at us. This wasn’t at a busy time, and I am a server as well. I was very upset by the rude attitude and lack of care. Won’t go back for sure and if you’re from out of town be aware of the ID situation!!

Unprofessional response when I’ve seen the same thing listed in my review in others. Like the bad attitude and rude bartender. How are you going to tell me we refused service when we sat and waited on you for a very long time and even as we were leaving you didn’t ask if we wanted anything just oh you’re leaving? It’s my first review because I’ve never had this bad of service. Dive bars still have good vibes and actually thrive on it, but okay! As well, a CAC is a government issued ID. A very legal form of identification and as a server you should know what it looks like and where the date is.

googleReviews.author: Joseph Mulcahy
googleReviews.text:
Frustrated, weary, and nearly broken... I found my oasis in the desert. As a petite blonde serves Nectar of the God's, the Ukuladies play light-hearted covers of pop classics. Construction traffic? Fuel prices? BURN 'EM ALL. Or at least consider negotiating strenuously, in case that reads like inciting arson.

The Tatted Bee changed my entire disposition within minutes. My chief complaints evaporated in the ambience. Cold beer washed away my frustrations with hoppy context. I was revitalized. I became a younger man. This unassuming storefront became my Basilica of Booze.

Don't come here for the beer. If that's where your heart is, you can get that at a package liquor shop and you can cry alone in the shower with your pop top. At the Tatted Bee... you come to worship at the Chapel of Craft Cerveza and the gods will find you in their favor.

We ordered the tots with green chili as an appetizer and that was a great choice. If you are in the area, I recommend checking them out.
