The atmosphere is exactly what I'd hope for. Great music, a fun rock-and-roll vibe, strong drinks, and a place that doesn't take itself too seriously while still delivering a great experience.

The staff was friendly and welcoming from the moment we walked in, and the overall energy of the place made it easy to relax and enjoy ourselves.

One thing that deserves a mention is how easy it was to visit. Good parking can be surprisingly hard to find in some areas, so being able to swing by, grab a drink, enjoy the atmosphere, and head on our way without any hassle was a huge plus.

We'll definitely be back the next time we're in Denver.

googleReviews.author: Scott Parr
googleReviews.text: Love this place! Paul and his crew do an awesome job. Great atmosphere, service and they know how to make a good drink. Love all the big screens on game day, live music and karaoke is a blast. Definitely my favorite watering hole!

googleReviews.author: Fred Kitzmiller
googleReviews.text:
Steven is an amazing bartender! The service he gives is 1000/10. By far the best bartender I've had the pleasure of meeting.

Plus side Mozarts is an amazing establishment. Great prices and social environment. Everyone is so friendly here! Recommend checking this place out!

googleReviews.author: Steven Visentin
googleReviews.text:
The Mozart Lounge on Kramaria Street is a true Denver classic! This spot has been around for years, and it’s easy to see why everyone knows it and loves it. The atmosphere is cozy, timeless, and full of character — the kind of place where locals and newcomers feel instantly at home.

Whether you’re stopping by for a drink with friends, catching up with regulars, or just soaking in the laid-back neighborhood vibe, Mozart never disappoints. The bartenders are friendly, the music is great, and there’s always good energy in the room.

If you’re looking for an authentic Denver experience — not a trendy pop-up or chain bar, but a real community favorite — Mozart Lounge is the place to be. A true hidden gem that’s been shining for decades! 🍸🎶

googleReviews.author: Tiny TT

googleReviews.text: MHK delivers sound quality that's simply unmatched. googleReviews.text:
We want to give a big shoutout to Mile High Karaoke and its amazing owner for their incredible kindness and generosity! The owner stopped by our dental practice, Lakewood Complete Dentistry, to let us know he put our practice name on his karaoke screen to help spread the word and drive traffic our way.

Even though we haven’t experienced Mile High Karaoke firsthand yet, this thoughtful gesture speaks volumes about the character and community-minded spirit of the business. If the karaoke experience is anything like the kindness of the owner, we’re sure it’s fantastic!

Thank you for supporting local businesses and fostering such a welcoming and collaborative community. We truly appreciate your thoughtfulness and highly recommend checking out Mile High Karaoke! 🎤✨

googleReviews.author: Isabella Nieves
googleReviews.text:
The head bartender is amazing. Super chill atmosphere and the music is so loud but in a good way. Super spacious and there is pool as well as darts to entertain. Upstairs patio and great djs. Still in the works but very hard working staff. Anyone songs you want to add? Bartender accommodates and will add in w/in the week. 100% recommend.

Typical late night bar food but who cares when you’re havin’ fun and drinkin’.

googleReviews.author: Bobby Rogers
googleReviews.text: Finally!  A karaoke venue that isn't a dirty old dive bar.  Totally online booking, even to tee up your favorite tune. Clean and well managed.  The sound system is top-shelf and you can actually hear yourself (a blessing for some, not so much for others).  The down side is that the cocktails and food are fairly pricey.  Also, it is very crowded on the weekends and you can wait an hour (or more) to sing one song.  The staff is friendly and will help you navigate the online queue to sing.

googleReviews.author: Kristen Billows
googleReviews.text:
Rare Karaoke Café exceeded every expectation. After hosting a client event here, I decided to throw my son a surprise 21st birthday in a private room—and it was unforgettable. The staff was attentive yet wonderfully hands-off, never pushy, and allowed me to bring in my own cake.

What made the night truly special was seeing a group of young adults with special needs connect through music in such an inclusive, comfortable environment. Huge thanks to Bryan, the owner, and Curtis, the GM, who went above and beyond to answer every question and make sure our needs were met.

Highly recommend for corporate events, special-needs gatherings, or any celebration in between.

googleReviews.author: Ann Albrecht
googleReviews.text: First time here. Drinks were excellent. Bartender asked if I like my Old Fashioned sweet or not sweet. We were able to order food kinda late. We had a chicken Caesar wrap that was really good. The wrap was grilled which was amazing!! Karaoke is awesome!! My husband was able to sing a couple songs while we were here. We highly recommend Rare Karaoke Cafe!!

googleReviews.author: anna garrett
googleReviews.text: My daughter rented a private room for her and her friends. They had a blast and it was nice they could do all their favorite songs instead of picking from a set list of older generation music. We ordered some apps, the pretzel bites and garlic cheese bread were faves. The service was helpful and excellent. My daughter can’t wait to go back!

I reserved a room for just 2 people right when they opened and they were very prompt with doing so. They are very sweet and the people that helped me were very nice.

I’ve been to other karaoke rooms in Denver and the equipment was very out dated and there were long waiting periods. The room was clean and very well kept. The mics sounded great and there were a lot more accessible features we could do.

The vibe of the room is perfect for a going out night. The lights fit the vibe and it does feel very private,

I couldn’t recommend it even more!! Please continue to support this business!! ❤️

googleReviews.author: Linda Baroldy
googleReviews.text:
Recently hosted a birthday party here and we had a fantastic time! The staff was incredibly helpful and accommodating, which made the whole experience smooth and fun for our group.

Overall, such a fun spot and we’d absolutely come back!

The bar serves up all kind of Korean drinks and shot deals which also adds to the overall experience.  Had fun but the times slots are very strict since the places is quite small.

googleReviews.author: lovinanime100
googleReviews.text: This Noraebang is one of the best ones I've been to in Denver. The staff were really kind and accommodating even though we were late to our reservation. Overall it was such a fun time and I highly recommend noraebang to anyone looking for a good time!

googleReviews.author: Stefanie Ramsey
googleReviews.text: First time going to the Dublin House last night.  It’s a great atmosphere.  Our waitress Nicole was awesome. Full of good people from the staff to the patrons.   All just wanting to sing karaoke, dance and have fun.  We will definitely be back.  I promise to work on my tone deaf singing… had a blast though.

googleReviews.author: Corey Brown
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been going to Dublin House for years, and the fact that I’m only now writing this review feels like I should be legally required to issue a public apology. To the staff. To the city. Most importantly, to the Reuben.

Let’s get something straight immediately: this is not just a sandwich. This is a full-blown life event disguised as lunch.

I’ve had Reubens all over—places that brag about them, places that charge too much for them, places that serve them with the confidence of a Michelin star. And I’m here to report, with zero hesitation and full emotional stability, that they were all frauds. Every single one. This Reuben didn’t just raise the bar—it quietly removed it and replaced it with something unattainable.

I am not a dramatic person. I don’t exaggerate. I don’t use phrases like “best ever” unless I’m prepared to defend it in a court of law. And I will gladly take the stand for this sandwich. Hand on the Bible. Eye contact with the jury. No notes.

There are nights where I want absolutely nothing to do with humanity. I’m talking full shutdown mode—no conversations, no eye contact, no acknowledging that other people exist. And yet… I will still walk into Dublin House. Because this Reuben has that kind of pull. It has influence. It has authority. It could run for office and I would vote for it.

The moment it hits the table, it’s over. Perfectly stacked, hot, balanced like it was engineered by someone who clearly understands consequences. I tell myself I’ll slow down, savor it, be present… and then it’s gone in what can only be described as a medically concerning amount of time.

I’ve tried to order something else. I really have. But it feels like cheating. Like I’m betraying a sacred agreement between me and this sandwich. I can’t do it. I won’t do it. Stay loyal.

If you’re in Colorado Springs and you don’t order this Reuben, I genuinely don’t know what to tell you. That’s between you, your decision-making skills, and whatever higher power you answer to.

10/10. Flawless. Untouchable. If this sandwich ever disappears, I will not handle it well.

googleReviews.text: Best St. Patrick's day ever here in Springs I really enjoyed the food and atmosphere there was 2 different areas if I wanted to listen to different music. The service was great, I would definitely go back again.

googleReviews.author: Ai Websim.c
googleReviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Filed by John “Prairie Dog” O’Byrne, Former Disturber of Colorado Avenue (Est. 1888)
I have returned from the late 19th century to inspect what has become of my beloved Old Colorado City.
I am pleased to report: the spirit remains intact.
Upon entering Thunder & Buttons II — named for my elk, who once scandalized the civilized citizens by trotting where horses feared to tread — I expected reform, temperance, and disappointment. Instead, I found proper defiance.
Ordered the Lunch Pail: beer and a shot. Efficient. Democratic. Frontier-approved. The keg sputtered mid-pour like an 1880s mining operation, which only confirmed authenticity.
The barkeep (Chelsea — competent, sharp-witted, likely would have survived 1888) handled the chaos without flinching. Laughter loud enough to spook livestock. Respectable pour.
Upstairs karaoke produced noises reminiscent of coyotes disputing territory under a high moon. Downstairs allowed for strategic planning and mild mischief — exactly as a Colorado Avenue establishment should.
When I drove elk down this street, it was to annoy the uptown crowd. I am comforted to know the tradition continues.
Five stars.
Should the gentry object, I recommend they harness wildlife and build their own saloon.
— J. “Prairie Dog” O’Byrne
Elk Enthusiast. Civic Problem. OCC Loyalist.

googleReviews.author: Briana Foster
googleReviews.text:
It felt for older people with older musical hits. It was not a highlight for me. At first I couldn’t find much about this place and my husband literally had to run in to find out if we would be able to attend the show. Not too much information online, very confusing.no pricing listed ($10 each person to get in)

When the show started they asked for requests through Venmo or napkin hitting at a top with it. I only left a dollar for my song request because they didn’t communicate what was a good “tip suggestion”. They played someone’s song who gave $10 tip right away. We stayed for an hour and a bit and they never played my songs even though they claimed to “have the show determined my the guests”. I just noticed they played a lot of wedding type songs for the older generation. If you are 20s I wouldn’t say this is your vibe. Maybe they didn’t know the songs I suggested which is fair. But then just stick with what you know.

It was very impressive they could all play different instruments and sing. The girl singer was amazing. But not really my vibe, I wouldn’t go back.

Also no prices on the menu irritated me as well. They lack communication in a lot of areas.

Also if you make a song suggestion I’d say write it on a napkin with a big tip.

Also our waiter was nice and on top of getting us drinks which was great.

googleReviews.author: Arianna Faye
googleReviews.text:
Brigette’s Last Laugh is an absolute gem of a dive bar. We stumbled in on a Tuesday because we were desperately trying to find karaoke somewhere, and somehow they were the only place that had it going. Instant win.

Karaoke every single night of the week?! Iconic.

The drinks are reasonably priced, the vibes are immaculate, and the crowd was genuinely fun and welcoming. The woman running karaoke is phenomenal, organized, engaging, and just the right amount of hype. And the karaoke system itself is amazing. They use an app that makes everything so easy and smooth, total quality-of-life upgrade compared to most karaoke spots.

Pool tables, good people, great energy, it checks every box you want in a dive bar.

We’re from out of town, but you can bet anytime we’re back, Brigette’s is our go-to karaoke spot. 10/10 would absolutely belt my heart out there again.

googleReviews.author: James Boyce
googleReviews.text:
I'm submitting this review in the hopes the management will read it. My wife and I were regulars at Bridgett's for karaoke, once a week at least was the norm. What we loved was that every time we walked in it was a balance of familiarity, yet not too much, because the regulars were always there, but a nice variety of people would mix in.
I don't know if DJ Ty is no longer there or if we're just not choosing the right nights, but he was the best. His nights always had the best variety of singers. You'd get pop, rock, metal, R&B, reggae, country, you name it, and such appreciation from both Ty and the crowd in general.
Now, I don't know. We've almost stopped going entirely. Too much metalcore B.S. by a DJ that doesn't seem to welcome much else, and so the crowd has gotten nastier and less fun. Quite frankly it's turned us off, and people we used to enjoy seeing have mysteriously gone missing. I wonder why.
Look, I like hard rock and metal. I grew up on it. It's just not what should dominate a karaoke night, in my opinion, and given the disappearance of a lot of people who used to come in to sing, I don't think I'm alone.
Now, management, if metalcore dominance is the future of Bridgett's karaoke, and if it's packing the place and business has never been better, so be it. Who am I to judge? God bless ya. It just won't include much of me. We'll just maybe poke our heads in once a month instead of once a week and see if things have improved.

googleReviews.text:
An otherwise perfect night of service. But I gave 2 slips to the karaoke guy over the course of 3 hours and he ignore. Eventually the 3rd slip worked. I guess I’ll come back again lol

googleReviews.author: Lisa Chapman
googleReviews.text: This is a great concept but is executed incredibly poorly and unprofessionally. We showed up on time only to stand and wait for 10 minutes while the employee was on the phone. I decided to navigate ourselves to our own room only to discover it was much too small for our party size even though that is what an employee told me to reserve.  There was even a sign on the wall saying we were limited to six people and we had seven.  But even then, these rooms are incredibly small and the furniture is under scaled.  Since we were the only people there, I asked if we could upgrade to a larger room at no cost and he said yes and puts us in a room that we liked, got settled in and then he came back and said no you can't be here my boss will get mad at me it's VIP and moved us to another room.  So that's a good 15+ minutes of time we didn't get out of our two hours. Then an hour and a half in he burst through the door and says that we were half hour over and I said "No, I booked it for 2 hours."  He looked confused.  Every song we wanted we had to look up on YouTube and watch commercials. And settings were difficult or not able to change (like the reverb) and the employee couldn't help.  We promptly left at the 2-hour mark But felt like I could have and should have asked to stay longer. And when we checked out I paid without questioning the amount but was significantly overcharged. And I have called and left messages three times to try to talk to someone about getting a partial refund and I have not had one single call returned.

googleReviews.author: Alysse Normoyle
googleReviews.text:
The rooms were so fun! We started in the Marilyn Monroe room and were having such a great time that we asked to stay longer—they were kind enough to move us to the Japanese Suite, which I actually preferred out of the two.

They had a great music selection, and a lot of the songs play with music videos and lyrics on screen, which made it even more entertaining.

Everything was reasonably priced—the rooms, drinks, and food. We ordered the garlic edamame, gyoza, vegan udon stir fry, kimchi fried rice, and the munchie fries. Everything was delicious, and I’d definitely order most of those again.

The staff were friendly and helpful. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a fun karaoke night with good food & drinks!

Went here last week for a friend's birthday and had a blast! We had a private room that was decked out with a plush wrap around couch, large screen TV, and kiosk to select songs. The room came with two mikes and we could be as loud and fun as we wanted!

For drinks and food they have a QR code you can scan and a server will come to you. It is an easy system as you can keep singing and enjoying yourself without having to go to the bar. But, they have this option as well!

Only suggestion would be to add a couple of additional bathrooms somewhere as there is just one of each. Compared to the size of the place I think there should be at least four or more.

googleReviews.author: Matthew Hurtt
googleReviews.text:
I travel some for work, so I’m always looking for a local bar wherever I am. I went to Gypsy’s three days in a row on a recent work trip, and the service is really great.

Eva (or perhaps Ava) and Maria are rockstar bartenders. Really great service. Definitely my “spot” when I come into Phoenix.

I didn’t order food, but everything that came out of the kitchen looked and smelled great.

Plus, there’s a TouchTunes jukebox.

googleReviews.author: Nate Petz
googleReviews.text: The bartender sucked!!! She just needs to learn to watch the door and bar on when someone comes in. I went in and found a seat at the bar. Then some other guys came in about 5 minutes after me. They walk straight up to the bar and get service. She helped a couple other people then finally got to me. Yeah that’s not gonna get me to come back or give a very good review. I ended up going next door and got great service and their kitchen was still open.

googleReviews.author: Jose Junio
googleReviews.text: Gypsy’s Roadhouse is one of my favorite go-to spots for karaoke nights in Phoenix. The stage setup is solid, good lighting, decent sound, and the song queue is well managed so you actually get a turn. The crowd is lively but not rowdy, making it fun whether you’re singing or just watching. Drinks and bar snacks are reliable without fuss, and the overall vibe feels casual and welcoming. It’s a spot I feel comfortable dropping into on a weeknight or weekend for a fun round of singing with friends.

googleReviews.author: Matthew Burkett
googleReviews.text:
f you're in Phoenix and looking for a fun and lively dive bar, Gypsies Roadhouse is definitely worth a visit! This place has a great atmosphere and is perfect for grabbing a few drinks with friends or playing a game of pool on one of their three tables.

But let's talk about the real star of the show here: the food. The smash burger at Gypsies Roadhouse is seriously tasty and definitely not to be missed. It's loaded with flavor and will leave you feeling satisfied and happy. The only downside? The fries were a little over-seasoned for our taste, but that's just a minor quibble.

If you're feeling a little more adventurous, we highly recommend the green chili cheese crisp and salsa. These are the perfect complement to your burger or any other dish you decide to try. The cheese crisp is crispy and loaded with gooey cheese and green chili, while the salsa has just the right amount of kick to keep things interesting.

And we can't forget to mention the staff, especially Lindsey! She's a fantastic bartender with a fun personality that will keep you entertained all night long. Whether you're in the mood for some good conversation or just want to kick back and relax, she's always up for a good time.

So, if you're looking for a fun and tasty spot in Phoenix, make sure to stop by Gypsies Roadhouse. You won't be disappointed!

googleReviews.author: Angela Salas
googleReviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Amazing food and great vibes!
I stopped by Gypsy’s Roadhouse and tried The Tuna Melt—absolutely delicious, perfectly grilled, and packed with flavor. The onion rings were golden, crispy, and some of the best I’ve ever had! Huge thanks to Ryan, the cook, for making everything just right. You can really taste the care that goes into the food here. Highly recommend stopping in—you won't be disappointed!

googleReviews.text:
The Nugget has alway’s been a fun loving place for me and my pals.  I was there about two weeks ago to support a friend in a karaoke contest.  James sang his heart out and came in second place.
Didn’t eat any food…

googleReviews.author: Norma Triana
googleReviews.text: Most elegant bar I've been to, don't let the outside fool ya, they're working on it :D

googleReviews.author: Vanessa Ruiz
googleReviews.text: I celebrated my last 3 birthdays at The Nugget and they were all absolutely unforgettable! The staff went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, from the decorations to the impeccable service. The ambiance was lively and fun, creating the perfect atmosphere for a celebration. The drinks were top-notch, and the bartenders ensured my glass was never empty. All my guest loved the music and vibes so much that they have all started having their birthday celebrations there. The food from Bahndicted was delicious and I love to go grab a bite and a drink at the patio! Thank you to THE NUGGET for making my birthday so special!  Can’t recommend this place enough.

googleReviews.author: Paulette D
googleReviews.text: The Nugget is such a special place. From the moment you arrive you’re greeted by fabulous security. All of them are super kind and caring and take their job seriously ensuring that you feel safe. Before entering the door you can find a beautiful patio where you can enjoy their new bar and be sure to check out the Banhdicted food truck where Donnie is cooking up the best Banh Mis in Tucson. Super friendly and helpful if you have any questions with the items on the menu. I highly recommend the popcorn shrimp with the lemongrass Mayo, Chicken Banh mi with fries and their Iced Coffees are a really great pick me up. If you’re not too hungry don’t worry they have some snacks you can ask or be offered inside. Once you’ve ordered and are waiting for your food make your way inside for my personal favorite recommendation for the Lavender Collin’s if you enjoy vodka. Not too sweet but just right and has such a delicious flavor to it and ALL of the bartenders do such a fabulous job recreating the drink and they are all so kind and approachable. The ambiance and music is ALWAYS a vibe and not to mention their Karaoke nights that bring in such talented singers from all around. Any night of the week you can’t go wrong, which is nice for people who don’t have a regular schedule. If you happen to stop by and your lucky enough to meet the owner and his lovely dog your in for a real treat. The sweetest most caring person I have had the honor of meeting super kind, attentive and an all hands on deck kind of person. It truly shows why this is such an amazing place to visit because the example is lead from the very top. The effort that goes into your visits here shows and personally is so appreciated by me personally.

googleReviews.author: Classy Entertainment
googleReviews.text: Fantastic hospitality every time! We run a party bus business in Tucson and regularly bring birthday groups to The Nugget—and let me tell you, they treat our clients and driver like VIPs. From the moment we pull up, the staff is welcoming, respectful, and always ready to make the night unforgettable. They’re organized, accommodating, and genuinely appreciate the energy we bring. Our guests rave about the service, and our driver gets treated with the same level of courtesy, which says a lot about their professionalism. If you're planning a celebration, The Nugget knows how to deliver good vibes and great service. Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: ESTRELLA FINDZ
googleReviews.text:
If you are searching for the ultimate destination to unleash your inner rock star, look no further than Margarita Bay in Tucson. Our latest visit for their karaoke night was an absolute blast, filled with high-energy performances and a crowd that knows how to have a great time. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is electric, blending a laid-back tropical vibe with the thrill of live entertainment. It was a night of pure amazement as local singers took to the stage, delivering everything from soulful ballads to high-octane party anthems that kept the entire room on its feet.
​The venue truly excels at making everyone feel like a headliner. Whether you are a seasoned vocalist or a first-timer looking to check karaoke off your bucket list, the supportive environment and top-tier sound system make all the difference. Between the sets, we enjoyed some of the most refreshing drinks in the city, perfectly complementing the festive mood. The service was prompt and friendly, ensuring that the focus remained on the fun and the music. For anyone in the Tucson area looking to spice up their weekly routine, Margarita Bay delivers an unforgettable experience where the fun never stops and the talent never ceases to amaze. Don't miss out on the best vocal party in town! 🌟👀🎤🎤💃💃💯🍸🍸

googleReviews.author: Arthur Delsing
googleReviews.text: This place is not about thw food or even atmosphere. It is a good place to go chill early in the evening, nice bartenders and nice people. Later, you get some great karaoke going for fun and enjoyment. Listen, drink, play pool. And sing if you want. Great times gives it 5 overall.

googleReviews.author: David
googleReviews.text: Best Karaoke bar in town.  I drive from the west side of town because MB is worth it.  The staff is friendly and welcoming, the food and drinks are well-priced and the Karaoke family is amazing! No night is the same, except for the fact that they're all fun. I truly appreciate how encouraging everyone is with each other. This place helped me fall in love with Karaoke.

googleReviews.author: Alexis Olender
googleReviews.text: I used to enjoy this place alot, unfortunately I’ve had a bad experience when bringing friends here that makes me, frankly, embarrassed to even bring them to this establishment. There’s a one drink limit to sing karaoke which is very understandable and was told to everyone before coming, including my sober friend. Said friend purchased a soda (mind you, same price as their cheapest alcoholic drink) so he could participate in karaoke. After his first song, he was told by staff to purchase more to sing more. The rest of us that did purchase alcoholic drinks did not have the same restrictions to continue to sing karaoke. To me ans the rest of us, this seemed like a targeting whereas they were targeting a sober individual which seemed strange as we needed a sober person to drive us here in the first place. It was an uncomfortable situation, and if there were rules in place that “singing more than one song requires alcoholic drinks to be purchased” than we would have understood and went somewhere different. The fact that this bar targeted our designated driver just because he wanted to join us in singing more than one song is something that should be made clear beforehand.

googleReviews.author: Quinn Martinez
googleReviews.text: They will try to force you to buy more drinks in order to sing even if you HAVE bought alcohol and spent your money on the soda that’s the same price as the beer. They do not let you know about the policy to sing and don’t have it posted anywhere. If you just wanna sing or don’t want to drink a lot (or at all) this is not the place for you

googleReviews.text:
The Surly Wench is always a blast, but Chelsey takes the experience to a whole new level. From the moment you sit down, she makes you feel like you’re exactly where you’re supposed to be—whether you’re a regular or just wandering in for the first time.

Chelsey is everything you want in a bartender: quick, attentive, hilarious, and totally in control even on a packed night. She mixes a killer drink (seriously, her pours are perfect), and somehow still finds time to crack a joke or give a genuine smile. Her energy keeps the place buzzing, and you can tell she’s a big part of why the vibe is so electric.

The Surly Wench is known for being bold, wild, and unforgettable—and Chelsey fits that spirit perfectly. If you’re looking for a fun night out with strong drinks, great music, and a bartender who absolutely gets it, look no further.

Chelsey is a rockstar. Don’t miss your chance to grab a drink from one of the best in the game.

googleReviews.author: Malino Logini
googleReviews.text: Better than IBTS if your looking for a gay bar. Kali and Chuck are amazing! the rest of the bartenders (new staff), will take any chance they get to be as aggressive/harsh/rude as they can on some power trip, iv watched them escalate very minor situations into whole episodes for no reason at all. Something as light as someone not tipping enough, making a joke, setting their drink on a rail, being approached straight away with yelling, its embarrassing for everyone in the bar to see, the last thing I wanna be listening to is the bartender having a tantrum.  at the same time iv seen Kali calm down the most rowdy drunks and get them to leave on a friendly note. Empty most of the time, even when its packed you wont see a soul dancing. Pizza overpriced. Electronic meters on every liquor bottle guarantees your drink is underpoured so that the employees don't get their checks tapped from, so don't bother with anything that doesn't come bottled/canned. Parking requires a QR code, if you have any mind for your personal device privacy do not scan the code or use the bar wifi. Nice patio/ bathrooms and pool tables though.

googleReviews.text: Best place to stop for a bite to eat and good company. Been going here for years and Kali, Hayley and Brandon are just a jewel to hang around. Great service and food as well( you gotta try the breakfast canzone option 2) 20/10 would go again and again.

googleReviews.text: Super laid back chill bar. I came on a Thursday and they had line dancing! Seems a little quiet for a bar but so does a lot of Tucson. Strong drinks and AMAZING homemade ginger ale you cannot miss.

googleReviews.text: I love coming to Sky Bar! It's a lay back bar with great energy. The staff is amazing. Tues are Karaoke night from 4pm-10pm! DJ Chuck Healey is fantastic. Wednesday are open Mic and a ton of fun to watch. They have pool tables (3) in total. Come on in and have a great time. googleReviews.author: Alisha Hernandez
googleReviews.text:
I wasn't sure if I was going to like this place.  I am glad I gave it a try.  The restaurant was not busy at the time we went.  The restroom was clean.  it took me a moment to figure out which was the boys and which was the girls.  It was so funny how they identified that on the doors!

Our server greeted us and took our drink order.  We received our beverages very quickly.  I did not realize this restaurant did not use name brand such as Pepsi or Coke products.  When I told him I did not like the taste of the soda, he was quick to fill another for me to try and when that did not work, he took back the beverage without issues.

He took our food order and answered all the questions we had.  The food arrived warm and was very flavorful.  The portions were very good.

The atmosphere was appealing and gave us something to look at while waiting for the food.  The temperature of the restaurant was comfortable.  The prices were good.  I find it a bummer that everyone is charging to use credit/debit when they do not offer other electronic methods since cash is not a normal way to purchase these days.

googleReviews.author: Koh Yuan Chen
googleReviews.text:
Came on a Saturday evening. Dining hall was pretty empty with around 3 tables filled. Seat yourself type of restaurant. Slow service and our food was left sitting on the counter for a good 5 minutes before serving. Ordered iced water and it only came after the other 2 tables paid their checks and left.

Ordered 3 mocktails, their St Patrick's Day meal, meatloaf, wings to share, and their new Gravy Train option for their fish and chips. The mocktails were disappointing and was sugar syrups with water.

Had high hopes of the St Patrick's Day meal but the corned beef were too thin and didn't have much flavour and chew to it. Toast was burnt and couldn't choose the type of bread. Surprisingly the portion was not as I hoped for it to be. Ordered buffalo wings but was given it with hot sauce instead. Fish and chips was average and the coleslaw wasn't fresh and the mayo sauce with it just wasn't good and watered down. The meatloaf however was fantastic, so glad we were sharing or else would've definitely left the place unhappy. Meatloaf of good size, tasted good, and the tater tots side was fantastic.

googleReviews.author: Sarah Fries
googleReviews.text: Love that I finally tried this Tucson hidden gem! The diner in the front is super cute and the staff was helpful and attentive. I tried their famous meatloaf and opted for the chicken fried version of the Bad Attitude and it was tasty - the mushrooms were cooked perfectly and the meatloaf was delicious. The only thing that would have made it better was a bit more horseradish mayo. The Styx pretzels are AMAZING I loved the cheese sauce (didn't try the gravy because I'm not a gravy fan). Lots of parking in the back and a cute bar on the other side of the building if you want to grab a drink. Will be back again to keep trying new stuff from their gigantic menu!

googleReviews.author: Chaz Davis
googleReviews.text: I absolutely love Bumsteds. This has become one of my regular spots not only because of how kind everyone is and how welcoming the atmosphere always is but also for how many events and things they have to do here! I love Thursday Karaoke nights with Lady Magnum, but I also love that they have it every other night on Friday, Saturday but especially Sunday funday. They have a Loteria Burlesque show and Circus burlesque show that are so much fun!! The circus show is the BEST show ever!!! They have such diverse talent that I’ve never seen and highly recommend going to the circus!

googleReviews.author: Jai S
googleReviews.text: This place is truly a hidden gem!  We’ve driven by this location many times and never noticed it before.  We hung out and ate in the bar area, but they do have an old-timey diner-like restaurant connected to the bar.  The menu is huge!  We had the pork belly appetizer, which was delicious.  I opted for the Meatloaf Sole sandwich and my husband had the Marvin meatloaf sandwich, but he got his ‘chicken fried.’  Our friend ordered the Mac Daddy mac n cheese with hunks of meatloaf in it and we ended by splitting a warmed up peanut butter chocolate tart.  Everything was fantastic and the staff are super friendly.  Highly recommended.  We will be back for sure!!

googleReviews.text: I love this little dive bar.  I'm always surprised when I get my bill because the drinks are so cheap. The bartender, Hugh is amazing. googleReviews.text: We did not contribute to the mirror of kisses by the bathroom. Came here for the first time over the weekend. We asked the bartender (who was sooo fine btw) to surprise us & she made us a big Red Bull drink with duckies in them. It was so good. The DJ was playing so many good songs to turn up to. The patio had loud music as well & the Prince mural was awesome across the street. There is places to sit down if you don’t wanna stand or dance the whole time.

googleReviews.author: Mike Flemming
googleReviews.text:
Monkey Bar is the kind of place you end up calling your spot. They have Dragoon IPA on tap, which is my favorite beer and one of the best West Coast IPAs in the country in my opinion. It's brewed right here in Tucson, so grabbing one means I’m supporting two local businesses at once.

The vibe is exactly what I want in a bar. It has that welcoming neighborhood feel where everyone gets treated like they belong. The staff is always friendly and helpful, and when the owners are around, they’re just as approachable and easy to talk to. No attitude, no weird bar politics, just good people.

Happy hour prices are solid, and you’re welcome to bring your own food, which is a rare and underrated perk.

If you’re looking for a place with great beer, a relaxed atmosphere, and people who make you feel at home, Monkey Bar nails it.

googleReviews.author: java kyng
googleReviews.text: So yeah I just got reamed out by Theo the bartender for not buying 2 drinks for a tournament that I didn't even win. I've spent hundreds of dollars in this place as a local and for the one day I only had one beer , I get persecuted. $1.00 tip extra is what you would of got so ( was it worth it theo?)  Now you hurt the tournament operator because a bunch more people who you acted out violently in front of will never show up again. I want to mention that Hugh is an awesome bartender so whenever he is working I would show up but his brother is bad news.  Really sucks for the owner to put up with this.

googleReviews.author: Laura L.
googleReviews.text:
Where do I even begin?! This was our first time doing karaoke in a private room and the amount of fun we had was OFF. THE. CHARTS. We sang. We danced. We ate. We drank. We absolutely embarrassed ourselves in the best way possible.

The system is super easy to use — but if you get confused, just hit the big red button and someone comes QUICK to save the day!

The food was good, the service was impeccable, and the entire experience was unforgettable. 10/10 would absolutely do it again the next time we’re in town!

googleReviews.author: Madelyn Noh
googleReviews.text: Amazing place! Would come here again, food was great service was great and drinks were great as well especially the lychee love cocktail I loved! We had the kalbi tacos, fries, prosciutto flat bread, egrolls, poke nachos, and the dukkboki. Food was amazing, I was very impressed and satisfied. The size and decoration of the room was great and the technology was top notch. Really felt like an elevated Korean karaoke place. Our server Donny was amazing, super professional, helpful and friendly. I hope to come here again with my friends and family.

googleReviews.author: Steph Mazzaferro
googleReviews.text:
As a huge karaoke fan, I was genuinely excited for our visit to Kuma, which made the reality of the experience all the more disappointing. We booked and paid for a three-hour session, yet, similar to another reviewer’s experience, staff repeatedly interrupted us every 30 minutes to tell us our time was up.

These interruptions weren’t just frequent; they were handled in a rude and condescending manner. On one occasion, a staff member tapped her watch at us, and when we tried to calmly explain that we hadn’t even been there for an hour yet, she cut my friend off mid-sentence and said, “No, time is up.” This forced my friend to leave the room to prove our purchase and time of entry.

Even after showing proof that we were well within our booked time, the interruptions continued every 30 minutes like clockwork. Not once did anyone acknowledge the mistake, apologize, or attempt to make things right. To make matters worse, despite all the check-ins to rush us out, no one ever asked if we wanted to order anything or needed assistance. Just constant pressure to leave early.

A karaoke experience should be fun and immersive, not stressful and combative. Being repeatedly rushed, spoken down to, and made to defend time we had already paid for completely ruined the experience. I won’t be returning, and I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone looking for an enjoyable karaoke night.

Edited to Add: they also charged us a 20% gratuity, which while under normal circumstances is totally fine, was absolutely wild considering the circumstances.

googleReviews.author: Yahaira
googleReviews.text:
We went here as a party of 8 for my sister's wedding celebration. I called a week in advance to book a specific room and when I talked to the person they said they would honor the free bottle of champagne that you get when booking online.

When we arrived on Saturday the hostest confirmed that the reservation was for 3 hours but refused to provide the champagne special that we were told would be honored. The hostest told us that when the individual that booked us arrived we could work it out.  There was no follow thru on this and never received the bottle. Just FYI as it's a constant ad on their website for those looking online.

The room itself was clean and comfy. The room was deff a vibe with the decor and lights.  The karaoke system itself had difficulties and the host had to come in several times to fix it.  We ended up singing random songs that seemed to be cast from a diff room to ours while we waited for resolutions.

The service here is extremely bad. I don't know if they were trying to scam us or if they had miscommunication at the front. We had 3 different workers come to us every 30min telling us our hour was up and had to pay for another hour. Luckily someone in our party took a picture the moment we arrived and we used that as evidence to prove our start time. They then attempted to make us leave after an hour and a half. I had to repeatedly remind them that I had booked for 3 hours and confirmed as much when we checked in.

In the 3 hours we were there we received water once. We repeatedly asked for more and received none until a male friend physically stood there and waited for the water. The same thing happened when we ordered drinks. We just gave on asking for drinks after that.

Even though the service is horrible and we received 2 cups of water and 1 drink they tipped themselves over 100 dollars. Tip is automatic so beware of that.

We love karaoke and had a blast celebrating; it was just disappointing that we had to deal with all this craziness the entire 3 hours we were there.

googleReviews.author: Sara
googleReviews.text: shout out to the highly accommodating staff! alyssa was incredibly kind and helpful. super cool setup as well. great for groups. would recommend 100%!

googleReviews.author: Stephanie Batista
googleReviews.text: Had a great experience in this karaoke place! My family surprise me with a bridal shower. Our room is very clean and big. Sound system is very nice. Song selection is endless. Food is great! We had chicken wings, fries, teriyaki chicken, etc  We really love their service and overall experience. I highly recommend this place for party needs and hangout with friends. They have all you need! 5++ stars!!

googleReviews.author: Mike
googleReviews.text: I booked a room for a birthday party. The room was nice and spacious. However, it took us 30min to start because the machine wasn’t working properly. And I’m very upset at the fact that I was told I would get a free hour and sodas were $3. I paid a $100 deposit and booked for 3 hours. Therefore, I was only required to pay $100, and the 3rd hour was supposed to be free. He overcharged me and still made me pay for the 3rd hour. I knew about the gratuity, but they also added an additional service charge of 7%…also, instead of serving us the fountain drinks, our server brought in cans at $5 a can. Then charged $20 for 3 sips of a margarita. This place is way overpriced and I recommend you go elsewhere. I tried to discuss this with the manager and he was very dismissive and added a charge for the extra hour ANYWAY. Never again.

googleReviews.author: Kelly Daley
googleReviews.text:
Went here for their Brunch & Bingo on a Saturday, hosted by BrokenOpenENT, from 11am-3pm. The atmosphere was fantastic, but that was it! Unless you're renting this place for an event, it's not worth it.

You had to get the food and drinks yourself. No waitress. And they only had 1 bartender on a Saturday. Again, no waitress unless you pay for a VIP table.
They charged $33 for "bottomless" mimosas with ANDRE's champaign! (Smallest glass ever) And $10 for a KROGER bottle of water! Are you serious 😡 👎 Plus, all bills already have 18% gratuity added, without an itemized receipt.
Food was low standard.
We had to stand in line, again, for any drink refills.
I will never come again.

googleReviews.author: Gianna Strong Javate
googleReviews.text: Moonlight Karaoke hosted my birthday party and it was seriously the best time! The vibe, the music, and the way they kept everyone involved made the night unforgettable. They were organized, professional, and so much fun. The sound system was great and they had a huge song selection. All my friends kept saying how much they loved it. If you want a party that people will remember, book Moonlight Karaoke!

googleReviews.author: Brian Ines
googleReviews.text:
This is definitely a really cool Karaoke Bar that sits randomly in Henderson. If you don’t want to go to the Spring Mountain area for Karaoke then this is the spot for you.

The ambiance of this whole location is amazing even from the very door you enter through. You’re greeted at the entry way with a bar filled with RGB and reflection. And this lighting continues all the way to your karaoke room.

I wasn’t the one who rented the room so I can’t speak on that part of service, but ordering drinks was a breeze as a server will come in and ask if you need anything. Also if they happen to be busy, you can always go to the bar and order whatever you’d like. I haven’t tried to food either so I won’t be able to recommend anything in that department. But I do know that walking through the hallway, the kitchen smell lingers through the hallways which is an advertisement in its own.

The karaoke room we were in was a bit more high scale with the interior decorations and the couches reminding me of an upscale Las Vegas hotel. We didn’t go through the selections on the karaoke machine because we kept picking random YouTube songs.

The vibe of the place is just really relaxed and fun! The MC, Blue, was amazing and absolutely made our time there, and she was my friend's, "favorite MC of any karaoke bar she has ever been to." Great DJ too. If you're looking for something to do to make fun memories, I definitely recommend this place.

googleReviews.author: Andrea Harris
googleReviews.text: Was really looking forward to karaoke with my daughter. It was the strangest experience.  The host sang full songs in between each singer. We had no interest in listening to a one person show.  The place was dead and there was a guy below giving out free cover tickets.  You would probably attract more people of you let more of the patrons sing.  We left before singing.  Disappointing.   There is a reason why your business is not thriving.

googleReviews.author: bartellj
googleReviews.text:
Better hope your karaoke song is on their list. If you wanna hear the same old karaoke songs, this is your bar. If you want to have the freedom to sing any song you want choose a different bar. The staff and the atmosphere is fantastic. I was really looking forward to singing some  “Bad Company feel like making love” or “ Tenacious D “ but it was not on the list along with five other songs I was hoping to sing. Yes. I realize I’m a grumpy man. I just wanted to be able to have the freedom to sing karaoke songs that are normally at any other karaoke bar.
Please update your karaoke list !

googleReviews.author: Kemoni Bailey
googleReviews.text:
I went to Cats Meow Karaoke Bar with a group expecting a fun, carefree night, and instead left feeling completely disrespected and unwelcome.
During our visit, we were told they wouldn’t play “our music,” followed by comments that they “don’t want us there” and even “don’t want our kind there.” I want to be very clear those are the words that were said to us.
In a place that’s supposed to be about music, fun, and bringing people together, being spoken to like that is beyond unacceptable. It wasn’t just dismissive it felt targeted, intentional, and deeply offensive. No one should ever walk into a public establishment and be made to feel like they don’t belong.
What made it worse was seeing how other groups were treated differently at the same time served, acknowledged, and allowed to participate without issue. That contrast made the situation even more uncomfortable and hard to ignore.
I’m not here to exaggerate or twist anything this review is based strictly on what was said and how it was experienced. And what was said raises serious concerns about how customers are viewed and treated in this space.
Las Vegas is one of the most diverse, high-energy cities in the world. There’s no place for language or behavior that makes people feel excluded or unwelcome based on who they are.
I truly hope management takes this seriously, looks into what happened, and makes real changes. Because no one deserves to be treated like that especially in a place that’s supposed to be about entertainment and enjoyment.
As for me, I won’t be returning.

googleReviews.author: D Vegas
googleReviews.text: Very clean and well-kept karaoke studio! Korean food that tastes great. Excellent service. I had the bulgogi steak and it was flavorful, but not spicy. googleReviews.text: The place was nice and had a lot of music choices you could look up on your phone, but the smell made me want to instantly leave. googleReviews.author: Lexi Hua
googleReviews.text: We had a great birthday celebration here. Services and food was excellent. We booked a room in the same day, Cheap and fun. We spent $1,300 for a group of 15. Well worth it! It was clean, the only thing we didn’t like was, the sewer smell. After a few drinks it didn’t bother us anymore 😆. Overall recommend this place better than the high end expensive in the strip!

googleReviews.author: Tarron Kayalackakom
googleReviews.text: We booked a room for a birthday event, ended up being late due to the lack of parking but were still offered an alternate room after they cancelled due to an assumed no show. The staff were great and very courteous, the rooms were clean and large enough to easily seat our party of 7 and all the equipment worked perfectly. They had their own, in house selection of songs or you could alternatively switch to YouTube if they didn't have what you wanted on their system. We ended up ordering food and drinks, all of which was good, the bulgogi pizza was definitely the standout.

googleReviews.author: Lani Nicole
googleReviews.text:
Have been here quite a few times! Normally love the place! The ambience is great. The food taste amazing and normally everyone working is so attentive and so quick. Last night though was minir issues didn't bother us too much but our rooms wifi was out and we couldn't use the tablet so we connected our Hotspot so we could keep on going. It took a while to be able to order we ended up having to go to the front but they had aine and where busy so totally understandable! Like I said minor inconveniences! My biggest issue was that last night we left at 2am. This location says it closes at 3am. When we left i forgot my portable charger on the table. Figured I would wait until the open today to reach out about it. Was told that nobody turned it in and they would check the room to see if it was in there. I have a video of my portable sitting on the table exactly where I know I left it when we went home. Even accidently got a video of the employee helping us. Heaven forbid anyone leave anything in their rooms you might never see it again!

I have a clearer photo and video but with respect to privacy I will not post it.

googleReviews.author: Kris Lozano
googleReviews.text: We saw the signs for the soft opening and decided to try this place. Wow we were not disappointed. Came at 2 o’clock on a Saturday so wasn’t too busy and my goodness the atmosphere was adorable. The food was impeccable. Service was fantastic. 10/10 would come again! And then our server asked us if we wanted to see the karaoke rooms and we were absolutely floored. There are 20+ rooms, all uniquely themed, so super cool and very affordable. What a great idea for a fun night out. We will definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Somara Jacques
googleReviews.text:
We stumbled upon Mulgo Nozla after a long day at the Licensing Expo and honestly, it saved us. We were exhausted, starving, and tired of overpriced chain food at the Mandalay. Our Uber driver pointed us toward Vegas’s Chinatown and a quick Google search led us straight here. What a find.

The food was phenomenal. The takoyaki was perfectly savory, and the pho was absolutely massive and delicious, easily the size of my head. Everything was worth every penny, especially compared to what we’d been spending on the Strip.

Our waiter Will, along with the rest of the staff, was incredibly attentive and warm the entire time. The prices are more than reasonable for the quality you get.
We have zero complaints. This place is a genuine gem. If we’re ever back in Vegas, Mulgo Nozla is our first stop, and we’re definitely hitting the karaoke bar next door this time!

googleReviews.author: P2 Media
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been back to Mukgo Nolza more than a few times and kept ordering the same combo noodle soup (phở) for one reason: consistency.
Same result every time. Fresh meat, fresh noodles, and the broth has that real bone-based depth — not overloaded with sugar or shortcuts. You can tell when a kitchen respects the process.
The young staff here are respectful and handle customers well. Nothing forced, just good manners and solid service.
For me, this spot became my go-to for late dine-in and singing. Good food, honest flavor, and consistent quality. That matters more than hype.
No overrating here  just giving credit where it’s earned.

googleReviews.author: Amanda Vastine
googleReviews.text: This place is new and nice. The food is solid, and everything came out fresh and flavorful. The waitress was very friendly, attentive, and thoughtful throughout the whole meal. They also have private karaoke rooms connected to YouTube, which is really fun because you can easily find songs in different languages. The atmosphere feels lively but still comfortable for hanging out with friends or family. Definitely a fun spot to eat, sing, and spend a good evening.

googleReviews.author: Oscar Magallon
googleReviews.text: Absolutely delicious food!! Some of the best ive had in a while. Derek is an excellent waiter. And there is still so much more.

googleReviews.author: Principles & Righteousness
googleReviews.text:
I came here to attend an event.
I was buying a drink at the bar when a sweet, hardworking female bartender was working by herself to tend to a busy crowd.
When the owner, Steve, came behind the bar, he yelled out, "whoever thinks that this bartender is doing a good job, put up your middle finger!"
I bought a beer from Steve, said Hello to him, because I knew him from before he opened this business. I didn't get the feel of him being "nice,"  in which some of these reviews stated.
He charged me $6 for a beer.
I came back & bought the same beer, & was charged $9.
Great venue, thanks to Jon Taffer.
I like that theres an outdoor patio & clean restrooms.
But the parking is lacking. That's downtown for you.
There is no food served at this location.

googleReviews.author: No Passports Needed
googleReviews.text:
Mood - Bad Karaoke

So I grew up watching A League of Their Own. And the scene of the lady singing on stage It Had to Be You, has always inspired me to do karaoke but very badly. So this has been a running joke with my family. My bday this year was during the week, so after a very big surprise dinner we all were trying to figure out what to do next. Then the shenanigan side of me said let's do karaoke- but we gotta sing that song.

Upon entering was quickly greeted. We were ushered to a medium size room, given the run down of using YouTube for karaoke or their own. Also they have food and alcohol so it made for grand time. Now I usually don't drink, but for some bad karaoke I needed the courage.

Interior of each of the rooms is decent. There is enough seating depending on the size of your party. Reservation can be made or walk Ins are accepted. Everything was very clean.

Would most def recommend- pricing was beyond reasonable. The customer service was fabulous. They let us bring in the cake and provided the plates. Was a great bday celebration, and we may have added on an extra hour to sing a little bit of everything.

Location is Maryland/ Flamingo- ample parking

googleReviews.author: Janine Hargrove
googleReviews.text: Came here with my friends and family for our wedding after party! We did a small, intimate wedding and dinner, then came here to sing and party! We all absolutely LOVED this place! The rooms are spacious and comfortable,  the snacks and drinks were delicious.  And the staff was more than wonderful! They were very attentive and kind, and really helped to make our special day one of the most memorable ❤️   I was a bit buzzed, and don't remember their names tho, I wish I did! The prices are very reasonable.  They treat all of their customers like VIP. This is the perfect chill party spot, away from the hustle and bustle of the strip! If I lived in Vegas, I would definitely be a regular. We will definitely be back on our next visit. We loved everything about this place so much. I just wanna say thanks again to the staff. So if you are looking for a karaoke spot in Vegas, this is the one!

There was also a cieling fan for when the room got a little warm.
We rated it 10/10.

googleReviews.author: Brian Diem
googleReviews.text: Huge selection of spirits that rotates. Bartender likes Bad Bunny+++. Great vibe with fireplaces outback.

googleReviews.author: Devan Williams
googleReviews.text: My husband and I come here for drinks for my birthday & we really enjoyed ourselves! We sat outside by the fires and it was really nice! We will be back soon!

googleReviews.author: Giovanni Martinez
googleReviews.text: Z bar is amazing! The bartenders are all very friendly and quick to serve. Their craft cocktails are delicious and during happy hour 4-6 you can get them for 3 dollars off! One of the best bars in Reno and definitely a favorite in midtown!

googleReviews.author: Melika Mason
googleReviews.text: Come see Paul and Ella at the 4st coffee bar, they treated me like we had been fry for decades. Paul has had some fantastic experiences and is creating a wonderful atmosphere.  They have motorcycle parking out front, stop by and make some new friends and have a great coffee!

googleReviews.author: Forgotten Kaszás
googleReviews.text:
There was a night shift bartender that kept pushing me to leave the building after I was harassed by the male customers verbally .  They ganged up on me like I was truly a problem, but I was there by myself not bothering anyone. Yes I was tired from a long week of work and may have drifted to sleep briefly, but instead of allowing me to leave quietly the bartender started pushing me towards the door to leave and the white men yelled out obscenities to me that even the bartender had to tell them to stop.  I wanted to get proof of how I was treated so I recorded with it being the first time there and I was making sure I had my coat and bag as I was leaving, the bartender kept pushing me.  You only get this one time to mess with me. I recorded it all.
The response to this review is ridiculous.  For you to not hold accountable your regular customers and your bartender for harassment and your bartender assaulting another customer shows who you are.  I posted the video on YouTube and I'll be seeing you in court.

googleReviews.author: Vansant Courtemanhe
googleReviews.text: This is a nice and relaxed bar if you want to enjoy a few cocktails with nice company. I also liked the music, it pretty much matched my style. The bartender was knowledgeable, he knew about Flaming Lamborghini which is probably my favorite drink. Nice place.

googleReviews.author: J B
googleReviews.text: Not a bad place but I have no idea what people are talking about with the "sober" part. Really just another dive bar maybe they have a stage in back. It's on 4th Street so we all know about that, also there was puke and a broken bottle out front. Anyway if that's how people roll that's how they roll but I had the wrong impression initially. $5 Red Bull if you like those.

googleReviews.text: Love this place . Best people ever. Stephanie makes me laugh, Danielle is a great conversationist. Great owners very customer driven.

googleReviews.author: Michelle Leutzinger
googleReviews.text: Great local hangout spot with pinball, pool, slots, and lots of TVs.  The bartenders and owners are super friendly.   Drinks are reasonably priced.   No kitchen, but tons of spots to grab food nearby and bring it in or order food in.   If you haven't been since the new owners took over, come see what you're missing.  DIvey without being scummy and dirty.    Oh and now they do karaoke on Saturdays too!

googleReviews.text:
Friendly neighborhood bar. Great pool
Tables, no smoking and friendly staff. Steph is a great bartender and makes great drinks!

googleReviews.author: Lyric Amsterdam
googleReviews.text:
This is a great spot to get some drinks, play some pinball, and shoot some pool. Personally I’m there for the pinball.
It under new ownership and they have really cleaned up the place and made a nice and inviting atmosphere. The drinks aren’t too expensive and neither is the pinball. They have pinball tournaments there on Fridays.
They have several large TVs and will have any sports game on that’s playing during that time.
They have some snacks but no kitchen. They allow you to bring in your own food or get it delivered!
They no longer allow cigarette smoking in there, just vaping (thankfully).
Parking is easy and it’s not too far from the Nugget or Victorian Square.
They’re open till about 12am so if you need a late night pinball fix, this is your spot!

googleReviews.author: Mr G
googleReviews.text:
The services was mediocre,  The hostess sat dwn menu walked away. Being low light vision we moved to a different table.

Food like always good. Keno lady bit slow doesn't come around and had to be chased down. Probably only one.

Hope they can improve on the service.

Coffee is great but 20 mins plus to wait for a refill until I flagged down a lady. She brought me a fresh hot cup.

But by all means great place and reasonable priced.

googleReviews.author: Mindy Blaine
googleReviews.text:
My family had a great time at this casino! Lots of promotions, first day they went they got so many points to earn $40 in free play, one of my family members hit their first jackpot ever!
Next day if they had so many points they could exchange them for bottles of alcohol with a tight seal so they could take them home! they were like 8 points shorts and the staff was kind enough to still let them get a bottle.
I had our 1 year old and was told there was an arcade upstairs that he could play at.
Wasn’t really an arcade maybe 12 games up there tops. But it did have some of his favorite claw machines and he won his first claw machine all by himself!! There was a moment when the claw machine was stuck and it was a little tricky to get help since they didn’t own their arcade games like circus circus but we did eventually get help and we left with prizes! I’d say we all had fun! oh and bathrooms were nice too! also we could see everyone gambling on the second floor where the arcade was.

googleReviews.author: Oce Aerocks
googleReviews.text: They are doing their best at this little casino in the best little town! Prime rib lobster tail combo is a delicious meal at an affordable price served by engaged staff. Dinner could be updated to 2026 lighting and paint but retro is always in fashion. Good job everyone.

googleReviews.author: Nina
googleReviews.text: This isn't a high-class casino like GSR or Atlantis, in fact, its one of the oldest, run-down casinos in Reno. On the other hand, its a good place to go when you don't feel like putting on anythings special to wear or make-up! Its a 'come-as-you-are' type pkace; everyone is equally welcomed. Their security leaves a lot to be desired. The 'Top Deck' restaurant serves good 'ol American fare at decent prices and the penny slots are a good way to gamble when you're broke but still want to gamble!

googleReviews.author: Scott Gordon
googleReviews.text: Yea the whole place has there cartoonish looking 3d type machines. I found VERY few machines that had reels on it. I know that's everywhere now but still it's 80 cents for the smallest bet per turn on a penny machine. So basically playing a dollar machine. 20 dollars lasted 3 minutes. And that's because I went slow. I know I'm not going to win anything but I'd like to see some of what the game does.  So we left after about 20 minutes. We each played 60 dollars and nothing ever did anything. Why on earth would I go back.

googleReviews.author: Mr Noodlez
googleReviews.text:
I took the girls out for a much-needed afternoon of fun and we had an absolute blast! I've visited a branch of this establishment before, and it never disappoints.
​Just a friendly heads-up: it is a bit on the pricey side, so you'll want to budget accordingly. However, they have a fantastic selection of Japanese-style crane machines that are incredibly addictive and can easily keep you entertained for hours.
​I absolutely love this place! It was a total success—we even managed to go home with a massive haul of prizes! 🎁

googleReviews.author: Geo Reel
googleReviews.text: A small group of friends and I went in (4 of us, all 21+) on a late weekday night (around 12 am) and we got asked for our IDs REPEATEDLY from security and it was super annoying. We spent $100+ and were harassed the entire time, eventhough we showed we were 21+ with our IDs multiple times. Is this really how you treat your customers, just because we are on the younger side? The games are so much more expensive than they’re worth anyways. At this point, I’d rather make the drive to Dave & Busters because their value is so much better and so is their customer service and bar.

googleReviews.author: Greasy
googleReviews.text: The .99 ice cream cone got us! We went on a weekday and it was slow. They had 1 young girl working what seemed like the register AND the kitchen. She was busy and was SO slow. No acknowledgment whatsoever. I’m not mad at her for the business being understaffed. I waited patiently for about 20 min. I then asked if someone could help her since all we wanted was a couple ice cream cones. There were many other employees there (different departments maybe) a manager/supervisor then came out and helped us with those cones. He was nice and fast. I don’t think anyone should have to wait so long for something so simple and I don’t think 1 person should work both positions but maybe we came on a bad day. The ice cream was good though.

googleReviews.author: Jason Rich
googleReviews.text:
Great Job!

Booked a party with (New Manager) Eric, who took care of me every step of the way ~ Round 1 is clean, the staff is friendly and the food was great, the party room had its own sound system, leather couches, everything was on time, the entire experience was perfect.

Keep it up Round 1!  We’ll be back for sure!!!

Jason Rich
Reno, NV.

googleReviews.author: Nick Butler
googleReviews.text:
Fun place, worst customer service I've ever experienced. I get it, younger employees and it's very basic job. However we arrived at 12:01 (that's the time on our receipt) and had to pay more for the after-noon bowling rate. I didn't find it worthwhile telling the checkout lady we began talking to her at 11:59, it seemed pointless. But it was just weird and didn't seem normal. Then when I tried to get a refill, I stood in front of the gentleman at the food counter awkwardly for about 4 minutes, I'm the only one standing there, as he purposely avoids eye contact with me. I finally spoke up and said I just needed a refill and he brushed me off by saying he had to get "all these food orders out first". Again, very weird. I had to go walk around the facility to find another employee to go get me a refill. It took about 8 seconds to refill my soda. I counted. Took me about 8-10 minutes just got get a soda. It seems like the employees here just don't care about anything, including customers.

But, it's a fun place for the kids. Once you don't have to deal with their employees. Btw, ice cream is $1. Bowling and ice cream is a great deal!

googleReviews.author: Stacy Erck
googleReviews.text: I have been disappointed on more than one occasion by this place. I've been here 3 different times and called ahead each time before coming because I was bringing a large group of people. Two out of the three times they told me that they were going to have line dancing and lessons...  Thry also said we would be able to request dances. Well, it turns out there was very little line dancing and mostly a live band. Oh and the requests? Also not true. The last time that I went there, they more than doubled the cover charge for some band that was going to be playing, and they never even informed us when we called ahead. I go line dancing quite often and attend many different venues. We won't be coming back.

googleReviews.author: Susan Johnson
googleReviews.text: Cool place to go and line dance if you're not a chicken! It's pretty dark inside but not too dark they did have some sort of glow thing event the night I went drinks are a little spendy  a glass of Moscato wine and 1 white Russian in a on the rocks glass cost $25 bucks plus was told no cover charge and it was $ 6 per person ..  I did get my birthday shot thou that was nice except the tequila was house need I say more! But all in all a good hoppin place to go line dance

googleReviews.author: kevin link
googleReviews.text:
Walked in at 5:30p.m. No one here. Kitchen isn’t open yet, you go to the bar for a drink so no server. Go to the window called Grub and look at some paper with items to order, so no menu like the website showed.
Was told kitchen not open yet, but she didn’t say how long until it does.
Sorry but not a good impression. Going to wait for 15 min and see if things change. Otherwise, better choices out there unless you want line dancing and music.

googleReviews.author: SHAUN HALLETT
googleReviews.text: I have been coming here for about a month. I have met some great people. The atmosphere is wonderful, I feel safe and the employees are top notch. This is the only bar I will go to here in Reno, NV.

googleReviews.text: Great People, dance floor, DJ, band, food, and drinks. First time visiting and I will be back. Soon. Drinks are very fairly priced too.

googleReviews.text:
Came here back in 2019 on the way to SF from minneapolis driving in a moving van.

All around good vibes.

googleReviews.author: MMMyNameWasMangle
googleReviews.text: Abby's is quickly becoming my new regular spot in town. The bartender Brandon gives excellent service and makes wonderful cocktails. The free pool table in here is another excellent reason to swing by.

googleReviews.author: Hai Do
googleReviews.text: Clean, cool, and caring! The staff are thoughtful and clearly put a lot of work into their craft. The indoor space has a fun dive feel with pool, the outside area has a fire pit, patio seating, etc. I am from out of town but this spot was definitely worth a visit to get a real Reno feel

googleReviews.author: Kelvin Wong
googleReviews.text: Came here two afternoons on mlk weekend and it was practically empty, which was great for our large group. Bartenders make great cocktails for a dive bar and everything is reasonably priced. Highly recommend if you’re staying in the area.

googleReviews.author: Dawn (We Always WAnder)
googleReviews.text: We were travelers who wandered in on a warm summer day and were welcomed by a crowd of locals, a friendly staff, and great drinks - what more could we ask for!  We are fans of a good local dive bar and this one was a perfect place to grab a cold drink.  There were all the typical beverages you would expect beers, wells, and mixers - but this place had a surprising cocktail list too - my favorite was the "Kick Rocks" and raspberry lemonade drink with an explosive candied rim - pop rocks!  A trick I will be using at my home bar from now on!

googleReviews.text: Tiki bars in general appeal to me so I may be biased but this one can be fun and the drinks were both fun and tasty. I have been here on a busy weekend evening and a slow Tuesday evening at happy hour. Enjoyable either way but the happy hour prices are pretty good.

googleReviews.text: Had a blast! Honestly best deal for karaoke too, $190+ tax - we spent $60pp which included a bottle of Patron, entree & 2hrs of karaoke.

googleReviews.author: Danielle Kugell
googleReviews.text: Wonderful company event at Rosen!  Staff is so helpful and friendly.  They went above and beyond to make sure our group had a great time.  Clean large space, rooms are cool, thousands of songs to choose from.  Great team-building event. Thank you again!!

googleReviews.author: candice En
googleReviews.text: Rosen Karaoke in Koreatown, Los Angeles, offers an unforgettable night out with friends. The private rooms are stylish, clean, and equipped with easy-to-use touchscreen systems and an impressive selection of songs in multiple languages. The sound system is top-notch, and staff are attentive and quick with drink orders. Their cocktail menu is surprisingly solid, and there’s a good variety of Korean bar snacks to keep the energy up. googleReviews.author: Jules C.
googleReviews.text: I swung by here with 15 other friends recently for my birthday celebration. They have multiple rooms here but the one we got was the biggest I've ever seen in a karaoke spot. The room was spacious, well lit, and the package that we ordered came with enough drinks (soju + beer) and water/soda. We were all ready to hang out and party in the room. The staff were so kind to give us their attention when we wanted more drinks or needed anything. We stayed here for about 4 hours and had such a great time. Thank you to the staff for being so amazing!

googleReviews.author: rcandrade
googleReviews.text: Went to this Karaoke lounge with a couple of friends. The place looks cool that is the only pro in this review. Cons, there are several to start their selection for songs to karaoke was completely outdated and limited if you consider how much they charge for two hours over $200 (max 4 people). Songs had to be chosen from a big catalog that was organized very oddly with most songs/ artists being Korean which is totally fine but a warning of that would have been appreciated. What we paid included some soju bottles, six beers, and an appetizer with the two hours ok karaoke of course. I definitely recommend eating elsewhere. Overall I do not recommend this karaoke place knowing that there are much better options available.

googleReviews.text: Chris the security guard kicked us out of our room we spent almost $300 or more for our room for two ours for minutes before we were due to leave. Will not be returning after such an unpleasant encounter here because of the front desk and chris.

googleReviews.text: Don't waste your time with this karaoke spot. Their policies are super strict - they charge a $20 corkage fee for outside drinks that have to be under 20% ABV. And get this, they charged our group of 7 an 18% service fee, even though their website clearly states when it's groups bigger than 8 🤯. Service was awful, staff was rude, and the place didn't exactly smell great. There are way better karaoke options in LA, trust me. Skip this one

googleReviews.author: Jenae Lien
googleReviews.text:
Impossible to not have a good time here! They’ve changed some of the rules up. Now they carry beer and wine, so there is no more BYOB. If you bring food, there’s a fee per person. If you bring alcohol and they catch you, it’s $20/can they find.

Must be 21+, IDs are required.
There are some interesting signs and rules posted around the club that make you wonder about what happened here in the past 😅

I went with a party of 8. We booked a mid-size private room for 3 hours with 2 mics. They charge per person. The more people, the less per person. We got 3 pitchers of beers and a couple bottles of Prosecco. It was around a $550 tab when we paid at the end of the night.

Download the Healsonic app for free to easily line up and manage songs on screen.

googleReviews.author: Ximena Risa
googleReviews.text: Place was clean, Audio was pretty loud is great. Cute lights 💙 Had fun with my bestie 🫶

googleReviews.author: Alexis Ayala
googleReviews.text: We absolutely love love LOVE this place, whenever we need to let loose and sing our feelings out my best friend and I come here. We LOVE the service, they are very friendly make sure we are doing good :) they have great snacks but allow you to bring food/other snacks in as well! (Copied and pasted from my Yelp review:)

googleReviews.author: dora guerrero
googleReviews.text:
Max Karaoke Studio has been my go to karaoke lounge because of their affordable prices and convenience. Parking in LA is always difficult, but if you sing your heart out here, they will validate your ticket for 3 hours!

I admit they aren’t the most high end Karaoke lounge out there, and the rooms are very basic. But with prices under $10 a person (tax not included) with no drink minimum, I think it’s a great location for those looking to have a fun night out with a couple, or a lot of friends.

They have the regular rooms that are more affordable but also a bit more grungy, with beat up cushions. Or the VIP Rooms, which come with a strobe light and nicer furniture. They don’t have the option to link your phone to the internet and stream YouTube videos, but you can download the healsonic app to connect to their system and get an idea of what songs they have available. You can even set up your playlist ahead of time so that you can get right to singing!

Nice to see that they survived the rona!

googleReviews.text: Great customer service, clean, and well maintained rooms. Fridays and the weekends are charged by packages and other days can be hourly.
