googleReviews.author: Janice Duenas
googleReviews.text:
RJ, RJ, RJ IS THE BEST. We had a work event here and at first the gift card wouldn't work but RJ went above and beyond to make things happen for us. He is amazing, patient, and clever. Ask for RJ when booking. He is great.  The staff is so nice and friendly.

The mics, system, and room were excellent. The songs were relevant and new. They even had show tunes. The couches were comfortable and the bathroom is clean! I highly recommend this place. There is parking in front and street parking. It was safe and well lit. We had such a fun night!

googleReviews.author: Tamara Rodriguez
googleReviews.text: Best Karaoke place around they were super friendly and accommodating, I love singing in private or even with friends and be able to do harmonies or sing as loud as I wanted, it was so easy to understand the controls for the songs once I understood once you are inside the place you are in a different dimension it had good vibes and everything was super affordable and worth its prices, and the owners were really nice and friendly definitely coming back here thank you for making this space available for singers ☺️✨🙏🎤🎶

googleReviews.author: Filthy Rich Boneman
googleReviews.text:
We had a KILLER time at Culver Karaoke, the KJ system is extremely easy to operate, and the selection of music was unbeatable. You could even filter it by different languages. The rooms were also very clean and comfortable, and there were disposable covers on the mics ready to go.

The attendant at the time, RJ, was extremely hospitable; even though we came in rowdy, he showed us how everything works, and got drinks for us too. Be warned: no outside drinks!! And no tambourines on site (bring your own). Also I wish the music could have been a little louder, or at least an adjustable sound system—but this was RJ’s house and I respect the rules.

Definitely worth the trip to Culver City, if you live in town, or if you’re visiting one of the museums or restaurants nearby, this is one place you need to experience.

googleReviews.author: Greg
googleReviews.text:
Great little spot to practice your singing or to bond with some friends over music.

Couple different room sizes ranging from 5-12 people. Many different beverages, with alcohol and without. The system sounded good and the song catalog was perfect! We will definitely be bringing friends with us next time!

Abel was very pleasant and welcoming, definitely made us more comfortable.

googleReviews.author: Morgan Sydnee

My guests and I had so much fun and especially appreciated the song list which had more Broadway songs than other karaoke places I've been to. I would highly recommend this place!

googleReviews.author: David Nguyen (Duck)
googleReviews.text: Nice rooms and great service. Their music systems have pretty up to date music selection and is easy to use. You can set the lights to set the mood of the room. Service is excellent.

googleReviews.author: Timothy Holdaway
googleReviews.text:
Half off Monday and Tuesday deal on private rooms made this reasonably affordable for a group of ~10. Would have been pretty expensive on a full price night.

I attempted to both call and email to make a reservation. Response times were slow, they never answered the phones, and they wanted a credit card number via email(!) to reserve a room. As it turns out, it wasn't really necessary to reserve for a Tuesday. The place was dead.

The song library was very limited. I was expecting something with a larger library (e.g. KaraFun), but instead they had only a handful of songs from very popular artists, and generally did not even have any songs from less popular artists. If you just want to sing Billboard Top 40, this might be fine for you, but if you enjoy depth and breadth of song selection, you will find their library lacking. They did appear to have a number of non-english-language songs, but I can't comment on whether the non-english selection is any good.

To add insult to injury, the song selection all has to happen via a single touchscreen on the wall. Although the televisions have a QR code that looks like it ought to allow you to browse the song list and enqueue songs from your phone, neither browsing songs nor controlling the queue from a phone works. So you're stuck standing off in a corner of the room poking at this tablet on the wall, trying to browse a very limited selection of songs to find one to sing.

googleReviews.author: Lariza Sanchez
googleReviews.text: It was a chill fun atmosphere with everyone eager to see the next act. Everyone who performed were great!

googleReviews.author: GR P
googleReviews.text: Honestly the place itself is fun, decor, rooms and systems are nice too, but the staff are sketchy, bartenders overcharge/inconsistently charge for the same drinks, and several of us had items like jackets, jewelry and car keys stolen from our reserved room or as we were upstairs. Not worth the trouble so highly recommended Taisho if you want to do karaoke.

googleReviews.author: annie z
googleReviews.text: The upstairs area is an open karaoke bar while there was private rooms downstairs. We were able to get a small room for 4 without a booking, 2 hiurd minimum. Good range of songs in various languages. Had a good time there.

googleReviews.author: Darcy Marie Hughes et alia
googleReviews.text:
This is, hands down, my favorite bar this side of the Great Water (meaning the Bay). I have been a regular here for six years now, and absolutely adore the staff. I have never once seen them be rude to a single customer, and like real ones, they are more than happy for you to bring in outside food. Not drinks, though, obviously; please but drinks when you are here! The restaurant next door recently changed hands; there's a connecting door and the previous door would actually being your food to you in the bar, which was glorious. Haven't seen the new place do that yet, but I dunno what their plans are.

The music selection here is wild! I routinely tell people to not even check the book you can access via the posted QR code, just ask for what you want to sing and they will probably have it. I know if what I speak, too! My favorite songs to sing are obscure punk songs, dirty cabaret songs no one else has ever heard, and nearly-lost-to-history songs from literally a hundred years ago. Some of my favorite nights are the nights when I hear three or four languages sung in the mix - I've heard English, Japanese, Spanish, Chinese, Frebnch, Filipino, Gaelic, . . .

The only drawback to the Bay is that they don't have an extensive collection of the pretentious Italian liquors I like to drink, but they DO have a couple I rarely find nowadays (like Galliano and Sambuca)! Come in the earlier hours and the slower days so you can chat with them and the regulars. We're all an absolute hoot and SO LOVING. Another is my favorite nights is holiday nights, when people being food to share and it just feels like a family party. There's even a regular who makes karaoke videos, if you somehow wanna sing a song the KjJ can't play for you.

This is my home away from home and I love this place!

googleReviews.author: Latasha Duggan
googleReviews.text:
Our group of adults—all well over 40—had a terrible experience at Mint Karaoke. The man at the door was unbelievably rude from the start. One of our friends forgot their physical ID, but we had multiple other ways to verify age—and he still treated us with total disrespect. She had left and came back in with other proof. But he still handled it wrong.

Instead of handling it professionally, he spoke to us like we were causing trouble, even saying “Don’t mess with me,” as if we were about to fight him. Completely unnecessary and uncalled for. It’s not what you say—it’s how you say it.

We ended up leaving and had a much better time at the sushi bar next door—great vibes, friendly people—and then headed off to Pandora Karaoke where the staff actually knew how to treat customers right. Mint Karaoke? Never again.

No experience is worth being spoken to like that.

googleReviews.author: kathleen chan
googleReviews.text:
This has been my go to karaoke spot since 1996
Many of the patrons have been going over 20 years.
Staff are friendly, pour a stiff drink & stay for decades
The KJ’s are all very sweet, unless u keep asking when u r up, 5 minutes after u put in your song
The crowd is a delightful diverse eclectic group of humanity,
All sizes, shapes, creeds, persuasions  & we LOVE it
I seem to always hear 1 or 2 songs I have never heard- NIGHTLY
If u are solo or with a group, the Mint is welcoming to ALL!!
A fun time breaks out nightly!!!!
No singing skills required!!
A patron once said  not everyone can since but everyone can karaoke-there is a difference. desire is all that’s necessary!!

googleReviews.author: frank wang
googleReviews.text: Good equipment for karaoke set up. It can be busy some days, found out there were 35 people ahead of me to sing one time. Also the online song list is outdated, the bar seems to have a similar amount of songs like the karaoke bar.

googleReviews.author: Jay Yoder
googleReviews.text:
Five stars. The Mint Karaoke Lounge is one of my favorite bars in the world. I have been coming here for about a decade, and it is still the place I look forward to the most. It is fun whether you arrive with a group or walk in solo. It is so easy to meet people and blend in with the regulars because the atmosphere is always positive and welcoming.

All ranges of singers get support here, from first timers to serious performers. The crowd cheers everyone on which makes the whole night feel relaxed and memorable. The song list is huge, the sound is clear, and the staff is always helpful with getting songs set up fast.

There are many beers on tap and also bottles, plus great drinks from the bar. If you are looking for a San Francisco karaoke lounge that has real community energy and an amazing mix of people from all over the Bay Area, The Mint Karaoke Lounge is it. I cannot recommend it enough.

googleReviews.text: It's conveniently located next to a terrific restaurant and it's open late night when the mall has mostly closed. Pseudo-jukebox karaoke, hap hazard lounge setup. Pricey, poorly made and tasteless cocktails. Glad for the experience but will avoid in the future.

googleReviews.author: connie b.
googleReviews.text:
VERY intimate and Cozy. I prefer the off weekend sunday- wed times.
Prices are standard ,nothing fancy.
One drink Minimum is the Standard to enter,most Kaoroke  places is 2 drink minimum. Alcohol or mocktails are served. Bar snacks are pretty basic. No hot food but they do have Edamame.
Singing is 2.00 dollars cash a song.
Friendly staff . Weekends are crowded.
I enjoy coming here because  its a cozy spot with no frizzle ,met so many nice people here.

googleReviews.author: Julianna Diggs
googleReviews.text:
Came around 11:30 PM with three friends for karaoke. We were not drunk, dressed nicely, and my friends were already paying customers.

There is only one bathroom for the entire bar, and we had already been waiting in the bathroom line for about 10 minutes. When I tried to use the restroom, the woman checking IDs put her hands on me and physically blocked me without saying a word. She could have easily communicated a rule (order a drink first, bathroom not available, etc.), but instead chose to get physical with no explanation.

I have never experienced a situation where someone gets physical and it made me very uncomfortable. The interaction felt bizarre and unnecessary.

There are so many karaoke bars in this city this experience wasn’t worth it, and I won’t be returning.

googleReviews.author: Chelsea Robertson
googleReviews.text: The karaoke set up here is great. The stage has a great cityscape background that blends well with the leather swivel rolling chairs and cocktail tables to give a cozy, yet fun, vibe for the singers! $2/song. No liquor, but we didn't mind. Check it out!

googleReviews.author: Carmen Augusto
googleReviews.text: Not really my vibe, but if you like small, intimate karaoke, this is your spot. The place is very small, so I’d recommend renting it out and bringing around 20 friends. We were a group of 10, and since it was already full, we decided to look for another spot—but the vibes there definitely looked great.

googleReviews.author: Shannon Egan
googleReviews.text: Threw my friends a Bon Voyage party last night at K-Box and our experience was 10/10. We came for the music but stayed for the chicken tenders and pitchers of Modelo on tap. Our friend Zach left no crumbs after his performance of “No Scrubs” and Barrett blessed us all with his own rendition of Afroman’s critically acclaimed, hit single “Because I Got High.” The staff, service, and incredible ambiance of K-Box Karaoke certainly sent our two friends off on vacation with memories that will last a lifetime. We’ll be back!!!

googleReviews.author: Sophie Lan
googleReviews.text:
I've gone here a few times and I've always enjoyed the experience. The karaoke system is easy to use and it has a good song selection.

But my most recent visit has soured my experience of this place. In the middle of our session we went outside to add an hour and asked a staff when our new end time was. The time he gave us was 20 mins later than I was expecting, but he reaffirmed it.

But when we exited at the end time we were told, they made us pay an overtime fee. The same staff denied telling us this end time I was told and insisted he said the original end time that I'd originally expected. We ended up paying the overtime fee because the staff wouldn't budge.

I don't want to believe he purposefully told us a wrong end time to get us to pay an overtime fee, but there's no other explanation I can find. So if you go here, be careful about what the staff tells you. Now I can't ignore the feeling they're trying to find any way for you to pay an overtime fee.

googleReviews.author: Sarah Brink
googleReviews.text: I took my 94 year old grandmother to karaoke for the first time in her life and she thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The drinks were delicious. The karaoke system took a little bit of getting used to, we didn't find all the songs we wanted to sing, and the room was a bit cold but we had a great time. The staff were so helpful and lovely! They let us out the back way into the parking garage so that my grandmother didn't have to make the long trek back though the mall and construction zone.

googleReviews.author: Anna
googleReviews.text: This is a great place to have fun with your friends! Wide variety of songs and crazy volume. Make sure to book a room before coming. I would recommend 2 hours because time goes very fast. The place is very clean, has a great ambiance and service is good. They also have little sweet boba in the place so you can order from they directly from your room. My only complaint is the microphone in the middle of the room, is right in front of the tv and it blocks everyone if someone uses it. Overall great place!

googleReviews.author: Michelle C
googleReviews.text: My friends and I love coming here! It’s our favorite place to karaoke because of the vibes, song selection, and above all how friendly and great Jonathan and the staff here are! Would highly recommend

name: K-Time Karaoke
address: 870 Taraval St, San Francisco, CA 94116, USA
about: K-Time Karaoke is a karaoke bar in San Francisco, California. It holds a 3.9-star rating from 78 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: D Fannin
googleReviews.text:
TLDR: if you want high quality karaoke machine, good service, reasonable staff - DO NOT COME TO THIS PLACE. Instead go to any other karaoke places such as Kbox, Filmore and Level2

The karaoke machine in one of their room is broken.You simply do not have a functioning karaoke machine where you can queue songs. Instead, they provide you with this random YouTube version, which is basically equivalent to you doing karaoke at home, except you are paying $50 for nothing.

When we ask for them to fix the service, they simply don't even try. We could not even get them to reboot the machine. And instead of offering us any kind of compensation, with us coming all the way from the other side of town, they just told us we can refund you, even though we wasted all our time getting the machine to work.

We tried to find alternative solutions. For example, moving to a different room, but the staff was not helpful. First, they never told us that a large room was available and we had to find the room ourselves. Then we talked to a staff member who told us it was available at 11 pm, which meant we could have sung for an hour and a half. Later, we got another staff member who then told us that the room is not available and will, in fact, be taken by 10 pm. Overall, it just didn't seem like staff even knew what they were talking about.

If you have other karaoke options, do them. K-Box, Level 2, Fillmore, all of them will probably be better than K-Time.

googleReviews.author: Gina
googleReviews.text: Leaving review for the free drink but honestly would still give it 5 stars with or without it. Came in with friends had a great time highly recommend. Bringing a bigger group makes it more affordable and the front desk staff Josh or John? was super amazing also pretty cute ☺️ Overall a fun experience, would definitely come back!!!

googleReviews.author: Megan T
googleReviews.text:
AVOID!!! TLDR: We reserved a room and the karaoke system was broken. Staff offered no solution or compensation, and refused to change to another room even though there was one open.

We’ve been regular customers at this karaoke place for years but our experience was completely ruined today. It has really gone downhill.

We reserved a room in advance for 3 hours, showed up on time, and found out the karaoke system in our room didn’t work. Staff spent a long time trying to blame it on “copyright issues” before finally admitting the system was actually broken.

Their “solution” was to tell us to use YouTube on Google instead. Anyone who actually goes to karaoke knows how ridiculous that is. It’s basically like queueing YouTube videos on a TV at home and you can’t even browse or queue new songs while someone was singing without changing the screen.

There was zero apology, zero accountability, and zero compensation offered. It was basically “take it or leave it” for the Google YouTube Karaoke at full price.

We asked if there were any other rooms available and were told the place was fully booked. Later, we found out there ACTUALLY WAS another room open for hours.

When asked if we can use the working room, they wanted to charge us the full inflated price for that room ($80–90 instead of the ~$50 room we originally booked). That might be fine, but they didn’t even tell us there was another room open until we found out.

This is just wrong. We held up our end of the reservation. They didn’t hold up theirs, and made no effort to make it right. We used to come here regularly but we definitely won’t be back.

googleReviews.author: Karen Delgado
googleReviews.text: Confused by all the good reviews on here. This place is extremely dirty! Considering the 20% cleaning charge, they could at least sweep the floors. There were balls of hair all over the floor. Everything felt sticky and musty. There is no AC so it gets really hot and stuffy. The bathrooms were disgusting. Do not recommend! Way overpriced for what you are getting!

googleReviews.author: Corinne Capitonoff
googleReviews.text: We asked about the price beforehand and were told a much lower price than the room actually cost, at the end a bunch of fees were added onto the price. The buttons were popped off on one of the two microphones we had, making it really difficult to turn on, and the system couldn't play a song without buffering - I'm talking couldn't even get 10 seconds in. We had to connect the TV to our phone hotspot in order to get it to even work. Once our hour was up, I explained to the front desk our issues and asked if we could get a discount and they refused. We were only able to sing like 5 songs due to the difficulties. I paid and it was $60. SIXTY DOLLARS for one hour on a system that didn't work 👎

about: Sool Bar and Lounge is a bar in San Francisco, California. It holds a 4.4-star rating from 97 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Marcus R.
googleReviews.text:
Came for an after conference happy hour (week of 7.13.25). Not too shabby. Place is chill. Drinks were great. Food was a la carte. So, please, keep that in mind if there is one bartender serving multiple people (they're doing the best they can).

For those wondering, there are V.I.P. karaoke rooms on the 2nd floor. Looked like a grand time if you're looking to house a rowdy crew, and not worry about hitting the highest of notes.

Worth a visit if your in the area, or looking for a place to decompress from the matrix. Hope to visit again.

googleReviews.author: byron brooks
googleReviews.text: Was the Wifee's Bday and we were staying In Union Square and had planned to go to a piano bar. After reconsidering wanting to pay a cover and electing something a little more low key with entrainment, we discovered Sool. Only a few blocks from the Hotel, so we walked to and from. Nice small to medium sized venue to has free karaoke every night and the availability to reserve a large private karaoke room for an event. Unsure of the pricing, as we spent our time in the main bar. The Owner, Jin, was behind the bar being a master craftsman and a very pleasant and welcoming force.the drinks and the service were performed with care and there were multiple different meetings to settle in. Bar top chairs, high top tables, an area with legit couches, and coffee table and an area in the back of the bar kind of off itself a little more...good for if you wanted a little more distance from the singers to have easier conversations. Karaoke is easy to sign up for with your phone. Then you can monitor the cue to see how far out your song is. No having to glue your eyes to a ticket tape at the  lyric screens or feeling like you are bothering a DJ. Place was pretty full, but I was still able to get a few songs in without have ing to be here all night. (While we did spent almost 3 hours there). Patrons there were pleasant as well, no riff raff. So great for popping in for a short spell and plan to stay all night. If you are looking for something different, then I recommend trying the Soju. Cheers!

googleReviews.author: Julie Chen
googleReviews.text:
I booked the downstairs bar area at Sool for my birthday, and it was one of the best decisions I’ve made. The venue was the perfect size for my group of ~30 and had an awesome vibe all night long. Their drink selection is great. They had unique soju cocktails and the Korean bar food snacks were delicious and perfect for sharing.

Kha and the Sool team made the entire planning and coordinating process incredibly easy. Communication was quick and clear, and the flexibility of the venue was a big plus. They allow outside food and décor as well.

My guests and I had an absolute blast. I’d recommend Sool to anyone looking for a fun, affordable, and hassle-free spot for a celebration, private event, or just a night of karaoke!

googleReviews.author: Jade
googleReviews.text: I came here for a collaborative event with the SF Social Club, and I had a blast. The atmosphere was lively but not too loud, the drinks were super tasty and creative, and the venue was decently sized to accommodate a medium-sized group. It was a great space to mingle and meet new friends, and the karaoke upstairs was the icing on the cake to a fun night.

googleReviews.author: Natalia P
googleReviews.text: My friend and I went there, and one of us didn't have ID with us, we went to get it the hotel was nearby, but 15 minutes later, the bartender refused to serve us a cocktail and aggressively told us to leave. A Korean woman behind the bar was shouting, "Get out, I don't want to serve you." Even the waitress came over and didn't understand why the woman was acting that way; we weren't drunk that crazy, we had few drinks before, in normal way and actually I post it straight in 30min after that situation.

googleReviews.text:
Today was my first time coming here after “First Thursdays”, very close uber. My friends and I googled karaoke bars and this is the one that caught our eye the most. Private rooms; great choices in music (very diverse). You can change language of preference, they also have songs in multiple languages. The staff walked us step by step and was on call when needed.

I definitely recommend this place. Felt safe, good vibes, modern, 10/10 would return.

googleReviews.author: Yolanda L.
googleReviews.text: Very fun place with very nice staff! They helped us add a song request, shuffle rooms, and sort our timing. They were very accommodating. Good value too. Would go back for sure! Thank you! 🙏

googleReviews.author: Erica Cardoza
googleReviews.text: Such kind owners and really easy Song interface with wide array of songs. Lovely drink selection as well! Had a lot of fun with friends

googleReviews.author: Damian Costello
googleReviews.text: We spent our NYE at Level2 and had an excellent time. The staff were incredibly generous and took very good care of us. They even accommodated several time changes to our reservation. The rooms were cozy and the music selection was great!

googleReviews.author: Thomas Ng
googleReviews.text:
L2 Karaoke is my New Favorite Karaoke Spot!!

Reasonable prices, EXCELLENT Service, and ALL the songs I needed.

Some of the music videos are a little off, but def not a deal breaker.

Will definitely come back again with my crew!! 🙌🙌

googleReviews.author: A
googleReviews.text: Not to many places make it this easy to relax and be yourself!  To enjoy the best gem in san francisco and meet the best bar tender I have ever met kenzie will def inpress!!.  The place to be!!!!!!

googleReviews.author: Robert Gibson
googleReviews.text: Great neighborhood spot with surprisingly excellent food. The fish was perfectly crispy and flaky, and the tater tots were golden and crunchy. The wings were outstanding—crispy, flavorful, and cooked just right. Generous portions, reasonable prices, and a friendly atmosphere. Definitely coming back!

googleReviews.author: Benjamin Shaibu
googleReviews.text:
A super fun spot in SoMa. I've been there for Trivia night a couple times and also hosted a bar party recently! The crew is super friendly and the owner Jeremy went the extra mile to make sure we were having a good time. They had set ups for Karaoke, beer pong, and even a ring light for photos.

The drinks are some of the most reasonably priced you'll see in the city; the vibe is great on a Thursday night with a good amount of people, but plenty of space to sit and chat; and they've got some good happy hour food.

Some of the seats are a little old, but it adds to the cool fun neighborhood bar feeling the place has.

I would recommend stopping by - especially Thursday trivia!

googleReviews.author: Alec Scheller
googleReviews.text: Great Vibe! Kat is so Fun behind the Bar! Great little spot with an all night party atmosphere. Great anytime! Hidden Gem in SF!

googleReviews.author: Mimoh Mohan Das
googleReviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Jeremy Paz is what every bar owner should aspire to be. He didn’t open this place to be trendy or make a quick buck. He built it so anyone can walk in and feel at home. Honest prices, great food, zero pretension. That’s all Jeremy.
The man has decades of experience and it shows in every detail. If you’re lucky enough to catch him here, take a minute to chat. You won’t regret it.
SF needs more Jeremys. This is now my bar. ❤️​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
Question Mark Tavern is one of SF’s best hidden gems. The bar is beautiful, drinks are affordable, food is legit, and your dog is welcome too. No pretension, no gimmicks, just a genuinely warm space where anyone can feel at home.

googleReviews.author: Palina Rawat
googleReviews.text: Music City has just opened its doors, and I've already fallen in love with this place. The lounge is truly unique, creating a mesmerizing atmosphere with its musician-inspired ambiance and live performances. The food and beverage menu is spectacular. Among my personal favorites are the chicken wings, served with your choice of sauce, and a brioche bun with slowly cooked pork belly, served with coleslaw on the side.

googleReviews.author: Olivia Wong
googleReviews.text: karaoke is fun, everything is newly remodeled, bathrooms are clean, the rehearsal studios are affordable and come with ample outlets, good PA, amps. You can even order food to the room, which is insane. drinks are strong and good

googleReviews.author: Bobo Belsinger
googleReviews.text:
This gem of a place offers high in bar bites that are very affordable.
Tonight I had the brussel sprouts which were fantastic.
A few mornings ago on Sunday I had the delicious chicken and waffles.
A few days prior to that.

The mix of shows are wonderful
Tonight, there was no band.
The music that they had on for the ambience was so fantastic and incredible that words can't describe the cool feeling that I left with.
I will be eating my way through the menu and nurturing my person with incredible music add vibes from this place

googleReviews.author: BA M
googleReviews.text: Stayed at the hostel, everything was clean an the staff were wonderful. Don't sleep on the happy hour!

googleReviews.author: Ryan Babasa

googleReviews.author: Christine Le
googleReviews.text: I love that you can bring your own food and drinks ($5 charge per person for alcohol). I had the Daft Punk room for 8 people. The folks that check you in are friendly and great customer service. The song selection was great with variety of languages, genres, artists and eras, sound system was good. With the space and bodies in there it can get toasty with the singing, dancing, and drinking. I run very warm so at one point had to step out to get air. This was my first time here and we were celebrating the holidays and the start of a 2 week work break. I am definitely coming back.

googleReviews.author: Phuong Luong
googleReviews.text: Queue system and sound quality are great, the small room is still really spacious and everything is clean and well-maintained! Shout out to Ivan for accommodating our last minute booking we appreciate you Ivan

googleReviews.author: Trista Feng
googleReviews.text:
If you want to be KICKED OUT of your room with no reminder and front desk rolling her eyes at you, this is the place to go. They care nothing about customer experience and won’t remind you when time is up.  All they say when they kick you out is we can’t control our online reservation so please leave :)

Strongly recommend this place if you want your Saturday night ruined😬

googleReviews.author: L M1
googleReviews.text: Absolutely horrific management - I went this weekend and they held an ID and a credit card from our group before letting us into the room. They did NOT return these items as we checked out. I have been emailing and calling them for the last two days with no response.

googleReviews.author: Jianping Chen
googleReviews.text: This is a gem in the neighborhood. I left a bag with valuable stuff in there, I contacted the owner and he responded quickly and gave everything back to me. Thank you !! well definitely go back!

googleReviews.author: Ivory Randall
googleReviews.text: I visited here with some friends. We didn't realize karaoke began at 9pm,  but that's fine.  We were able to get onto the list to sing twice. We had a fun time. It was a little tight when it got packed. The fall drinks were good and priced normally for downtown. The food was so-so; but if you want a quick bite it'll do. I'd visit again.

googleReviews.author: Crystal Romo Meyers
googleReviews.text: We celebrated our wedding night at The Gaslamplighter and it was truly unforgettable! From start to finish, the staff went above and beyond to make the night special. Our engagement photos lit up the Jumbotron screen, and the cocktail servers surprised us multiple times with glowing LED signs and light displays—it felt like a true celebration! The music, drinks, atmosphere, and service were all top-tier. We’re so grateful for the love and energy poured into our experience. This night will forever hold a special place in our hearts. We absolutely love this place!

googleReviews.author: Shah L
googleReviews.text: Very Upscale karaoke but a GREAT TIME with really good service and tasty drinks. Shout out to whoever made green tea shots (they were perfect) and the manager who worked on the night of February 26, 2026!

googleReviews.author: Michel
googleReviews.text:
We had a phenomenal experience!   The location is beautiful,  staff was attentive, warm & welcoming, great drinks and music, the clientele was friendly and everyone had a great time.

I think the meal options can be spruced up a bit but it did not negatively impact our night.

We will definitely be going back!!!

googleReviews.author: Steve Lipinsky
googleReviews.text: All six in our party commented on how professional & fastidious the staff was on NYE.  Everyone on staff worked seamlessly together and seemed to be enjoying themselves at the same time. Like they were happy to be working there.  That energy shines through!!  The DJ was wonderful at reading the room, the music was perfect for the evening. Drinks were delicious as well. Our dedicated server and bar staff went above and beyond to accommodate special requests or adjustments on the cocktails due to taste preferences.  Blake made us feel at home.  We look forward to coming back!!!

I didn't see where the QR code mentioned on the screen was. Why not show it on the screen?

googleReviews.author: Kailah O'Brien
googleReviews.text: Decent little bar but understaffed. There is one really agitated bartender. It seems like they do karaoke all night but the dj sings most of the songs and tells people their songs have already been sung. Not very fun. Also this is a cash only bar. There is an atm inside

googleReviews.author: Eli Bezner
googleReviews.text:
Been here a few times over the years, more so recently. Really great local bar that reminds me of some bars back home. The karaoke hosts are super personable and encourage me to sing even though I suck lol the bartenders are fast and east-coast friendly. If you go on a night when jj, Spider, or Jess is working youre gonna have a great night!
Sidenote, the best smoking patio in San Diego. Well ventilated with lots of seating! If smoking isn't your thing, its still a great place to have a conversation away from the karaoke lights and sound. Ive met a ton of bartenders out there, definitely an Industry hang

googleReviews.author: Brandon Romes
googleReviews.text: First time here and I am coming back very soon!! I recently moved to SD and was looking for some good dive bars and this place was just what I was looking for. Love the staff and love the security. Overall great atmosphere to be around people and drinks!

googleReviews.author: KC Wilder
googleReviews.text: Classic dive bar vibe with a great karaoke setup.  The karaoke has a lot of energy, but the sound quality isn’t great and it’s unbearably loud unless you go to the back of the bar.  I’m a musician and have never been to any concert or bar that was louder than this.  Makes it very difficult to chat with your friends.  Getting your song to be played by the DJ requires a cash tip and a lot of waiting around.  The bar is cash only.

googleReviews.author: Simon Eats Too Much
googleReviews.text:
Alright, this place’s food is freaking fantastic and very unique. Settled nearby the main street in Gaslamp, so not as busy. There are nearby parking lots that result in maybe a 5-minute walk here.

The food was delicious, especially the Pork Belly Benedict. It was sweet, the meat was tender, and every single bite was unique. We were told by our waitress that we must try it, and shoot she was right. Best Eggs Benedict I’ve ever had. The California Burrito was also really good. These two orders will give you a filling, tasty lunch for two. Fair prices as well.

It was Valentine’s Day when I visited, and that was my mistake to come dressed up here lol. Not even trying to sound pretentious, I just mean this is more of a sports bar vibe. It’s SD so expected to smell marijuana in the air, and this place had loud music making it difficult to hear my partner across from me. There’s a bar inside with a lot of seating. Restrooms were kinda gross and out of napkins, but staff were super friendly and attentive. Overall cool spot to hangout with friends, but definitely not a fancy date spot lol.

googleReviews.author: rachel lapidus
googleReviews.text: Dope spot. Wills have loved to have more time to check out the night scene too. The brunch was amazing though! I got the pork belly Benedict fire! And we got the country fried steak delicious.

googleReviews.author: Jenn The Great
googleReviews.text: This place is supercalifragilisticexpialidocious!! Our server Anna was awesome! The food was even better. I had my two little ones with me (8yrs and 12yrs) and Anna was so great with them. The bloody Mary was just to dead for. When we roll through San Diego again, we will definitely be stopping by. Thank you for a great experience.

googleReviews.author: Steven Wood
googleReviews.text: This place has a good Brunch. I had Biscuits and Gravy. I had the Waterfront Sliders another night, that were exceptionally small,even for a Slider,but they were good. They have solid Happy Hour Specials and it looks like a $19 Rib Special on Thursdays. I haven't tried it. This place has a Corporate Vibe, and the Service is pretty bad, meaning slow and unfocused. I struggled to get a beer , I struggled to get my check. They weren't really that busy,so that was not the problem. The Website is pretty cheesy with Girls dancing on the Bar and other revelry, I can assure you, none of that was happening here, nor felt like it ever would. All in all, not a bad place. Could use tighting up a bit .

googleReviews.author: Stephen Calles
googleReviews.text: Best Bar and Brunch spot in San Diego. Was in town for a conference and actually visited this place twice. Jasmine was very polite and attentive. When we came back the next night they had karaoke and it was such a blast. Loved this place so much I bought a dang sweater. Also comics on the wall were pretty darn cool too!!

googleReviews.author: Camille S
googleReviews.text:
Finally got to check out Hive for the first time and had so much fun!

I feel like sometimes the karaoke system is kind of difficult when it comes to queueing up song, but this was SUPER easy.

There's a separate tablet for both ordering food and for songs. It was only the 4 of us, so we were in one of their smaller rooms and honestly it was the perfect size

it felt like we had a potluck bc of all the food we ordered but the wings were def our fav!!!! SO GOOD, tried basically all flavors

googleReviews.author: Collette Ojeda
googleReviews.text: Fun place. A little hard to find at first because it's located inside another restaurant. But once you find it, it's a cool place. Love the open concept when you walk in the main area. Karaoke rooms could use a new paint job and maybe better lighting, and there was one bartender that could have been a little more friendly (he seemed annoyed when you asked for anything--and it's not like we were asking for much) but other than that, had a great time. Perfect for casual parties. 👍🏽

googleReviews.author: Rock Lan
googleReviews.text:
Went here on a 4/26 Sunday 6pm room 7, parking on the area was packed, hard to find one just fyi.
Guy on the counter looks like he didn't want to work there and had 0 enthusiasm , the food was good tho, easy to order on the iPad . The seats had ripped parts, the floor and table were sticky . The music control was close to the TV and can block the others singers view while you were inputting songs, the keyboard remote wasn't working. The music selections were so so and was lagging 20% of the time. The walls were thin and you can definitely hear the other rooms well enough. The lighting was nice! Price was on the pricier side compared to other Karaoke places. Overall the experience was so so, would I come back to this place? Maybe if they had a discount but who knows .

Additional info they don't subtract the charge of your $25 reservation from your main bill

googleReviews.author: Jason Mario
googleReviews.text: Had such an amazing time with my friends there. Amazing food both in the room and also at the shared restaurant area. We booked for two hours and it went super fast. They had tons of song options in English and Spanish and really good quality, they use Singa for their karaoke, so we even made a playlist before we came to sing when we arrived. We stayed after for even more drinks at the bar will be back to visit soon for sure.

googleReviews.author: none ya
googleReviews.text: This place has individual rooms, call ahead of time and reserve your room. You can order food and drinks, it's standard pup food and it's good. The people who work here are kind and capable. Only reason I don't give this place 5 stars is because the rooms get hot if you have a large group, the microphones, and internet could be a bit better.

name: Melody Karaoke & Cafe
address: 4344 Convoy St, San Diego, CA 92111, USA
about: Melody Karaoke & Cafe is a karaoke bar in San Diego, California. It holds a 3.8-star rating from 189 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Chia Vang
googleReviews.text:
The floor in the karaoke room was really sticky. It looked like they put us in a room that a group had just finished using because there were still pitchers and cups left behind. They removed those items but never came back to actually clean the table. We also had to use an app to play karaoke songs, and the selection was extremely limited. We didn’t enjoy our time as much because we spent so long searching for songs.

Every time we wanted to order anything, we had to step out of the room to do it. We also had to go ask for the pitcher of water after waiting awhile, even though they said they would bring it. If gratuity is already included in the rates, I would expect and appreciate better service.

For food, there was a hair in the dumpling — thankfully, they refunded us. If you order chicken wings, make sure you check the prices before you pay. We were almost charged double, and they told us it wasn’t fixable. After we asked them to correct it, they weren’t able to adjust it, so they removed it from our bill instead. We’re glad they were willing to work with customers to fix the issue.

googleReviews.author: Sharon B
googleReviews.text:
We stumbled upon this place on a Saturday night. They had a small room available for our group of 6. There's a 2 hr minimum per room which was the perfect amount of time for us.

The room was very clean and there were microphone covers. The employees were all very helpful and nice.

We just came from dinner but ordered their popcorn chicken and fries. The popcorn chicken was really good. We ordered tea and sodas too. Orders were taken at the counter outside the rooms but they will bring your food to your room.

Like some have said, the music is mostly Chinese and the selection of American music is very limited. That was a little frustrating.
We had to download their app on our iPhone to use. The machine in the room is in Chinese and so we couldn't really use it directly to pull up songs we wanted. Everything was done through their unreliable app.

googleReviews.author: Lily P
googleReviews.text: The karaoke itself is fine, but do not order food from here. Waited 30 minutes for chicken teriyaki, thinking it was taking that long because it was made to order, but when they brought it to us the chicken was ice cold. Not even sure if it was cooked. Did not eat it because I was pretty sure it’d get me sick.

googleReviews.author: Jael Cruz
googleReviews.text:
This was my first time ever coming here and I just want to say that Everything was excellent, from food/drinks to music.I loved that there was options for non alcohol drinkers. Had caffeine free tea and many other drinks. My friends enjoyed their alcohol drinks as well! Hosts were very attentive and patient in explaining the menu if we had any questions. Great atmosphere! Very clean and kept.
Hostess gave us clear instructions in how to navigate with karaoke. It seems at first  like there are no english songs options because of how the app is set up.the App that is used for karaoke, gets downloaded from app store and gets linked from phone app to tv. There are plenty English karaoke options if you type songs under search tab.
I had a wonderful birthday experience, I really appreciate how the hosts went out of their way to give us an exceptional customer service. I look forward to coming here again! Thank you so much guys!

Starbar was the only place that acknowledged us when we walked up to the bar, and the service was top tier. Rob and Dalton were amazing,  friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. googleReviews.author: unprettyjournal
googleReviews.text: Came here on an impromptu date night on a Saturday around 7pm and stayed about 2 hours. The 2 ladies at the front desk were so sweet and nice!! We had already eaten before hand so we didn't bring our own food but we just ordered a couple of soju bottles and that was enough for me and my husband. They have a HUGE selection of songs ranging from older hits to the Kpop Demon hunters soundtrack already on the list! Navigating the remote was really easy since they do provide an English language translation for all the buttons. We could have easily spent a few more hours here but we will definitely be back and would easily recommend this place to everyone for any kareoke outing!

googleReviews.author: Jesus Ayala
googleReviews.text: The owners were nice and accommodating. All of the terms and conditions were clear and laid out. The sound system and rooms were great too. They don’t serve food but they let you bring your own, even your own unlimited drinks with a corkage fee.

googleReviews.author: Michelle M
googleReviews.text:
Looking for a place to hang out with your friends or family?

This is my favorite BYOB karaoke bar in convoy. Not only do they have the best prices, but you can come here and bring your own food and drinks.
Be for warned that they do have a corkage fee. Make sure you clean up your mess so that you don’t mess it up for anybody else. There is a bathroom, but it is outside and there is a key.

The rooms have lights, air condition, tambourines, and a great sound system. My opinion for a great for; you, party of two, or a party with your friends and family or coworkers. It is on the second floor, there are stairs and the elevator.

If you forgot your snack snacks they have a menu and beer available as well

googleReviews.author: Allie
googleReviews.text:
Wanted to write a good review because the karaoke experience was great but when I asked my friend for the receipt the next morning, I realized they severely over charged us ($130) and had to go back the next day to get a refund.

I went for my birthday with friends and they tried to over charge us and use camera footage against us.

I made the reservation for 7pm for 6 people. When we walked in, they confirmed our party, and said “for 7 people”, I thought it was an error but everyone was there so I didn’t correct him. Little did I know there is a cost difference from 3-6 people to 7-9 people. They pulled up the camera footage to prove I agreed for 7 people. I showed them photos of our group of 6 so they agreed to refund that.

Then they charged an extra $90 and said we brought our own beer. They pulled up the camera and pointed to my grocery bag that had snacks.

The receipt has a charge for BYOF (bring your own food). They don’t charge for food, only outside alcohol so why is there a code for that and why was it $90 when I called before and they said the corkage fee was $50?

I had to show photos and videos from my phone to show them our table full of snacks and count the people in it before they gave us that refund.  The refund was even wrong but at that point I just wanted to leave. They refunded us for 2 hours for a party of 7 not 3 hours but it wasn’t worth battling an extra $10-15 or whatever it was.

The only reason I didn’t look at the receipt that night was because it was my birthday, and my friends insisted on paying for me. They weren’t familiar with what to look for on the receipt so they blindly paid.

Be cautious of going here with groups and just double check your receipts if you do go. Like I said, the karaoke experience was really fun
but this was a terrible way to do business. We cleaned up our entire room, took all of our trash and food out with us. They literally had to do minimal work, and my friend gave them a generous tip that was not deserved.

googleReviews.text: A good experience, I liked the drinks, calmness on a Sunday night, and overall I feel I could read or study here if I had to. But earlier this week there were many people and Karaoke was good.

googleReviews.author: Chris Clippinger
googleReviews.text: Absolutely love this place. Your quintessential dive bar. Been coming here for karaoke for nearly 15 years, even before they moved to their current location. Have made so many friends here over the years, and even met my wonderful bf here. The drinks are STRONG and the prices are low. The bartenders are awesome, they all have different personalities that add up to a great mix and they are so funny. Karaoke is 7 nights a week and on the weekends you get a big exciting crowd; on the slower weeknights you get more chances to sing or try a new song out with less pressure of a big crowd. They have the mics up loud on the busy nights, and a tiny bit lower on the slower ones, so the levels feel balanced well over the ambient bar noise in any given night without it being impossible to talk to the person next to you. All 3 KJs mix the levels on the mics from singer to singer to help everyone sound their best. They have a huge library, but you can request a song they don’t have and they will try and find it for you on the spot or have it ready for next visit. Parking around Convoy is insane certain times of the day, but I’ve never had trouble at all showing up even as early as 8. It can get a little crowded in the center between 5:30-7:30pm but there is also a lot of street parking available. And karaoke starts at 9pm anyway so never any trouble for me. Love you CH. Thanks for all the fun times and good memories and cheers to many more!

googleReviews.author: Anton S.
googleReviews.text:
Atmosphere: 7/10
Located in Little Italy, tucked inside another bar. Classic tiki vibe with a strong backbar and immersive decor. Music is loud overall—typical for tiki bars. Seating is limited: a few tables and bar seats, with many standing-only spots, which makes the space feel crowded quickly.

Drinks: 7/10
Recommendation: Three Dots and a Dash
Stylish, high-quality tiki menu with an exhaustive selection. Tiki mugs and themed glassware throughout; garnish work is solid. Flavor execution is average—fun and approachable, but not especially refined. Presentation is standard.

Service: 6/10
Water service is inconsistent—typically only provided with a reserved table. Team is friendly, professionalism is average, and attentiveness drops during busy periods. Reservations are recommended to secure a table. Prices are slightly below average for San Diego.

googleReviews.author: Shreya Nooli
googleReviews.text: This has to be the coolest bar I’ve ever been to. The bartenders are amazing and insanely knowledgeable, they had a ton of complicated drinks but they knew every single one of them. I got the Matchaloooha, which sounded cool, it was great but didn’t have a lot of matcha😂 I loved the whole experience and just went there by myself for my birthday, the bartender was very sweet and nice (I forgot his name I think it was John?) and was the only one to wish me that night! My first time being alone at a bar, it was fun! PS, they don’t serve food at all.

googleReviews.author: Armand
googleReviews.text: If you're in Little Italy, San Diego, definitely check out False Idol. It's a speakeasy within Craft and Commerce. An amazing tiki bar awaits you, which does escapism well and specializes in tropical cocktails. They have a large selection of rums and serve other beverages as well. A mixologists approach to the cocktail is taken, and fresh ingredients are prepared in-house. They have an amazing drink menu, featuring images of the staff, as well as the drink selections. If you're looking for an awesome tropical getaway, accompanied by great customer service, delicious well balanced cocktails and overall friendly people, this is your spot. It's drinks only, so plan solid nourishment accordingly. Definitely look into reservations, especially headed into the weekends, but they will accommodate walk-ins, depending on the crowds. Cheers and I'll definitely see you at the bar!

googleReviews.author: AJ
googleReviews.text:
The atmosphere here is very unique, with a fully themed interior that makes the place feel different from typical bars.
The cocktails were good, and there are a lot of options to choose from cocktails🍹
They also serve some light snacks, which is convenient if you want something small to go with your drink.

It gets pretty busy, so making a reservation is recommended if you want to get a seat without waiting.

googleReviews.text: False Idol was a tiki lovers dream! From the moment you step through the entrance you’re fully immersed into a tropical getaway! We came to celebrate my 33rd birthday and Crizel and team made our experience super memorable! The drinks were well crafted and delicious and the service was absolutely above and beyond. Honestly one of our best experiences in San Diego, we cannot recommend this fun tiki bar enough! Thank you Crizel and False Idol!!!

googleReviews.author: Pranali Lad
googleReviews.text:
This place is super fun for a group karaoke party!
When you book, you get assigned to a room. All rooms have a nice cough, tables, 3 screens with lyrics and one control screen where u search the songs you wish to sing. Each room also comes with 2 mics
You bring your own food and drinks. There's chips and little snacks in the lobby.
The songs themselves sound super cool - none of us were singers and we all loved how we sounded! There is some type of filter on which makes it fun. You do hear yourself different when singing, more original but the people hear the filtered version which sounds cooler lol
Price point was okay for a large group as we split everything.

2 things that I would like to mention
- The bathroom is okay. One of the ladies used it but I didn't.
- The mics kept losing charge so we had to keep getting them changed. I think we had to do this 3-4 times in a 2hr slot
- We could hear other rooms as their door was open but ours was closed, but otherwise the rooms are well soundproofed.

All in all, it was still a fun experience as our group took things in stride. And we would definitely go again.

googleReviews.text: Modern rooms, great sound system. I have yet to find a better karaoke environment in the South Bay yet. Had Asian food, and they held my reservation even though I was 20 min late!

googleReviews.author: Sofiya Joseph
googleReviews.text:
Perfect spot to have girls nights out. We are a group of 8. Reserved private room well ahead but pretty sure you'd get room even if you walk in. There were plenty of rooms. Maintained neatly. They had good selection of bollywood and Spanish songs which we were interested at. They had songs in many other languages too.
You can order food from the room and food will be brought directly to the room. They didn't have many options for vegetarian food. Wish they had good options for finger foods.

googleReviews.text: The song selection is average. We couldn’t find some of the songs we wanted to sing. We tried the Thai tea, and it was delicious. This is a drug-free facility, so there is no alcohol or smoking. Overall my groups had a fun time here!

googleReviews.text: Such a fun night for everyone! The song selection is huge, so you can sing pretty much any song you want all night long. googleReviews.author: Kevin Cheng
googleReviews.text:
The Magpie is hands-down the best karaoke spot in town! The moment you walk in, you can tell it's a super modern and stylish place, which makes for such a fun and comfortable night out.
What really sets this place apart is the song selection. Forget outdated songbooks; they let you search for any song you want right on YouTube. It's a total game-changer and meant we could sing all of our favorite obscure hits that you can never find anywhere else.
The sound is great, the vibe is fantastic, and the ability to sing whatever you want makes for an unforgettable evening. Highly recommend The Magpie for a truly fun karaoke experience!

googleReviews.author: Sungwon La
googleReviews.text:
An amazing karaoke experience!

I came here with a group of friends, and we had an absolute blast. The private rooms were super clean, comfortable, and had great soundproofing — we could sing our hearts out without feeling self-conscious. The song selection was huge, with both English and Korean options (plus plenty of recent hits). The sound system was crisp, and the mics actually worked perfectly the whole night — which isn’t always the case at karaoke spots!

Highly recommend. I will be coming back often.

about: 7 Bamboo Lounge is a karaoke bar in San Jose, California. It holds a 4.3-star rating from 41 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Stacy Daigh
googleReviews.text: Great and fun karaoke bar with the right kind of party vibes. Anyone that can sing is welcome without any pressure

googleReviews.author: Julie Larson
googleReviews.text: 7 Bamboo has a wonderful positive vibe. The range of ages and ethnicities and singing skills is so perfect and cool. My group of work friends had such a great time last weekend that they have already planned a repeat.

googleReviews.author: Ricj
googleReviews.text:
Let this be a notice to7 bamboo that one of your employees desperately needs de-escalation training, and a warning to people going there.

Last Friday, an employe from 7 Bamboo handled a situation in a way that felt unnecessarily aggressive and honestly could’ve gone a lot worse.

I get that businesses have the right to refuse service or ask someone to leave that’s not the issue. The problem is how it was done. Within minutes of us being let in, my friend was forcefully removed with no warning and no real explanation.

When I asked why, the employee just said my friend was too intoxicated. I asked what he actually did and he just said the same thing. At one point I even said, Are you serious? This is a karaoke bar. People are drinking. Can you give me an actual explanation on what he did to have you physically remove him.

After that, his whole attitude shifted. He got more aggressive in how he was standing and talking, and kept saying it didn’t matter, my friend had to go. The situation began to feel unnecessarily aggressive. Fortunately, another staff member stepped in, recognized the tension, and addressed me in a respectful manner. After that conversation my friend and I left.

Later, I came back to make sure my friend didn’t have a tab open. The same employee who helped before was cool about it and asked me to wait outside, which was no problem. While I was talking to someone outside, the same aggressive employee came over, pointed at me, and made additional remarks. I told him you can back off and go away now cause we are done.

Yeah we had some drinks before we got there. We walked over there fine and was let in without any issue, so the way things escalated didn’t make sense.

I didn’t get his name, but he was a Hispanic male, between the height of 5’7” - 5’11”, wearing a black cap and a black shirt with nothing on it showing he was security or staff.

This isn’t about making a big deal out of nothing it’s about how situations get handled. That kind of approach can turn a normal night into a bad situation real quick.

Just watch out future guests. If you have a few drinks before arriving and wanting to have a beer and sing a song, a good night can go for a turn.

googleReviews.author: Raul Peralez
googleReviews.text: It wouldn’t be Japantown without a proper karaoke bar. This is a great spot to visit with friends, or you could plan a team building trip like I did!

googleReviews.text: Fun filled environment … thoroughly enjoyed our evening…. Highly recommended for Groups and couples… the energy in the atmosphere was thrilling

Beware of the hidden charges. The room rental cost $115 ($59/hour for 7 people) for 2 hours but then there's "mandatory" 18% system/cleaning fee and 20% service charge (the lady went in our room only one time to bring the drink and food we ordered that we have to order at the front. There's no other people in this place but us but the smell of the restroom smells really awful.

I do not recommend coming to this place!!!!

googleReviews.author: Autumn Cao
googleReviews.text: I had a fun experience at this karaoke place! Clean, spacious rooms with a solid selection, though I wish they had certain songs I was looking for such as Broadway musicals. They had rooms of varying size groups. Staff were all very nice and polite. I think the pricing was a bit expensive, but still within the realm of reasonable. Parking was easy to find, but I heard that is not usually the case.

googleReviews.author: janet
googleReviews.text:
It’s a hot summer day and AC was broken so the small room without windows was really hard for us to stay, I couldn’t breathe properly without leaving the room every 10 minutes.

We arrived at the front desk and for more than 5 minutes no staff showed up.

There’s also a 18% forced tip where they describe as cleaning fee so be aware of that. When we asked about this fee the staff told me normally they’d charge ppl a second tip on top of this so we should be thankful for not being asked to tip again. After we paid the whole bill anyways, he said he could have given us a discount if we hadn’t question about the extra fee. Kinda weird cuz I already paid so how are you gonna give me a discount?…

The machines themselves have no problems and mics worked fine. Service is kinda concerning. No AC in a room with no ventilation is something they should mention in the reservation phone call too.

Honestly, between the good vibes, great service, and friendly staff, I’ll definitely be coming back!

googleReviews.author: S P (we.must.consume)
googleReviews.text: Well I can't speak for the food I did appear here to go to a Halloween party. I did not partake in any karaoke so I cannot speak on how karaoke is but I noticed they have rooms that looks pretty cool nice size karaoke rooms with service if you order food to the rooms. They seem to always have something going on at this location is located next door to the supermarket which is also fabulous. Take it if you're in the mood for karaoke definitely check them out or if you want to come out and dance and have a drink & a DJ on some occasions

googleReviews.author: Randy Wehner
googleReviews.text: Fun atmosphere and seating in the booths.   They provide 2 options for choosing your karaoke music.  1. YouTube via 1 of your parties phones.  If that person doesn't pay for YouTube Premium then you will spend some of your hour listening to commercials you can't skip.  Option 2 is the traditional karaoke book.  If I went again I would most likely go with option 2.

googleReviews.author: Michael W.
googleReviews.text:
KP Karaoke & Dining is a fun place to go with friends or family if most of your friends and family members like to sing. Their karaoke rooms have a good selection of songs, or you can connect your phone with songs from the internet.

The service is hit and miss. We can’t find any workers sometimes if we want to place drinks or food orders. But the drinks and food quality are okay. You will like this place if you enjoy singing!

googleReviews.author: Erik Lehman
googleReviews.text: I love this place. The people, the wait staff, the food and of course the drinks. Try this place you will not be disappointed. Rent a karaoke room or sit at the bar and watch sports on any of the large flat screens. Enjoy the food it is far better than any other bar. Especially the lumpia, ramen or wings.

googleReviews.text: Had my girls bday party here at the Cornerspot and man did we had a blast. We got the Gatsby room that night and it comfortably fitted out group of 25. googleReviews.author: bartellj
googleReviews.text: This is a locals dive bar with a Lotta character. The bartenders do heavy pours! It’s kind of hidden upstairs which is nice. Lots of space and a great bar top to drink out. Definitely older style ambience. Has a lot of oak panel siding and trim. This is great for day drinking or if you come past 1030 you can hit the night crowd and it gets a little wild music and dancing. The bar staff is really nice so don’t be rude to them or anyone in the bar!

googleReviews.author: Ashley Bell
googleReviews.text: Karaoke was super fun! Dive bar drinks

googleReviews.author: Zoe M
googleReviews.text: These guys are weirdos about their water. Came for Karaoke in November for my bday, asked for just regular tap since we were already multiple pitchers and shots deep and I was thirsty. They told me they only have bottled water and it’s a dollar. Then thr female bartender said I can have one for free. Yippee! Then when my fiance tried to get water they told him it was two bucks. Another person got told three bucks. When we asked the bouncer how much water usually costs you he said it’s free. Mind you were all paying patrons! And they refuse to give you water in a cup and instead wanna charge you for bottled (when it’s literally illegal to withhold/charge for water). Anyway most of us resorted to filling our empty beer cups in their gross bathrooms lol. My friend literally went to the chevron to go to the bathroom bc they’re so nasty but at least the sink was ok lol. I mean I’m used to gross and it’s a dive bar and even then he went to a GAS STATION instead. That should tell u how bad it was. This is also not the first or last time this whole water thing happened!!! Also it’s so loud you can’t hear the person sitting right next to you but at the same time the karaoke audio is so shitty u can barely make out the words. Just a huge mess of a bar lol. Needless to say I won’t be returning 🫨

googleReviews.author: Hannah Page
googleReviews.text: We came in here with a big group and ordered a couple pitchers of beer. They gave some folks water for free and then asked for $2 when another person ordered it. We assumed it was because our DD was sober when she asked for water and they didn’t know our group had already ordered multiple pitchers. When she walked up and grabbed another water (after they’d already told others in the group it was free), they accused her of stealing and kicked us out. Felt really unnecessary, we were just starting our night out and are generally a respectful crew!

googleReviews.author: TheTech660
googleReviews.text: Just had my Daughter's Birthday party here! What an experience! Never been to a Karaoke/Chinese restaurant before. How we discovered this was through my other Daughter, who comes here with friends on a regular night out. The Karaoke room was a nice atmosphere to sing in and also to eat in. The staff, especially the Lady that helped us from beginning to end was very helpful! (1/24/2026 4-7pm our stay RM #2) Food was great in my opinion. Had the Mongolian beef with white rice. I would definitely come back and try their newly remodeled RM #1! Thanks You Star KTV Lounge for a Fun Evening!

googleReviews.author: Raymond Fok
googleReviews.text: Awesome food with wok hay.  Especially the Beef Chow Fun, and the soy sauce chow mein.

googleReviews.author: Michael W.
googleReviews.text: Many people in Sacramento know Star KTV Lounge about their famous karaoke. But they are also an excellent Chinese restaurant. They have delicious Chinese dishes and very attractive customer service. I love to have my meal here even if I'm not using their karaoke room. The only problem is their parking lot is jam-packed. I have trouble getting a parking space almost whenever I'm there. Street parking is available, but it is also hard to get.

googleReviews.author: Ahmet Can Güler
googleReviews.text:
I came here on a Tuesday night with a group of friends around 11:15 PM. Even though it was later in the evening, everything was still fresh, vibrant, and absolutely delicious. We ordered eight different dishes to share, and every single one of them was outstanding. The flavors were perfectly balanced—bold, rich, and incredibly satisfying. It might honestly be the best Asian food I’ve ever had.

We also enjoyed a bucket of beers, which made the whole experience even more fun. From start to finish, everything exceeded our expectations. You can really tell that the kitchen takes pride in every plate that comes out.

This was my first time here, but it definitely won’t be my last. I’ll be recommending this place to all of my friends. The atmosphere was welcoming, the service was attentive and friendly, and the food was exceptional.

Thank you for such a memorable experience.

googleReviews.author: Ly So
googleReviews.text:
CANCELLED our booking for a teen birthday party of up to 25 people on 9 March in their VIP KTV room 2-7pm on a Sunday.   Reason: It is too expensive here!

Went on 23 Feb to try out the place..
$70 for 1 hour to sing and eat for THREE people in their smallest KTV room!

Ordered 2 food items, salt pepper fish $16 and Hong Kong noodle $15.
This place charges a mandatory 18% gratuity the moment you sing, eat and drink in their KTV room!

$24/hour smallest KTV room before 7pm
(be $48 after 7pm!) +$16 fish + $15 noodle (drank ice water only!)
=$55 + 8% tax + 18% gratuity
=$55 + 4.40 + $9.90
=$69.30!  (70 cents to $70!)

Cancelled our booking of their VIP room for up to 25 people that will cost $54/hour.
($108/ hour after 7pm!)

$2.50 per can of soda = $62.50 if every of 25 people gets ONE can.
Or, $10 for a small jug of juice for 4 people, $70 for 7 jugs for 28 people.
Add cost of food for 25 people, estimate $10 per person average, total $250 to $300.

VIP KTV room + drinks + food
=$54X5 hours + $70 + $300
=$270 + $70 + $300
=$640   + 8% tax  + 18% mandatory gratuity
=$640 + $51.20 + $115.20
=$806.40 !!

Over $800 Just to sing, eat and drink for 5 hours during their NON-PEAK hours!!

Decided to CANCEL the booking, instead, went on Amazon to buy 2 karaoke speakers that each comes with 2 wireless microphones, $95 each set, ~$200.

Just need to clean up our house, decorate with balloons etc, and have the birthday party in the comfort of our home!

This way, not only can save $806.40-$200
= ~$600 for food and drinks!
But also, we get to keep the speakers for more of future karaoke sessions instead of just pay and go home with nothing!!

But I’ll say, the salt pepper fish and noodle tasted decent, might go back to eat, in the restaurant NOT in their KTV room!!
(Thus, 2 star for this review)

Parking is limited and tight, not ideal for big group party.
Neighbourhood does not look or feel too safe I would feel even more so at night?
Maybe 60% safe out of the 100% safest-feeling neighbourhood?

googleReviews.author: Rachel Erotika
googleReviews.text: SNUG bar has awesome Halloween decorations, is more on the fancy side yet, a spooky bar and serves great old-fashioned cocktails. Great bartenders and cocktails are served in awesome spooky mugs. I love the spooky horror-themed, eerie lighting and relaxing atmosphere. They don’t serve any food, but you’re more than welcome to bring your own. We loved it this place while visiting town for Aftershock.

googleReviews.author: Stevee G
googleReviews.text: When my wife and I travel we always look for speakeasies. This one was on my list for a while, and we came here for her conference on our anniversary. We were treated really well. The drinks were fantastic. The ambiance was great. The staff was really nice. Definitely, had the speekeezy vibes we were looking for.

googleReviews.author: Jason Williams
googleReviews.text: Very chill relaxing spot with a vibey, stately type feel that is snug and cozy. The drink menu is very creative and reaches into some fun areas with some great spins on classics, and a plethora of original recipes. This is most definitely a great date night spot, or to meet up with friends.

googleReviews.author: Briana Bizzle-King
googleReviews.text: I was referred over here by a very nice bartender from Shipwrecked! He did NOT disappoint in the recommendation!!! The place lived up to its name being placed in a tight, cozy back corner. You have to know where you're going, or you'll definitely walk right it! Inside though, it's very spacious! The bartenders/mixologists are INCREDIBLY knowledgeable and very welcoming! He made some drinks based on my personal preferences of Tequilas and Mezcals that were AMAZING! Then,  he made a snack concoction to go with the drinks that were pure DELIGHT! I will DEFINITELY be back again!

googleReviews.author: Michael W.
googleReviews.text: The Snug is a happy place to be with friends. They have all the delicious drinks and holiday season drinks available. The indoor area is busy and has a lively atmosphere. The holiday decorations are beautiful. The outdoor seating area is perfect for drinks with friends, and the bench seats are comfortable. They are very busy with lines at the front door all the time. Come at the time when they first open on the day before they get super busy is a good idea.

googleReviews.author: Leanna Le
googleReviews.text: Our group of 11 just did two hours in the biggest room here, though we should have booked it for at least three hours! Ace was very welcoming and walked us through how everything worked. We took advantage of the option to bring in outside food (super appreciated!) for a small fee. There are snacks available to purchase up front and we easily ordered alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks through a QR code in the room. There is a small cooler bag in each room that Ace puts the drinks in after you order. The chairs are comfy and there are fans to keep you cool. Our group will definitely be back! I also appreciate that hourly rates here are better than back home in the Bay Area! Thank you Ace for a great experience from the moment we walked in the door to the moment we left!

googleReviews.author: dyna san
googleReviews.text: Had a blast tonight! This place was awesome. They have rooms depending on your party sides. The owner was really accommodating and nice. Their song selections are pretty good and they have drinks, seltzers, and snacks. I'm so happy a place like this exist in Fresno. Try it out you won't regret it! We'll be coming back regularly!

googleReviews.author: Jastine Berlin
googleReviews.text: I wanted to sing without people gawking at my awful performance. This place popped up, and I'm glad I put down a reservation. The place is immaculate! The karaoke machine is easy to use and the acoustics were great. I spent 2 hours singing my heart out. They also take song requests that will hopefully be added to the system, so next time you come over, it might be on the list.

googleReviews.author: Adrianne James Datiles
googleReviews.text: Absolutely a great experience! My friends and I have been eye-ing this Place for months. We finally got a chance to get together and go this past weekend! Absolutely amazing experience! The room was private and very comfortable 😁 You can’t expect a karaoke place to have all the songs you want, but they had the songs we liked 80% of the time. Overall, loved it! And it’s LOCAL

googleReviews.author: Ray Valle
googleReviews.text: I love this place! Very clean and private. Just hoping more music options are added. Extremely affordable as well. Will definitely be back.

googleReviews.author: Kimberly Bounlutay
googleReviews.text: Our wedding DJ wasn’t just great – he was incredible. googleReviews.author: Jeanette Harley
googleReviews.text: We had my son 21st birthday party and my husband 39 birthday party 🎈 🎊 🥳. They had an amazing time. All of my guest absolutely love it they're. We are thinking about. Having our next year's christmas party in one of the karaoke rooms. We'll definitely be going back.

googleReviews.author: Charnela Mountz
googleReviews.text: I really loved this place but I went last night, which was Tuesday and they were supposed to close at 11pm. I went at 9:47pm and they said after 9:45 they don't sell bowling lanes anymore nor pool. Though I had went the other day and was told they stopped selling at 10pm. It just felt very inconsistent. It was a fun place to hang out with friends. Though after this experience I don't think I will be coming back here. If the establishment stops selling at a certain time it should be posted online, the whole experience was just unpleasant. A loyal customer was lost.

googleReviews.author: Martha Perez
googleReviews.text: Not too bad experience for our first time here. Bartender was busy but he was so kind and helped us as soon as he was able to. The Birria pizza was the best! Only thing that was kind of disappointing was that they advertise karaoke “All Day” but Sunday they stop at 9pm. 🙁

googleReviews.author: Angel
googleReviews.text: I always go here every Monday to watch Monday night football and sometimes on the weekends to play pool with friends. Ryann is an amazing server, always smiling and laughing and always on top of the things. Overall the food is pretty good, and it's a great atmosphere.

googleReviews.author: Chris Schmidt
googleReviews.text:
Hidden little paradise!

Being new to the area I had found X by mistake and one of my favorite places (especially for the games).  The service is great, food was amazing, games and bowling, what else could you ask for?? My happy place for sure!

Great atmosphere, great staff, great food!

If you’re trying to have an intimate conversation, probably not your place.
