googleReviews.author: WD Stoner
googleReviews.text: Looking for a down-to-earth, friendly, local bar? This is it! The service is great and friendly. Drinks made to order were delicious. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming for us out-of-staters. We really enjoyed our visit.

googleReviews.author: Juan Lara
googleReviews.text: Good music and plenty dancing. The bartenders were awesome cold beer 🍺

googleReviews.author: Esmeralda Rivas
googleReviews.text:
I love this place—the bartenders and staff are amazing. I went out to Tower one night for a concert, got very intoxicated, and accidentally left my wallet in an Uber on the way home. Unfortunately, the next person who was picked up in that same Uber took my wallet and stole the cash from it.

The next morning, I realized my wallet was missing and contacted Uber, but the driver did not have it. Hoping for some luck, I posted on Facebook. Nicky reached out to me and said she had found a wallet that matched mine. She was incredibly kind—she even went to her closed workplace just to retrieve it and met me later that night to return it. I was honestly panicking, thinking I had lost everything, and her kindness meant so much to me.

I also want to add that I am Mexican, and I believe the negative comments about this place are untrue. I’ve been here multiple times before and have always had positive experiences.

googleReviews.author: Gloria “La Yaqui” Romero
googleReviews.text: The Midori Sour was exquisite.. not many places get it right!! Had to have more than one 😁🥰

googleReviews.author: Jared Halphin
googleReviews.text: I have been to almost every bar in Fresno, and this bar is by far the worst bar I have ever been to. I've been to this bar about half a dozen times. It's always the same. The security will shove you into other people, stare at you in the eye and step on your toes to get you to say something to them so they can kick you out.. Bartenders are fair, drinks are fairly priced. DJ is okay, dancing area is small, one bar, bathrooms are smaller than an airplanes, only about 5 high top bar tables. Pool table is in an awkward spot. Extremely strict dress code..no sports attire (t shirts, hats, polos, etc)...can't wear any white tops...save your money and go elsewhere...literally anywhere else and you'll find a more friendly staff and not as strict dress code..

googleReviews.author: Stephany Monterroso
googleReviews.text: First time at this Karaoke lounge with 4 coworkers & it was so much fun!!! We got the medium sized room which I would say was great for us 5, a smaller room wouldn’t have given us enough room to dance. We stayed for 4.5 hours (part happy hour & part regular price) which was about $400 - including fried dumplings & drinks.

googleReviews.author: Carlos Gonzalez
googleReviews.text: A little hard to find. It's hidden in the very corner on the top floor. Workers are nice,friendly and helpful. It is a 15% gratuity so it can definitely raise the price up fast but still worth the fun nonetheless

googleReviews.author: Eric Lee
googleReviews.text:
Amazing karaoke place! Tad bit expensive unless you go with a lot of people.

Service is great and the employees are nice, but it might take a few pushes of the button for them to get there.

googleReviews.author: Dr.Maryam Fallatah
googleReviews.text: The service was okay — there were only two staff members working during our visit, and they did their best to assist everyone. Unfortunately, we experienced multiple issues with the karaoke microphones and had to request help several times. The lighting was uncomfortably dim, the food and drinks were not great, and the restrooms were poorly maintained. Our room also had a strong fried food smell coming from the nearby kitchen, which was unpleasant. In addition, a 15% service fee was automatically added to the bill, and we still ended up leaving a tip.

googleReviews.author: rilakkuma
googleReviews.text:
All the 1 star reviews have common complaints, and I couldnt agree more!!
The employee helping us/at the front desk was rude, food is bad and took forever to come, microphones didnt work, sound was horrible and almost ear piercing, couldnt even call staff to help us because they never came, control is almost impossible to use, room is extremely hot, the list goes on!! Ive seen many reviews complaining about the staff working here, and they are just as mean as the reviews say. Don’t come here

googleReviews.author: Arthur Ruiz
googleReviews.text: We came as we were. It was a very modern site karaoke. 🎤 It has many rooms to accommodate all size groups. The drinks were interesting and they had soo many choices. The food was delicious and not too filling. 😋 We had so much fun. We were there 2 hrs and it flew by. The prices were fair and the service was very friendly.

googleReviews.author: Jackie J
googleReviews.text: Always a fun time! Great individually controlled rooms. Choose your songs from a mega-list and sing to your heart's content. Staff are friendly, the food and drinks are good and its fun to have your own space to sing.

googleReviews.author: Ari C
googleReviews.text: Came for New Year's Eve karaoke, didn't know i had to reserve a room but luckily there was the main barfront room doing karaoke, so I hopped in for that. GREAT vibes. Great crowd. Prices for drinks were reasonable and the staff were super friendly. Loved my time here, thank you for making my trip enjoyable!!

googleReviews.author: JN
googleReviews.text:
Super fun but small place! Karaoke booths are nice, clean, and the song app is pretty updated with most modern songs both in English and in Asian languages. Drinks were great! They get booked pretty fast too so it's a good tip to call in a week or so in advance to book a room.

No free parking around the area and the place can get really busy at night.

googleReviews.author: koko
googleReviews.text: My favorite way to spend a night out in Seattle! It's also great for birthday parties. I wish they allowed for you to bring in some outside food since they have limited options and the food options aren't allergy safe. Remember to bring your ID because they will check that you're 21+

googleReviews.author: Graham Tian
googleReviews.text:
I had such a great experience at Vox Karaoke thanks to Jessica! She was incredibly friendly, patient, and attentive the entire night. From helping us get our room set up to quickly fixing any technical issues, she made everything super easy and enjoyable.
Jessica has that perfect balance of professionalism and warmth. She checked in just enough to make sure we had everything we needed without ever interrupting our fun. You can tell she genuinely cares about guests having a good time.
If you’re planning a karaoke night in Seattle, definitely ask for Jessica. She made our experience unforgettable, and I’ll for sure be coming back because of her!

googleReviews.author: Roxie He
googleReviews.text: I came here for my birthday and I highly recommend this place. The staff was great at making sure we were all taken care of while enjoying karaoke. It was a pleasure celebrating with my friends and family in a private room where we could sing our hearts out without any issues.

googleReviews.author: Joey Gu
googleReviews.text: Hosted my girlfriend’s birthday here. Very well communicated staff! It’s nice they put up some birthday decoration for us! Will be back for sure! Shout out to Eric

googleReviews.author: Katherine Yang
googleReviews.text: Karaoke prices are very reasonable, and they offer a solid selection of drinks. The only downside is the limited food options, so I’d recommend having dinner beforehand. Overall, it’s always a fun experience, and I’d definitely come back!

googleReviews.author: Olivia W
googleReviews.text: Had such a great time here! 🎤 The sound system is crystal clear, the song selection is huge with all the latest hits, and the private rooms are super clean and comfy. Staff were really friendly and quick to help set things up. Perfect spot to sing your heart out with friends — definitely coming back!

googleReviews.author: Scoot Josh
googleReviews.text:
First time coming to Nova Box with a group of six, and we had a really good experience. Pricing is based on the room, not per person. We got a small room for $43 an hour, which ended up being just a few bucks per person , totally reasonable in my opinion (drinks are extra).

I had seen some reviews saying the place was dirty, but that wasn’t the case at all when we were there. Everything looked clean, and I noticed the staff cleaning regularly throughout our visit.

Shoutout to Ivan and Jana! They were awesome. Super friendly, helpful, and made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.

Overall, we had a great time, and I’m actually considering having my birthday here later this year. Would definitely come back!

I come back again for my large group party, they was amazing!

googleReviews.author: Amy
googleReviews.text:
They offer private rooms in different sizes with different pricing, which makes it easy to choose the right option for your group. The private rooms are clean, modern, and well sound-proofed, with great audio quality that really makes singing more fun. Their song selection is decent, and everyone in our group was able to find songs they loved.

The staff were friendly, responsive, and made the whole experience smooth from start to finish. Drinks and snacks came out quickly, and the overall atmosphere felt comfortable and welcoming. Perfect spot for friends, birthdays, or just a casual night out. Highly recommend NovaBox if you’re looking for a top-tier karaoke experience in Seattle. (It’s very popular on weekends, so I highly recommend making a reservation in advance to secure a spot.)

googleReviews.author: Anna Y
googleReviews.text:
I came here for New Year’s Eve with a large group of friends, and we had a great time. We split the cost, which made it very affordable, and we also ordered some beers and fried chicken wings to enjoy while singing.

The place was clean, the atmosphere was fun, and the staff were friendly and polite. It’s a great spot for parties and group gatherings. I also heard they have happy hour deals on weekdays, which makes it even better value.

Overall, a fun and lively karaoke place—I’d definitely come back again.

googleReviews.author: Jiahui Lu
googleReviews.text: The sound effects are amazing and the service is also very nice. They open until so late that my friends and I always go here when we want to have some late night fun. The song choices are a wide variety which is great. Highly recommend this place.

googleReviews.author: Ja cky
googleReviews.text: Stopped by for a quick session. Staff were friendly and very quick to deliver the drinks. Nice hidden gem in the Udistrict. I would definitely revisit this place in the future with my people. NovaBox is the best!

googleReviews.author: Kylie Dugan
googleReviews.text: A nice spot for karaoke with friendly staff! The karaoke is one song per person per round, which was ~90 minutes when we went on a Thursday night. Love that the DJs/hosts get a chance to sing too!

googleReviews.author: Abryel Wilder
googleReviews.text:
Blatant Bias and Unprofessionalism  Ruined Birthday Celebration

Came all the way from Tacoma for my birthday and booked a room at Level Seattle specifically to enjoy this spot, but the experience was a total letdown. We signed up for karaoke at 9:30 PM. For hours, my three friends and I watched people walk in long after us, sign up, and get to sing, while we were completely ignored.

The Karaoke DJ appeared intoxicated or otherwise impaired. When I finally confronted him about why our names hadn't been called, he gave a dismissive excuse about 'nexting the rotation.' Even after speaking with a bartender—who was helpful enough to try and intervene—nothing changed. We spent nearly $300 on local accommodations and a heavy tab at this bar just to be blown off. The biased treatment is blatant. To the owner: Check your cameras for the night of May 9th- am of the 10th. Your DJ is driving away high-spending customers with his unprofessionalism and lack of sobriety. Disgusted.

googleReviews.author: Ronelda Baldonado
googleReviews.text: So much fun! Good food, strong drinks & good vibes! Highly recommend the wings. Went on a Saturday night around 8. Get there early for a table, it gets crowded. Note: they charge a $5 cover tho and no cash at the door.

googleReviews.author: Sebastian Bauer
googleReviews.text: This bar has a fantastic happy hour and some of the best karaoke in town. The vibe is great, but you should definitely arrive early since it gets incredibly busy on the weekends. If you love great deals and singing your heart out, this spot is a must-visit for a fun night out, just watch out for the crowds!

googleReviews.author: Peter Lee
googleReviews.text:
I decided to check out this bar for karaoke on a Wednesday evening around 7pm. The bar was pretty empty when I arrived, and it was just me and the staff members who ended up singing in the karaoke before I left shortly after, but I really enjoyed my visit.

The bartender lady and the lady that runs the karaoke were both very kind and lovely.

I am glad decided to stop by this place just before moving to New York.

googleReviews.text: I had a great experience at this place with my friends. The staff is very kind and helpful. It was only $20 a person for a room with disco lights and a lot of songs to choose from. Me and my friends were happy to see they had a variety of genres. It was also BYOE which is awesome. I will definitely be coming back!

googleReviews.author: Katie R
googleReviews.text: SBK is really the best!! ✨🎤 We come here all the time, and no other place around Seattle compares. Bring your own food and drinks and enjoy your own karaoke room with friends. It will be sorely missed 😞

googleReviews.author: Jimmy H
googleReviews.text:
It's literally a room with a laptop plugged into a TV and a sound system and microphones with cafe chairs around the edges I am amazed by how basic it was

The "software" on the laptop to pick songs is ridiculously hard to use or you just pick songs from YouTube.

Like just get a bunch of your mates and buy a couple of the Bluetooth microphones from Amazon

Owner seemed nice and it's pretty clean but sorry it's not a good karaoke experience

googleReviews.author: Naya U.
googleReviews.text: My family and friends loves this place, we’d travel an hr away to go here. I’m so sad that they might shut down, I hope everything will go well.

googleReviews.author: David M
googleReviews.text:
Not the sleekest karaoke spot.  The acoustics could be better.  I think it used to be a dentist office or something.  Definitely dentist vibes on the inside.
But if you just like to sing with friends, this is the spot. Affordable rates. Pay +$10 bring all your own food and drinks you want.  Great time every time.

about: Jupiter Bar is a bar in Seattle, Washington. It holds a 4.6-star rating from 1,510 Google reviews. Hangout with local art, cocktails & light fare, plus an arcade with pinball machines & a pool table. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Wm “Ben” Chitwood
googleReviews.text: Remember Chuck E Cheese? It's something like that, just no tickets, and sadly no rat. The front is a standard bar that can give you a cheap beer and shot, adult slurppes, and or a cocktail that exists nowhere in the known universe. Good Shape pizza is also in the front, 12" personal pizzas are the go to, these are really good. The back is a pinball heavy arcade, everything is curated, with a mix of vintage and new machines, including some current generation arcade cabinets, there's also a bar back there as well. The whole is venue is clad with local art, dripping with culture. This place has a lot of locals as well, that serve as Dungeon Masters for the local area, they will help you complete your adventures. There's also Xorbo's Lounge, which has karaoke, live events Wednesday, and can even be rented for private use. There's a reasonable amount of non-alcoholic options available as well. This place has a lot for everyone, so do not be surprised if it's moderately busy.

googleReviews.author: EC
googleReviews.text:
I actually like Jupiter a bit more than I realized! Sometimes it’s too crowded and not fun but if you hit it on a weeknight the bar is super pleasant to hang out in. Good crowd, nice bouncer (somehow feels rare lately) and they got tons of games back there!

They have live music occasionally and serve pizza (haven’t had it)

googleReviews.author: Reuben Renat
googleReviews.text:
Great! Lively! Great service and good drinks. Fun arcade too!
Definitely coming back next time in Seattle.

Did not try the pizza adjacent to the Jupiter, we were there to just drink!

googleReviews.author: K L
googleReviews.text:
I came to Jupiter to try the pizza at Good Shape, which is served inside the bar. As soon as I walked in, I was greeted by chill staff members. I ordered a pie and grabbed some drinks while we waited. The beer selection was nice, and the cocktails had some solid mixology behind them. The pizza was really good. I recommend it!

After eating, we decided to hang around and play some pinball games. It was a fun way to relive some childhood arcade moments. The prices for the games were pretty fair, though a few did seem a little overpriced. Overall, it’s definitely worth it if you’re just looking to relax, have a drink, and play some games.

The place has a laid-back vibe with two bars, and there’s also a karaoke lounge that seemed to be pretty popular while I was there. Overall, a cool spot if you're in the area.

googleReviews.author: Kumar Vaibhav
googleReviews.text:
I came here mostly to hangout. Turned out to be a pretty sick dive bar. Lots of arcade games options out here. Definitely played lots of games. You can exchange dollar bills for quarter coins and play arcade games. Pretty cool spot to hangout during late evenings. The cocktail options are limited but good. googleReviews.author: Brian
googleReviews.text: The Unicorn is truly a hidden gem in Seattle! As a gay man, I always feel welcomed and comfortable being myself here. The atmosphere is fun, inclusive, and full of energy. Tuesday Drag Bingo is always a blast, and the hosts Freya Love and Izzy Access are absolutely amazing — hilarious, energetic, and they make the whole night unforgettable. They also have great events throughout the week like Monday karaoke and Wednesday drag shows. If you’re looking for a fun night out with great people and lots of laughs, I highly recommend checking this place out!

googleReviews.author: Beatrice Doyle
googleReviews.text:
Oh my God, this place is amazing 🤩
Our bartender Burt Tarrosa is fabulously amazing 🤩
The Unicorn has an amazing atmosphere and vibe!
Friendly to all.
The drinks are generous and the people are amazing!
So glad we came here.
Please come when you're in the Seattle area!

googleReviews.author: Delonna Halliday
googleReviews.text:
This a great club! Being as I'm definably older than their target audience, I am happy to report we had a wonderful time! We arrived just before the peak surge. Drinks were delicious, and we only ordered loaded tots. The downside to service was the food arrived upstairs and we had to get it ourselves.
The DJ mixed well, and the small dance floor was quickly packed.
They had a lot of security who were all very courteous.

googleReviews.author: Genevieve Condron
googleReviews.text: The food is delicious, the drinks are so yummy, and the vibes are amazing. It is two floors of just pure fun. From the amazing decor, to the upbeat music, all the way to fun arcade. I highly recommend checking out. My only complaint is they don’t take tap or Apple Cards. Something about their system that doesn’t like them so make sure you have a physical card that isn’t Apple.

googleReviews.text: I had a great time with the fun atmosphere it's easy to meet a new friend. When my card fell out of my pocket at the unicorn, I was able to find it with the help of complete strangers. 🙂 This place is a true unicorn, mythical.

googleReviews.author: Maria Lyon
googleReviews.text:
My husband and I got married in Capitol Hill last week and headed from the reception straight to Crescent Lounge to sing Can't Take My Eyes Off of You. Everyone was SO nice. I was kind of nervous about showing up with this big old veil, but I shouldn't have been worried. Everyone was very kind. The bouncer even sang Just Like Heaven and dedicated it to us. We will be back!! Thanks for helping us end the day on a high note :)

Photo by Joe Tobiason

googleReviews.author: Isaac Pine
googleReviews.text:
Over the past year and a half, many changes have taken place at the Crescent Lounge. While not all of them have aligned with my personal preferences, I want to take a moment to recognize and commend Double D for the outstanding work they consistently deliver.

I attend all of their karaoke nights, and the experience is always exceptional. The music played between singers is fun and well curated, their energy is welcoming, and they clearly put extra care into mixing each performer to ensure everyone sounds their best. Beyond the technical skill, Double D brings a positive attitude, a genuine smile, and a clear passion for what they do.
In my interactions with them outside of performances, they have always been professional, respectful, and sincerely engaged with customers. Their dedication and care truly enhance the atmosphere of the bar!

11/10! an excellent asset to the Crescent Lounge.

googleReviews.author: Raven E
googleReviews.text:
Saturday night was easily one of the most enjoyable karaoke experiences I’ve had.
I’m a DJ from Oklahoma, visiting Seattle for the first time with my husband for my sister’s wedding. While spending the evening in Capitol Hill, we happened to stop by the Crescent Lounge and I’m really glad we did.
From the moment we walked in, the bartenders were friendly, efficient, and attentive. We had our drinks and our tab paid in under two minutes, which immediately made us feel welcomed.

We stayed for several hours, and Double D was hosting karaoke that night. He clearly takes pride in what he does. From handing out free stickers on the stage to engaging the crowd, his energy set the tone for a fun and welcoming atmosphere. When it was my turn to sing, I was greeted warmly, given a clean microphone, and even accommodated with a last minute song change which, as a DJ myself, I know isn’t always easy. The sound quality was excellent, and he did a great job hyping the crowd afterward, making the experience even more memorable.
Saturday night karaoke at the Crescent Lounge is truly top notch, and Double D is a big reason why.

The only downside to the evening was the tone of some interactions with the door staff, which felt more intense than expected and affected the overall comfort of the experience.

That said, overall we had a great night and would absolutely return especially for karaoke.

googleReviews.author: Sterling Vaughn
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been a regular customer on both Saturdays and Sundays for about a year. In recent weeks, however, I’ve chosen to stop attending on Saturdays and now only visit on Sundays due to repeated uncomfortable interactions with door staff.

On several occasions, the door staff on Saturdays approach toward my friends and me felt unnecessarily abrupt and unwelcoming. There were instances where security closely monitored our table, removed drinks before we had finished them, and used a very aggressive tone with patrons at closing time. While I understand the need to manage a busy bar, the manner in which this was handled felt excessive and inconsistent with the otherwise friendly atmosphere of the bar.

One situation in particular stood out, where a friend was asked to leave shortly after calmly questioning the tone being used with him. The situation escalated quickly and did not appear to be handled with de-escalation or clear communication. This left several of us feeling uncomfortable.

I genuinely enjoy The Crescent Lounge and appreciate the community it creates, which is why I’m sharing this feedback. I hope management considers reviewing front of house interactions to ensure guests feel welcome, respected, and comfortable returning.

googleReviews.author: Beatrice Doyle
googleReviews.text:
I loved everything but the smell of Pine Sol and Urine.
I'm happy for everyone that loves it but I have a smell issue.
Maybe closing the bathroom doors would help.
The bartender was super friendly and so were the people at the bar.
Good place it just needs some pretty smelling candles or something.

googleReviews.text:
This restaurant has been a famous spot in Seattle for years, and the service has improved significantly since the new ownership. I had the pleasure of meeting the owners, Erica and Pano, who are incredibly hospitable. Tonight, I had an amazing dinner featuring succulent Chinese cuisine.
I enjoyed the Singaporean noodles, Mongolian beef, and house fried rice. Without a doubt, they deserve their award winning Chinese food praise. As a bonus they are rated the best karaoke bar in Seattle and have some of the cleanest pinball machines. 10/10 highly recommend.

googleReviews.author: Erin Covington
googleReviews.text: Love the vibe! The bar is super cute, and the staff are genuinely friendly and welcoming. I rarely have a memorable encounter with a door guy, but the person working Saturday night was kind and funny, and had people in a great mood before they even walked in. Karaoke was a blast and the sound system is great. Very minor feedback: it was a little tough to hear my own vocals. Maybe a small monitor or speaker aimed at the singer would help? Drinks were amazing (thanks, J.T.!). We ordered a few bar snacks and everything was delicious. Good times, definitely recommend.

googleReviews.author: Jason Scott
googleReviews.text:
I have quite a few memories of PJ's Pub with many karaoke nights and some pool nights. Their food is affordable and actually quite good, their staff is nice, and their karaoke is awesome. The Establishment itself is beautiful hardwood and does indeed look like a pub. The outdoor beer garden is also very nice with lots of places to sit. My favorite part about PJ's is the karaoke which they have seven nights a week.

I have no complaints and I generally recommend PJ's to anyone seeking a good tavern atmosphere with decent food but also anyone who is seeking pub activities like darts, pool, and karaoke. I know they also have poker tournaments but I have never tried that so I cannot vouch for it, but I wanted to mention they do have poker.

googleReviews.author: Christian Adams
googleReviews.text: PJ's IS MY GOAT. My go to neighborhood pub. Decent tap selection, great bottle and can selection, good cocktails for more of a pub setting. Great patio. Great food. Karaoke every night of the week. Met the owner and she's super nice. Every time, and I mean literally every time I come here I make a new friend. No exaggeration. PJ's crowd is a different breed. Two levels as well. Cannot sing their praises enough. My favorite spot in town.

googleReviews.text: Best Spot ! Great new choices Meadow Frank Added to her full service Menu. Great  karaoke host Donny is a great entertainment leader,and his customer service ,exceptional. The atmosphere is always pleasant and a wide variety of peers from every walk of life, Come join us and eat ,sing a song and make some new friends,You will not regret it.

googleReviews.author: Denise Santos-Cucalon
googleReviews.text: Lots of fun games, Touch screen, pool tables, Jukebox with a great selection. Great fenced in covered back patio. I personally look forward to the food, pinball and people watching, my husband plays pool. He likes it here becuase there is rarely a wait, (not sure about tournament days, we call ahead) cool vibe and friendly people. They have a farely large menu, lots of crispy awesomeness. Fast service, even on busy nights. Everyone that works here has been  friendly, helpful and always made us feel welcome. If you're looking for a stuffy upscale vibe, probably not the place for you. But, if your looking for a neighborhood bar, with excellent service, great drinks and food, fun things to do, you'll enjoy this place.

googleReviews.text: Amazing food. Amazing service. I love playing pool here. It’s a great kid friendly place to stop and enjoy any meal of the day. I’ve had nothing but great experiences here. Really good parking as well.

googleReviews.author: Mason Reinders
googleReviews.text: This is a great Spokane bar, I would affectionately describe it as a dive, which happen to be my favorite places to go. The pool tables are .75 per game, and well maintained, but I'd advise you bring your own cue, the house cues have definitely seen better days - though there are a lot of them! Great chicken and the fries were fantastic. Nice, attentive service and a good crowd. Rowdy without being unfriendly. I'll definitely go back.

googleReviews.author: D G
googleReviews.text: I usually love Bigfoot but the bartender Ali is a horror show. She talks to her friends, doesn’t do her job, speaks to customers poorly won’t clean the place and has a terrible attitude. She needs to be fired or else this place is going to lose a lot of business. She acts like she hates her job. I hope she quits. Beware if Ali is working just leave. All the other bartenders are awesome.

googleReviews.author: ELFMAN1
googleReviews.text: Have only been into The Bigfoot a few times since new ownership. Of the few past afternoon stop in's the place hasn't offered that old welcoming Local Pub Vibe but thought I'd give it another try this afternoon. - I walk in @ 4:30pm Friday & there are 3 ppl sitting in the upper section & 2 guys on the long east end bar which "Both" female bartenders are talking to. I pull up a seat at the small west end bar & lay $'s out on bar to order & pay for a drink -  Bartender makes eye contact & continues talking to 2 guys @ bar - 2 New  ppl walk in from street, go to bar right next to me & get served - Bartender goes back to other bartender & continues talking to 2 guys - Another person comes in from outside & orders drink at bar right next to me - Bartender serves him, glances at me & goes back to talking to the 2 guys at other end of bar & other bartender - Somewhat STUNNED, I get up, go over & ask her if she was aware I was sitting there waiting to get served? - She simply looked at me with a uncaring stare & with no apology or apologetic look simply said "I didn't see you" & doesn't offer to help me & goes back to talking.  - If you know the layout of the Bigfoot & what I have described, the chances of her not seeing me especially after making eye contact are next to "0%"!!! This was not a case of not seeing me, it was a case of  #1 Horrible Customer Service  #2 Poor training & accountability by the on sight General Manager to make employees understand why they are employed there. Which is to make Money! #3 Failure as a corporation to develop & implement consistent management practices & goals. This 1 stumps me the most because just a few miles away is another 1 of their Corporate Bars where you will find non of this. = I used to spend $1,000's at the Bigfoot annually & do understand times change & the Target Audience changes with it. But to be treated like that on a dead afternoon @ 4:30pm is insulting not only to me but also to the management there. As a life long northsider I will Never Patronize the Bigfoot Again & have to wonder why anyone else does. *I just don't get it. Cuz on a positive note for Tangen Hospitality, great customer service with a smile is alive & well at another 1 of their  bars just down the road, Fizzie Mulligan's

googleReviews.text:
I feel like they were short staffed. But it took forever for us to get waited on and it was pretty slow getting our food.
Once we got it the food was very good. Loved the atmosphere/vibe. A mix of a regular old style bar and a more current sports bar without losing the local feel to the bar.

googleReviews.author: Lee Ann Suggate
googleReviews.text: The loaded jojos was so yummy. The bartender was great. Music was kinda loud for the more quiet Monday night crowd, giving me a headache. Chicken sliders was yummy just wish they would add 1 more to the basket.

googleReviews.author: Cam Cam
googleReviews.text:
I posted on Spokane Food Finder a few weeks ago looking for a place I could decorate for my birthday party. They reached out to me and offered their space, told me they would decorate and bring in their karaoke host, and even make personalized drink menus for my Spongebob theme.

They went so above and beyond, made me feel so special, and did all of this for FREE. This is such a great service they offer for our area, I seriously cannot recommend Neon Moon enough.

googleReviews.author: Katie Brown
googleReviews.text: Had my birthday party at Neon Moon and they went above and beyond for me! Love this place! The karaoke is always such a fun time and the drinks are so good (especially the jell-o shots). I would highly recommend this place for hosting any events! The amount of effort they put into the experience is truly impressive and made my birthday so memorable. Huge shout out to all the amazing staff!

googleReviews.author: April Mesecher
googleReviews.text: Great place to sing karaoke and hangout with friends. The Kjs are fantastic. If you dont want to sing they have darts and pool.

googleReviews.author: Chy
googleReviews.text: I have been in a few times now! I adore it, I mainly go to play pool and spend time with my friends. But the people there are amazing.

googleReviews.author: Rhea Ray
googleReviews.text: Fun place. It was our first time being here. Hubs ordered the philly, and I got the spicy chicken sandwich. We also ordered an appetizer of onion rings. The onion rings were ah-mazing. Best we've ever had. They melt right in your mouth. The boom boom sauce is also a serious new favorite. The chicken sandwich was grilled chicken and so tender. I have braces so cutting the sandwich was so easy. Like a hot knife in butter. They were also doing an Oktoberfest for the weekend. So so fun

googleReviews.author: Joseph
googleReviews.text:
So our go to place closed so we tried something different.  Iron horse delivered to the max.
Cheese steak,tots, patty meltss, coleslaw and steak bites, yum!
All the food was so good, hot and fresh, for sure. The cheesestake was great and the tots were cooked just right.

The patty melt was one of the top 5 ever and the coleslaw cut through the richness perfectly.
The place was clean but the background  music was to loud.
Over all a good experience that has left us hungry for more.

googleReviews.author: Lisa RL
googleReviews.text: We love this place!! Always enjoyable and especially when there’s music or karaoke. We are one of many regulars so it’s definitely a Cheers for us and we feel so welcomed and appreciated by the community especially Patty and Kelsey! Great service, Thank you! Try the coconut prawns and the prime rib.

googleReviews.author: Cecil Curran
googleReviews.text: Stopped in for lunch.  The burger and tots were fantastic.  The chefs tossed salad was more than i hoped for, really good.  The atmosphere was great.  Service was a little slow but very good.  We will definitely come back to this little treasure.

googleReviews.author: Cara “Barista01”
googleReviews.text: I wish we knew about this place sooner. Food and drinks were great, cooked well, and full of flavor. The service was friendly and helpful. Try the Rosemary Fries with some ranch on the side. Perfection. I forgot to take a photo of my food but here’s the dessert we gobbled down. Chocolate chip cookie cake. Try it!

googleReviews.author: Brandi R.
googleReviews.text:
New to Spokane, stumbled upon a walkable Bar & Grill on a Sunday arvo. Darts, pool, decent tunes – everyone was friendly, especially the bartender, Capone. But the real quest? IPA Taps! Score! Elysian Star Dust & Hop Valley Bubble Stash. (Apparently, some other, less exciting beers were also present).
Had an IPA, then, I wanted tequila, A Capone-recommended tequila, Double, Neat. Two hours of good vibes and chat later, another IPA (walkable, remember!). Food looked amazing but tummy said "nah, not today."
This local spot? A luxury. Officially becoming a regular to discuss crucial IPA matters: one's gotta go.

Suddenly craving everything. Karaoke tonight? Maybe. Spokane, you've got my attention (and my walking shoes). 😉

googleReviews.author: Emily Chapman
googleReviews.text: Fantastic food, a bit up from what you might expect from a establishment in its given location. Great people and a diverse music selection are also available.

googleReviews.text: Have been here a few times. Food is better than average dive bar (portions). Only 2 pool tables (no bueno). Bartenders are decent and friendly. Neat little outdoor patio outback. Not too bad overall.

googleReviews.text:
Customer service is the best and the drinks are strong if they didn't now the drinks give them the recipe and they will make it. Love this place.
Go to this business they are great. Always friendly and the bar tenders are on top of the place. Thay always have activities going on throughout the month and always friendly.  This is a great place to support and gave fun.

googleReviews.author: MONZTERO (monty)
googleReviews.text: The drag shows here are great, tons of very talented performers. I will always continue to come here for the drag. As a bar, it's not my favorite environment. If they changed the playlist every once in awhile I would enjoy my experience more, but I can only listen to Pink Pony Club so much. I want to emphasize it is absolutely worth going to the drag shows. Their drinks are strong 👍

googleReviews.author: NOT SO LOST NOMAD
googleReviews.text: 🏳️‍🌈 Fun atmosphere, amazing staff, lgbtqia safe space spokane, was in town for pride weekend and spent the weekend frequently at nyne! Enjoyed the food we had nachos and sausages, djs kept the best beats, drag shows were tons of fun and mocktails were yummy! Thank you nyne for a fun weekend in spokane washington!

googleReviews.author: Mariah Frees
googleReviews.text: I have been coming to NYNE for about a year. It has always been really enjoyable from the good drinks to the fun drag shows. I wanted to leave this review because although I love NYNE, I will not be coming back due to the horrible service. Almost every time I have went to NYNE, there is a bartender named Melissa who is very rude. She acts like every drink you order is an inconvenience to her as if it isn’t her job. I am a nice person and even nicer while drinking, I have never had an issue with any bartender. Well, last night I went out to have a fun night with my friends after not being out for over a month. Mind you, I was ordering my 3rd drink, I was not very intoxicated. Anyways, she was extremely rude and yelled at me across the bar because I was trying to read the menu. She did not say I can help you over here or anything of the sort. She yelled “hello” at me in a very rude condescending tone. So i said sorry and ordered my drink. I was already put off by being yelled at for reading the menu. She didn’t hear me ask for a splash of pineapple juice so I asked again but instead of saying something like sorry i didn’t hear you she said “it’s loud in here and i can’t fing hear you over the music. I don’t have to serve you” I was apologetic at first but she kept yelling and cussing at me so I told her I do not want her to serve me a drink and I walked away. My friends and I decided that closing our tabs and going elsewhere was for the best. While in line to close our tab, she came up to me and was getting up in my space. I told her there was no reason for her to treat me that way, yelling and cussing at me and that we were j closing our tabs to leave. She then proceeded to tell the bouncer to kick me out because what? because she didn’t hear me ask for pineapple juice? She then proceeded to talk badly about me to my partner while they were closing our tab. overall, I hope management takes this complaint seriously as her treating customers rudely is nothing new and definitely doesn’t help businesses. She is extremely unprofessional and rude. It is very unfortunate that NYNE has someone like that in a place where people are supposed to feel accepted and welcome. If you don’t like drunk people, don’t work at a bar. I did nothing to warrant being treated that way and it was a disappointment and hurtful.

googleReviews.author: Dylan Moore
googleReviews.text: Great place to feel safe when so called "Men of God" are harassing you in Spokane! My view is the religious right needs to leave our community be. We deserve the same respect as all Americans. So if your passing thru Spokane, this is a great place to visit and dance.

This is a nice Kareoke bar with private lounges.

It is nicely designed.

It is great for small and large group.

I did not try any food. I am not sure it is available.

You'll have a good time here if you come with your Karaoke friends.

googleReviews.author: S McC
googleReviews.text:
Threw a Family Members Birthday here for +20 people.
Had a Great Time & the Staff were Awesome! !
The 1st thing the Birthday Girl said after we left was, the Staff was Absolutely Amazing.
The Food was really good, staff was attentive, and the drinks were well done. Even if there is a 2 Long Island Ice Tea limit per person (which is smart). Didn't realize that would be the drink of the Party LoL
The is our 1st time at this Location and 2nd time at a Voicebox. Totally worth it!

googleReviews.author: Fal Gal
googleReviews.text: Karaoke bar with Karaoke food... be careful with pork tots or any hot food really as it will melt into your food like pic and you will need to pull it apart. Karaoke is super fun and great for events with friends and family.

googleReviews.author: Patty Piazza
googleReviews.text: Wow, we had the greatest party here! The staff was so nice and they showed us how to control the lights in our room and cue up the songs we wanted. Then they took any drink or food orders and said they would leave us alone unless we needed more help, in which case they would come right in. This situation put even the shyest singers at ease. We can't wait to go back! Thank  you Voicebox SE!

googleReviews.author: Cindy Lipton
googleReviews.text: This place was more fun than I even imagined. My best friend and I sang our little old hearts out in a private karaoke room. The room was amazing and they served food and drinks and there were fancy dancing lights. All our inhibitions were gone and we made some big sounds that no one but us could hear. Old tunes, new tunes, 2 screens, good mikes. And you get your Playlist to remember your set list. We will be back. 2 hours is a good duration for a booking. Highly recommend.

googleReviews.text:
Apologies for the previous review as it was confused with an earlier bar down the street that had a bouncer.

Cowboy was the cutest greeter.
Followed by an awesome guy in a cowboy hat and lady at the bar.  The karaoke was super fun, bathroom gave those vibes, iykyk.

The drinks were on point too!

googleReviews.author: Jen Rountree
googleReviews.text: I don’t typically come to this part of Portland or karaoke bars but my husband is a huge fan of the Shining and so we had to come. I enjoyed it so much more than I expected! The bartender was so kind and friendly. I enjoyed my margarita and there’s plenty to do here if you don’t come for karaoke. My husband really liked all of the small details connected to the shining.

about: Baby Ketten Klub is a karaoke bar in Portland, Oregon. It holds a 4.6-star rating from 598 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Loren Bornstein
googleReviews.text:
Haven’t had the food but folks seem to like it. Been here a few times now for private room karaoke. It’s a fun time though the acoustics and speakers make it hard to hear both for those singing and trying to chat. Don’t know if there are volume controls but that would be helpful.

Not all songs are in original key so you may be challenged by that. If you wanna karaoke, the vibes are good. The drinks are very tasty and the folks working are solid.

googleReviews.author: Michelle
googleReviews.text: Love karaoke here, always a fun experience. I wish the food menu had more options that weren't fried but you also don't really go for the food. Cocktails were great. One thing I think would be great is if they can add the feature that allows you to finish out the song when your time is up rather than cutting a song off in the middle. But regardless, love this place and will always go back.

googleReviews.author: M
googleReviews.text:
My group had a great time. Reservations were easy to make. The staff was wonderful and attentive. The ability to use a phone to control the music was seamless.

Highly suggest having as much time in your reservation before things pick up after 9 pm though. If the general area picks an intense song like death metal, the vibrations can ovewhelm the sound in the disko room.

googleReviews.author: Veronica Langworthy
googleReviews.text: The bartenders here are so kind and patient. We all know karaoke is the most chaotic crowd, yet they handle us all with grace and ease. Never once have I had a bad time at this establishment or felt like I was too much or didn’t belong. Thanks for letting the good times roll

googleReviews.author: Amy Philip
googleReviews.text: Hosted a team party in the 70’s Room and had an absolute blast! The staff was incredibly attentive and the song list is insanely long and 2 hours flew by-we ended up extending our time a bit. Looking forward to coming back and butchering my favorite songs loudly and off key 😁

googleReviews.author: Monica Gafford
googleReviews.text: I left my Handbag and a bag of groceries at the counter bar and went to bathroom came back they had taken it put it behind the bar thought I left. I had my wallet in my pocket so I thought someone stoled it . I left i went back a couple of weeks later and ask bartender if anyone had found it and they had it in list and found all my belongings were in my handbag alot of expensive things and my medication and a great Tarot deck I really loved  it was amazing 👏 🤩 ❤️ 💙 ♥️.  So I am a big fan . Also great place for karaoke.  Staff is excellent drinks are great !!! Prices are awesome.  Music is fun . Specials and great local Bar . Highly recommended  this place. I also live in the area so there's alot of choices.  Thank you Twenty First Bar . 🍸

googleReviews.author: Hope Ferns
googleReviews.text:
I’ve been going to this bar for years and had one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had in Portland. A man outside the bar was EXTREMELY racist to my friend who is a person of color yelling at her “ILLEGAL, CALL ICE”
The security guard did absolutely nothing and was even cutting it up with the racist. I went out to confront the man who yelled at her and the security guard THREATENED TO KICK ME AND MY FRIENDS OUT? but not the racist???? The security guard told me “he apologized, he’s really drunk don’t make a scene don’t start anything” even tho this man fully yelled at my friend. At least the bar tender had our backs for the most part but that man was just free to be in the bar harassing people? That security guard absolutely needs to go. Unacceptable. Stand up for something, people are literally being taken off the street. This shit is serious. Absolutely disgusting and disgraceful

googleReviews.author: Blunt Headed
googleReviews.text: The ambiance here is great.  I usually don’t frequent this area but parking was not that bad and it was very easy to find.  It doesn’t look big from the outside… but it is very spacious once you’re inside.  Also there is an outdoor patio that is wonderful and very spacious and peaceful.  I would recommend this place if you enjoy Karaoke on Wednesday’s and just an all around chill place to hang at.

googleReviews.author: Michael Alfonso
googleReviews.text: Visited from out of town & searched for a good Karaoke spot. Arrived @9pm when Karaoke started on a Friday night. Ordered drinks with a quick friendly bartender before submitting our Song Request tickets that you pick up from the DJ. Better to add your song request soon as you as arrive. Got x2 prints at the photo booth, chilled in the back patio, and took photos of their wall of classic albums before getting on the mic by 11.

googleReviews.author: Gabrielle Lemos
googleReviews.text: The security guy on friday night June 5 charged me and my friend $5 bucks to get in even tho was my birthday and he even told me happy birthday, later on my other friends arrived and he didn’t charge any of my 8 friends that was with me! I feel like he was getting money for himself on the entrance

googleReviews.author: Cascade Neuway
googleReviews.text: Scotty and Cassie were amazing. Bartender and sound guy love them.  Love the vibes of the place and just overall amazing energy. If you’re looking for a grungey fun time 10/10 recommend. I haven’t even been there on a Sunday but cabaret night sound super fun.

googleReviews.author: Lisa Hart
googleReviews.text: Went here thinking it was a good place for karaoke. I was mistaken. They expect you to tip...expect ...not just the expectation...but it matters how much you tip... so... the more you tip the better your chances are to actually get up and sing. So you sit there the whole time spending money on drinks and food waiting over an hour to sing one song! While I can appreciate the live band this is kinda ridiculous. You basically pay for the live band. What a disappointment. And highly frustrating. Don't go here if your on a tight budget and love to sing more than one song.

googleReviews.author: Angelyka Cava
googleReviews.text: I'll be honest, my main reasons for not preferring to go to Dante's have to do with my sensory processing disorders, as the venue can easily get cramped, hot, and overwhelming. However, I must say that they have a lot of great shows, especially if you're a metalhead, and the tickets are usually quite cheap compared to other places. Plus the vibes of Dante's just fit any kind of metal music so well. It's dingy and divey, but edgy with a lot of cool decor. I like their services, as the drink bar is efficient and the Pizza Slut restaurant is pretty yummy.

googleReviews.author: Tim Rog
googleReviews.text: There are very few bars or clubs that really make me feel at home.  Standing room only GA could be a little tight given the type of event put on.  But customers and fans are a lot of fun to hang out and talk to.  The bartenders are super cool  and friendly.  My first time there I felt very welcomed, unlike most places I have been in my life,  I'm there for one night and I feel like these people would be life long friends.

googleReviews.author: Antonio Vargas
googleReviews.text: Dante’s in Portland Old Town is an unforgettable venue. I went for a concert and the energy of the place was incredible, the music sounded great and the crowd kept the atmosphere alive all night. The beer might not be the strongest point here, but the vibe, character, and overall experience more than make up for it. This spot has everything you need for a fun and memorable night out in Portland.

googleReviews.author: Julia Hines
googleReviews.text:
I will say that I ordered Alfredo and got mac and cheese, BUT it was very excellent mac and cheese and the server was a sweetheart otherwise, so I didn't mind.

The prices are great, the food is good, the portions are fair for the price while still filling. Service was good. The atmosphere was really loud and hard to hear, but it was karaoke night on a weekend. Great place to get late night food for cheap and having a decent place inside to sit.

googleReviews.author: James Allen
googleReviews.text: Easily the worst wings I’ve ever had. Unseasoned, horribly sauced, disgusting. After tasting them the only thing I could think was …. Why they waste a chickens life on these wings.

googleReviews.author: RaChelle Hafen
googleReviews.text: Where do I begin? I was greeted immediately by Spenny. I felt so welcomed. I wasn't sure if I wanted to sit at the bar or not. The staff reassured me that I could move to a table if I felt the need. Isabel (bartender) took my very picky drink order so very kindly. Diet coke, light ice, 2 lemons, 3 cherries. No problem. I discovered they have a taco Tuesday special. $1.99!? Wowza. I decided to order. I really prefer to eat at a table. Once again, no issues. I got to sit at a big comfy booth, even though I was just by myself! So comfy. Spenny took my order, and was SUPER attentive. I told him what my diet restrictions are, and he responded warmly. How nice! HE was also very very attentive. Checked on me, was kind l, and made me feel good. I had a bad day and he really cheered me up. The food was delish, and Spenny got my drink order right and I stayed longer basking in comfort. I will return to this gem, thanks to this staff! Woohoo

googleReviews.author: Rachelle Crites
googleReviews.text: Ok. So my husband, mom, & I were looking for a late late happy hour after a concert and Google suggested this place and so we went. First impressions weren't great. It's not the prettiest place, but that's ok. The "funny" part was the unfriendly bartender for a place named "cheerful". The first thing she did was card us (we are 49, 57, and 83...very clearly over 21, but whatever). We passed and were allowed to sit. Fortunately the night got better and we got the sweetest server. She was very genuine and helpful. The bowl drink was delicious and I got a free turtle toy lol and the happy hour food was good & cheap. No, we won't be back, we don't frequent the downtown area and it's not really our kind of place, but I did want to leave a positive review only because of our fabulous server. I wish I had gotten her name so I could post it here. Hopefully her manager is reading this. As for the bartender, please be more "cheerful" and do you really have to card an 83 year old? I mean, really? I can't remember the last time I got carded. I guess if it's policy, fine. It's just funny. Me personally, I would've been silly about it and said sorry, we have to card everyone. But she was just grumpy about it. The 5 stars for service is for the server only. :)

googleReviews.author: Christopher Williams
googleReviews.text: I was given a $50 gift card from a friend.  When the server came to say she would get the bill I handed her the gift card.  Her response was “that will cover it” and then she proceeded to leave the table and she did not come back with any balance or way to give me the remaining balance on the gift card. I then had to get up and find her and asked, “What was the remaining balance?” (for the record she never actually gave me a bill for me to see.) Her response was an ambivalent “15 dollars.”  I asked if that covered tip and she said no. To be honest I was a little dumbfounded and didn’t even know how to respond.  What happened to my remaining $15 dollars and why was I not offered a way to get the remaining balance in another gift card?

googleReviews.author: Store Junk
googleReviews.text:
Didn’t order any food. Place was okay, the attentiveness was onpoint. The price depends on how many people are in your party, $10 per person plus drinks and food.
I was not too happy being charged the total number of people in our party that didn’t show up. This place didn’t acknowledge the fact 2 didn’t show and they still charged us. I’d not go back due to this. This is such a scam. The little details they don’t tell you or disclose anywhere on their website or menu.

googleReviews.author: Aaron Griffin
googleReviews.text:
Had such an fun experience! Celebrated a birthday of a friend and planned on only renting a small room for 2 hours and ended up staying an extra hour and probably could've went all night! 🌃
Staff was friendly and courteous, one of our group forgot their lighter and the staff provided us a loan firestarter. 🚬
The food was great, the drinks were pretty high in price but that didn't dampen our experience, especially since they serve Ninkasi IPA.

googleReviews.author: Therin Ratliff
googleReviews.text: My group of friends and I have been regulars here for more than five years and I can’t recommend it enough. Rooms are comfy, service is excellent, and the food is delicious.

googleReviews.author: Daniel E
googleReviews.text:
Been here a few times, it’s fun. My last trip there bothered me though, it was an $800 bill for less than 2 hours and not a large drink and food order for 8 people. It was a shocker when we’re got the bill. Most likely won’t be back.

I’d likely feel a bit better if you didn’t have to load the videos on a YouTube playlist on someone’s phone, which becomes more than chaotic, especially when drinks get involved. Even then, still insane pricing.

googleReviews.author: Beth Olson
googleReviews.text:
First (and last) time trying this venue with a group of 8. $20 minimum each person for 2 hours. Logging into YouTube on personal cell phones was awkward, and frustrating as we spent a lot of time trying to get the songs to queue correctly, adjust balance, and we had to endure all the YouTube ads. Food was good, but overall we all thought this place was too expensive and a hassle.
Go to a karaoke bar and pay nothing but drinks and tips, and a KJ runs your songs.

googleReviews.author: Julie Heiligenstein Kelly
googleReviews.text: A surprising discovery, the food was amazing. Had the steak bites with bacon which was delicious, so were the mozzarella sticks and mash potatoes and gravy. Violet was our server and she was lovely, great advice and outstanding service. This place is a lot of fun and great prices!

googleReviews.author: Jessica j
googleReviews.text: The Spare Room is definitely a fun place to go.  Sometimes they have live bands and other times they have DJ's playing good music and having great energy 🥳🥳🥳 they also do karaoke.  The drinks are really good and the staff are amazing!!! They have pool tables and shuffleboard.  And of course slot machines.  They have a good menu of food and keep the party jumpin! We will definitely be going back and recommending to others 🥳🥳🥳

googleReviews.author: avalon151
googleReviews.text:
One of Portland's old time, jumbo sized (dive bar) treasures at NE 42nd & Alberta. Affordable drink and food prices . . and that's saying a lot these days. A much better deal than most of the really overpriced, gentrified establishments all up and down NE Killingsworth & Alberta. Vintage locals bar & restaurant, def worth trying out . . especially for the breakfast food, which is available from open to close! They also have breakfast and lunch specials. The best time to visit for a chill, more relaxed customer/server vibe, is from 7:00am to about mid afternoon. The servers can seem a bit aloof until you get to know them better but it's mainly because they're just really busy and runnin' their tails off most of the time. Server Tiffany, is a real off the wall, hoot! lol ♡♡♡

They feature karaoke, dj's or live music on the weekends.

googleReviews.author: Alex Hammond
googleReviews.text: Came here for lunch. Love the dimmed lighting and nostalgic bar vibes. The place is very spacious and seats are comfortable. Staff is a friendly bunch and are happy to make sure you feel welcome. I sat and was helped quickly, got my order filled and then got my food - Mushroom swiss burger - in record time! Food was great and I'll be coming back again. The place is kept somewhat cool so you might want to bring another layer if you get a bit chilly!

googleReviews.author: Christina Digenis
googleReviews.text:
I had a really disappointing experience here around 9:30pm. I ordered one drink and was sitting quietly on a phone call when the bartender (Sabrina) told me she would not serve me again because I was “stimming.”
I am autistic, and stimming is a natural behavior, not intoxication or disruption. I was calm, seated, and not causing any issues.
When I questioned this, she then claimed I looked like someone who had previously been kicked out, which was incorrect. The situation felt dismissive and unfair.
After leaving, I called to follow up and was met with mocking and unprofessional behavior before the call was ended. The waitress on phone Mocked me when I said HIPPA law violation & said did you say Hippopotamus.
I hope ownership takes this seriously and provides better training around disability awareness and respectful customer interaction.

googleReviews.author: Peyton Lieuallen
googleReviews.text: What an amazing place! If you love to sing, but don’t love the wait and crappy songs from randoms at bars, this is the place for you. Randomly on a Friday night at 11pm, our group of 10 people decided we wanted to go sing. We didn’t want to go to some random crowded bar and found this place… PERFECT! We called and got scheduled for an appointment easy peasy. Again, we had a 10 person group! It was so easy to get in and get to signing! The food was great, the drinks were better and the customer service was excellent. I HIGHLY recommend coming here!

googleReviews.author: Samay Murray
googleReviews.text: That was so fun! The private rooms is such a fun experience! The staff was so amazing, each person made the experience so perfect. Everything was so clean, the drink I had was a mocktail and it was so pretty and yummy! I had such an amazing time! Thank you!

googleReviews.author: Simple Things
googleReviews.text:
We rented a room for 2 hours. The staff was super helpful and checked on us regularly. The karaoke system was user-friendly and easy to select music.

We had a ton of fun, and what was super cool is you could change the lighting in the room and add comments through the app so you could say fun encouraging things to the people singing. Another cool option in the app is a link to click to notify the staff you needed service. The last thing that brought the energy level up is a disco ball!

googleReviews.author: Elisa S
googleReviews.text: We had a great time singing, love the individual area to be alone with your party. Drinks were very good. Food was lacking in ever department, unfortunately.

googleReviews.author: Quinnell Flanagan
googleReviews.text: Always a treat! The staff has always been friendly to me and the prices are great. Always book ahead and you're guarenteed to have a great time!

googleReviews.author: Victoria H
googleReviews.text: This is a place I like to frequent with my kids, my fiancé, and my nephews. There is such a great variety of games to choose from, so everyone always finds something they enjoy. One of my favorite parts is the huge selection of claw machines — I’m starting quite the collection of plushies because every time I come here, I’m guaranteed to win at least one. The claw machines actually work well, which makes it even more fun. Overall, it’s a great place for family time and we always have a blast coming here.

googleReviews.author: Hope Pichette
googleReviews.text: Super fun place, celebrated a birthday & did not have to make a reservation. So many games to choose from reasonable pricing for the food. Prizes that you actually want to take home!

googleReviews.author: Jack Kendall
googleReviews.text: Round1 at Valley River Center is such a fun spot to hang out. The bowling lanes are great, and the pool tables are always in good shape for a quick game with friends. I’ve also spent some time in the arcade, and honestly, the claw machines are actually fair—I’ve won prizes multiple times, which doesn’t always happen at other places. The whole place has a lively, fun vibe, and it’s perfect whether you’re there to bowl, play games, or just chill for a few hours.

googleReviews.author: Ryan Ladd
googleReviews.text: Seems cool enough, but waiting an hour and a half for chips and cheese and a coke is ridiculous. It’d be faster to drive over to Bend for lunch and come back. Definitely don’t think you’re going to get a quick snack here. That’s not possible. Oh, but you can get a drink at the bar in 5min. Maybe you’re supposed to show up at 10, put in your food order, go play games for 90min and then come back up here to eat?

googleReviews.author: Gin Ae
googleReviews.text: It is honestly so sad how much it costs to play 3 maybe 4 arcade games for $30. And if you want to play a two person game with someone you might as well take out a personal loan. This place is a joke and low key a scam. Your better off going to a different arcade down town. Because at least the other arcades its around $1 for each game which should be the standard. Seriously dont waste your money.

googleReviews.author: Kandi Nelson
googleReviews.text: We hired Caught In the Act Entertainment for our annual party in December.  Their karaoke services have always hit the mark.  Our KJ, Nanette did a great job especially with all the kids we had that wanted to sing (or just breathe into the mic).  They were having such a great time, we paid for an extra hour.  Thank you for making our party a huge success this year!!

googleReviews.author: Lisa Radley
googleReviews.text:
We hired Jared for our wedding at the end of September 2025 at Sweet Cheeks Winery.

He was professional from the beginning. He was always available if we had any questions. He was a great MC as well. Keeping the party flowing and everything going smooth which was a huge help.

The mic was also provided for our minister to use from Jared. The price to hire him was very reasonable and he helped me and my husband out a lot. Our guests spoke very highly of him as well. We would highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Emily Boyd
googleReviews.text:
Caught in the Act Entertainment and Jared are
AMAZING. Jared DJ'd my wedding reception on April 25th. Not only did I have literally the best time, my friends and family were complimenting the music and announcements days after the event.
Jared met with us twice in person before the wedding to discuss specifics of what we wanted regarding music, announcements, vibes, and extras.
He was always very attentive and took what we said to heart. The wedding reception went so smoothly and we just had a ball. He also brought his Photo Booth, which was a huuuuge hit with us and all our guests. I would 100% recommend Jared and his business to anyone who needs any type of event DJ'd. Jared and his team are the BEST!!!

googleReviews.author: deborah liberati
googleReviews.text:
We hired Jared from Caught in the Act for an 80’s‑themed 50th birthday party, and he absolutely crushed it. The entire night felt like stepping straight back into the neon era — and Jared was a huge part of making that happen.
🎤 Karaoke Rental:
The karaoke setup fit the 80’s vibe perfectly. Crystal‑clear sound, endless throwback hits, and a smooth setup that kept the crowd singing all night. Guests were belting out everything from power ballads to ‑pop classics, and Jared kept the energy flowing like a true pro.
📸 Photo Booth Rental:
The photo booth was a total blast. The lighting, props, and retro‑style touches made every picture feel like a time‑capsule moment. Our guests couldn’t get enough of it, and we walked away with unforgettable snapshots that captured the spirit of the night.
Jared brought professionalism, personality, and a genuine passion for making the event special. He didn’t just provide services — he helped create an atmosphere that made the party unforgettable.
Thank you, Jared. You made our 80’s celebration one for the books.

googleReviews.author: natasha trevino
googleReviews.text: I made a last-minute decision to have a DJ and photo booth at my wedding, and it was well worth it. Jared was a pleasure to work with, being readily accessible by phone, text, or email, and always eager to assist. On the day of the wedding, Jared and the photo booth attendant exceeded my expectations. Thank you again for providing exceptional service. The photo quality was outstanding!

googleReviews.text: Highly satisfied! Cosplayer friendly, and we will definitely be back for more. If ever you want to see your favorite friendly neighborhood spidey, you just might in the future, right here at level up arcade!

googleReviews.author: jess lynn
googleReviews.text:
Despite all of the negative reviews I saw, I took my 4 year old
Here on a Sunday night and it was AWESSOME 🤓
the bartender ToNy was super nice , made me a delicious Long Island and my daughter a “light” kiddy cocktail.
The French fries were great (and I’m picky)

The games were great and great prices , love that it takes quarters are nostalgic
(especially compared to other arcades that use preloaded cards and cost a couple dollars a game)
I appreciate that there is one door in and out helps me keep track of my child

Minors are allowed until nine and they were super friendly about letting us know. It was nearing the time to leave.

Definitely will be back. Thank you for the lovely experience.

googleReviews.author: Brittany McCahan
googleReviews.text: Love love love!! Went here for a girls night the only night, we were safe and respected. The staff are sweet. Prices are good, drinks are awesome, they were even able to make drinks no one else has had. The only thing I wish they had was video poker.

googleReviews.author: James Schick
googleReviews.text: Great spot for drinks and games! Plenty of off-street parking, full bar, and a decent draft selection. While we did not order food, we did check out everything else. Comfy booths up front, perfect for intimate gatherings or larger parties. Lots of bar seating, too, as well as two different table-style arcade machines. Great selection of pinball machines, as well as a curated selection of 8-bit (or less) classics and a few modern partner FPS/multi-player racing games. Pool table and air hockey available at the rear of the building. Absolutely worth a visit, probably a few. The decor is also a chef's kiss to retro gamers!

googleReviews.author: OOP Media
googleReviews.text: The bartenders here are jerks with terrible personalities.  They’re only nice to people that come in to drink but if you come in to play pinball they treat you like a second class citizen.  Seriously, get over yourselves.  I might actually order a CBD soda more often if they weren’t rude.  But the pinball machines are nice and well maintained with a good variety of titles.

googleReviews.text: This place has always been a cool spot. Good food, plenty of TVs, and nice pool tables. Went in today and got treated like scum of the earth immediately upon walking through the doors. The bartender visibly scowled and was entirely cold to our party for the duration of our visit. We're all service industry folks and were shocked and appalled at the service, or rather lack thereof, we received. We've always had great experiences in the past so this was really disappointin. I get everyone has bad days but it was inexcusable. Hoping management addresses the hospitality issue and is able to improve things soon!

googleReviews.author: Blair Hickok
googleReviews.text: This place is your friendly neighborhood spot. There was karaoke when we went. There's pool tables, darts, lottery, 2 smoking decks, and a giant screen for watching sports. The food was good. The burgers were juicy and the buns were soft. The tater tots were overcooked, but they were nice and spicy-- I got the cajun kind. I will be going back there. The prices are amazing, it cost less than $60 to get food and drinks for 3 people (not including tip).

TIP YOUR BARTENDER ACCORDINGLY 😁🤘🙏💯 Becky is AH-MAZING! They support our Eugene local graffiti artists 🎨 🤘💞 Let's Goooooooo! Star Wars is also represented (Yes, I also wear Beskar)
HOUNDSTOOTH is a staple in EUGENE! GO DUCKS 🦆🦆🦆

googleReviews.text: I have frequented the Hound's Tooth for years. It's hands down the most laid back low-key spot in Eugene, but the real gem is the food. Best Mac and cheese I have ever ordered from an establishment, period. Go treat yourself, you won't be disappointed.

googleReviews.text: We go there when ever we can....love music ...pool and drinking and I get to play one handed pool with my fiance. And we love the live bands.

googleReviews.author: Chaz
googleReviews.text: Went for the first time after wanting to for a long time , great food , so cool there was live music , bartender was super cool and made me feel like a regular, great vibes.

googleReviews.author: Sandy Thoms
googleReviews.text: We like the food, but the staff is having to work too hard!! We had a cold pizza tonight, and had to grab it ourselves from the heat lamp window, because the staff couldn't keep up! Hire more help for busy nights!!!

googleReviews.author: Eileen F
googleReviews.text:
Ordered some great huge Breakfasts, Lunches & Dinners here lately. Never ever disappointed. They've been having some great Bands here too. Tonight's Band was Howlin' Dogma, with the great Walter Herleman singing & blowing his Harp! (aka Harmonica)

I have loved Happy Hours for years. The food at the Countryside Pizza & Grill is FANTASTIC beyond words & larger than large. I go here to Happy Hours to see my Band friends perform. Always a great time dancing & having some delush food!

googleReviews.author: eric hinman
googleReviews.text: I usually love this bar. The bartenders are usually very nice and the establishment has a nice environment. So I convinced my brother and a friend of mine to come check it out for their first time. Then comes the worst bartender ive ever encountered. We came in at roughly 4 pm on saturday, 1/31/26. Whoever the bartender getting off shift was, was over the top rude. When my buddy tried to hand his ID, he snapped at him to speak up, and when he asked what ciders were on tap, he was told "youre being really weird dude". After following that up with a couple other nasty remarks about there only being one cider on tap, my buddy turned to us and asked "what the heck was that about? Did I say something rude?" The bartender stops pouring, comes over to him and says "oh do you not like me? Thats ok". He then brings the drink over and slams it on the table followed by "i hope im cool enough for you now" Finally, the bartender says "alright were getting all 3 of your drinks at once, im not getting a cider 3 times" well unfortunately for him, I had a card and my buddy was paying cash. So when I say I also need one, im met with a few rude remarks of my own, and rather than hand me my card back, he throws it right on the matt full of ice and some other drink. He made a comment about having to serve customers before he gets off and that he doesnt get the tips so he doesnt care about the interaction. Like I said, ive been coming here for years, as well as working security for establishments for the better part of a decade and never once have I encountered a bartender like that. My brother and buddy refuse to come back and thats a bummer. I would recommend doing something about him before you lose more business.

googleReviews.text:
When we walked in it seemed like a cool saloon type of a dive bar, but one of the cooler ones, and the vibe was very friendly and the service was awesome. They rock it out every day even under pressure.

googleReviews.text: This is a super clean, newly remodeled place, very NW industrial look, nice!  The food is great, very high quality, creative and delicious.  Love taco Tuesday.  Great selection of regional wines and micros on tap.

googleReviews.author: Talon Barber
googleReviews.text: The Spare room has excellent staff, frequent and delicious specials, and a very nice home like environment. This is the only bar I know of in town you can sit on the couch and watch the game. There are multiple tvs for optimal visibility as well. For those looking for the extra level of entertainment the proximity and accessibility to the best bowling lanes in town is unbeatable. If you are looking for a little entertainment within the bar there are also two pool tables and a cozy video lottery section. I strongly recommend this bar for anyone looking for a calm, welcoming environment.

googleReviews.author: Ashley Anderson
googleReviews.text: The Reuben is deliciously amazing! I do recommend ordering from the bowling alley on fridays, the waitress in the bar is quite rude and slow And has an attitude with us and my Developmentally disabled adults when we're paying or ordering. googleReviews.text: For real. Check it out. 10/10. Great for kids. Great beer. Hot dog was good too. Check it out. Good for 2 or so hours no doubt. Owner was super nice. googleReviews.author: Grace K
googleReviews.text:
This place is amazing!!! 10/10! What a great concept! Purchase a drink and video games are free! You and your friends can get your own booth with a giant TV and play all the video games you could possibly think of. They also have a ton of claw games, board games, and a pool table.

Their beer and seltzer selection is awesome. They offer fancy hot dogs and snacks. You can sit at the bar and eat or enjoy the outdoor patio.

I met Justin at the bar and he was super friendly and gracious. I’ll definitely be back to support this local business! Highly recommend!!

googleReviews.author: Hillary Green
googleReviews.text: So excited a place like this opened up in Eugene - definitely different from the arcade bars because there's plenty of space to break out board games! Love the beverage selection. There's something for anyone including NA, kombucha, and cold brew coffee. We will definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: James Schick
googleReviews.text: It's not my jam, but your mileage may vary. The bartender was nice enough but seemed overwhelmed to have six people at the bar at once which is never a good sign. Darts outside on the smoking patio, claw machines, pool tables, and "Nintendo lounges" inside. Games of pool or darts and Nintendo offerings are free with a drink order, claw machines are pay as you go. They are currently remodeling a section, so it may be vastly improved afterward but I can't honestly say. Certainly an interesting attempt, and there is a small parking lot that's free.

googleReviews.text: Amazing place with amazing employees. Karaoke is every night and they have some of the best songs!

googleReviews.author: Large_flips_that!
googleReviews.text: I recently visited Overland Bar in Boise, and it’s hands-down one of the best spots in town! This place has everything you could want in a dive bar—great vibes, friendly people, and an unbeatable atmosphere. The bartenders are absolute rockstars; they’re quick with a smile, pour strong drinks, and make you feel right at home. Karaoke every night is a total game-changer—I had a blast belting out tunes with the crowd, and the sound system is top-notch. The outdoor area with the heated smoking section, pool tables, and shuffleboard just adds to the fun. Drinks are affordable, the hot dogs hit the spot, and the whole place has this cozy, welcoming charm that keeps you coming back. If you’re looking for a laid-back night filled with good times and great company, Overland Bar is the place to be. Five stars all the way!

googleReviews.author: Scott
googleReviews.text: Excellent little hole in the wall neighborhood bar. Jukebox, pool table, outside smoking. . Bartenders excellent. Friendly, knowledgeable and all around. Fun. If you like those little out of the way places where everyone does your name cool place to go. Karaoke DJ's name is Brandon.
