googleReviews.author: Cambria Yarnell
googleReviews.text:
I was extremely disappointed with this DJ’s doing the karaoke's performance. The song rotation was poorly managed, and many people were left waiting unreasonable amounts of time for their turn. On top of that, the DJ refused to allow certain songs to be sung based on personal preferences rather than treating everyone fairly and professionally.

A DJ’s job is to create an enjoyable experience for all guests, but this performance felt disorganized and unwelcoming. The lack of consistency and professionalism negatively impacted the atmosphere of the event. Unfortunately, I would not recommend this DJ based on my experience.

googleReviews.author: Mandy Page
googleReviews.text: Terry's is a local favorite, known for its stiff pours, karaoke almost every night and extremely cheap happy hour pricing. Some call it a dive bar just because it's an older, small, cheap, basic and simple bar that focuses on just good service, good prices, good people and not filled with fancy stuff. They have a few TV'S always playing sports, a Touch Tunes for your enjoyment, 2 pool tables, Golden Tee, darts, small bathrooms, and smoking on the side patio. Bring your ID, don't be shy and step up to the bar to order (cash or credit) because when they get busy they don't typically do table service.... And plan to Uber home if you're making a night out of it.

googleReviews.author: Joe DeGraw
googleReviews.text: The 1 star is purely for the fact I wasn't there for food and I have no idea if it was available. Great place to have a drink and sing.

googleReviews.author: Calvin Zito
googleReviews.text: Terry's is one of the best dive bars in the Treasure Valley. The bartenders especially Sam and Amber are very friendly, karaoke every night of the week, and you can't beat the drink prices. And nightly specials make it worth visiting whenever you want to have a drink with friends and belt out a song.

googleReviews.text: Eastside is a great neighborhood dive bar that has all the bar games in a wide open space. They also do all sorts of different events like open mic night, karaoke, and live music. The prices are good and they have a ton of weekly specials. They are also dog friendly!

googleReviews.author: Patty Tatum
googleReviews.text:
Fun neighborhood gathering spot for live music

While traveling in Idaho, our duo Sound Traveler had the opportunity to perform at Eastside's open mic on a Wednesday night in June.  We weren't sure what to expect, but everyone - the host, staff, and other performers - really made us feel so welcome.  It's a laid-back place; dogs are even welcome here! The bartender was super-friendly too - someone we know wanted to hear us play and called Eastside during our set, so the bartender held up the phone so they could listen!  That's how friendly this place is!  Give 'em a try when you're in the area!

googleReviews.author: shannon K
googleReviews.text: This bar has had a lot of great memories for me. I grew up doing all our family Thanksgivings here. My Gma and Gpa Sharon and Leo owned it when it was crickets. googleReviews.text: Great drinks. Friendly service. Cool mood vibe. Would be a great Halloween haunted. Had a lot of fun playing Nintendo and Xbox games. 10/10 recommend.

googleReviews.author: Caitlin “Boise Socialite” Montoya
googleReviews.text:
VooDoo Cellar is one of the most unique spots in Boise. The atmosphere is super moody, with an awesome layout and a haunted vibe, it makes for such a fun experience.

They've got an awesome beer selection, and they have fun activities throughout the week including movie nights on Tuesdays with free popcorn, comedy on Wednesdays, and beer pong on Thursdays (which I totally sucked at but had a blast playing!) I also enjoyed their video games, they've got a few different options and massive TVs.

The service at Voodoo was top-notch and everyone was super welcoming. I also love that this place is locally and family owned, especially since the owners are so incredible!

Stop in and go to their daily happy hour from 5-7pm and make sure you try their slushy drinks, they were AMAZING!!!

googleReviews.text: What a fun venue, we were visiting from Canada and found out about the free comedy show on Tuesday nights; "open mic". googleReviews.author: Aqeeb Hussain
googleReviews.text:
Boise Liquid Lounge is hands down one of the best places to grab a drink and enjoy a great atmosphere. The vibe is welcoming, the drinks are excellent, and the service is always top-notch. A special shoutout to Izzy, who truly made the experience exceptional. Friendly, attentive, and professional, Izzy went above and beyond to make sure everyone felt taken care of and had a great time.
The staff, music, and overall energy make this a place you'll want to visit again and again. If you're looking for a fun night out with outstanding service, Boise Liquid Lounge is the place to be. Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Dani Stephens
googleReviews.text:
We came to Liquid last year to chill for my son's 21st birthday. Tonight we came to chill for our daughter's 21st birthday. We came in around 10:30. The vibe was easy going. It's wasn't overly crowded yet. Everyone there was just hanging out and enjoying the scene.

The bartender that helped us tonight was really nice. We started a tab and got some drinks started. I have had obscene amounts charged on my card before from the bartender not being attentive with which card was charged. I appreciate that this bartender was careful and reassuring me that it was my card that was being charged. That showed me that he was careful with other tabs as well.

We ordered a few drinks. Washington apple shots, Captain and cokes, dirty Shirleys. Each one of the drinks were not lacking in the alcohol department. You're getting your money's worth in your drink.

The pool tables are always busy.  We played a couple rounds. Mario Kart is always a win.  And watching buzzed people punch the punching bag is always entertaining.  If you're looking for a cool spot to kick it, Liquid is your joint. Music is loud, the games are fun and the drinks are good. We had a great time kicking it with our daughter at Liquid tonight. I'm sure she will be back to enjoy the vibe. Us old folks will just hear about it the next day.

googleReviews.author: Alvaro Limon
googleReviews.text: I thought I’d write this while everything is still fresh in my mind. This place is just not worth it. It took a LONG minute for them to get my first drink order when I arrived even though I sat at the bar. Granted, one of the 2 bartenders was good and attentive. The one with the very short hair and older seemed very cold and uninterested. I finally get my food. I got the “famous” burger and fries. It’s decent, but worth over $20? Negative. In the end, I get charged for a beer that I never ordered, plus some ranch I never ordered. It’s not the price, just the principle of everything. If I never pointed anything out, I would’ve been charged for things I didn’t even order. Luckily, the other and good bartender did remove what I never even ordered. All in all, I won’t be back. There’s enough decent/good bars in the valley for anyone to deal with this.

googleReviews.author: Zoe Batie
googleReviews.text:
I came to Hooligans for their grand re-opening at the end of May, and WOW! The new owners are doing SUCH a phenomenal job taking the place over. The food was incredible, the drinks were cold and never empty, and the vibes were immaculate!

Thanks Dan & Amanda! 😁✨️🎉

& Shout out to Boyd- Its not everyday you find a top tier 5-star soup chef right in the heart of Boise's favorite trivia spot. 😁🍲🍜

googleReviews.author: Susan Perrier-DeFusco
googleReviews.text: Great atmosphere, excellent service, and an awesome French dip…bonus points for being GBP fans. 🧀

googleReviews.author: Amanda
googleReviews.text:
I had high hopes for Hooligan’s especially after hearing about how awesome their burgers are. However I found this sport bar pretty average. Don’t get me wrong, it wasn’t bad in any way at all but it wasn’t exceptionally memorable either.

My husband and I sat at the bar and ordered a PBR ($3.00) and cranberry vodka ($6.00), respectively. For grub, we chose Nachos ($9.00/half order, $16.00 for full) with beer cheese (+$2.00) and chicken (+$3.00), and the highly acclaimed Hooligan’s Burger (locally-raised, grass-fed beef with grilled onions, lettuce, tomato on an Acme brioche bun with fries, $13.00) with American cheese. The price is just right for the great quality of the food. The nachos were fantastic – they were extremely generous with the toppings which were all fresh. I couldn’t really tell a difference in the cheese. The burger was cooked just pink enough (which is default, you have to tell them if you’d like it more well done). But it wasn’t much more than another pub burger. Again, I am not saying it wasn’t great. It just didn’t stand out in my long, long list of fantastic burgers the Treasure Valley offers. Fries were yummy! I would definitely return for the great priced drinks.

googleReviews.text: Great place to stop and have a drink for date night the people are warm and welcoming. They have a few pool tables and the drinks are reasonably priced!!! We got the cheese curds they were amazing just a bit too much salt other than that it's worth stopping by!

googleReviews.text: UPDATED Review as if my first review wasn't spectacular. We had so much fun our 1st visit that our 2nd night downtown we canceled our reservation at another bar and returned here. googleReviews.text: Last night we were just walking by and noticed their sign for karaoke, so we figured we'd pop in. The stage and lighting are awesome, plus having two different microphones to choose from is great. Definitely a hidden gem for a Sunday night out when you're dreading returning to work on Monday. I didn't try the food but I saw a few other guest's plates and it looked amazing. Will definitely try it next time I stop by. googleReviews.author: Mike
googleReviews.text:
A group of 6 of us went for my sister's in laws Bday (Fri the 13th). 2 or our 6 had been to Drag shows before. The other 4 of us was our first time. It was fun and we laughed so hard!!! Very entertaining. Relax get involved and it'll be a blast. My wife got the bacon chicken ranch wrap w/sweet potato fries. It was big, good flavor and the fries were delicious 🤤

I got the hamburger, built it how I wanted it, lettuce, tomato, pickles, ketchup and a lil mayo.
I got s.p. fries as well, basic burger BUT so good!!

My one sister in law got the loaded fries with crispy chicken. It was really really good.

They gave my sis in law a special birthday cake with ice cream.

The 2 MC queens were hilarious. All the performances were extremely impressive, fun and well chorographed. The host at the door and all the servers were joyful, entertaining and you could tell they all love their jobs!

googleReviews.author: Sara Tripp
googleReviews.text: Took the family out, mom’s first drag  show on their Mother’s Day show, and what a good show they put on. They know how to entertain and host. We traded some 20’s for the roll of $1’s they have because you know those outfits and makeup ain’t cheap. A girls gotta work for tips. But you can also buy $1 rolls with a card. It’s a very well run group. I highly suggest catching a show. We had snacks, super yummy. Definitely coming back here! Don’t be shy and come catch a show, it’s worth the table price! 10/10

googleReviews.author: Sav
googleReviews.text:
Be prepared to spend around a hundred dollars. The show was so fun though and I will never regret suporting my local queens. Definitely recommend a seat in the middle as you can see the queens vogue and duck walk n such. Also pregame and eat beforehand if you want to save money.

Edit: recently just wanted to come into the bar to get a drink because I find the vibes of this place very nice and have been here twice for the drag show. Plus my friend is a bartender here. But the cover charge just to get in was $20 dollars, and $25 for venmo?? I'm not paying $50 dollars for my partner and I just to get into a bar. Maybe the security person outside was confused and thought I wanted to see the midnight show or something. Cause I'll gladly pay that for a show, but not to just get in. No ma'am.

googleReviews.author: Tehya toller
googleReviews.text:
we came with a party of 15 for a birthday party, and let me tell you IT WAS SO MUCH FUN!!! the queens were absolutely beautiful and amazing and funny. it was such an enjoyable experience. the food wasn’t the best but not the worst, and the penis shaped waffles are so fun!
my only complaint would be that our server was very unkind — but the rest of the staff was incredible. it was a packed full house and everyone killed it! if you’re thinking of coming, just do it!

googleReviews.author: April Carver
googleReviews.text: Absolutely awesome experience. The staff are super kind and helpful. Very professional even when some other customers were being very rude to the staff. Super accommodating. Loved being able to have our own space due to having some stage fright in the group. Super fun, loved the prohibition room. Very clean. Love that we can bring our own snacks, one person in our group has celiac which usually limits where we are able to go. They do have some snacks/drinks for purchase as well but think like mini gas station, so not many options but still good selection and pricing. Fantastic selection of song and easy to use system. Had a blast and would definitely recommend and will be going back.

googleReviews.author: Heather Hemingway-Hales
googleReviews.text: So much fun for my 55th Birthday. We all had a blast. Huge song selection. We brought our own food, drinks and birthday cake. Would recommend to a friend.

googleReviews.author: Jessica Reynoso
googleReviews.text: Absolutely love this place! They have a huge selection of music to choose from, including plenty of songs in Spanish. Something I thought was cool was the fact that you can change the key of the song, as well as the volume of the lead and backup vocals, so you can tailor the music to suit your performance needs. My friend and I booked the Musical Theatre room and it was sooo cute! I loved the mood lights and stage. The owner was super nice and accommodating, and did not judge us for screaming a bunch of break up songs!

googleReviews.author: Sophie Imada
googleReviews.text: I was looking for a karaoke place with private rooms a little bit closer to home (I live in Harrisville). We have been to Heart & Seoul Karaoke in Provo. We loved it there but hate the drive. I was so excited to find Vibe Karaoke. It’s still a bit of a drive for me but not nearly as few as Provo. It’s worth the drive too. I took my daughters and one of my daughter’s best friend here on the night of New Year’s Eve. The atmosphere was really nice. The two workers were really nice. One of the rooms was already booked but they let us look at the other two rooms before deciding which room to sing in. They let us check out the third room before we left for the night. They had a lot of little snacks and drinks to choose from in their little office. All the rooms are nicely decorated and the sound equipment is great. We had no issues with the mic or anything. There were sooooo many songs to choose from. We enjoyed our time there so much that I decided to throw my teenage daughter’s birthday there next month. We are so excited to go back!

googleReviews.author: Mary Lou Spencer
googleReviews.text:
We had a wonderful time!!  The song selection was limitless!  You have to try this. My 94 year old mom sang and loved the whole experience. We all loved it even those of us who are quite off pitch.
Tyler is great to work with. He responds quickly to our communications.  He has made it easy to book and easy to have a great memory!

about: Manny's Again is a bar in Salt Lake City, Utah. It holds a 4.5-star rating from 273 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Dennis Thurman
googleReviews.text: Never been at Manny's until last night, I was there because I was booked to play music. I was so pleasantly surprised at how clean and nicely decorated the place is. Very nice crowd as well. I didn't eat, but other guests said it was very good. They're promoting music, good drinks, food and a friendly staff. Give it a try

googleReviews.author: Jessica Hainey
googleReviews.text: Only leaving a a one star cuz i cant do less. Not a bar goer it was my cousins 40th birthday, only for their Kareoke. Do not recommend they over charge and dont know how to make a drink. Got very confirmational over a 15 dollar drink being poorly made. Cut off the entire party. Do not recommend.

googleReviews.author: Mariah Porras
googleReviews.text: Such a great friendly atmosphere! Great audience for karaoke if you are nervous or new. It was my first time in the state and this bar. I will definitely recommend to anyone and will be coming back!

googleReviews.author: Jennifer Griggs
googleReviews.text:
Manny's Again is the only pub I'll go to right now.  Penni is taking every precaution she possibly can.  She's so concerned over the health and safety of her customers and staff, whom she has made her family, that not stopping in and seeing her, wasn't an option, any longer.

I miss Manny's Again so much.  Covid has taken away so much, but I miss Manny's, the most.

If you're going out for drinks, this is the only place to go!!

googleReviews.author: Juan Manuel C
googleReviews.text: Mannys is a dive bar with a quaint but welcoming feel.  The drinks were on par for Utah and I loved the burger place next door. Def a recommend.

googleReviews.author: Brittney Ma
googleReviews.text:
Came to Flankers for a girls night in the Karaoke room and it was a fun time! We booked a room for 2 hours and sang our hearts out - so much fun! Joaquin was our server and he really did great taking care of our group of 8 girls and he came to check on us pretty often to make sure we had everything we needed. Huge thank you to him!!

The price was very reasonable for the room itself and the drinks were fantastic. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to have a karaoke outing or just to hang out at the speakeasy bar or the sports bar itself.

Highly recommended and can’t wait to go back!

googleReviews.author: teresa cereska
googleReviews.text: Love the themed speakeasy! Second year going. The atmosphere is fun and the decor is true to the theme and well done. Bartenders are great. Drinks are tasty but pretty overpriced… unless is comes in a festive glass. Sadly, you don’t get to keep the glass. 😂😂 Food is also spendy and basic but the names are clever.

googleReviews.author: Sara Govero
googleReviews.text: Excuse me, mister. I know you probably had a really nice dinner planned somewhere but it’s the college championship game. We gotta have TVs. That’s exactly what happened to me Monday night in Salt Lake. I was there for business and completely obliterated the dinner plans to watch the college football championship. It was my duty and the potential client was on board. Flanker was the move. The nachos are illegal. The chips are clearly seasoned with something addictive, the fresh jalapenos bring the perfect heat, and the side of cheese ensures no sad, dry chip at the bottom. Genius. Spicy tuna bites were also a win. Indiana won. I won all my two team teaser bets. The universe was aligned. Whoop.

googleReviews.author: Dain Ayesha
googleReviews.text: Wow, the food and the ambiance was incredible! Not to mention our waitress Eve, she was just the nicest and answered all of our questions with a smile ! Definitely loved our time for game 7 !

googleReviews.author: Suzy Nieroth
googleReviews.text: We love the speakeasy and do our best to check out all the fun themes. Arrived to our reservation 20 min early and even though we were happy to wait, the staff went out of their way to try to get us seated sooner. We chose to wait for a table and Rod was able to get us seated at the best table and made us feel like VIP’s just by being so kind.  We had so much fun with the drink and food selections but our server Theresa had the best presence and was in the holiday spirit for sure while taking great care of us. I highly recommend checking this place out, it is always a fun time.

googleReviews.author: mesha smith
googleReviews.text:
I’d give this place a solid 3.5 stars. The staff is always super nice and welcoming I’ve been there four times and they always make me laugh. The vibe is really fun.

However, the security definitely needs improvement or at least more security, especially around the 18+. I’ve seen grown 30+ year old men staring at younger girls, which is uncomfortable and honestly weird. I’ve also seen some of the 18+ crowd come in already drunk and start shoving people. It would be nice to have better supervision to keep everyone safe.

The music is okay I love the throwback songs but I wish they’d mix in more new or trending music. And more variety from Black artists beyond just Nicki Minaj and Drake would be great.

Overall, I do enjoy this place, but it’s not somewhere I’d go to often.

googleReviews.author: Logan Baker
googleReviews.text: One of my favorite clubs in the US. A standout nightclub ESPECIALLY considering how poor I think Utah's nightlife scene is. If you don't like the alt vibe they advertise I once went cosplayed as Mr Clean in all white and everybody loved it. The regulars and staff here make the place what it is, not the themes.  The themes are just fun if you feel like joining in

googleReviews.author: Chels
googleReviews.text: Love Area! From karaoke to the dance floor, there’s something for everyone. Shout out to Loki, Hel, and Pyro for being the best bartenders in SLC!

googleReviews.author: Sheida H. Maguire
googleReviews.text:
Area-51 is the best and longest running danceclub in Salt Lake City with a wide range of Goth, Industrial, Alternative and top 40
music. The bartenders, DJs and management know how make everyone feel invited. It’s always a great experience!

googleReviews.author: Lauren Henry (LSilly)
googleReviews.text:
My favorite place to be myself and sing karaoke. I feel like I can be genuine here and I always meet kind, eccentric people.
Kink nights are great for people watching

(They could use a better system for it)

googleReviews.author: gracie lopez
googleReviews.text: Piper Down by FAR has one of the best Brunch foods (for a bar). Their chicken fried steak is so good, probably the best we’ve had. I got the burrito and it was also very good. There are no pancakes on their brunch menu though, so if you’re a pancake fan i’d go somewhere else. Unsure about the overall bar environment since i’ve only gone here for their brunch but it was delicious and honestly took be by surprise.

googleReviews.author: Mary Scott
googleReviews.text: (The pics attached to this review are of plant based items - if that helps any wandering veggies out there) - I have been coming here for years now. Not only is the regular menu incredible, but the vegan menu is absolutely iconic. If I am going out to dinner or know someone who is, this is the 1st place I recommend. There is truly something for everyone. Prices are great, people are kind, portions are perfection. On the plant based menu try out their version of a blt, or their garlic mushroom burger, or their basic cheese burger 🍔. For the non veggies, I would recommend their fish tacos or the cowboy burger. Their desserts are also incredible. To top it all off they serve Brigham's Brew from Wasatch Brewery, you cannot go wrong.

googleReviews.author: Parley Bates
googleReviews.text: Bar is good. Full service bar with friendly and experienced bartenders. Visited on a weekend when a live band was playing. There was a $10 per person cover charge to enter since a band was playing which seemed unusual for a bar v. Club or music hall. Nobody in our group enjoyed the music, however there were lots of food and drink options. A member of our group frequents this bar and said it’s usually a good vibe. We didn’t stay as long as planned since the music wasn’t good, it was too loud to hear anything, and the servers kept skipping our table. I’d recommend you give this place a try since I’ve been told it’s usually pretty good, but for me it wasn’t enjoyable. Parking nearby is hard to come by for your D.D., but drop offs and Ubers are easy.

googleReviews.author: katy. esp
googleReviews.text: The service and drinks were nice, but my girlfriend and I couldn’t get over the smell. It was like a mixture of mildew and sweat. Unfortunately this made us leave after 1 drink. They're a lot of bars in slc with similar prices and a better vibe.

googleReviews.author: Randy Prazen
googleReviews.text: I’m giving this bar 5 stars because I love the food and bingo. Service is what you’d expect from a bar, the food is awesome. I always get the Rubin and Fries which is one of the best Rubin Sandwiches in the valley. The restrooms are bad. The smell in the hallway is that of a litter box that hasn’t been cleaned, ever. Restroom floors are sticky around the urinal. Please clean them.

about: Heart & Seoul Karaoke is a karaoke bar in Provo, Utah. It holds a 4.6-star rating from 481 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Cathryn
googleReviews.text: Tonight has gotta be my 5th+ time here to do Karaoke in the past year. I LOVE THIS PLACE! It's cheaper and more effective than therapy I swear. The private rooms are SO nice and comfy. We had a group of about 18 people, and the first room they put us in had some microphone issues (room 6) but the two girls working the front were quick to help us. We ended up being able to move to a different room which we really appreciated. We had hardly any break in our time since they worked so fast to help us out! Thank you!!

googleReviews.author: t okelberry
googleReviews.text: There are parts that are not wheelchair accessible! I booked the large room for my large family but was not told it wasnt handicapped accessible. Instead, was shown a flight of 20+ stairs. We would have to leave out some family members if we continued, including the birthday girl! We were told we could use the lobby area where everyone comes in (what?!) Or try the medium sized room. We squished into the medium room. It was very squishy. Medium room people got an upgrade at my expense since I was still charged for the large room. I'm willing to change my review if the website will CLEARLY state the large room isn't handicapped accessible and I get some compensation for the downgrade. H&S, you have to do better.

googleReviews.author: Michael Luther
googleReviews.text:
Tonight marks the 3rd time we have been here, however this is our first time trying the open mic night. Tonight was by far the absolute WORST experience i have ever had at ANY karaoke establishment. I am used to singing in dive bars, and this DRY karaoke establishment was filled with the most beligerant, selfish, and incredibly rude customers ive ever seen. Drunk teens/ young adults filled the main room tonight, being incredibly rowdy, and adding multiple songs per person within their respective groups. They continuously pushed multiple of their own songs to the top of the queue, even though the rules specifically state to only have 1 song queued at a time, and to play them in the order they were added. I waited well over an hour to sing 1 song and finally get out of there, despite my best efforts to keep my song in its place in the queue. Somebody kept changing the key and tempo of the music while people were trying to sing their songs, which made even listening to the room a miserable experience. the 2 girls working the front desk outright ignored all of this chaos. They were on their phones with earbuds in, actively tuning the room out. My SO went up to tell the employees what was happening, and only then did one of the girls get up and shout "hey guys dont change the order of the queue please" and then she sat back down and put her ear buds right back in. This did nothing at all to help the situation.  After an hour and a half we had to leave, as the whole experience was incredibly frustrating and not fun at all. Whats more frustrating is that this is the ONLY place in the area to even do karaoke, and it sucks that its so incredibly mismanaged.

If you have a big enough group to justify the private rooms, that experience is better, albiet not great. You will still deal with random issues ranging from dead microphones to actual water leaks dripping from the ceiling (this happened on my previous visit).

Honestly, if you love to sing, youre better off just singing in your car :/ we love karaoke, and this place dissapointed us more than we ever thought possible tonight.

googleReviews.author: Christina Beebe
googleReviews.text: Really great time at Heart & Seoul! We reserved a room and it was a decent price. It's the only legit karaoke place around that I"ve been able to find. We were able to bring our own food for an extra $10 charge, which was so worth it. I love the experience of snacking and being able to chill and jam to your fav songs with your good friends. I'm going to be a little more nit picky here..The system crashed twice while we were there, but the workers were really prompt in fixing it. On top of that, I recognized that the room itself was pretty dirty. I think the table and chairs are clean and they may sanitize the mics (I hope) but we spilled a drink on the floor and when cleaning it up, there were balls of hair on the floor and it was just REALLY dirty. In a pandemic, we gotta keep things cleaner, if possible. Still, it's the best local karaoke spot. Wish it was bigger! We will be back, for sure :)

googleReviews.author: Faith Marthe
googleReviews.text: We had such a great time hanging out! The room was large with a variety of options in addition to karaoke which was great for those less comfortable with belting out music. We had pizza which was pretty standard fare.  The only downside to the whole experience was that the floor was a little weak so if you jumped  around or moved too much in one area it caused the ceiling in the room below to shake. I would still recommend it to anyone looking for someone to rock out with their friends. Just be a little careful not to jump in this room.

googleReviews.author: Abigail Thomas
googleReviews.text:
I walked in completely sober and was refused service with no clear explanation. Staff told me it was because their boss “said so,” but no one could explain what policy I had violated or why I was being denied service.

I calmly asked for clarification multiple times and never received a straight answer. The lack of transparency and basic professionalism was frustrating and unnecessary.

While I was on the phone explaining the situation to friends, the bartender, who I later learned was the owner, inserted herself into the conversation and spoke to me in a confrontational and unprofessional way. That escalated a situation that could have been handled simply and respectfully.

I don’t mind being turned away if there is a legitimate reason, but being refused service without explanation and then treated rudely by management is not acceptable. There are plenty of other places in Billings that handle customer interactions far better.

googleReviews.author: Chelsea McCreary Villalba
googleReviews.text: If going for the karaoke, be prepared to experience local favoritism. If you are not a local, your karaoke bid will not be considered for priority in the lineup. The establishment is anti-non-local, and its service priorities, overall, reflect that. If the DJ and bar staff perceive you as foreign to the Billings area, you are not welcome. Do not waste your time visiting this establishment. There are far better establishments in the area that treat you fairly and without outright prejudice. I did not enjoy myself at this establishment due to its incredibly rude DJ and supporting staff.

googleReviews.author: David Bain
googleReviews.text:
Karaoke 7 nights a week!!
Tons of fun, friendly staff, great crowd.
Reasonable drink prices..

googleReviews.author: Nic Gerbase
googleReviews.text:
Crystal Lounge is a great place to relax and have fun. It has a friendly atmosphere and a wide variety of drinks and games. The karaoke is always a hit, and the staff is always happy to help out. If you're looking for a place to unwind, Crystal Lounge is the perfect spot.

The bar is located in a historic building in downtown Billings. It has a cozy, old-fashioned feel with exposed brick walls and dark wood floors. The bar is decorated with a variety of vintage items, including a jukebox, a pinball machine, and a pool table.

The drink menu at Crystal Lounge is extensive. They offer a wide variety of beers, wines, and cocktails. They also have a selection of non-alcoholic drinks, including soda, juice, and water.

The food menu at Crystal Lounge is limited, but they offer a few basic items, such as burgers, fries, and pizza. They also have a few appetizers, such as wings and mozzarella sticks.

The karaoke at Crystal Lounge is always a hit. They have a large selection of songs to choose from, and the KJ is always happy to help out with requests. The karaoke room is also a great place to meet new people.

The staff at Crystal Lounge is friendly and helpful. They are always happy to make recommendations and answer any questions you may have. They are also very knowledgeable about the bar and its history.

Overall, Crystal Lounge is a great place to relax and have fun. It has a friendly atmosphere, a wide variety of drinks and games, and a great karaoke room. If you're looking for a place to unwind, Crystal Lounge is the perfect spot.

googleReviews.author: Brenda Warren
googleReviews.text: The large TV screens were appreciated. However, our food was burnt. My husbands was too. But he was hangry so he ate it. Mine was rubbery and my husband confirmed it was burnt and rubbery. I couldn't eat any more🤢The tater tots were very good, but the service was adequate.Th waitress asked if I wanted a box. I told her no, Thank you. It is burnt. She said okay and left to get us changed. So no, sorry, no. Can we replace it? Oh no sorry, I'll take it off your bill. I would have gladly just paid for the tater tots. Maybe if we had a few drinks we wouldn't have noticed or cared, LOL, but definitely not returning.

googleReviews.author: Rose Uriarte
googleReviews.text:
Where’s the post of who won and what the cash prize was in the karaoke competition????
You’d think the winners would be showcased on this page…Especially after all the build up and participation received from said competition. 🤔🤔🤔 I would think pictures and videos would be shared, especially of the finalists and the winners…all the build up…then…nothing. Crickets. Back to posting food, trivia nights and bartender memes.
I even noticed someone requesting pictures of the assumed winner and her comment was ignored.
My bf and I competed, and we are pretty decent singers. We spent decent money in your establishment that night, between drinks, food, and gaming. Even brought a couple friends who did the same. We’ve been there several times prior before winter…but we weren’t bar regulars by any means.
We didn’t expect to win as we know there are a lot of really great singers out there. What we expected and hoped for at the very least was an honest, fair competition. This was not that. This “competition”appeared to be a ploy to sucker a 20 fee out of people to participate just for the “judges” to choose their bar buddies friends to move forward.
I’d love to see pics and videos of these amazing finalists and winners and be proven wrong.
3 weeks later.,.still nothing, like this competition was a figment of everyones imagination.
This competition was a complete joke.
Shame on you Red Door for allowing this bs.
I know I know, what I have to say will mean nothing really, you have your regulars and my thoughts won’t really matter here…but it needed to be said and it’s astonishing I’m the first one to call you out on it.

googleReviews.author: Sandie Marie
googleReviews.text: I don't know if red door has food I think they do but I haven't eaten it yet so I just went ahead and gave him five stars for that cuz if it's as good as their service and the atmosphere, then it must be amazing!

googleReviews.author: Rachel Tahnee Dehler
googleReviews.text:
The Reno will always hold a special place in my heart. There’s something about walking through those doors that feels both nostalgic and alive all at once. It’s run by some of the greatest humans you’ll ever meet—people who show up not only for their customers but for the entire community in ways that go far beyond the walls of their business.

Every time I’ve sat down at their machines, I’ve walked away a winner—not just because of the jackpots (though yes, I’ve hit those too), but because of the energy, the warmth, and the genuine care that radiates from this place. The Reno continues to outdo itself time and again, reminding me why it’s more than just a spot to play—it’s a cornerstone of what community and connection are supposed to look like.

googleReviews.text: The bikers are so dangerous, first they struck into my lane to where I had to break check and make sure I didnt hit them then I honked since I had children with me, meanwhile another biker heard me honk and chased me from the reno parking lot up the road to scare me. The bikers here make this location so unsafe and trashy. Dont go here unless you want to be harassed by bikers over their own road mistakes.

To be honest the only good thing about the Reno club is Jen who tends the liquor store.

googleReviews.author: Richard Brown Jr, MBA
googleReviews.text:
At Essential Living Support, LLC, we believe in dignity, inclusion, and community connection—and 2 Bar & Grill truly embodies these same values. It’s a wonderful establishment that not only offers great food and a welcoming atmosphere but also opens its doors to everyone, including individuals with disabilities and special needs.

The staff at 2 Bar & Grill are exceptionally friendly, attentive, and respectful, making every guest feel valued and included. Their willingness to host community events and support inclusive gatherings reflects a genuine commitment to making Cheyenne a place where everyone belongs.

As a business dedicated to empowering individuals and promoting inclusion, Essential Living Support is proud to recognize and support local establishments like 2 Bar & Grill that share our mission of kindness, accessibility, and community engagement.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommended for their hospitality, heart, and inclusive spirit.

googleReviews.author: Craig Life
googleReviews.text:
Took a chance on Two Bar Bowl since the outside doesn’t really stand out, and I’m glad we did.

I parked on the east side and wasn’t totally sure where to enter, but we eventually came in through the bar. Once inside, it had a great old-school bowling alley feel, which was refreshing.

We reserved our lane online, and that was a major reason we gave this place a shot. Check-in was easy, and the employee helping us was friendly and thoughtful enough to space out the lanes instead of bunching everyone together.

The lane setup was also really cool. The main lights were turned off over the lanes, with red LEDs running down the lanes and neon lighting on the pins. It gave the whole place a fun, relaxed vibe without feeling overdone.

Getting shoes was simple. The names were already entered from the online reservation, so creating funny bowling names was out the window, but that was no big deal.

My wife wasn’t too excited about bowling alley food, but we gave it a chance because the menu had a wide variety of choices. The food ended up being really good, filling, and reasonably priced. The lady taking our order was patient and very friendly, and she even thanked me for my modest tip, which you don’t see much anymore.

When our number was called, the cook actually came out to make sure our order was good to go. Is this really bowling alley customer service?

We bowled two full games with zero mechanical issues, everything ran smoothly, and we just had a really good time overall.

Between the service, the atmosphere, and how easy everything was, this place definitely exceeded expectations. We’ll absolutely be back.

googleReviews.author: Dale Pruett
googleReviews.text: With the snow coming down, the crew at Two Bar were very understanding and quick to help by putting ice melt in the handicap parking areas so no one would slip. Really good people who care about their customers’ safety.

googleReviews.text: We had a great time here last week. We brought our toddlers bowling, they loved it. The staff helped get them a ramp, rental shoes, and pointed us to the lighter balls for them. Carousel Lounge is a standout bar that exudes authentic charm and a welcoming atmosphere. The crowd here is truly unique - vibrant, friendly, and full of character. It’s the kind of place where the sense of community feels natural and unforced. During my visit, two separate guests ordered drinks for everyone, adding a rare and delightful touch to the evening.

The music selection perfectly complements the lively ambiance, creating a rhythm that keeps the energy high throughout the night. The bartender, a charismatic and skilled professional from the Czech Republic, deserves special mention. His engaging personality and excellent service made the experience even better.

The interior design is both stylish and cozy, adding to the allure of the place. From the decor to the people, every element of Carousel Lounge comes together seamlessly, making it a bar worth returning to again and again. Truly a gem that delivers on all fronts!

googleReviews.author: Justin Cazel
googleReviews.text: Where else do you go when visiting your daughter in Anchorage? A dive bar, where else? This place is right out of the movies. Pool, darts, karaoke and 1000 people that would pull off the side of the road to help you change your tire.  I loved it.

googleReviews.text: The bar tender wasn't very friendly and looked like i was a inconvenience.  If I'm spending my money and tipping well, then the bar tender should at lest act friendly.  Left after my second drink. A short spiked hair lady was the bar tender serving my drinks at the bar. The band playing music was good.

googleReviews.text: Love dancing here. Always great bands that play great dance music. Great bartenders and wonderful atmosphere.

googleReviews.author: L. P
googleReviews.text: Our group rented out the ice room way in the back for karaoke night for a very large group! Our bartender Joe was great. Now the bar is definitely something..... And different rooms with different themes, so you can't say it'll be a dull moment that's for sure. What a local dive bar which always can be so much fun! And we had a great time!! Did not quite understand the security though. I mean I do... But if you have to walk through the scanner for weapons and then You are a female with a purse and you put that off to the side, walk through and then pick up your purse on the other side - hello you didn't scan my purse... How do you know "it" wasn't in the purse? Just asking for a friend 😉🤣🤣🤣

googleReviews.author: Bee&Bear
googleReviews.text: LOVED IT!!! This place was walking distance to our air bnb so we were able to get a tad drunk and walk home nice and easy. Our bartender was awesome! My husband and I do not drink much so we just asked for recommendations and he delivered! We did karaoke and the crowd was so involved. It was a Wednesday but it was poppin! Arcade was super fun and really eats your quarters but worth it! Pizza was dang good for bar pizza and definitely worth the price for how big it was! Cheap drinks too! Would definitely love to return!

googleReviews.author: Renato Jack
googleReviews.text: This place has 9 different bars/atmospheres in it. The most ecletic establishment I've ever been. Nighttime life place, super different and interesting. Bartender Harrison is your man. It's worth checking it out on sat night for sure, from club dance floors to live music stage and hole in the all slanted bars, it caters for pretty much all sorts.

googleReviews.author: Ashley Carle
googleReviews.text: This is my absolute favorite bar in Anchorage! You won’t find something like this anywhere else. As a younger women, I feel extremely safe here. The drinks are great, fast and affordable! The atmosphere is great, there’s a place for everyone. Rather you like arcade games, pool or just want to listen to music and dance. There are multiple areas and “rooms” which are all differently themed. The last one is my favorite! A MUST if in Anchorage!

googleReviews.author: Amy Thomas
googleReviews.text: Like no other bar you'll ever find. Its like a food court of bars with a quirky alaskan twist. For certain events it's shoulder to shoulder. Other times it's like an empty castle. The decor alone is worth a visit. Great "drunk" food to share. There's a pinball machine room! Some pretty epic bands have come through too.

If you're visiting Anchorage (like I was!), this is THE gay bar to go to.

They have it all!  (1) outdoor space with bonfires and games (massive jenga and connect 4!), (2) awesome AWESOME drag shows, like NYC calibre, (3) dance floor/area, and (4) food!  You may never leave.

And, quite befittingly, the entrance is in the rear, not the front street.

googleReviews.author: Abhi Reddy Dandu
googleReviews.text: Who knew a gay night club in Anchorage could be this good. Great cocktails, friendly bartenders, very inclusive crowd and a fun karaoke night. Even on a Wednesday night this place was very lively and happening! PS try their waffle fries- chef kiss

googleReviews.author: Emily
googleReviews.text: Such an incredibly welcoming, inclusive, and fun place!!! The drinks are so unique and have fun names. ;) We unexpectedly went in and there was a drag show!! The bartender informed us there is a standing area in the stage room if you have not reserved a table. However, before the show started a server sold us a table. MAKE SURE YOU HAVE DOLLARS BILLS!!  Tip your drag queens and kings!!! The dance floor with the stripper pole is too much fun!! After getting bored of the same old songs at the spur (in fbx) it’s so nice to actually dance to songs with a DJ that KNOWS THEIR AUDIENCE and is also super talented. Such a fun environment and a great place to end a magical night!! (They did also have food but I did not order any)

googleReviews.author: Sandra Weinacht
googleReviews.text: Came for the drinks, loved the friendly service and stayed for some absolutely travelicious food. Auf Wiedersehen! We’ll be back soon. Mad Mario Pizza and the Mac’n Cheese with bacon are YUMMY and big enough to share with friends.

googleReviews.author: Mictacular
googleReviews.text:
I had fun in the beginning but I had a medical emergency which was handled improperly. I have small seizures which are part of my life. Can't change it, they don't hurt and all I need to do is sit or lay down for a bit and then I'm fine. When I went lay down the female bouncer who was working was yelling at me and my friend who knows my medical history was trying to tell her to stop yelling at me and was trying to tell her what was going on. But the female bouncer screamed back at my friend claiming I was faking it. The male bouncer had the other bouncer move away from the situation. I wasn't that drunk. I have a breathalyzer with me for fun and blew a .07.

While my friend had another person call an Uber they wouldn't let me wait inside. I'm from Florida visiting and cold weather is not my thing so having wait outside for 15 minutes waiting for an Uber was not any more helpful in my situation.

Drag show was nice. But how medical situation was handled. And claiming someone is faking it is very unprofessional.

googleReviews.text: just got to anchorage and this bar made me feel like family! such cool people here, staff’s talent level with cocktails is so incredibly next level you’d never expect this walking in. Went in for one beer ended up staying all night and switching over to cocktails. Awesome theme nights, seriously this is the place you check out if you wanna hang out with alaskans.

googleReviews.author: Ryan Stafford
googleReviews.text:
If you're looking for a cozy neighborhood bar then Van's Dive Bar is your next stop.

Van's Dive Bar was previously named 'Kings X'.  On the outside there isn't much to the place.  Located next to the best pan-fried chicken diner, Lucky Wishbone.

On the inside Van's Dive Bar is cozy and well designed for live bands and sports events. The bar is on one side, seating in the middle, and pool on the other side. The restrooms are down the hall and at the end of the hall is a very small outdoor area to have a smoke.

I feel like the new name also brings a new clientele to this cozy neighborhood bar. Next time you're in the area stop by for a quick beer and relax. Cheers.

googleReviews.author: Teresa Ubando
googleReviews.text: clean room, great sound, extensive song library, easy to use. loved the tambourines and maracas. price for room and drinks is very reasonable. service is exceptional. we had such a great time we had to extend our time

googleReviews.author: Rheina
googleReviews.text: The lady at the front was very nice and explained to us how the karaoke machine works but we werent 100% listening yet still manage to figure it out. The medium room was good size for the 8 of us. We all fit and there was tables we could put our stuff on. They offer food and drinks, but we mainly got drinks and brought our own food/snacks. Personal opinion, but I think water should always be free, but then it was water bottle instead of tap so it's fine I guess. Defininifely a nice and fun company with friends. They offer props, idk what they're called as I'm writing this but it made noise that went well with every beat when shaken. Place was a little bit hard to find but it's on the second floor! The bathroom was a decent amount of walk but since you need a code, it was on the cleaner side so that's good. Would definitely recommend this place  and come back.

googleReviews.author: Tierra Crooms
googleReviews.text: So fun!! Great catalog of music. The bar staff was very prompt and accurate with our drinks even though they were busy. Love that you can bring your own food. Clean rooms. Great equipment. Technology was easy to use and understand by everyone. The layout of the venue is good as well. Rooms were nicely insulated. We didn’t hear anything outside our room. Front desk staff was helpful and efficient.

googleReviews.author: Merri W
googleReviews.text: This our first time at wave808. The room was clean but the couch we had needs an update but the rooms we passed were nice.  The system was easy to use. The staff is friendly and very attentive. You're able to bring in your own food but need to order drinks there. The drinks are a little expensive. Overall we had a great time.

googleReviews.text:
Our organization, Hawaii Children’s Action Network, rented a room at Air Park for a 25-person celebration honoring our ʻOhana Leadership Council, and we had a wonderful experience. The space was clean, comfortable, and perfect for our event.
Kylee was incredibly attentive and welcoming. We appreciated being able to bring in catered food, and everyone loved the delicious drinks from the bar. Parking was also very convenient, and the website provided clear, easy-to-follow instructions.
We truly appreciated the warm hospitality and seamless experience from start to finish. We’ll absolutely be returning for future events. What a fantastic venue! ❤️

googleReviews.author: Precious Brown
googleReviews.text: My party and I had a blast at Air Park Karaoke!! We brought in our own food & our server made sure we were well taken care of! The Happy Hour specials were quite the steal! Their Karaoke system was very easy to navigate and had so much song options, we had to add an extra hour to keep the great vibes going!

In observing how much fun everyone was having, I can say that it's fun for kids and adults alike! Great selection of songs and really helpful staff! HIGHLY recommended! You won't be disappointed if you're looking for a karaoke place in town!

googleReviews.author: Vivi Qinwei Xie
googleReviews.text:
My favorite karaoke spot in town. Staff is super chill and friendly, always helping us with the machine and never rushing us. Rooms are clean, AC works, sound is solid, and there’s a huge song list in English and different Asian languages, so everyone in our group is happy usually. Even Asian grandmas like my mom lol

The vibe is really local and relaxed, not touristy. Perfect for hanging out after dinner (or omg you can do take out with your own food), birthdays, or random weeknight stress relief… though more rare now for us though with the kid 🙄

I also find that their prices are fair and we always end up staying longer than we planned.  (Not great the second day but hey at least we had fun lol) 🤩

5 stars for a karaoke bar, easy

googleReviews.author: Akemi S
googleReviews.text:
This is a late review, we visited this place back in August.
My friends and I had a very disappointing experience here. We were each overcharged for our room — instead of splitting the cost as requested, they charged each person the full amount. They also failed to mention that gratuity was already included, so we all tipped extra on top of the automatic charge.
What made the situation worse is that charges were added to one of my friend’s credit cards without authorization. At the end of the night we left feeling content, only to later discover on our statements that we were billed more than what we actually purchased. To make matters worse, the tabs were already mixed up with items placed on the wrong bills.
When we tried to resolve it, the process was frustrating and slow. It took a full week of back-and-forth communication before any refund was issued, and even then, the refund was still incorrect. There was no urgency or accountability shown by the staff throughout the entire ordeal.
This experience turned what should have been a fun night of karaoke into a stressful mess. If you do go here, I strongly recommend keeping your receipts and checking your credit card statements carefully — you may be charged a different price than what you authorized.
Until they improve their billing practices and customer service, I cannot recommend this place.

googleReviews.author: Andrew Huang
googleReviews.text: Modern karaoke bar with good service and drinks that do not break the bank. The lack of reviews compared to other Karoake spots was definitely something I was cognizant of going in, but the place is very nice and I’m sure most people who come agree.

googleReviews.text: I had SO much fun at this karaoke bar last night! I am so glad I went, and I wanted to leave a positive review. googleReviews.author: Leiana Helms
googleReviews.text: Wang Chungs used to be so magical when it was Lil  Wangs back in 2010. I took so many girls in the bathrooms 🤫 The magic continued at Big Wangs with bartenders Cory Nomura, Bri Gavin and Chris who would make you feel like you belonged there. 2015 was a glorious year! So thankful! Everyone was sooo beautiful. So many amazing  memories. It was my 2nd home back then til 2017 when Dan chose to dismiss their friendship for a hookup, Thats when Wangs lost its magic. Now it’s an empty shell of that fantasy. When i lost my hearing after being attacked on Dukes Lane in 2017, I still tried to sing with my new cochlear implant device in 2020 but i could tell my voice was not good enough for the new bartenders with their plastic smiles. I love to sing so much and this place was my sanctuary. It hurt so bad that on my birthday December 30th, when I went out to smoke, i came back to find my seat taken and all my birthday stuff was given to me by a snobby bartender who I thought i had tipped $20 to. I felt so depleted on my birthday. End of an era for sure. Broke my heart to be dismissed like that on my special day.  Now i know never to go back again. 😢 Thanks for the memories, Dan. Magic can’t last forever.

googleReviews.text: Pandora is probably my favorite 24-hour spot in Honolulu. The people working here are incredibly kind and consistently nice, and the food is great. I highly recommend eating here or ordering carryout or delivery. While Denny’s can be hit or miss and the staff there can sometimes be rude, the people here are always pleasant. googleReviews.text: We came on a Friday night, a group of 6 and we had the time of our life! The drinks and the food were so delicious we had to go for seconds. address: 137 National Plaza #200, Oxon Hill, MD 20745, USA

googleReviews.author: Keonna G
googleReviews.text:
The aesthetic of this place is amazing and definitely sets the vibe from the moment you walk in. The atmosphere in the main area was fun, energetic, and very cultural. Even people who didn’t know all the songs or words were still joining in and having a great time, which made the experience feel welcoming and entertaining for everyone.

One thing I will say is if you plan on drinking heavily, be prepared to walk down a full flight of stairs because the venue only allows the elevator to be used for guests with disabilities. So definitely drink responsibly because those stairs are no joke by the end of the night.

The food was decent overall. I ordered the crab cheese wontons and they were really good. I was honestly so hungry I forgot to take food pictures before eating. The shrimp skewers were also delicious and full of flavor. The mozzarella sticks could’ve been much better if they had arrived hot instead of cold. The drinks, however, were great and definitely helped keep the energy going throughout the night.

One downside was the YouTube connection in the private rooms. It barely worked at times, and that kind of disrupted the full karaoke experience since song selection and timing matter in that type of setting.

Joy, one of the servers, was absolutely amazing. Her energy matched the atmosphere perfectly, and she really helped make the experience enjoyable. Our main server seemed overwhelmed and a little checked out, but Joy definitely stood out with her attitude and customer service. I also want to give credit to the security staff because they did an excellent job managing the microphones and keeping an eye on everything to make sure the environment stayed safe and fun.

Overall, despite a few issues, the vibe and atmosphere made this a memorable experience and I’d still come back for another night out.

googleReviews.author: Samantha Stanley
googleReviews.text: Joy was wonderful, the best service we had out of the 3 servers that walked into our private room. We waited 30 mins to get our room, she came in and made the night much smoother and helped us enjoy our time we had left!! She’s the best.

googleReviews.text:
Our daughter had her Birthday Party at Ginza. MyvWife and I loved it, and she had a great time with her friends. The Karaoke system was pro grade with excellent  sound quality. Karaoke rooms were clean and had very nice lighting. Staff was very friendly.
Raul was our event coordinator, and did a wonderful job, plus very friendly and  professional. Food service was spot on. My only (tiny) recommendation is for more desert options. We are coming back soon.

googleReviews.author: Maya
googleReviews.text:
ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT:

This location is wheelchair accessible (though the sidewalks are still not cleared of snow and ice widely enough in the surrounding areas, even from the metro to the location, as of 2/6/26.) Elevators are functional to the right of the stairs but it was originally blocked by a divider and the hallway is narrow which may make it difficult to self-propel (our group had motorized chairs.)

The private rooms are spacious enough that they can likely fit 3 wheelchairs. The touchscreen to select songs may be too high for some folks to reach from a wheelchair, especially in the bar area.

There were no audio commands for selecting songs, so someone who is blind or low vision would likely need staff or other guests to assist with song selection. Song selection was through YouTube videos with lyrics so you can likely find any song you'd like.

No AEDs or first aid kits were visible.

There were single stall all-gender restrooms with 1 grab bars that may be too small for some folks to transfer. A chair can only be positioned in front of the toilet, not on either side. There is no changing table or urinal. The blow dryer is also mounted too high for folks in wheelchairs to reach comfortably.

googleReviews.author: Vanessa Fuentes
googleReviews.text:
Last night was my first time visiting Ginza Karaoke & Rooftop Lounge with my sisters, and we had an absolute blast! We spent two hours there, and it flew by. The appetizers and drinks were delicious, and the atmosphere was fun and welcoming.

The host was incredibly friendly and took the time to explain how to use the karaoke machine, which made everything easy and enjoyable from the start.

On a side note, I accidentally left my purse in the bathroom. I realized it about an hour later and called the lounge right away. I was so relieved when they told me they had it safely kept at the bar. Their honesty and excellent customer service really stood out.

Ginza Karaoke & Rooftop Lounge is a great place to hang out with friends, and we will definitely be back!

googleReviews.author: Natalie Chantel
googleReviews.text:
Good evening,

I wanted to share some feedback from my visit tonight, as someone who frequents and supports the establishment.

There was a situation involving two patrons that began to escalate. One individual was asked by security to pull his pants up, which he did. However, his friend began to argue and compare the situation to others, creating a scene.

I would like to acknowledge that security handled the situation with professionalism, poise, and control. Even while being provoked, they did not escalate the matter and maintained a respectful environment, which I truly appreciated.

I understand and respect that this is an inclusive space that welcomes everyone. At the same time, I believe it’s important that clear and consistent boundaries are upheld across the board to ensure a comfortable and respectful environment for all guests.

Thank you for your time, and I appreciate the continued effort to maintain a positive atmosphere.

Best regards,

googleReviews.author: Ashlee Whitaker
googleReviews.text: The service is bad and I’ve been a regular there for two years now. I bring them so many groups and so much money in there. Last Friday I went there and the service was trash. They had employees drinking and taking customers orders. There was a bold female that kept stating that she works there and she kept skipping peoples songs. I ordered wings and when they came out there was a drunk man standing there. He picked up my wing and ate it. I asked if they could remake them and explained the situation. I waited over 20 minutes for new wings and they gave me undercooked wings. When I asked the manager for a refund he began to get very rude and nonchalant. I asked for a refund and he told me they had to put it back on my temporary card which I wasn’t gonna have by the time they refunded it. He didn’t show any concern or make any accommodation for me due to the inconvenience. I ended up just asking for a drink to replace the wings and he gave me a lemon drop with no drop. It was all juice.  I went back last night and brought more people and spent more money. I told my friend to go to the female that was working. He walked over to her and told her to over charge up. I got a margarita with Tito’s and a margarita with mango. The only reason we got mango is because that was the only flavor they had. Two $12 drinks. My total was 45 dollars. When I approached the female she got so nasty and told the manager she wasn’t making us another drink or giving us money back. She was so rude and nasty. She still ended with a $10 tip which was definitely lack of judgement. I asked for the tip back. She gave us the small cups and we weren’t accommodated then. Security told me it’s not what I say but how I say it. She would’ve gave me my money back if I didn’t yell. Mind you this is a loud place and the bartender wouldn’t walk back over to the counter so I had to project a little. I’ll place pictures and let you be the judge. They have nasty attitudes and clearly get overstimulated when you come to them with a issue

googleReviews.author: Nicole K
googleReviews.text:
This bar is located right in the middle of the gay district, and honestly, it’s a welcomed relief that it isn’t actually a gay bar itself. For anyone who isn’t gay, the interior feels rustic—bordering on old—and the bathrooms are absolutely unacceptable. They smelled awful, there was no soap, and it genuinely felt like they hadn’t been cleaned in years.

The saving grace? They serve an incredible ale called The Duchess. I’d recommend that drink to anyone.

googleReviews.author: Lewis Winston
googleReviews.text: Let's say you wanted to go to a bar that was unpretentious but really had both amazing staff and superb drinks. Then this would be it. It's a really great neighborhood bar. You won't get a meal here but that's OK. You will get great service from a team that's like family who truly wants you to enjoy the experience and the amazing liquid libations. Ask about pairing beer with liquor because it takes great knowledge to do that. It's probably one of the best curated beer selections available. And don't worry if you're not sure about the beer you want because they probably have one for every palette.  It's refreshing to know that this place is available in DC. Locals know, I'm sure, but if you're in town for a visit, stop by and enjoy. Parking could be tough, but you'll appreciate not driving here to truly enjoy the experience. I'm definitely coming back and would highly recommend it.

googleReviews.author: Richard Hammond
googleReviews.text: The Crown and Crown is easily the best bar in the city. The management and staff (Graham, Travis, and Hook especially) really make every experience a fantastic one. The music and drinks are great, and the Guinness never disappoints. Highly recommend this bar to anyone in town looking for a great evening!!

googleReviews.author: Maya
googleReviews.text:
ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT:

The bouncer said that the elevators to access this bar are in the Compass Real Estate just south of it on 14th St. It is unclear whether the elevator is accessible during all operating hours of the bar, and I'm not sure how well informed they'd be about outages, so you may want to call ahead to be sure.

Otherwise, there is 1 flight of about 24 stairs with a landing in the middle and two handrails to descend to enter (the image is from the halfway point.) The stairs have poor contrast between them as the yellow and black caution tape has faded.

Management, please add contrast tape and install brighter lighting in the stairwell to enter to avoid falls and liability issues.

The tables and bar are high, most with stand-alone chairs but some along the wall also have a booth.

The restrooms are single stall for any gender. They have grab bars.

General info:
There are happy hour specials. There is no food available, but there's plenty of restaurants nearby.

googleReviews.author: Andrea Pedemonte
googleReviews.text:
Charming. Welcoming. Unforgettable
We hosted my husband’s birthday celebration at The Crown and Crow, and it was nothing short of incredible. We had a party of about 20 people, and every single one of us had an amazing night. The vibes were exactly what you want for a celebration with friends and family.

The service was superb from start to finish. Manager Graham and the entire team were so welcoming, attentive, and genuinely kind. The drinks were delicious across the board—beer, cocktails, and wine—shoutout to one of their bartenders who made me the best Old Fashioned on the East Coast.

We would highly, highly recommend this spot to anyone in DC looking for a great night out. Whether you’re celebrating something special or just grabbing drinks with friends, The Crown and Crow nails it every time. Cheers!

googleReviews.text: My go to kareoke joint in the area. Many reasons why. Bartenders are great. They are hip and they look like they enjoy being there. Not forced. So they make the experience happen. googleReviews.text: What a fun evening! After dinner at Kogiya, my wife, eight-year-old daughter, and I booked a small room for an hour for $40 to sing karaoke. The music library is robust (even though they didn't have KPOP Demonhunters songs per my daughter's dismay). It comes with microphones, strobe lights, water, and more!

googleReviews.text: Went here on a rainy and cold night with family. We got to sing our blues away for two hours. Ordered some food and drinks. Mostly serving Korean food and it was fine. We had bulgogi as an entree, truffle fries, and bulgogi quesadilla. Will definitely come back.

googleReviews.author: MN
googleReviews.text:
Glam Karaoke has become my second home — my friends and I are regulars, and we seriously love everyone here. The staff is always so welcoming and full of good energy. The vibes are immaculate every single time, and I’ve never had a bad experience.

Recently, Issa joined the team, and she’s been amazing — super sweet, uplifting, and makes the whole place feel even more fun.

And don’t even get me started on the food — every dish here is bomb! My go-to is the shrimp Alfredo pasta (elite every time), and I always snack on their tater tots. If you like a little heat, their spicy BBQ sauce is a must-try.

googleReviews.author: Sandra Schmidt
googleReviews.text:
Great experience here for a small work lunch  (7 people) event with food and bowling. Easy to plan online with packaged pricing per person that includes food, soft drinks, and reserved bowling lanes with shoe rental.

The setup exceeded my expectations. We had a buffet table with food warmers for our pork sliders and wings (sweet sauce)—both absolutely delicious! The dips platter with chips and veggies was all very good. I brought a bakery cake and our server Julia brought out a really nice cake platter to hold and display the cake which was very unexpected and welcome.

The bowling was easy to play and a staff member setup the names for us. Julia was friendly and ensured our soft drinks were always full. Frank the manager was very friendly and both welcomed us and checked on us after to ensure we were taken care of.

For the price point, the service and gaming experience exceeded a previous work event at Top Golf. Bonus points for easy and cheap garage parking, elevated service, and food that is both delicious and kept warm.

googleReviews.author: Jordan Massey
googleReviews.text: Grace was awsome. Made me a pretty damn good Margherita haha. I opened punchbowl back in 2019 and im glad to see its still up and running. Love what they did to the place.. a bunch of new decor and upgrades. Definitely come check it out and make sure you ask for grace!!

googleReviews.author: Sarah
googleReviews.text:
I was visiting the area for work for a conference and someone at the hotel I was staying at mentioned this place for great drinks and food. I wasn’t sure what to expect. I came on a Monday night and they ended up doing monthly Monday night spelling bee. The vibe had a lot of energy and the food was really good. They offer a lot of Monday happy hour specials. I had the rosemary fries which was a ton of food for only $5. I also had the Highway 66 Hibiscus punch which was also only $5.
As you walk further into this place, it’s basically like a Barcade, where they have all different kinds of old School arcade games. They had shuffleboard, darts, they even had a small bowling area. On Tuesdays they have trivia. I feel like they have something for everyone.

Huge shout out to Noel, who provided 5 star 🌟 service and made sure our little party had the best time!

googleReviews.text: Best pint of Guinness around. Good daily specials. Friendly staff. What more can you ask for in an Irish pub?

googleReviews.author: thuggs bunny
googleReviews.text: Seemed at first like the car crash woke this place up, but their staff have frequently been rude to me and my friends/family since and the most recent incident has solidified that this place just isn't worth the money. Food is okay, obviously a complete 180 from where they used to be, but when I'm spending around $100 for a meal for two if you drink (one blue moon draft in a regular pint glass cost $11 for example), probably closer to $60 if you don't drink, I dont want my experience there to be a crap shoot. The reason I won't be giving this place my business anymore (which I'm sure they could care less about because they clearly take Clarendon's foot traffic for granted) is because of how this place has treated me and my friends. Once, a friend of mine was confronted by a waitress for how much they tipped (something around 10% I recall) as we were exiting. I would note that this waitress probably visited our table a total of like 5 or 6 times (a very conservative estimate) across a nearly 2 hr period. A separate time the hostess refused to sit us at their open high top tables without any reasonable explanation, and instead argued with us when we asked why. We were told that because we were a party of two, we could not sit at any of their open high top tables (seats 4), unless we were willing to sit at the same table as other groups of two because these seats were considered "community tables" (have no idea why these other groups of two were allowed to sit at these tables alone but not us). There were at least 3 empty high tops on a Thursday afternoon, as well as numerous other empty tables all throughout the portion of the restaurant that we were requesting seating in. It made no sense, and the manager even admitted as much once he was finally called over for assistance. The owner then began eyeballing us after we sat down, and eventually approached us asking about the incident. We explained what happened, and instead of apologizing, he patronized us and justified the nonsense situation because she was apparently only 16 years old. Ageism isn't appropriate no matter what way it's served up.

googleReviews.author: John David Church
googleReviews.text: Love this place! Great friendly staff! The remodel really turned out well and the vibe here is jovial at worst and Cheers-esque at its best.

googleReviews.author: Fatma Icilacci
googleReviews.text:
After the Soccer game that Washington DC United had with the New Yorker team, me and my fiancé were late to have some decent food and drinks. It was about 10 minutes before the service closing and we had the best treatment, felt welcomed, not like “oh where did you guys come up from now” … No no… They really made us all the dishes that we requested with the care as if it is not last minute. Plus we are living right across the street from this beautiful place so we are now officially regulars!!! People are so well dressed up, properly conducting themselves, very kind and everybody’s respectful; it is the reflection of the service that is provided here! Plus… The place is filled with regulars. They are all like family. I lived in the UK for 10 years and this place took me where ai exactly wanted to be. Great place to spend time even if it is late, you will feel safe and still taste good food!

We ordered classical pub food that we would get in the UK & Ireland.

googleReviews.author: Ty
googleReviews.text:
Where do I even begin? I’ll start by saying that I do not recommend this place for karaoke. I went last month for a birthday party, and the entire experience was disappointing from start to finish.

First, the booking process is extremely inconvenient. Whoever is booking the room has to go to the location in person just to choose a room—nothing can be done online. The deposit also has to be paid in person, with the remaining balance due on the day of the event. On the day of our party, our money was mistakenly returned to us, and an hour later they came back asking for it again, saying they made an error. Very unprofessional.

We booked three hours starting at 4:45 PM with a $500 food and drink credit, but of course we didn’t get into the room at 4:45. When we finally entered, the room smelled like cigarette smoke and a bathroom. Apparently, smoking is allowed in the rooms, but there really should be non-smoking options for guests who don’t smoke. Each room has its own bathroom, which was visibly clean but still had that unmistakable “bathroom smell.”

The karaoke catalog was another letdown. Many of the songs we looked for weren’t available; the selection was mostly Asian music. We had to use an app on the screen—basically YouTube—to find songs we actually wanted to sing. It was annoying because the videos weren’t sized correctly for the screen, and the lyrics didn’t display in typical karaoke style.

Now on to the food and drinks—an absolute nightmare. We tried to order drinks only to be told that the bartender doesn’t arrive until 7 PM, so they couldn’t make any mixed drinks before then. What a way to run down the clock. When the drinks finally started coming out after 7, they were decent, at least.

The food, however, was horrible. We ordered wings, fries, and spring rolls. The wings were the worst I’ve ever had—over-fried, rubbery inside, and they tasted like fish. It seemed like everything was fried in the same oil, which made no sense. The oil clearly needed to be changed. The fries were fine, and the spring rolls were okay, but the wings were truly inedible. When we asked for a refund, they refused because the wings had been bitten into. We weren’t “eating them”—we were checking different pieces to see if all of them had the same bad taste. They didn’t even bother checking the garbage where we threw them out.

To top it off, the karaoke cut off exactly at the scheduled end time, despite all the delays earlier.

Overall, this was a terrible experience, and I definitely do not recommend this place for karaoke or events of any kind.

googleReviews.author: Rita L
googleReviews.text:
Cool karaoke spot! Stopped by today and did some karaoke here, space is big and good for groups, we had around 20 people and booked from 4:30pm-10:30pm and came out to be about $40 a person. You can order food and drinks with the room price. The skewers and fried buns are good. Also good beef noodle soup! Popcorn chicken is a bit inconsistent. Pricing is $25 for a small room an hour and $30 for medium before 7pm. Call to reserve ahead of time!

Sound system and speakers are good and the room has nice airflow, sometimes karaoke rooms will have a smoky smell but this one is fine. The only issue I had was the broken bathroom lock on the door, have to hold it to make sure people don’t come in.

Their song selections are also good and you can pick songs by scanning the QR code on the TV screen. Super convenient and easy to use so you don’t to leave your seat.

Overall a good spot and I’d recommend it. Make a reservation before you go!
