googleReviews.text: Recently visited 9 Plus KTV and it was an amazing experience! The atmosphere was vibrant in stylish and comfortable private room with an extensive song selection. Whether you’re into English, Mandarin, K-pop, or other international hits, they have a fantastic variety of songs to choose from. Unlike other KTVs, 9 Plus KTV offers real food that tastes delicious. It is not just the usual bar snacks. The menu has a great selection, and everything we ordered was fresh and flavorful especially the crawfish. If you're looking for a fun and hassle-free night out with friends, 9 Plus KTV is definitely the place to go.

googleReviews.author: Kevin Chen
googleReviews.text: ID check at the door. Stepping inside is like entering a cyber hyper lounge. You check in at the front to select your duration and you can add time later too. Pricing is reasonable. There are many private rooms down the hallways full of other parties actively enjoying their own karaoke session too. The control panel is easier to navigate if you can read mandarin but there is an english language option. Otherwise, there is also a mobile qr scan you can use to connect too. It’s a comfy large couch on one side of the room facing a large TV. A duplicate projection is also viewable from behind the couch. You can also order various drinks to enjoy with your session. Staff are overly courteous and helpful with requests. Great option for groups that are karaoke fans and located in a prime location to hang out.

googleReviews.author: Vanessa Ma
googleReviews.text:
$48/2 hrs, you get what you pay for, maybe a little less.
1. You can't queue songs, you can't use anything but YouTube, and you can't remote control from your phone. So you have to slowly type each song on the wall tablet keyboard, wasting time in between songs.
2. You can't full screen on the big TV. So you might not be able to read the lyrics well. Asked the server for help with all this and he confirmed you can't do any of this!
3. The ac wasn't on, had to ask twice if they could turn it on/up, and still left sweaty from the heat and humidity.
4. Moved tables to create space, found used tissues, vapes, and other trash underneath.
5. No explanation on how to use the system, spent the first hour figuring how to unmute the music, increase the volume, add songs, and full screen to find out you can't.
5. In conclusion, not sure if it was a bad room, but I wouldn't go again to find out. The servers were in a rush, and not explanatory, and the singing experience definitely sucked. Highly do not recommend this place.

A top-notch KTV experience!

googleReviews.author: Stephen K
googleReviews.text:
I had always passed by this karaoke bar, but never had the chance to check it out until now. My friends and I had a few hours to kill, so we decided to try out this karaoke bar.

The reception was very helpful, answering all of our questions and helping us get the best rate possible, despite us walking in without a reservation. We had to sign a waiver, which is typical of any karaoke bar, and she was helpful to quickly summarize it for us. Even better, we did not have to wait long before a room opened up for us.

With the amount of room credits we had, we could not order much, but we still had enough to order our fill! There are tons of choices for you and your friends to choose from, ranging from alcohol and drinks to appetizers and rice/noodle dishes. Of course, they do offer packages, deals, and bundles, if you wish.

The only downside I had with this karaoke bar is the music selection. Granted, I understand that every karaoke bar is different and not all of them will have the same selection of music. However, even some of the popular bands were not available on the list. I would assume that this specific karaoke bar is mostly for Chinese songs, with Japanese, Korean, and English being the minority. On the bright side, you can connect to Spotify or YouTube and sing along to the songs there, which I found unique and hilarious.

A fair warning to anyone coming here to sing, please watch out for the first song you enter. The sound system may restart in-between rooms, so if you are not careful, your first song could be blasting out your eardrums or be very muted.

googleReviews.author: Yuchen Kang
googleReviews.text: Never go here. They deliberately fail to warn you so that they can demand extra payment when you settle the bill.  I've been here more than 10 times and they're getting worse and worse over years.  We booked room for an hour and when times up we're weird why no one hits up to remind us so we walked out ready to end and pay, and the front desk guy just said "oh i thought u booked for 2 hours".  Bro we said it in the phone AND at the front desk that we want ONE HOUR and he said ONE HOUR with his mouth. You just lie like that??  And he tries to explain it by "the business were hard", like YEAH NO WONDER.   We even have to argue for only paying 1.5 hr rather than 2hr when we're only there ONLY 1 HOUR!!!    (And food and the mechines were getting worse too, you can also hear your neighbor from inside. Front desk guy seriously lie on purpose. )

googleReviews.author: Yeman Tam
googleReviews.text:
Jo, the woman at the front desk, was incredibly accommodating. She was friendly and welcoming and made all the rules very clear. I like that she speaks English pretty well because often times, there’s a language barrier. But she was really great and I would definitely recommend Wave KTV solely on Jo’s attitude and presence.

The rooms are very clean and the service is definitely up to par. When I ring the service bell, it’s probably 10 seconds before someone comes in and helps us.

The song selection is awesome. They have the latest songs out. But if you wanted to sing something specific, we learned that we could connect Spotify and just sing with those lyrics!

The prices are reasonably priced. I rented a small room on a Friday night which was $68 an hour. That amount acts as credits for the room, so you can order things off the menu and it’d basically make the room rental free.

This place is definitely my favorite KTV spot in Flushing, hands down. Thank you Jo and staff!

I have had times where one of the mics stopped working. You can also order food equal to the amount you pay for the room. It is over priced though.

about: Third Floor Pocha & Karaoke (삼층포차 & 노래방) is a karaoke bar in Palisades Park, New Jersey. It holds a 4.9-star rating from 1,088 Google reviews. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Eloy Yip
googleReviews.text:
If one has been in Korea and still hasn't gone to a pocha (포차), it’s time to change that.

Pocha is short for "pojangmacha," which literally translates to “covered wagon." Back in the day, these were food stalls covered with tarps to block the wind and rain. Today, they're more like Korea’s answer to the dive bar meets food truck meets neighborhood auntie’s kitchen.

Located on the 3rd floor at Broad Avenue, we decided on the Third Floor Pocha and Karaoke (삼층포차 & 노래방) in Palisades Park for a celebratory event.

Upon arrival as first-timers, we were greeted by the host, who led us to a private room in the back. The reservation was made for 2 hours but extended to 3 for a crowd-pleasing fun time with karaoke (Noraebang).

The venue was exceptionally clean and well-maintained, creating a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. The karaoke system itself was outstanding and offered multiple versions of songs.

The menu features tavern-style Korean food. The real reason one comes here is to drink soju paired with a beer and Ube Sweet Rice Wine as a toast shot.

We ordered various Korean appetizers from Old Style Korean Fried Chicken, including a fried sampler platter, fried dumplings, fried chili shrimp, etc. Every bite was flavorful; using fresh ingredients went terrifically well. It was tastefully delicious and ideal for sharing, especially with slush soju with grapes. The staff was friendly and accommodating.

Nothing like singing one’s heart out with good company.

googleReviews.author: vivi Chanle
googleReviews.text:
Overall, the food tasted good, but it’s more of a fast Korean food spot rather than a true Korean BBQ experience. I was expecting the meat to be grilled on a hot plate or induction stove at the table, but there was no heating element, and everything was served as cold dishes. Maybe heating is only provided if you order soup.

The intestines dish was very flavorful and well-cleaned, with no unpleasant odor, which I really appreciated. However, it was slightly too oily—if it were a bit lighter, it would be perfect.

googleReviews.author: Lauren S
googleReviews.text:
Third Floor Pocha & Karaoke (삼층포차 & 노래방) is such a fun spot in Palisades Park if you’re looking for real Korean pocha vibes without going into NYC. It’s on the 3rd floor, and once you walk in, it feels lively, casual, and perfect for a group night out.

The food was SO good and the portions are generous. We ordered the Rose Chicken Ddukbokki (로제치킨 떡볶이) and it was the perfect balance of creamy and spicy with chewy rice cakes and crispy chicken on top. The Bulgogi Sukiyaki (소불고기스끼야끼) was great for sharing — flavorful, comforting, and cooked right at the table. The 육회 (beef tartare) tasted super fresh, and the 문어숙회 (blanched octopus) was tender and simple in the best way.

The homemade Lychee Slush Cocktail (리치소주) was refreshing and dangerously easy to drink — pairs perfectly with the spicy dishes.

What really makes this place stand out is the vibe. It’s energetic, great for groups, and they have karaoke, which makes it perfect for birthdays or a fun night out with friends. Food, drinks, and entertainment all in one spot.

googleReviews.author: Jaelee J
googleReviews.text: The food was amazing. Everything was cooked perfectly and the sauces were delicious. The portions were great too for the prices. I was very impressed. The atmosphere was enjoyable as well. I liked that it wasn’t too packed around 11pm. I will definitely come back to try more of the food and take friends with me.

googleReviews.author: Andy Liu
googleReviews.text:
Rating: 9/10
Date Last Visited: 8/31/2025

We ordered a variety of Korean dishes, including boneless Korean fried chicken dishes, multiple soups, and seafood pancake. Each dish tasted above average for the dish - all had great flavor and portion sizes. My favorite dishes were the boneless chicken with scallion salad and sweet and spicy boneless chicken. The soups were a close second. This place is a great place to eat good food while drinking. The staff is also super nice - they heard us sing happy birthday to one of our friends and brought over a free drink with a sparkler. We also received a free bottle of beer for leaving a Google review (my rating is not influenced by that, but just stating this fact). They also broke up a fight between two drunk customers and apologized to us for the commotion. The prices were also pretty good, we spent a little under $50/person which included 8 dishes, a pitcher of beer, and 4 bottles of soju. Overall, I would recommend this place if you’re looking for a pocha with good food.

TLDR: The best karaoke spot! A little pricey, but would totally go again!
We had a BLAST! The staff was fantastic, but only go if you’re cool with loud music. Our party got food first (the oysters, rib tower, and apple snails) and really enjoyed it. The place is decorated really well, so we started taking pictures. The staff actually brought lighting equipment to make the pictures perfect.
Afterwards, we went to our karaoke room and they actually decorate it for free if it’s a birthday. The rooms are also really nice and all have their own bathroom. And the karaoke machine lets you easily look up songs on YouTube. Afterwards we came out the room to a live DJ in main area and someone who took our pictures with a professional camera (even transferred all the shots to our phones).
The food ended up being $90ish dollars before tip and the room was $60/hour, so not the cheapest place. But I don’t want to karaoke anywhere else now!

googleReviews.author: Uyen Dinh
googleReviews.text: Checked out a new karaoke spot, and I was really surprised and enjoyed the food. I keep coming back to finish the menu. Service is always excellent, with friendly smiles. Staff are careful when asking and taking orders, friendly, and helpful if I have questions about online singing issues.

googleReviews.author: Hector Perez
googleReviews.text: I went with 3 other people. We called for details and we made a reservation. The minute we walked in the front desk person had us a room ( we got it upgraded to a bigger room "the gold room" ) the room had 3 couches, one giant TV. Clean. The room also came with a bathroom!!!! We ordered the beer tower. The songs could be picked from YouTube!!! The sound system was amazing + 👏 . The host was very fast when we pushed the button for service. $1 per 1 minute. And we stayed 60mins so that was $60.  We wanted to stay longer but it was getting late haha. The lobby had a DJ and ample tables to sit and wait , if need be. we really enjoyed it a lot. Only negative thing i have to say is the room got a bit stuffy haha.

googleReviews.author: Carlos Vivas
googleReviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ BEST KARAOKE NIGHT EVER – You&Me Karaoke is a hidden gem in Duluth!

Last night after dinner, my family and a few friends decided we wanted to do something fun… and wow, choosing You&Me Karaoke on Pleasant Hill Rd was hands down the BEST decision of the night!

From the moment we walked in, the experience felt VIP. The manager personally welcomed us, gave us a full tour, and explained all the different private rooms — perfect for small hangouts or big party groups. You can really tell they care about their guests.

Once we picked our room and ordered some drinks… the PARTY STARTED! 🎤✨
The sound system was amazing, the song selection was huge, and having our own private space made it even more fun (and hilarious 😂). We laughed, sang our hearts out, and completely lost track of time.

And let’s talk about the vibe — the decorations and atmosphere make you feel like you’re in a trendy karaoke spot in New York or Seoul. Super modern, stylish, and perfect for photos.

If you’re looking for:
✅ Family fun
✅ Birthday parties
✅ Date night
✅ Friends night out
✅ Or just stress relief

This is THE place to go.

Trust me… don’t miss it. You’ll love every minute. We’re already planning our next visit!

🎶🎉 You&Me Karaoke = unforgettable memories guaranteed!

googleReviews.author: l P
googleReviews.text: The karaoke is so fun and lively especially with all the lights. It’s like my own private party and the hourly rate for the rooms are reasonable especially with a group of friends. I think the best part is that each private room has its own private bathroom, which is so convenient. It’s ranges from small room 50, medium room 70, and large room 90 on weekdays. It’s 10 dollars more fri-sun. They also have a wide variety of delicious Vietnamese food.

googleReviews.author: paige buckley
googleReviews.text: I’ve never felt the urge to leave a review for anywhere until now. We went here last night for my friend’s Birthday, and upon arrival, we were instantly greeted with eye rolls and attitude. The ONLY nice staff member was Grace, so exclude her from this review. We were put into the wrong room at first, we were 9 people, and paid for the biggest room. When I mentioned this to the staff, they said that the big room is for 30+ people, and after a brief conversation, we were then placed into the right room. It seems that they have a pattern of scamming people with that trick. Once we were finally in the right room, an older lady who worked there kept coming in and out, unannounced, would stare at us, then leave. Not too sure what that was about. We had a very hard time trying to queue music, and were not given too much instruction on how to use the remote. Other than that, we made the best of the situation and had a good time as friends, but unless you want to get scammed, or as other reviews show, screamed at, do not come here.

googleReviews.author: Myrlande Mondesir
googleReviews.text: Did not order food, but loved the experience was awesome. Friendly staff, good selection of music and amazing sound system.

googleReviews.author: Jasmine Brown
googleReviews.text: Went for a friend’s 21st birthday, And the lady who served us said that she wasn’t allowed to get a drink until the next day and that she wasn’t 21 yet. Was very rude and very short. I’ve been here previously and the service was better and they were very nice, but I don’t know what happened this time. They were very nice, but I don’t know what happened

googleReviews.author: Leo Tsukinaga
googleReviews.text:
I would give this negative stars if possible for physically getting liquids poured on us, chairs flung half across the room, being screamed at, having a man be held back while raising hands at us, and being forced to call the police.

We are previous customers over the years, but this was our last time going to this establishment.

Upon entering, the five of us weren’t checked in and were sent into a room, which is strange. We ended up having to go ask to get put into the proper room, and we were subsequently were given one where none of the technology would actually function. We have all been to karaoke countless times and are familiar with various machines. We chose this location due to the option to use YouTube, but it was not working.

We went to get help and wanted to spend even more money to get food and beverages, The times we went here, the staff has never been very attentive or welcoming (why it is not our main place). This time, the entire staff was eating dinner and acted as though we were intruding…as customers.

We were extremely cordial and apologized for needing help. One of the women dramatically sighed and shot up so fast and hard her chair flew back and fell over before storming between us, which made us incredibly uncomfortable.

She entered the room and basically told us the YouTube was not functioning without actually troubleshooting and we needed to use the book. We came here solely for YouTube, which was said and confirmed during reservation, and after the incident in the lobby we decided we no longer wanted to stay. It had been 7 minutes and we had not gotten any technology to work. We did not consume anything. We did not instigate anything. We literally did nothing.

We left the room as we found it and exited, saying we were no longer interested. We were chased outside and screamed at as they demanded we pay them ($50/hr). We did not use their services. We didn’t get anything out of this. It had been 7 minutes and all were spent with staff either being hostile or putting us in different rooms.

As we were descending the stairs, the same woman ran out and dumped an entire water bottle over the railing, soaking one of us with it, and all of them were continuing to scream. When one of us shouted that this was not okay, one of the staff raised hands at her like he was going to hit her and was held back. It was honestly crazy and surreal.

We did end up contacting the police and filed a report with an officer who reviewed the situation. The officer stated that we are not at fault and it was incredibly unacceptable and extremely abnormal for them to react to us changing our minds. We were open about not paying, which he also stated was normal when we didn’t get any sort of service. He went to talk to the people inside and we encouraged him to review the footage. He went on his way and so did we.

It was terrible and distressing. The 45 minutes home was miserable and damp. We will never return. If you value a positive experience, please consider another family-owned and operated location. There are several awesome ones with consistent and reasonable pricing!

googleReviews.author: Matthew Michaud
googleReviews.text: Food was awful, very few songs in English, we were overcharged and hit with undisclosed fees...then suddenly the lady up front forgot how to speak English. Clearly racist against non-Asian people, as other reviewers have noticed as well. Don't go here unless you want to get ripped off, eat frog legs instead of chicken wings, and not get to sing the songs you want to sing.

The music choices were spectacular, and finally the food and drinks most definitely hit the spot. If you are looking for a karaoke bar, TRUST ME this is the place to go.

googleReviews.author: Luke Han
googleReviews.text: My friend is close to the new owner so we have been there a couple of times to relax, eat, drink, and sing. The drinks are always refreshing and the food is pretty good. The first time, we were there for four hours, but the owner only charged us for the drinks.

googleReviews.author: Caleb Smith
googleReviews.text: Great facility, friendly and helpful staff and free parking. The place is very clean and was a great time. If you're looking for karaoke, I would highly suggest this place. I found the room to be absolutely freezing, so be prepared.

googleReviews.author: cong tran
googleReviews.text:
This establishment may not be suitable for you if you're not Korean. Upon arrival, my group was quoted a price way higher than the reviews seem to let in on ($100/hour). The group consisted of people who were not Korean. We did see other patrons arrive (Korean) who were lead into their rooms. This could be explained by having prior reservations, though.  However, since we were all celebrating a birthday party,  we agreed to this rate with the expectation that we'd be served just as normally as other guests.

There were several bad things to start off the night, I initially dismissed this assuming that they might have been busy, considering every other place was booked. When my group entered, we waited since the hosts started the rooms were all taken and we had to wait for the other big group to come out. When peering into their hallway, it seemed a bit odd, since there didn't seem to be other customers since the rooms were so quiet. While waiting, I went to use the restroom and noticed that there were a few rooms that was open with no occupants. I also dismissed this doubt since there could've been problem in those rooms.

The other group left, we were finally led into the room by a male employee and he got our drink orders. We asked the employee if there was any food being served since we had kids within the party who were hungry. The employee stated that the kitchen was closed so we thought that we just needed to order food. At this point, the employee heard us declare that we were going to get outside food to make up for their kitchen being closed and chose to not say anything. We sat awkwardly in the room, for what seems like 10 minutes, attempting to put songs into the machine but the machine didn't work. The machines had loud music, but only if you're not singing. Whenever you start singing, the starts music receding like LeBron's hairline in 2008. There was no service, even though our drink orders were taken, they were not brought into the room. We had to go back out into the lobby to ask for drinks.

Once food was brought into the establishment, we sat down and continued to sing, but did not open our food. About 2 minutes later, the female host bursts into the room and starts yelling at us for bringing in food. We were all confused as to what we could've done to warrant such reaction. If the host stated that they did not allow outside food in the establishment from the beginning, we wouldn't have done so. Additionally, she could've just entered and stated that outside food was not allowed instead of coming in like we stole the Declaration of Independence. We stated that we didn't know outside food wasn't allowed inside and offered to take the food & kids out so that they can finish eating. We've also tried apologizing since we didn't know the proper rules of the establishment, as it was our first time there. The host then started to get very irate about the whole situation and told us to leave. We tried to pay for our time there since we did spend ~35 minutes there (33 minutes singing and a minute or so with the argument) and had 9 bottles of soju. The host then refused our payment and threatened to call the police while yelling at her other employees in Korean. We left after this statement was made since the host did not want us there.

This place offers many basic services though, if you can get through the apparent racially charged mistreatment. It comes with a dark room, musicc & enough room to do possibly anything. If you're not Korean, you get the back room with no AC and no service. The hosts rarely check on you unless you bring in chicken nuggets. A "No Smoking" sign is on the door but the inside smells like they're filming a cigarette advertisement with actors who can't smoke properly. Their restroom offers one very large stall with 2 urinals. The sinks are very basic. Two newly placed sinks with 3 soap dispensers (no soap inside) and a napkin machine that doesn't work. The service and pricing here varies depending on your race. I would not wish this execrable experience upon my enemies.

googleReviews.author: Nadia Landas
googleReviews.text:
Update: We went to Do Re Mi Karaoke instead which is just across the street next to the Super H Mart.

We came at 7PM, which is the opening time listed on Google Maps. The business hours have been removed from the window. For some reason, the front door was unlocked, but when we opened it the lights were off and it seemed like nobody was there. We called out just in case there were people in the back but nobody responded. It does not appear to be in operation.

googleReviews.author: Sydney
googleReviews.text:
Owner didnt know how to work the TV or any of the apps like how to open youtube or any music streaming platform... we had to move rooms genuinely over 4 times because they couldnt figure out how to operate their own system. Moreover, they are very dodgy about their prices and do not have a set rate listed anywhere.

also youd think a karaoke place would give u free water, but they charge u for it and dont allow outside drinks. Okay, a little money hungry, but fair i guess... but then u realize they also serve actual food, making them a restaurant, and at restaurants, water is legally supposed to be free. What a loophole lol

Still ended up having a fun time with my friends thanks to our eagerness to go karaoking, but it definitely could have been better.

googleReviews.author: Honest Reviewer
googleReviews.text: I went on a Saturday and had so much fun! It's cute for pictures and small inside. Crowd was mostly Asian, the rest Black. They played rap most of the night which I loved! Waitresses are gorgeous and sweet. Manager was very sweet as well and everyone had great vibes and actually danced! No cover. Small drink was $14 with 20% service fee before tip! Don't just come in and leave because its not packed like I saw a lot of people do. Stay and vibe a little while- you'll have a great time! We will be back!

googleReviews.author: Cedra Thomas
googleReviews.text: Came from out of town to visit this place because a friend referred me. Hours of operation that are posted on their building for a Friday night says 3am. Got there at 2:10 with a bright red open sign, just to be rudely greeted by security saying “WERE DONE IN HERE”.

googleReviews.author: Viondi B
googleReviews.text: I really enjoyed RED Lounge.  Me and a group of friends visited here over Labor Day weekend. The ambiance is nice and chill.  After 11pm or so it amps up with a live DJ.  Enjoyed the food and drinks and the hookah was on point.  Customer service was amazing.  The staff was very prompt,  attentive, and made sure everything was to our liking.  Definitely check it out.  The only not so great thing, for me (just my opinion), was the music volume.  Once things really started jumping the music was very loud and after awhile I couldn’t bear it, but everyone was dancing and enjoying. I’ll definitely visit again.

googleReviews.author: N CL (Natcl)
googleReviews.text: Bartenders kept ignoring us, and tried to lie about having our order on the queue. They tried to apologize but it was only deflection of their responsibility. Felt discriminated after being ignored for almost an hour, meanwhile other tables were being served right away

googleReviews.author: Cash M
googleReviews.text: I actually liked this place. The vibe was perfect, the food was good, and the hookah was ok. But the service was lacking. Our server barely checked on our table. Music changed for the worst. And I had to flag down my server to get the bill. We were the only people in the building. Smh. Sad because I thought I found a cool place to chill..

googleReviews.author: Izzy
googleReviews.text: Didnt really get any food but the price for karaoke was good. we got a smaller room since the big rooms were full and we paid around 40 for 2 hours.

googleReviews.author: Emily Kaufmann
googleReviews.text:
I’m not sure where to begin. If I could give 0 stars I would. Let me start with the fact that the employees here are downright rude and unprofessional. We walked in and were never told prices when asked (sketchy). We then were given no assistance to set up the karaoke system, had us waiting 15+ minutes (put towards our overpriced karaoke bill of 30$/hour). BUT THIS IS WHAT REALLY GOT ME- as my friends and I were leaving and paying, we were all a bit taken aback by the price. Mind you, I’ll pay for what I OWE YOU FOR, but then they FORCED ME TO TIP THEM. I initially put the ——— through the tip section and rewrote my $90+ total… we received 0 service and rude behavior, why would I tip?? Then as we are walking out the door the guy LITERALLY STOPS US IN OUR TRACKS and says “you need to either check one of the boxes with the prewritten tip amounts or check the custom amount and put a tip”. So I go back in, write $1 on the tip because I wasn’t about to argue at 11pm at night. As we go to leave again, he has the AUDACITY to say “a $1 tip are you serious? You’re not serious. $1. I make money on your tips.” ARE YOU SERIOUS RIGHT NOW?!!!!!!?!!?!!? He then FORCED ME TO TIP MORE AND CHANGE MY AMOUNT. I’m already nonstop checking my credit card account because I won’t be surprised if they try to upcharge me even more when putting the slips in.

To the 2 guys who did this to me, If you’re reading this, I have already contacted my credit card company as well as authorities 🤗

THIS PLACE IS A SHADY, CREEPY, DISGUSTING establishment. Please do not go here. They will force you to tip them.

googleReviews.author: Thomas D
googleReviews.text:
I called 2 times to make reservations.  They advised to call back 1hr before coming in to make reservations.  When I called back to reserve they advised we would have to walk in.

My party got to the location about 8:45pm and were told that it would be $30 per hour which was ok with us.

After being in the room to get adjusted with how to use the machine because it was mostly setup for Korean we called them in to order food.

The person came to the door and said that on the weekend they only allow groups to rent the room for 1hr because they had a line of people waiting.  We advise had we known we would have went somewhere else.  We were just getting into it.

As we paid there was no one waiting.  Not sure why they made us leave but I would recommend getting all info. Upfront to ensure you get your monies worth.

As other people have stayed it does seem out dates but they did have a good selection of Pop songs.  That's it.  Will not go back.

Will I bring a friend? L TO THE NO

googleReviews.author: Darth Princess
googleReviews.text:
I had a great time at Just Chill Pub & Grill in Lynnwood! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt fun and laid-back — perfect for grabbing drinks with friends or catching a game on one of their many TVs.  ￼

🍔 Burgers That Hit the Spot
Their burgers are definitely a highlight. The jalapeño burger is packed with flavor and cooked just right, and the patty was juicy and satisfying with every bite. I’ve heard from locals that their burgers are some of the best around, and I can see why!  ￼

🍹 Great Drinks & Bartenders
The drink selection is solid, and their bartenders really know what they’re doing. Whether you’re into classic cocktails, cold beers, or something a bit more creative, they pour strong, delicious drinks with great attention to detail. The staff made everyone feel welcome and kept the vibe upbeat throughout our visit.  ￼

🎉 Fun Ambience & Good Vibes
The pub has a friendly, neighborhood feel, with plenty of screens to watch sports and games like pool or darts if you’re in the mood for more than just eating and drinking. It struck the perfect balance of lively without being overwhelming.  ￼

Overall, I’d highly recommend Just Chill Pub & Grill for anyone looking for tasty burgers, strong drinks, and a fun, casual spot to hang out!

about: Goshen (고센) is a karaoke bar in Glenview, Illinois. It holds a 4.2-star rating from 421 Google reviews. This sleek, dark nightspot offers Korean snacks & beer, plus pool tables & private karaoke rooms. Find current hours, directions, and more on KaraokeNearMe.org.

googleReviews.author: Joah Kim
googleReviews.text: Where do I even start? I LOVE Korean food and Korean pubs serve some of the best. Why? Because Koreans love to drink and the food has to be good to keep the drink flowing. Goshen (formerly Jurang) is one of the longest-standing Korean pubs in the Glenview area. It's an OG spot. IYKYK. The management changed in August and it changed for the better. Jurang was the most popping pub pre-Covid, but like many restaurants, it never bounced back up after Covid. Goshen kept all the crowd favorites from the Jurang days and added some new bangers to the menu. The new owner is seriously the sweetest and most thoughtful person and the very few staff on the weekend ROCKS! If you get a chance to talk to them, you can tell they're all passionate about creating a place where people can vibe, enjoy good food, and be in the moment. The space is HUGE. When you walk in, there are private booths with curtains if you're feeling a chill, more private vibe. If you keep walking, it opens up into a completely different vibe. It's spacious, open, and LIT. There's even a cute backdrop for a little photoshoot with your friends. They also offer a live DJ on weekends. So many fun events every month. The owner keeps making upgrades and changes for the better which I love to see. I REALLY want this place to thrive and stay open for a LONG time. It's such a great spot whether you're coming for a quiet dinner or to have a party with your squad. They also have private karaoke rooms in different sizes. Small room: $30/hr (fits up to 4 people). Medium room: $40/hr (fits up to 8, and is way more spacious than the small one. It's worth the extra $10). Large room: $60/hr (fits up to 20 people). Party Room: $150/hr (fits up to 50 people and comes with four mics. No mic-fighting here). The large and party rooms can also be connected through Bluetooth so you can easily hook up your phone. Now for food, I love Chef Auntie and the Sous Chef's cooking. Some of my recent obsessions are hot stone squid bibimbap (mix it well and let it crisp at the bottom. Add mayo if you're not good with spice. Sounds weird, but TRUST), hot stone kimchi fried rice, braised beef tendon (melts in your mouth and it's huge), bossam (pairs perfectly with their homemade radish kimchi), spicy seafood noodle soup (a classic from the Jurang days. Spicy, flavorful, and with chewy noodles), squid stir-fry (tender, flavorful, bomb. Octopus version slaps too but I'm team squid), gopchang hot pot (best one I've had. They don't skimp on the gopchang. It's thicc, plump, and absolute bonkers). I could go on but my fingers are starting to hurt. A quick list of more faves: squid platter, brisket salad, kimchi pancake, mung bean & brisket, ALL their fried chicken (personal fave: corn), stir-fried kimchi & pork belly, hotteok (Korean sweet pancakes), pineapple sherbet. Oh, and the service is fantastic. Run, don't walk.

googleReviews.author: lexie cicale
googleReviews.text:
If you want to sing karaoke on a Saturday night go to the double instead, Henry the owner is very kind and the DJ who runs karaoke there on Saturdays is very fun and sweet and chill.

This is not the case at sidekicks. I have come on a weeknight when bones was DJIng and had a pretty good time, but the rest of the staff is always hostile.

Do not expect to sing on a weekend. I waited FOUR HOURS for my song to come up. It seemed like lots of people sang before me who showed up and signed up after me. The white male DJ’s here are very agressive. I wish I got the name of the one who was working tonight, but he isn’t the only one we’ve had issues with. They are racist, they are power tripping. They are constantly coming out of their booth taking microphones away from people singing, trying to control how they sing, I’ve seen them cut off people’s mics (I could maybe understand a situation where this could be warranted but this was not the case here). Several people in my party have had issues with these DJ’s trying to stop them from singing. It’s not that serious. We are all here to sing Karaoke. We’ve waited our turn, your job is to play the songs in the queue, and keep the vibe up!!! The dj really brings everyone down and is ruining the energy in the space. I don’t often leave reviews like this but I like this bar I think the decorations are cool, my friends love the food, and it’s awesome that it’s open late, but this is the 5th time I’ve had problems with these DJ’s, I won’t be coming back anymore.

The bar staff is also very rude. The bouncers are hostile. There are cameras everywhere filming you. The overall vibe is very militant. Not really what you’re looking for in a fun karaoke night, or celebrating a birthday.

Additionally, the bar feels pretty unsafe. Very dark parking lot. It feels like the type of place where your drink would get spiked and no one working would care to help you or do anything about it.

I keep giving this bar chances because i love to sing with my friends and we like the layout, but there are so many other better places to go.

googleReviews.author: Michael Romasanta
googleReviews.text:
I love coming here after band practice! Fort Knox Studios is right down the street! I love the food at Sidekicks and the good atmosphere. The place is very clean and the staff is very nice. They do have a parking lot which is great. The place seems to be pretty lenient, laid back and the prices are good. You could watch the game or do karaoke with your friends!

What would I change? Sometimes the karaoke could be a tad bit too noisy so I would just work on the volume mixing.

Nothing bad, but there are giant television screens that are wired to the lyrics in the main room. I would keep the lyrics running only on the smaller tvs near the stage, and keeping the bar channels on the big ones near the kitchen.

All in all I love Sidekicks! The bar is a yin-yang balance between super chill and electric fun.

googleReviews.author: Ami Schhh
googleReviews.text:
Went here for karaoke and the heavy set white security guard with brown hair was extremely rude to me and questioned if I had any water bottles from outside or outside liquor. I told him no and he kept aggressively questioning me. I only had a small purse with me and it was not even zippered and was wide open as I had just pulled my wallet out to show my ID. This happened both times I have gone and this security guard has been working. The first time I was told aggressively that there was a 2 drink minimum within 5 minutes of being inside because I put in a song request before purchasing a drink.

Tonight after telling him I had no outside drink he futher aggressively questioned me to the point it felt like an attack. The black man i was with stepped in and said there's ways to say things less aggressively and the security guard kicked us out. I felt profiled and this looks extremely racist and discriminatory. I doubt any of the other patrons in the bar were questioned so aggressively. I have money, thanks, and i will spend it at places with a more welcoming and inclusive atmosphere even if the drinks cost more. I've never been treated like that at Alice's.

You lost out on a decent amount of money and our incredible vibes. We were going to get food and beverages. For an establishment that i have been to several times where there is only 2 other people inside for hours (clearly hurting for money with the security guard doing the most) you'd think you'd want people to feel welcome so they'd come back and spread the word. Yall deserve whatever financial hardship you're experiencing.  Based on other reviews it looks like you're trying to transition into a "whites only" establishment.

Do better.

I came here with a group of friends to celebrate my engagement; did not expect to be treated so poorly by one of the bartenders. My friend (who is Black) was purposely skipped over multiple times by the same bartender. There was a group of us who witnessed it and even some people who weren’t with our party. She waited a half an hour to be served by this man. He served the people to her right and the people to her left MULTIPLE times and they came to the bar after her. googleReviews.author: Caleb Foster
googleReviews.text: We stopped by for an early lunch and honestly had such a great experience 😊 The food was absolutely delicious, everything tasted fresh and well-prepared, and the staff made us feel really welcome with their friendly attitude 🙌 The prices were very reasonable too, which made it even better. They also have a cool happy hour, though it’s just for drinks 🍹 But $5 Don Julio shots?! That definitely caught my attention 😄 I’d happily come back again!

insiderDetails.micVolume: Bar-level mix — vocals sit on top of the room's music and crowd noise; comfortable for casual singers more than full-volume soloists.
insiderDetails.spaceSize: Standard bar footprint — a defined stage or karaoke corner with bar and table seating around it.
insiderDetails.ambiance: Vibe leans polished and upscale. Expect dim lighting, an enthusiastic singing crowd, and a come-as-you-are dress code.
insiderDetails.crowdAge: Broad mix of ages — mostly mid-20s through 40s, with a friendly, social regulars-and-newcomers blend.
insiderDetails.busyHours: Quiet early, packed late — peaks Thursday through Saturday from about 10 PM until close (open past 2 AM). Arrive before 9 PM for a table or a shorter wait on the list.

groupSinging.note: Open-mic format — add your name to the host's list and sing for the whole room. Great crowd energy and sing-alongs.

privateRooms.note: Open-floor venue — singing happens on a shared stage, not in private rooms.

korean.note: Western-style karaoke; song list is mostly English-language pop, rock, and country.

googleReviews.author: Behemoth
googleReviews.text: Nice friendly atmosphere,  local bar hidden in side streets , away from traffic.  I think most of patrons are local people and family connected.  Music is good and not too loud like some other bars. My friend took me there and for sure I'll stop by again!
